#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,k;
	cin>>n>>k;
	vl v(n);
	ll sum=0;
	forin(v,n);
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		sum+=v[i];
		if(sum<k)
		{
			cout<<i+1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
		else
			sum-=k;
	}
	if(sum>0)
	{
		cout<<(n+(sum/k)+1)<<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);

	// solve();
	cc

		solve();

ll sum(ll num)
{
    ll ans=0;
    while(num)
    {
        ans+=num%10;
        num/=10;
    }
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(n%3)
    {
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=n-97;i<=n;i++)
    {
        ll sum1=sum(i);
        ll sum2=sum(sum1);
        if((sum1+sum2+i)==n)
        {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

Title: CHEFGR
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include<stdio.h>
int main(){
    int t;
    scanf("%d",&t);
    while(t--){
        int n,m;
        scanf("%d%d",&n,&m);
        int a[n],i,max=-1,sum=0,j;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++){
            scanf("%d",&a[i]);
            if(max<=a[i]){
                max = a[i];
            }
        }
        for(j=0;j<n;j++){
            sum += (max - a[j]);
        }
        if(sum == m){
            printf("Yes\n");
        }
        else if(sum>m){
            printf("No\n");
        }
        else{
            int rem = m - sum;
            if(rem%n == 0){
                printf("Yes\n");
            }
            else{
                printf("No\n");
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
vector<vector<ll>> ncr(52,vector<ll>(52,0));
void cal(){
    ncr[0][0]=1;
    for(ll i=1;i<=50;i++){
        ncr[i][0]=1;
        for(ll j=1;j<=50;j++){
            ncr[i][j]=(ncr[i-1][j]+ncr[i-1][j-1]);
        }
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srt(v);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        m[v[i]]++;
    }
    map<ll,ll> m2;
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++){
        m2[v[i]]++;
    }
    ll ans=1;
    for(auto x:m2){
        ll total=m[x.ff];
        ll need=x.ss;
        ans*=ncr[total][need];
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;

		ll flag=0;
		ll sum=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			if(v[i]>k)
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
			else
			{
				if(sum+v[i]>k)
				{
					sum=0;
					count++;
				}
				sum+=v[i];
			}
		}
		if(sum>0)
			count++;
		if(flag==1)
			cout<<-1<<endl;
		else
			cout<<count<<endl;

}

bool compare(pair<ll,ll>&a,pair<ll,ll>&b)
{
    if(a.ff>b.ff)
        return true;
    else if(a.ff==b.ff)
    {
        if(a.ss<=b.ss)
            return true;
        else
            return false;
    }

        return false;

       a[i]={temp,i};

    sort(all(a),compare);
    vl ans(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ans[a[i].ss]=1+i;
    }
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;

typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 10000009
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair

#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"

#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll prime(ll num)
{
	for(ll i=2;i<=ll(sqrt(num));i++)
	{
		if(num%i==0)
			return 0;
	}
	return 1;
}
ll solve()
{
	vl ans;
	for(ll i=2;i<=200;i++)
	{
		if(prime(i)==1)
			ans.pb(i);
	}
	cc
	{
		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		ll flag=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<ans.size()-1;i++)
		{
			for(ll j=i+1;j<ans.size();j++)
			{
				ll temp=ans[i]*ans[j];
				ll rest=n-temp;
				for(ll k=0;k<ans.size()-1;k++)
				{
					for(ll l=k+1;l<ans.size();l++)
					{
						if((ans[k]*ans[l])==rest)
						{
							flag=1;
							break;
						}
					}
					if(flag==1)
						break;
				}
				if(flag==1)
					break;
			}
			if(flag==1)
				break;
		}
		if(flag==1)
			yes
		else
			no
	}
	return 0;
}

{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
}

// Some print

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}

{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v.pb({a,b});
    }
    srt(v);
    vl q(m),ans(m);
    forin(q,m);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll x=q[i];
        ans[i]=-1;
        ll low=0,high=n-1;
        ll temp=-1;
        while(low<=high)
        {
            ll mid=(low+high)/2;
            if(x>=v[mid].ff&&x<v[mid].ss)
            {
                ans[i]=0;
                break;
            }
            else if(x<v[mid].ff)
            {
                temp=v[mid].ff;
                high=mid-1;
            }
            else
            {
                low=mid+1;
            }
        }
        if(ans[i]!=0)
        {
            if(temp==-1)
                ans[i]=-1;
            else
                ans[i]=temp-x;
        }
    }
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;

#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair

#define Endl "\n"

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    cc
    {
        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        vl a(n,0);
        forin(a,n);
        ll m;
        cin>>m;
        vl b(m,0);
        forin(b,m);
        ll flag=0;
        vector<bool> check(n,false);
        ll pos=0;
        loop(i,0,m)
        {
            loop(j,pos,n)
            {
                if(b[i]==a[j]&&check[j]==false)
                {
                    pos=j;
                    check[j]=true;
                    flag++;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==m)
            cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
        else
            cout<<"No"<<endl;
    }
}

typedef vector<char> vc;

#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 10000009
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n1,n2,k;
	cin>>n1>>n2>>k;
	ll a,b;
	a=n1,b=n2;
	k=(k*(k+1))/2;
	n1=max((n1-k),0LL);
	n2=max((n2-k),0LL);
	if(n1==0||n2==0)
	{
		cout<<abs(a-b)<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	cout<<(n1+n2)<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,k;
	cin>>n>>k;
	ll maxo=0;
	vl v(n),v2(n);
	forin(v,n);
	forin(v2,n);
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		ll temp=k/v[i];
		temp=temp*v2[i];
		maxo=max(maxo,temp);
	}
	cout<<maxo<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))

#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	ll prefix=0,sufix=0,pos=0,pre=LONG_MAX;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		sufix+=v[i];
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		prefix+=v[i];
		if(i>=1)
			sufix-=v[i-1];
		ll total=prefix+sufix;
		if(pre>total)
		{
			pre=total;
			pos=i;
		}
		// cout<<"prefix and sufix is "<<prefix<<" "<<sufix<<Endl;
	}
	cout<<pos+1<<endl;
	return 0;
}

#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
	cc
    {
        ll n,temp;
        cin>>n;
        vl f(n+1,0),g(n+1,0);
        loop(i,1,n+1)
        {
            cin>>f[i];
        }
        loop(i,1,n+1)
        {
            cin>>g[i];
        }
        ll front=0,back=0;
        for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        {
            if(f[i]<=g[i])
            {
                front++;
            }
            if(f[i]<=g[n-i+1])
            {
                back++;
            }
        }
        if(front==back&&back==n)
            cout<<"both"<<endl;
        else if(front!=back)
        {
            if(front==n)
                cout<<"front"<<endl;
            else if(back==n)
                cout<<"back"<<endl;
            else
                cout<<"none"<<endl;
        }
        else
            cout<<"none"<<endl;
    }
}

        cout<<mini<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll maxo=0,temp_sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        temp_sum+=v[i];
        if(temp_sum<=0)
            temp_sum=0;
        maxo=max(maxo,temp_sum);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

T mymax(T x,T y)

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k1;
    cin>>n>>k1;
    vvl dp(n+1,vl(k1+1,-INF));
    vvl temp_max(n+1,vl(k1+1,-INF));
    vl v(n+1);
    ll maxo=-INF;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>v[i];
    for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++){
        dp[i][0]=temp_max[i][0]=0;
    }
    dp[1][1]=temp_max[1][1]=v[1];
    for(ll i=2;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll k=1;k<=k1;k++){
            if(k>i)
                dp[i][k]=-INF;
            else{
                dp[i][k]=max({(dp[i-1][k]+(k*v[i])),(temp_max[i-1][k-1]+(v[i]*k))});
            }
            temp_max[i][k]=max(dp[i][k],temp_max[i-1][k]);
        }
    }
    maxo=dp[1][k1];
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        maxo=max(maxo,dp[i][k1]);
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vector<ll> v(n);
            ll sum=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                sum+=v[i];
            }
            sum*=2;
            if(sum%n){
                cout<<0<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            else{
                ll temp=sum/n;
                map<ll,ll> m;
                ll no_of_way=0;
                for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                    no_of_way+=m[temp-v[i]];
                    m[v[i]]++;
                }
                cout<<no_of_way<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

        Codeforces cf;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll x=0,sum=0,required=0;
	sum=(n*(n+1))/2;
	if(sum%2!=0)
		cout<<0<<endl;
	else
	{
		required=sum/2;
		ll pos=0,temp_sum=0;
		pos=(sqrt(required*2)+1);
		while((pos*(pos+1))/2>required)
			pos--;
		ll count=0;
		count+=(n-pos);
		// cout<<"count is "<<count<<Endl;
		if(((pos*(pos+1))/2)==required)
		{
			ll temp1=(pos*(pos-1))/2;
			ll temp2=((n-pos)*((n-pos)-1))/2;
			// cout<<"temp1 is "<<temp1<<" "<<temp2<<endl;
			count+=temp2;
			count+=temp1;
		}
		cout<<count<<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;

		solve();

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	cc
	{
		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		vl a(n,0),b(n,0);
		map<ll,ll>mp,mp1,mp2;
		ll mini=INT_MAX;
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			cin>>a[i];
			mini=min(mini,a[i]);
			mp[a[i]]++;
		}
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			cin>>b[i];
			mini=min(b[i],mini);
			mp[b[i]]++;
		}
		ll flag=0;
		for(auto v:mp)
		{
			if(v.second%2==1)
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
			else
			{
				mp1[v.first]=v.second/2;
			}
		}
		if(flag)
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			continue;
		}
		else
		{
			mp2=mp1;
			vector<ll>v1,v2;
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				if(mp1[a[i]]>0)
				{
					mp1[a[i]]--;
				}
				else
				{
					v1.push_back(a[i]);
				}
			}
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				if(mp2[b[i]])
					mp2[b[i]]--;
				else
				{
					v2.push_back(b[i]);
				}
			}
			sort(v1.begin(),v1.end());
			sort(v2.begin(),v2.end(),greater<ll>());
			ll y=v1.size();
			if(y==0)
				cout<<0<<endl;
			else
			{
				ll ans=0;
				for(ll i=0;i<y;i++)
				{
					ans+=min(2*mini,min(v1[i],v2[i]));
				}
				cout<<ans<<endl;
			}
		}
	}
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    ll l1=-1,l2=-1;
    if(n%2==0){
        l1=v[n/2]-(k+1)/2+1;
        l2=v[n/2+1]-(k+1)/2+k%2;
    }
    else{
        l1=v[(n+1)/2]-(k+1)/2+1;
        l2=v[(n+1)/2]-(k+1)/2+k%2;
    }
    ll ans1=0,ans2=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        ans1+= max(abs(v[i]-l1),abs(v[i]-(l1+k-1)));
        ans2+= max(abs(v[i]-l2),abs(v[i]-(l2+k-1)));
    }
    cout<<ll(min(ans1,ans2))<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
	string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=s.length();
    ll c=0,h=0,e=0,ans=0;
    loop(i,0,s.length())
    {
        if(s[i]=='C')
        {
            c=max(c,i+1);
            while(c<n&&s[c]!='H')
                c++;
            if(c==s.length())
                break;
            h=max(h,c+1);
            if(h==s.length())
                break;
            while(h<n&&s[h]!='E')
                h++;
            e=max(e,h+1);
            if(e==s.length())
                break;
            while(e<n&&s[e]!='F')
                e++;
            if(e==s.length())
                break;
            e++,c++,h++;
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll hcf=0;
    vl v(m);
    forin(v,m);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        hcf=__gcd(hcf,v[i]);
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i*i<=hcf;i++){
        if(hcf%i==0){
            ll temp1=i,temp2=hcf/i;
            if(n>=temp1)
                ans=max(ans,temp1);
            if(n>=temp2)
                ans=max(ans,temp2);
        }
    }
    cout<<n-ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0){
        if(y%2==1){
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}

    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num){
    return to_string(num);
}

    A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
    //Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
    //priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve(){
    vector<char> v={'a','e','i','o','u'};
    ll n;
    string s;
    cin>>n>>s;
    ll ans=1;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x=='a'||x=='e'||x=='i'||x=='o'||x=='u'){
            continue;
        }
        else{
            ll mini=INF,count=0;
            for(auto y:v){
                ll dist=abs(x-y);
                mini=min(mini,dist);
            }
            for(auto y:v){
                ll dist=abs(x-y);
                if(dist==mini){
                    count++;
                }
            }
            ans=(ans*count)%mod1;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main(){
    speed;
    /*
        #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll one_pos = 0;
    for(ll i = 1;i <= n;i++)
    {
        cin>>a[i];
        if(a[i] == 1)
        {
            one_pos = i;
        }
    }
    ans_array[0] = 0LL; 
    if(one_pos == 0 || one_pos == n)
    {
        for(ll i = 1;i <= n;i++)
        {
            ans_array[i] = ans_array[i - 1];
            if(i == n)
            {
                ans_array[i] += (a[i] & 1) ? a[i] : (a[i] - 1);
            }
            else
            {
                ans_array[i] += (a[i] & 1) ? (a[i] - 1) : a[i];
            }
        }
    }
    else if(one_pos == 1)
    {
        ans_array[1] = 1;
        for(ll i = 2;i <= n;i++)
        {
            ans_array[i] = ans_array[i - 1];
        }
    }
    else
    {
        for(ll i = 1;i <= n;i++)
        {
            ans_array[i] = ans_array[i - 1];
            if(i == n)
            {
                ans_array[i] += (a[i] & 1) ? a[i] : (a[i] - 1);
            }
            else
            {
                if(a[i] != 1)
                {
                    if(i + 1 == one_pos)
                    {
                        ans_array[i] += (a[i] & 1) ? a[i] : (a[i] - 1);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ans_array[i] += (a[i] & 1) ? (a[i] - 1) : a[i];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ll q;
    cin>>q;
    // scanf("%lld", &q);
    while(q--)
    {
        ll r;
        cin>>r;
        // scanf("%lld", &r);
        r %= MOD;
        ans = ((r / n) * (ans_array[n] % MOD)) % MOD;
        if(r % n)
        {
            if(one_pos == 0)
            {
                if(a[r % n] & 1)
                {
                    ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n] + 1) % MOD;
                }
                else
                {
                    ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            else if(one_pos == 1)
            {
                if(r == 1)
                {
                    ans = 1;
                }
                if((r % n) > 1)
                {
                    ans = (ans + 1) % MOD;
                }
            }
            else if(one_pos == n)
            {
                if(a[r % n] & 1)
                {
                    ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n] + 1) % MOD;
                }
                else
                {
                    ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                if((r % n) == one_pos)
                {
                    if(a[(r % n) - 1] % 2 == 0)
                    {
                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n] + 2) % MOD;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                else if((r % n) + 1 == one_pos)
                {
                    if(a[r % n] % 2 == 0)
                    {
                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n] + 1) % MOD;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                else
                {

                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n] + 1) % MOD;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ans = (ans + ans_array[r % n]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if(one_pos!=1)
            {
                if(a[n] % 2 == 0)
                {
                    ans = (ans + 1) % MOD;
                }

        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    ll temp=0,increment=1;
    while(1)
    {
        if(temp>=n)
            break;
        else
        {
            ans++;
            temp+=increment;
            increment++;
        }
    }
    if(temp==n)
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll temp1=temp-n;
        ll temp2=n-temp+increment-1;
        if(temp1>=temp2)
            ans--;
        ans+=min(temp1,temp2);
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
long long solve()
{
    ll n,e,h,a,b,c;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld%lld%lld%lld",&n,&e,&h,&a,&b,&c);
    // cin>>n>>e>>h>>a>>b>>c;
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    // let fix cake
    // a->omlette, b-> shake, c->cake
    for(ll x=0;x<=min({e,h});x++){
        // cout<<"x is "<<x<<endl;
        ll ans=0;
        ll temp_e=e-x;
        ll temp_h=h-x;
        ll omelette=temp_e/2;
        ll shake=temp_h/3;
        if(x<n){
            if(a>b){
                ll temp_shake=min({shake,n-x});
                ll temp_n=x+temp_shake;
                ans=x*c+temp_shake*b;
                if(temp_n<=n){
                    ll req=n-temp_n;
                    if(omelette>=req){
                        ans+=req*a;
                        mini=min(mini,ans);
                        // cout<<"ans at x "<<x<<" "<<ans<<endl;
                    }
                }
            }
            else{
                ll temp_omelette=min({n-x,omelette});
                ll temp_n=x+temp_omelette;
                ans=x*c+temp_omelette*a;
                if(temp_n<=n){
                    ll req=n-temp_n;
                    if(shake>=req){
                        ans+=req*b;
                        mini=min(mini,ans);
                        // cout<<"ans at x "<<x<<" "<<ans<<endl;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            mini=min(mini,(n*c));
        }
    }
    if(mini==LONG_MAX)
        mini=-1;
    // cout<<mini<<endl;
    printf("%lld\n",mini);
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    // cin>>test;
    scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    ll n;

<problem>
Title: CONSADD
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
#define yes cout<<"Yes"<<endl; 
#define no cout<<"No"<<endl;
ll a[1001][1001],b[1001][1001],temp[1001][1001];
ll check(ll r,ll c){
    for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
            if(a[i][j]!=b[i][j])
                return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}
long long solve()
{
    ll r,c,x;
    cin>>r>>c>>x;
    // ll a[r+1][c+1],b[r+1][c+1],temp[r+1][c+1];
    ll sum_a=0,sum_b=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
    	for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
    		cin>>a[i][j];
    	}
    }
   	for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
    	for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
    		cin>>b[i][j];
    	}
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
    	for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
            temp[i][j]=a[i][j]-b[i][j];
    		sum_b+=b[i][j];
            sum_a+=a[i][j];
    	}
    }
    if(x==2){
        ll temp_sum=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
                ll factor=1;
                if((r+c-i-j)%2==0)
                    factor=-1;
                if(!(i==r&&j==c))
                    temp_sum+=factor*temp[i][j];
            }
        }
        if(temp[r][c]==temp_sum)
            yes
        else
            no
    }
    else{
        if(r<x&&c<x){
            if(check(r,c))
                yes
            else
                no
        }
        else if(r<x){
            for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<=c-x;j++){
                    if(a[i][j]!=b[i][j]){
                        ll diff=b[i][j]-a[i][j];
                        a[i][j]+=diff;
                        ll k=1;
                        while(k<x){
                            a[i][j+k]+=diff;
                            k++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if(check(r,c))
                yes
            else
                no
        }
        else if(c<x){
            for(ll i=0;i<c;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<=r-x;j++){
                    if(a[j][i]!=b[j][i]){
                        ll diff=b[j][i]-a[j][i];
                        a[j][i]+=diff;
                        ll k=1;
                        while(k<x){
                            a[j+k][i]+=diff;
                            k++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if(check(r,c))
                yes
            else
                no
        }
        else if(c>=x&&r>=x){
            for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<=c-x;j++){
                    if(a[i][j]!=b[i][j]){
                        ll diff=b[i][j]-a[i][j];
                        a[i][j]+=diff;
                        ll k=1;
                        while(k<x){
                            a[i][j+k]+=diff;
                            k++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for(ll i=0;i<c;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<(r-x+1);j++){
                    if(a[j][i]!=b[j][i]){
                        ll diff=b[j][i]-a[j][i];
                        a[j][i]+=diff;
                        ll k=1;
                        while(k<x){
                            a[j+k][i]+=diff;
                            k++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if(check(r,c))
                yes
            else
                no
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    // scanf("%lld",&test);
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    map<char,ll> m1,m2;
    for(auto x:s1)
    {
        m1[x]++;
    }
    for(auto x:s2)
        m2[x]++;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s2[i]>s1[i])
        {
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> ans;
    for(ll i=25;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(m2[char('a'+i)]>0&&m1[char('a'+i)]==0)
        {
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        if(m2[char('a'+i)]==0)
            continue;
        else
        {
            vl temp;
            ll flag=0;
            for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
            {
                if(s2[j]==char('a'+i)||s1[j]==char('a'+i))
                    temp.pb(j);
                if(s2[j]==char('a'+i)&&s1[j]!=s2[j])
                    flag=1;
            }
            if(flag)
                ans.pb(temp);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans.size()<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<ans.size();i++)
    {
        cout<<sz(ans[i])<<" ";
        for(auto x:ans[i])
            cout<<x<<" ";
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

ll sum_of_digits(ll num)
{
	ll sum=0;
	while(num!=0)
	{
		sum+=num%10;
		num/=10;
	}
	return sum;
}

	vector<bool> v(n+1,false);
	while(1)
	{
		if(v[x]==false)
		{
			v[x]=true;
			x=(x+k)%n;
			if(v[y]==true)
			{
				yes
				return 0;
			}
		}
		else if(v[x]==true)
		{
			no
			return 0;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,m;
	cin>>n>>m;
	string s1,s2;
	unordered_map<string,string> name;
	unordered_map<string,ll> m1;
	unordered_map<string,ll> m2;
	vector<string> ans1,ans2;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>s1>>s2;
		name[s1]=s2;
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
	{
		cin>>s1;
		m1[s1]++;
		m2[name[s1]]++;
	}
	ll maxo1=0,maxo2=0;
	for(auto x:m1)
	{
		maxo1=max(maxo1,x.ss);
	}
	for(auto x:m1)
	{
		if(x.ss==maxo1)
		{
			ans1.pb(x.ff);
		}
	}
	srt(ans1);
	for(auto x:m2)
	{
		maxo2=max(maxo2,x.ss);
	}
	for(auto x:m2)
	{
		if(x.ss==maxo2)
			ans2.pb(x.ff);
	}
	srt(ans2);
	cout<<ans2[0]<<endl;
	cout<<ans1[0]<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
	// cc
	// {
	// 	solve();
	// }
}

    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n,k;
            cin>>n>>k;
            n=n%4;
            if(n==0){
                n=4;
            }
            if(n<=3){
                if(k==1){
                    cout<<"Ambiguous"<<endl;
                }
                else{
                    cout<<"On"<<endl;
                }
            }
            else{
                if(k==1){
                    cout<<"On"<<endl;
                }
                else{
                    cout<<"Off"<<endl;
                }
            }
            return 0;

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
char number(string s)
{
	if(s=="0000")
		return 'a';
	else if(s=="0001")
		return 'b';
	else if(s=="0010")
		return 'c';
	else if(s=="0011")
		return 'd';
	else if(s=="0100")
		return 'e';
	else if(s=="0101")
		return 'f';
	else if(s=="0110")
		return 'g';
	else if(s=="0111")
		return 'h';
	else if(s=="1000")
		return 'i';
	else if(s=="1001")
		return 'j';
	else if(s=="1010")
		return 'k';
	else if(s=="1011")
		return 'l';
	else if(s=="1100")
		return 'm';
	else if(s=="1101")
		return 'n';
	else if(s=="1110")
		return 'o';
	else
		return 'p';
}
long long solve()
{
    long long n;
    cin>>n;
    if(n==0)
    	return 0;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    for(long long i=0;i<n;i+=4)
    {
    	string ans="";
    	ans=s[i];
    	ans+=s[i+1];
    	ans+=s[i+2];
    	ans+=s[i+3];
    	// cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
    	cout<<number(ans);
    }
    cout<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //     freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)

        ll n,k;

        ll count=0,temp=0;
        loop0(n)
        {
            cin>>temp;
            ll temp1=temp%k;
            ll temp2=k-temp1;
            if(abs(temp-min(temp2,temp1))>0)
                count+=min(temp2,temp1);
            else
                count+=max(temp1,temp2);
        }
        cout<<count<<endl;
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll sum=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll temp;
                cin>>temp;
                sum+=temp;
            }
            ll ans=0;
            for(ll i=1;sum>=(i*(i+1))/2;i++){
                ll temp2=(i*(i+1))/2;
                if(temp2<=sum){
                    ans=i;
                }
                else{
                    break;
                }
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            sum += num[i]-48;
            inc += 9 - (num[i]-48);
        }
        if (sum % 9 == 0)
            cout << "0\n";
        else if
            (sum < 9 && n > 1) cout << 9-sum << "\n";
        else

    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);

    srt(v);

    for(ll i=2;i<n;i++){

            diff=temp_diff;

        return 2;

                }
            }

ll solve()

    vl v(n);
    ll odd=0,even=0;

#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
unsigned long long power(unsigned long long x,unsigned long long y)
{
    unsigned long long res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll k;
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    unsigned long long a=0,b=0;
    string s="";
    for(ll i=n;i>=1;i--)
    {
        if(a<=b)
        {
            s+='1';
            a+=power(i,k);
            // cout<<"a is "<<a<<endl;
        }
        else
        {
            b+=power(i,k);
            // cout<<"b is "<<b<<endl;
            s+='0';
        }
    }
    reverse(all(s));
    if(a>=b)
        cout<<a-b<<endl;
    else
        cout<<b-a<<endl;
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    cin>>k;
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

int solve()
{
	ll n,a,b,c;
    cin>>n>>a>>b>>c;
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<=min(a,n);i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<=min(b,n);j++)
        {
            if((i+j)<=n)
            {
                count+=min(c,(n-i-j))+1;
            }
            // count+=temp;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
	return 0;
}

    	solve();
    }
}

ll solve()

    if(a==b)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll diff=abs(a-b);
    set<ll> s;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(diff);i++)
    {
        if(diff%i==0)
        {
            s.insert(i);
            s.insert(diff/i);

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long solve()
{
    long long n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    long long sum1=0,sum2=0,count=0;
    vector<long long> a(n),b(m);
    for(long long i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
    	cin>>a[i];
    	sum1+=a[i];
    }
    for(long long i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
    	cin>>b[i];
    	sum2+=b[i];
    }
    sort(a.begin(),a.end());
    sort(b.begin(),b.end(),greater<long long>());
    long a_pos=0,b_pos=0;
    while(1)
    {
    	if(sum1>sum2)
    	{
    		cout<<count<<endl;
    		return 0;
    	}
    	if(a_pos>=n||b_pos>=m)
    		break;
    	sum1-=a[a_pos];
    	sum2-=b[b_pos];
    	sum1+=b[b_pos];
    	sum2+=a[a_pos];
    	a_pos++;
    	b_pos++;
    	count++;
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //     freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

{
    for(int i=0;i<500;i++)res[i]=0;
    resS=1;
    c=0;
}
void calculate(int n)
{
    res[0]=1;
    for(int i=2;i<=n;i++)
    {
        for(int j=0;j<resS;j++)
        {
            res[j]=res[j]*i+c;
            c=res[j]/10;
            res[j]%=10;
        }
        while(c)
        {
            res[resS]=c%10;
            c/=10;
            resS++;
        }
    }
}

  cin>>t;
  while(t--)
  {
    int n;
    cin>>n;
    calculate(n);
    for(int i=resS-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        cout<<res[i];
    }
    cout<<"\n";
    reset();
  }
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll count=0;
    ll iron=0,magnet=0;
    vl dot(n,0);
    ll dot_count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]==':')
            dot_count++;
        dot[i]=dot_count;
    }
    while(iron<n&&magnet<n)
    {
        while(1)
        {
            // cout<<"first "<<endl;
            if(s[iron]=='I'||s[iron]=='X'||iron>=n)
                break;
            iron++;
        }
        while(1)
        {
            // cout<<"second "<<endl;
            if(s[magnet]=='M'||s[magnet]=='X'||magnet>=n)
                break;
            magnet++;
        }
        if(iron>=n||magnet>=n)
            break;
        if(s[iron]=='X'||s[magnet]=='X')
        {
            ll temp=max(iron,magnet);
            iron=temp+1;
            magnet=temp+1;
        }
        else
        {
            // cout<<"iron and magnet is "<<iron<<" "<<magnet<<" and sheet1 is "<<sheet1<<" and sheet 2 is "<<sheet2<<endl;
            ll power_m=k+1-abs(iron-magnet);
            // cout<<"power_m is "<<power_m<<endl;
            // cout<<dot[max(iron,magnet)]<<" difff is "<<dot[min(iron,magnet)]<<endl;
            power_m-=(dot[max(iron,magnet)]-dot[min(iron,magnet)]);
            // cout<<"power_m is "<<power_m<<endl;
            if(power_m>0)
            {
                iron++;
                magnet++;
                count++;
            }
            else
            {
                if(iron>magnet)
                {
                    // sheet2=0;
                    magnet++;
                }
                else
                {
                    // sheet1=0;
                    iron++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    // {
    //     cout<<"i is "<<i<<" and number of sheet is "<<dot[i]<<endl;
    // }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve(vector<ll> fibo)
{

                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;

            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }

            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }

            return to_string(num);
        }

        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll a,b;
            cin>>a>>b;
            ll ans=0;
            ans+=a;
            if(b<=a){
                ans+=abs(b-a);
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }

    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

{

    cin>>a>>b;
    vl ans;
    ll count=0;
    vector<bool> check(a.size(),false);
    for(ll i=0;i<ll(a.size());i++)
    {
        if(a[i]!=b[i])
        {
            check[i]=true;
            if((i-2)>=0)
            {
                if(check[i-2]!=true)
                    count++;
            }
            else
                count++;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        const ll mod1=1e9+7;

        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }

                }
                y>>=1;

            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;

        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            string s;
            cin>>n>>s;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
            for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
                ll temp=(s[i]-'0');
                if(sz(ans)&1){
                    temp=temp^1;
                }
                if(temp==0){
                    ans.pb({1,i+1});
                }
            }
            cout<<sz(ans)<<endl;
            for(auto x:ans){
                cout<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

        ll x;

        {
            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,w,l;
    cin>>n>>w>>l;
    vl h(n),r(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>h[i]>>r[i];
    }
    ll start=0,end=1e18;;
    while(start!=end){
        ll mid=(start+end)/2;
        ll sum=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            ll temp=h[i]+mid*r[i];
            if(temp>=l){
                sum+=temp;
            }
            if(sum>=w)
                break;
        }
        if(sum>=w){
            end=mid;
        }
        else
            start=mid+1;
    }
    cout<<start<<endl;
    return 0;
}

<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
const ll maxo=1e7+1;
// partailly accepted
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(n==1)
    {
        vector<ll> weight(n),l(n);
        for(auto &x:weight)
            cin>>x;
        for(auto &x:l)
            cin>>x;
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if(n==2)
    {
        vector<ll> weight(n),l(n);
        for(auto &x:weight)
            cin>>x;
        for(auto &x:l)
            cin>>x;
        if(weight[1]>weight[0])
            cout<<0<<endl;
        else
        {
            if(weight[1]==weight[0])
                 cout<<1<<endl;
            else
            {
                if(l[0]==1)
                    cout<<2<<endl;
                else
                    cout<<1<<endl;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        vector<ll> v(n);
        map<ll, ll> l;
        map<ll, vector<ll>> position;
        for(ll i= 0;i < n;i++)
        {
            cin >> v[i];
            position[i].push_back(v[i]);
        }
        for(ll i = 0;i < n;i++)
        {
            ll temp;
            cin >> temp;
            l[v[i]] = temp;
        }
        ll count = 0;
        while(1)
        {
            bool flag = true;
            ll val = 0;
            ll index = -1;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> store;
            for(auto it : position)
            {
                for(auto itr : it.second)
                {
                    store.push_back({it.first, itr});
                }
            }
            for(ll i = 0;i + 1 < n;i++)
            {
                if(store[i].second > store[i + 1].second)
                {
                    flag = false;
                    val = store[i].second;
                    index = store[i].first;
                    break;
                }
                else
                {
                    if(store[i].first == store[i + 1].first)
                    {
                        flag = false;
                        val = store[i + 1].second;
                        index = store[i + 1].first;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(flag)
                break;
            if(find(all(position[index]), val) != position[index].end())
            {
                position[index].erase(find(all(position[index]), val));
            }
            if(position[index].empty())
            {
                position.erase(index);
            }
            position[index + l[val]].push_back(val);
            count++;
        }
        cout<<count<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE

    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    srt(v);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i==0)
        {
            ans[v[i].ss]=pos;

        else
        {
            ll d=v[i].ff-v[i-1].ff;

    {

        cin>>l>>r;

            cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
        else
            cout<<"No"<<endl;

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

    vector<vector<ll>>v(n,vector<ll>(3));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i][0]>>v[i][1]>>v[i][2];
    }
    srt(v);
    for(ll i=0;i<(1<<n);i++){
        ll cost=0;
        ll max_time=0,min_time=LONG_MAX;
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            if(i&(1<<j)){
                cost+=v[j][2];
                min_time=min(min_time,v[j][0]);
                max_time=max(max_time,v[j][1]);
            }
        }
        if(min_time!=LONG_MAX&&max_time>0){
            cost-=(max_time-min_time)*k1;
            maxo=max(maxo,cost);
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
bool compare(pair<ll,ll>& a,pair<ll,ll>& b)
{
    if(a.ss==b.ss)
        return a.ff>b.ff;
    else
        return a.ss<b.ss;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    vl f(n);
    forin(f, n);
    vl c(n);
    forin(c, n);
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
    for(int i = 0;i < n;i++)
    {
        v.pb({f[i], c[i]});
    }
    sort(all(v), compare);
    ll ans = 0;
    ll fill = n;
    for(int i = 0;i < n;i++)
    {
        if(fill<= 0)
        {
            break;
        }
        if(v[i].ff >= fill)
        {
            ans += fill * v[i].ss;
            fill = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            ans += v[i].ff * v[i].ss;
            fill -= v[i].ff;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    pan;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;
int gcd(int x, int y)
{
	if(y==0)
		return x;
	else
		return gcd(y,x%y);
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	long long n;
	cin>>n;
	while(n--)
	{
		long long a;
		string b;
		cin>>a>>b;
		if(a==0)
			cout<<b<<endl;
		else
		{
			long long num=0;
			for(long long i=0;i<b.length();i++)
			{
				num=(num*10+(int(b[i]-'0')))%a;
			}
			cout<<gcd(a,num)<<endl;
		}
	}
}

const ll MOD=1e9+7;
long long bpow(long long a, long long b, long long mod = MOD)
    {
        long long res = 1;
        while(b)
        {
            if(b & 1)
                res = ((__int128)res * a) % mod;
            a = ((__int128)a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    void solve()
    {
        long long a, b, n;
        cin >> a >> b >> n;
        if(a == b)
        {
            cout << (bpow(a, n) + bpow(b, n)) % MOD << '\n';
        }else
        {
            long long d = (bpow(a, n, a - b) + bpow(b, n, a - b)) % (a - b);
            cout << __gcd(d, a - b) << '\n';
        }
    }

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            int n;
            cin>>n;
            vector<int> p(n,0);
            for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++){
                p[i]=i+1;
            }
            if(n%2==0){
                for(int i=0;i<n;i+=2){
                    swap(p[i],p[i+1]);
                }
                for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                    cout<<p[i]<<" ";
                }
                cout<<"\n";
            }
            else{
                if(n==3 || n==1){
                    cout<<-1<<"\n";
                }
                else{
                    swap(p[0],p[1]);
                    swap(p[0],p[3]);
                    swap(p[2],p[4]);
                    for(int i=5;i<n;i+=2){
                        swap(p[i],p[i+1]);
                    }
                    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                        cout<<p[i]<<" ";
                    }
                    cout<<"\n";
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

                }

            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll one=0,minus_one=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll x;
                cin>>x;
                if(x==1){
                    one++;
                }
                else{
                    minus_one++;
                }
            }
            ll maxo=max(one,minus_one);
            ll mini=min(one,minus_one);

            diff*=2;
            mini-=diff;

            if(mini==0 || mini==1){
                if(maxo<=2){
                    yes
                    return 0;

                else{
                    no
                    return 0;
                }

    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;

                c++;

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve(){
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    int n=s.size();
    int count=0;
    int oneZero=0,zeroOne=0;
    for(int i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i-1]=='0' && s[i]=='1'){
            zeroOne++;
        }
        else if(s[i-1]=='1' && s[i]=='0'){
            oneZero++;
        }
    }
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        int tempZeroOne=zeroOne,tempOneZero=oneZero;
        if(i-1>=0){
            if(s[i-1]=='1'){
                // 11 -> 10
                if(s[i]=='1'){
                    tempOneZero++;
                }
                // 10 -> 11
                else{
                    tempOneZero--;
                }
            }
            else{
                // 01 -> 00
                if (s[i] == '1')
                {
                    tempZeroOne--;
                }
                // 00 -> 01
                else
                {
                    tempZeroOne++;
                }
            }
        }
        if(i+1<n){
            if(s[i]=='1'){
                // 11 -> 01
                if(s[i+1]=='1'){
                    tempZeroOne++;
                }
                //  10 -> 00
                else{
                    tempOneZero--;
                }
            }
            else{
                // 01 -> 11
                if (s[i + 1] == '1')
                {
                    tempZeroOne--;
                }
                //  00 -> 10
                else
                {
                    tempOneZero++;
                }
            }
        }
        if(tempZeroOne==tempOneZero){
            count++;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase=1;
    cin>>testCase;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()

    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(k);i++)
    {
    	if(k%i==0)
    	{
    		if(k==(i*i))
    		{
    			if(i<=n)
    				count++;
    		}
    		else
    		{
    			if(i<=n&&(k/i)<=n)
    				count++;
    		}
    	}
    }

    	cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
    else
    	cout<<"No"<<endl;
    return 0;

// to run ctrl+b
vector<ll> factor(ll num)
{
    vector<ll> ans;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(num);i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
        {
            if((i*i)==num)
                ans.pb(i);
            else
            {
                ans.pb(i);
                ans.pb(num/i);
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll a,m;
    cin>>a>>m;
    vector<ll> ans;
    vl ans2;
    ans=factor(m);
    for(auto x:ans)
    {
        ll temp=m/x;
        if((temp-1)%a==0)
        {
            temp=(temp-1)/a;
            ans2.pb(temp*x);
        }
    }
    cout<<sz(ans2)-1<<endl;
    srt(ans2);
    for(auto x:ans2)
    {
        if(x>0)
            cout<<x<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

    {
        ll x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3;
        cin>>x1>>y1>>x2>>y2>>x3>>y3;

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
	cc
	{
		ll n,u,d;
		cin>>n>>u>>d;
		vl v(n);
		forin(v,n);
		ll pos=0,height=v[0],count=1,flag=0;
		loop(i,1,n)
		{
			pos=i;
			if(v[i]>height)
			{
				if(v[i]-height<=u)
				{
					height=v[i];
					continue;
				}
				else
				{
					flag=1;
					break;
				}
			}
			else if(v[i]==height)
			{
				height=v[i];
				continue;
			}
			else if(v[i]<height)
			{
				if(height-v[i]<=d)
				{
					height=v[i];
					continue;
				}
				else
				{
					if(count>0)
					{
						count--;
						height=v[i];
					}
					else
					{
						flag=1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if(flag==1)
			cout<<pos<<endl;
		else
			cout<<pos+1<<endl;
	}
}

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()

    ll n,m,x,y;
    cin>>n>>m>>x>>y;

                full++;

                partail++;
            else
                wrong++;
        }

#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    cc
    {
        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        vl v(n);
        forin(v,n);
        srt(v);
        ll mini=LONG_MAX;
        for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++)
        {
            ll temp=abs(v[i+1]-v[i]);
            mini=min(mini,temp);
        }
        cout<<mini<<endl;
    }
}

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,a,b;
    cin>>n>>a>>b;
    ll alice=0,bob=0,common=0;
    ll lcm=(a*b)/(__gcd(a,b));
    ll temp=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp%lcm==0)
        {
            common++;
        }
        else if(temp%a==0&&temp%b!=0)
            bob++;
        else if(temp%b==0&&temp%a!=0)
            alice++;
    }
    if(common)
        bob++;
    if(bob>alice)
        cout<<"BOB"<<endl;
    else
        cout<<"ALICE"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */

    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll pre=v[n-1];
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        if(v[i]<=pre){
            pre=v[i];
            continue;
        }
        else{
            temp_pos=i+1;
            break;

            yes

            yes
            cout<<1<<endl;

        else
            no
    }

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll lcm_cal(ll num1,ll num2){
    return (num1*num2)/__gcd(num1,num2);
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll x,y;
        cin>>x>>y;
        v[i]={x,y};
    }
    srt(v);
    vl lcm(n),hcf(n);
    ll temp_lcm=1,temp_hcf=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        temp_lcm=lcm_cal(temp_lcm,v[i].ff);
        lcm[i]=temp_lcm;
    }
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        temp_hcf=__gcd(temp_hcf,v[i].ff);
        hcf[i]=temp_hcf;
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(hcf[i]%lcm[i]==0){
            ans+=power(2LL,v[i].ss,mod2)-2;
        }
        if(i>0&&hcf[i]%lcm[i-1]==0)
            ans++;
        ans%=mod2;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{

    map<ll,ll> m;
    ll maxo=0;
    ll temp;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        m[temp]++;
        maxo=max(maxo,temp);
    }
    if(m[maxo]>=2)
    {
        no
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        for(auto x:m)
        {
            if(x.ss>2)
            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }

    for(auto x:m)
    {
        if(x.ff!=maxo)

            if(x.ss==2)

                v1.pb(x.ff);
                v2.pb(x.ff);
            }
            else
                v1.pb(x.ff);
        }
    }
    v1.pb(maxo);
    srt(v1);
    srtGreat(v2);
    yes
    for(auto x:v1)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    for(auto x:v2)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}

    ll count=0,more=0,bot=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        if(v[i]!=-1)
            count++;
        if(v[i]>k)
            more++;
        if(v[i]==0||v[i]==1)
            bot++;
    }
    if(count<(n+1)/2)
        cout<<"Rejected"<<endl;
    else if(more>=1)
        cout<<"Too Slow"<<endl;
    else if(bot==n)
        cout<<"Bot"<<endl;
    else
        cout<<"Accepted"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

ll solve()
{
    ll n,d;
    cin>>n>>d;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(n,vector<ll>(3,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>v[i][0]>>v[i][1]>>v[i][2];
    srt(v);
    priority_queue<pair<ll,ll>> q;
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=d;i++)
    {
        if(pos<n)
        {
            if(v[pos][0]==i)
            {
                while(pos<n&&v[pos][0]==i)
                {
                    q.push({v[pos][2],v[pos][1]});
                    pos++;
                }
            }
        }
        if(sz(q)>0)
        {
            ll a=q.top().ff;
            ll b=q.top().ss;
            b--;
            q.pop();
            if(b>0)
            {
                q.push({a,b});
            }
        }
    }
    ll sum=0;
    while(sz(q))
    {
        ll a=q.top().ff;
        ll b=q.top().ss;
        sum+=a*b;
        q.pop();
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
map<ll,ll> m;
const ll N=1e3;
// Partially AC
void cal(){
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=N;i++){
        ans=0;
        ll temp1=0,temp2=0;
        for(ll j=2;j<=(2*i)+1;j++){
            temp1=i+((j-1)*(j-1));
            temp2=i+(j*j);
            // cout<<"temp1 "<<temp1<<" "<<temp2<<endl;
            ans+=__gcd(temp1,temp2);
        }
        m[i]=ans;
    }
}
long long solve()
{
    ll k;
    cin>>k;
    // cout<<m[k]<<endl;
    for(ll i=1;i<=k;i++){
        cout<<ll(m[i])<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    cin>>test;
    cal();
    // scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,i,j;
        cin>>n;
        vector<vector<char>> a(2,vector<char>(n));
        pair<ll,ll> fi;
        ll flag=0;
        for(i=0;i<2;i++)
        {
            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
            {   char c;
                cin>>c;
                if(flag==0 && c=='#')
                {
                    fi.first=i;fi.second=j;
                    flag=1;
                }
                a[i][j]=c;
            }
        }
        flag=0;
        queue<pair<ll,ll>> q;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(a[0][i]!='#')
            {
                if(a[1][i]=='#')
                {
                    q.push({1,i});
                    a[1][i]='0';
                    fi.first=1;fi.second=i;
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
            if(flag==1) break;
            if(a[1][i]!='#')
            {
                if(a[0][i]=='#')
                {
                    q.push({0,i});
                    a[0][i]='.';
                    fi.first=0;fi.second=i;
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
            if(flag==1) break;
        }
        if(flag==0)
        {
            q.push({fi.first,fi.second});
            a[fi.first][fi.second]='.';
        }
        while(!q.empty())
        {
            ll x=q.front().first;
            ll y=q.front().second;
            q.pop();
            if(x==0)
            {
                if(a[x+1][y]=='#')
                {
                    a[x+1][y]='.';
                    q.push({x+1,y});
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if(x==1)
            {
                if(a[x-1][y]=='#')
                {
                    a[x-1][y]='.';
                    q.push({x-1,y});
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if(y<(n-1))
            {
                if(a[x][y+1]=='#')
                {
                    a[x][y+1]='.';
                    q.push({x,y+1});
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==1)
        {
            q.push({fi.first,fi.second});
            while(!q.empty())
            {
            ll x=q.front().first;
            ll y=q.front().second;
            q.pop();
            if(x==0)
            {
                if(a[x+1][y]=='#')
                {
                    a[x+1][y]='.';
                    q.push({x+1,y});
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if(x==1)
            {
                if(a[x-1][y]=='#')
                {
                    a[x-1][y]='.';
                    q.push({x-1,y});
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if(y>0)
            {
                if(a[x][y-1]=='#')
                {
                    a[x][y-1]='.';
                    q.push({x,y-1});
                    continue;
                }
            }
            }
        }
        flag=1;
        for(i=0;i<2;i++)
        {
            for(j=0;j<n;j++)
            {
                if(a[i][j]=='#')
                {
                    flag=0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(flag==0)
            break;
        }
        if(flag==1)
        cout<<"yes\n";
        else
        cout<<"no\n";
    return 0;
}

// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    float p,s;
    cin>>p>>s;
    float l = (p - sqrt(p*p - 24*s))/12;
    float v = l * (s/2.0 - l*(p/4.0-l));
    cout<<fixed<<setprecision(2)<<v<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    vector<vector<ll>> matrix(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>matrix[i][j];
        }
    }
    ll count=0;
    vector<vector<ll>>pre_sum(n+1,vector<ll>(m+1,0));
    pre_sum[1][1]=matrix[0][0];
    for(ll i=1;i<m;i++)
        pre_sum[1][i+1]=pre_sum[1][i]+matrix[0][i];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        pre_sum[i+1][1]=pre_sum[i][1]+matrix[i][0];
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<m;j++){
            pre_sum[i+1][j+1]=pre_sum[i+1][j]+pre_sum[i][j+1]-pre_sum[i][j]+matrix[i][j];
        }
    }
    ll mini=min(n,m);
    ll maxo=max(n,m);
    count=n*m;
    ll temp=2;
    while(temp<=mini){
        count+=(mini-temp+1)*(maxo-temp+1);
        temp++;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=mini;i++){
        for(ll j=i;j<=n;j++){
            for(ll z=i;z<=m;z++){
                ll sum=pre_sum[j][z]+pre_sum[j-i][z-i]-(pre_sum[j-i][z]+pre_sum[j][z-i]);
                if(sum<(i*i*k))
                    count--;
            }
        }
    }
    // for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++){
    //  for(ll j=0;j<=m;j++){
    //      cout<<pre_sum[i][j]<<" ";
    //  }
    //  line;
    // }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }

typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);

// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
