#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll kadane(int arr[], int size)
{
    ll maximum = INT_MIN;
    ll max_so_far = 0;
    ll best_so_far = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
    {
        if(arr[i] > maximum)
        {
          maximum = arr[i];
        }
        max_so_far += arr[i];
        if(max_so_far < 0){
          max_so_far = 0;
        }
        if(max_so_far > best_so_far){
          best_so_far = max_so_far;
        }
    }
    return (best_so_far>0)? best_so_far: maximum;
}
ll solve()
{
    int n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    int arr[n];
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
    ll kadaneSum = kadane(arr, n);
    if(k == 1){
      cout<<kadaneSum<<endl;
    }
    else{
      ll totalSum = 0,leftSum = INT_MIN,rightSum = INT_MIN;
      for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        totalSum += arr[i];
        leftSum = max(leftSum, totalSum);
      }
      totalSum = 0;
      for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        totalSum += arr[i];
        rightSum = max(rightSum, totalSum);
      }
      if(totalSum < 0){
        cout<<max(leftSum + rightSum, kadaneSum)<<endl;
      }
      else{
        cout<<((leftSum + rightSum + (totalSum * (k-2))))<<endl;
      }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    cc
    {
        ll n,k;
        cin>>n>>k;
        string s;
        cin>>s;
        ll zeros=0,ones=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(s[i]=='0')
                zeros++;
            else
                ones++;
        }
        if(ones==n||zeros==n)
            cout<<s<<endl;
        else
        {
            ll div=n/k;
            if(zeros%div||ones%div)
            {
                cout<<"IMPOSSIBLE"<<endl;
            }
            else
            {
                zeros/=div;
                ones/=div;
                string out="",rep="",rev_rep="";
                for(ll i=0;i<zeros;i++)
                {
                    rep+='0';
                }
                for(ll i=0;i<ones;i++)
                    rep+='1';
                for(ll i=ll(rep.size())-1LL;i>=0;i--)
                    rev_rep+=rep[i];
                ll cnt=0;
                while(ll(out.size()<n))
                {
                    if(cnt&1)
                        out+=rev_rep;
                    else
                        out+=rep;
                    cnt++;
                }
                cout<<out<<endl;
            }
        }
    }
}

	{
		if(y%2==1)

{
	ll n;

	vl v(n);
	ll sum=0,mini=LONG_MAX;
	ll temp;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>temp;

    {

            for(ll j=i;j<maxn;j+=i)

                prime[j]++;

		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	string s,t;
	cin>>s>>t;
	unordered_map<char,ll> m;
	ll count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<s.length();i++)
	{
		m[s[i]]++;
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<t.length();i++)
	{
		if(m[t[i]]>0)
		{
			m[t[i]]--;
			count++;
		}
	}
	cout<<count<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	// solve();
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    vector<bool> check(n,false);
    if(s[0]=='1')
    {
        check[0]=true;
        if(n>1)
            check[1]=true;
    }
    if(s[n-1]=='1')
    {
        check[n-1]=true;
        if(n>=2)
            check[n-2]=true;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='1')
        {
            check[i]=true;
            check[i-1]=true;
            check[i+1]=true;
        }
    }
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(check[i]==false)
            count++;
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))

// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll temp,hcf;
	cin>>hcf;
	for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>temp;
		hcf=__gcd(hcf,temp);
	}
	if(hcf>1)
	{
		ll ans=hcf;
		for(ll i=2;i<=(sqrt(hcf)+1);i++)
		{
			if(hcf%i==0)
			{
				ans=min(ans,i);
			}
		}
		cout<<ans<<endl;
	}
	else
		cout<<-1<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

    while(y>0)

        ll x;

        {
            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vl p(m);
    forin(p,m);
    map<ll,priority_queue<ll>> mp;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll ci;
        cin>>ci;
        while(ci--){
            ll temp;
            cin>>temp;
            mp[i].push(temp);
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        if(sz(mp[p[i]])){
            ans+=mp[p[i]].top();
            mp[p[i]].pop();
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        solve();

		loop0(n)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			if(k%temp==0)
			{
				count=k/temp;
				count--;
				if(mini>count)
				{
					flag=1;
					mini=min(count,mini);
					ans=temp;
				}
			}
		}
		if(flag==0)
			cout<<-1<<endl;
		else
			cout<<ans<<endl;
	}
}

	{
		string s;
		cin>>s;
		if(s.length()>=47)
			cout<<"Good"<<endl;
		else
		{
			ll flag=0;
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				if(s.find(v[i])!=-1)
				{
					flag=1;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(flag)
				cout<<"Good"<<endl;
			else
				cout<<"Bad"<<endl;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();

    vl ans(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll count=0;
        ll pos1=i+1;
        while(pos1<n&&v[pos1]<=v[i]){
            if(v[pos1]==v[i])
                count++;
            pos1++;
        }
        pos1=i-1;
        while(pos1>=0&&v[pos1]<=v[i]){
            if(v[pos1]==v[i])
                count++;
            pos1--;
        }
        ans[i]=count;

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;  
     while (y > 0)  
    {  
        // If y is odd, multiply x with result  
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;  
        // y must be even now  
        y = y>>1; // y = y/2  
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

void solve()
{
	ll n, inp, a, b, c, m, p;
 	cin >> a >> b >> c >> m >> p;
	if(a==0){cout << "NO " << 0 << endl;return;}
	if(a==1) {cout << "YES " << p%100000007  << endl;return;}
	ll x=power(a, b, m);
	ll x2 = power(x, c, m);
	ll ans  = x2 % m;
	ll ans2=(p * ans) % 100000007;
	if (ans2 == 0)
		cout << "NO " << 0 << endl;
	else
		cout << "YES " << ans2 << endl;
}
int main()
{
	ll t;
	cin >> t;
	while (t--)
		solve();
	return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=s.size();
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if((i-3)>=0)
        {
            if((s[i]=='?'||s[i]=='F')&&(s[i-1]=='?'||s[i-1]=='E')&&(s[i-2]=='?'||s[i-2]=='H')&&(s[i-3]=='?'||s[i-3]=='C'))
            {
                s[i]='F',s[i-1]='E',s[i-2]='H',s[i-3]='C';
            }
            else
                if(s[i]=='?')
                    s[i]='A';
        }
        else
            if(s[i]=='?')
                s[i]='A';
    }
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    pan;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<ll> v(n);
    ll ans=0,maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
    	cin>>v[i];
    }
    sort(v.begin(),v.end());
    for(ll i=1;i<n-1;i++)
    {
    	ans=0;
    	ans+=abs(v[i]-v[0])+abs(v[i]-v[n-1])+abs(v[0]-v[n-1]);
    	maxo=max(maxo,ans);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //     freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

*/

{
	ll n,k;
	cin>>n>>k;
	unordered_map<ll,ll> m;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		ll temp;
		cin>>temp;
		m[temp]++;
	}
	for(ll i=1;i<k;i++)
	{
		if(m[i]==0)
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			return 0;

	if(m[k]==0)
	{
		cout<<n<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	else
	{
		ll count=0;
		for(auto x:m)
		{
			if(x.ff!=k)
			{
				count+=x.ss;
			}
		}
		cout<<count<<endl;
	}
	return 0;

ll solve(){
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    srt(v);
    ll alice=1,bob=n-1;
    ll flag=0;
    ll ans=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(flag==0){
            // alice tern
            ans=ans|v[alice];
            alice++;
        }
        else{
            // bob tern
            ans=ans&v[bob];
            bob--;
        }
        flag^=1;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main(){
    speed;
    /*
        #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }

            return num;

        string num_to_str(ll num){

        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            // MAXTHEMIN
            ll n,k;
            cin>>n>>k;
            vl v(n);
            ll maxo=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
            }
            if(k>=n-1){
                cout<<maxo<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            srt(v);
            cout<<v[k]<<endl;
            return 0;
        }

ll dfs(ll i,ll j){
    if(i<=0||i>6||j<=0||j>6)
        return 0;
    if(v[i][j]==1)
        return 0;
    if(check[i][j]==true)
        return 0;
    check[i][j]=true;
    dfs(i-1,j);
    dfs(i+1,j);
    dfs(i,j-1);
    dfs(i,j+1);
    return 0;
}

        dfs(1,1);

        cout<<"No"<<endl;

        cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
    return 0;

<problem>
Title: MEXSTR
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
long long solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=s.size();
    ll flag0=0,flag1=0;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x=='1')
            flag1++;
        else
            flag0++;
    }
    if(flag0==0){
        // cout<<"ans is "<<"0"<<endl;
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if(flag1==0){
        // cout<<"ans is 1"<<endl;
        cout<<1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> right(n,vector<ll>(2,0));
    vector<ll> dp1(n+1,0), dp2(n+1,0);
    string ans = "1";
    ll pos0 = n, pos1 = n;
    for(ll i = n - 1;i >= 0;i--){
        if(s[i] == '1')
            pos1 = i;
        else
            pos0 = i;
        right[i][0] = pos0;
        right[i][1] = pos1;
    }
    for(ll i = n - 1;i >= 0;i--){
        dp1[i] = dp1[i + 1];
        if(s[i] == '0' && right[i][1] < n){
            dp1[i]=max(dp1[i], dp1[right[i][1] + 1] + 1);
        }
        if(s[i] == '1' && right[i][0] < n) {
            dp1[i]=max(dp1[i], dp1[right[i][0] + 1] + 1);
        }
        dp2[i] = dp2[i + 1];
        if(right[i][1] < n) {
            dp2[i]=max(dp2[i], dp1[right[i][1] + 1] + 1);
        }
    }
    ll size = dp2[0] + 1;
    ll temp = right[0][1] + 1;
    for(ll i = 1;i < size;i++){
        if(temp >= n) {
            ans += '0';
            continue;
        }
        if(right[temp][0] >= n){
            ans += '0';
            continue;
        }
        if(dp1[right[temp][0] + 1] < size - i - 1){
            ans += '0';
            temp = right[temp][0] + 1;
        }
        else{
            ans += '1';
            temp = right[temp][1] + 1;
        }
    }    
    // cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
    dp1.clear();
    dp2.clear();
    right.clear();
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer
*/

        mid=high;

                else
                {
                    // cout<<"increase hua at 1 "<<i<<" "<<j<<endl;
                    ans1++;
                    island1++;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                flag^=1;
                if(v[i][j]=='.')
                    continue;
                else
                {
                    // cout<<"increase hua at 2 "<<i<<" "<<j<<endl;
                    ans1++;
                }
            }
            // flag^=1;
        }
        // line;
    }
    // cout<<"ans1 is "<<ans1<<endl;
    flag=0,flag2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        flag2^=1;
        flag=flag2;
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            // cout<<flag;
            if(flag==0)
            {
                island2++;
                flag^=1;
                if(v[i][j]=='*')
                    continue;
                else
                    ans2++;
            }
            else
            {
                flag^=1;
                if(v[i][j]=='.')
                    continue;
                else
                    ans2++;
            }
            // flag^=1;
        }
        // line;
    }
    // cout<<"ans2 is "<<ans2<<endl;
    if(island2>island1)
        cout<<ans2<<endl;
    else if(island1>island2)
        cout<<ans1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<min(ans1,ans2)<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

        ll z;

            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n+1);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        v[i]=i;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(v[i]==i)
            swap(v[i],v[i+1]);
    }
    if(n&1)
        swap(v[n],v[n-1]);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cout<<v[i]<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    map<ll,ll>m1;
    ll temp=0,maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        m1[temp]++;
    }
    map<ll,ll> m2;
    for(auto x:m1)
    {
        m2[x.ss]++;
    }
    for(auto x:m2)
    {
        maxo=max(maxo,x.ss);
        // cout<<x.ff<<" occur "<<x.ss<<endl;
    }
    vl v;
    for(auto x:m2)
    {
        if(x.ss==maxo)
            v.pb(x.ff);
    }
    srt(v);
    cout<<v[0]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);

        solve();

<problem>
Title: MODEQ
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
long long solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll ans=0;
    vector<ll> count(n+1,1);
    for(ll b=1;b<=n;b++){
        if(b==1)
            continue;
        ll temp=m%b;
        ans+=count[temp];
        for(ll j=temp;j<=n;j+=b)
            count[j]++;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

	cc

        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        vl l(n,0),r(n,0);
        forin(l,n);
        forin(r,n);
        ll pro=0,temp=0,pos=0;
        loop(i,0,n)
        {
            if((l[i]*r[i])>pro)
            {
                pro=(l[i]*r[i]);
                temp=max(temp,r[i]);
                pos=i;
            }
            else if((l[i]*r[i])==pro)
            {
                if(r[i]>temp)
                {
                    temp=r[i];
                    pos=i;
                }
                else if(temp==r[i])
                {
                    pos=min(pos,i);
                }
            }
        }
        cout<<pos+1<<endl;
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;

        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll odd=0,even=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll temp;
                cin>>temp;
                if(temp&1){
                    odd++;
                }
                else{
                    even++;
                }
            }
            if(odd%2==0){
                cout<<min(odd/2,even)<<endl;
            }
            else{
                cout<<even<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll k,d0,d1;
	cin>>k>>d0>>d1;
	ll temp=d0+d1;
	ll ans=temp;
	ll sum=(2*temp)%10+(4*temp)%10+(8*temp)%10+(6*temp)%10;
	k-=2;
	if(k>0)
	{
		ans+=(temp%10);
		k--;
	}
	ans+=(k/4)*sum;
	k%=4;
	ll temp1=2;
	while(k--)
	{
		ans+=(temp1*temp)%10;
		temp1=(temp1*2)%10;
	}
	if(ans%3==0)
		yes
	else
		no
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	// solve();
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve(){
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vl v(n);
    ll maxo=0;
    map<ll,ll> mp;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
        mp[v[i]]++;
    }
    srtGreat(v);
    vl v1;
    for(auto x:mp){
        v1.pb(x.ff);
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(v1);i++){
        ll temp=v1[i-1]-v1[i];
        ll remainder = temp%m;
        if(temp<0){
            remainder = m+remainder;
        }
        temp=v1[i-1]+v1[i]+remainder;
        maxo=max(maxo,temp);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        maxo=max(maxo,2*v[i]);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main(){
    speed;
    /*
        #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    string m,w;
    cin>>m>>w;
    if(m.length()>w.length())
        swap(m,w);
    ll pos=-1,count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<m.length();i++)
    {
        for(ll j=pos+1;j<w.length();j++)
        {
            if(w[j]==m[i])
            {
                count++;
                pos=j;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(count==m.length())
        yes
    else
        no
    return 0;
}

class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            vector<ll> pos;
            for(ll i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
                if(s[i]=='1'){
                    pos.pb(i);
                }
            }
            // printv(pos);
            if(sz(pos)==0){
                cout<<0<<endl;
            }
            else{
                for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(pos);i++){
                    if(pos[i+1]==pos[i]+1){
                        cout<<2<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
                cout<<1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    while(1){
        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        if(n==0)
            break;
        vl v(n);
        forin(v,n);
        sort(all(v));
        ll ans=0;
        for(ll i=n-1;i>=2;i--)
        {
            ll f=0,r=i-1;
            while(f<r)
            {
                if(v[f]+v[r]<v[i])
                {
                    ans+=r-f;
                    f++;
                }
                else
                    r--;
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }

            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
const ll N=1e7+1;
vl prime;
void sieve(){
    vector<bool> check(N+1,true);
    for(ll i=2;i*i<=N;i++)
    {
        if(check[i])
        {
            for(ll j=i*i;j<N;j+=i)
                check[j]=false;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=2;i<=N;i++)
    {
        if(check[i])
            prime.pb(i);
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(n==2)
        cout<<1<<endl;
    else if(n==3)
        cout<<2<<endl;
    else if(n==4)
        cout<<2<<endl;
    else{
        ll no_of_prime = upper_bound(all(prime),n)-prime.begin();
        ll temp=n/2;
        ll temp1=upper_bound(all(prime),temp)-prime.begin();
        no_of_prime-=temp1;
        no_of_prime++;
        cout<<no_of_prime<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;
    sieve();

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll l,r;
    cin>>l>>r;
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=1;j<=sqrt(i);j++)
        {
            if(i%j==0)
            {
                if((j*j)==i)
                {
                    if(j&1)
                        sum+=j;
                }
                else
                {
                    if(j&1)
                        sum+=j;
                    if((i/j)&1)
                        sum+=(i/j);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
// partially accepted
int solve()
{
    int n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<int> a(n),b(m);
    vector<int> ans;
    map<int,int> M;
    ans.push_back(0);
    M[0]++;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>a[i];
    }
    for(int i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        cin>>b[i];
    }
    for(int i=0;i<ans.size();i++)
    {
        int x=ans[i];
        // cout<<"x is "<<x<<endl;
        for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            int temp=x|a[j];
            // cout<<"in or "<<temp<<endl;
            if(M[temp]==0)
            {
                // cout<<"hi1 "<<endl;
                M[temp]++;
                ans.push_back(temp);
            }
        }
        for(int j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            int temp=x&b[j];
            // cout<<"in and "<<temp<<endl;
            if(M[temp]==0)
            {
                // cout<<"hi "<<endl;
                M[temp]++;
                ans.push_back(temp);
            }
        }
    }
    // cout<<"\tnow final set is "<<endl;
    // for(auto x:ans)
    //     cout<<"\tin set "<<x<<endl;
    cout<<ans.size()-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //     freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    int test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n,q;
    cin>>n>>q;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl bits(32,0);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=v[i];
        ll pos=0;
        while(temp){
            if(temp&1)
                bits[pos]++;
            pos++;
            temp>>=1;
        }
    }
    ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<32;i++){
        if(bits[i]){
            ans+=pow(2,i);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    ans=0;
    while(q--){
        ans=0;
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        a--;
        ll temp=v[a];
        v[a]=b;
        ll pos=0;
        while(temp){
            if(temp&1)
                bits[pos]--;
            pos++;
            temp>>=1;
        }
        pos=0;
        while(b){
            if(b&1){
                bits[pos]++;
            }
            pos++;
            b>>=1;
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<32;i++){
            if(bits[i]){
                ans+=pow(2,i);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    {
        solve();

		sl s;
		loop(i,0,n)
		{
			temp2=v[i];
			if(s.find(temp2)!=s.end())
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
			else
			{
				s.insert(temp2);
				loop(j,i+1,n)

					{
						flag=1;
						break;
					}
					else
						s.insert(temp2);
				}
			}
			if(flag==1)
				break;
		}
		if(flag==1)
			no
		else
			yes
	}
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>>v(m);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v[i]={min(a,b),max(a,b)};
    }
    vl ans;
    vector<bool> check(n,false);
    for(ll i=m-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(check[v[i].ff]==false&&check[v[i].ss]==false)
        {
            ans.pb(i);
            check[v[i].ff]=true;
            check[v[i].ss]=true;
        }
    }
    reverse(all(ans));
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll palindrome(ll number)
{
	ll sum=0,temp=number;
	while(temp!=0)
	{
		sum=sum*10+(temp%10);
		temp/=10;
	}
	if(number==sum)
		return 1;
	else
		return 0;
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
#define pb push_back
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
#define ss second
#define ff first
// slope jada ho ya equal ho to chalega
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    ll maxo=0;
    scanf("%lld",&n);
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> p,temp;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll a;
        scanf("%lld",&a);
        p.pb({i+1,a});
    }
    if(n==2){
        cout<<1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    temp.pb(p[0]);
    temp.pb(p[1]);
    maxo=1;
    for(ll i=2;i<n;i++){
        while(sz(temp)>=2){
            if(sz(temp)<2)
                break;
            double temp1=(double(temp[sz(temp)-1].ss)-(double(temp[sz(temp)-2].ss)))/(double(temp[sz(temp)-1].ff)-double(temp[sz(temp)-2].ff));
            double temp2=(double(p[i].ss)-double(temp[sz(temp)-1].ss))/(double(p[i].ff)-double(temp[sz(temp)-1].ff));
            if(temp2>=temp1){
                temp.pop_back();
            }
            else
                break;
        }
        temp.pb(p[i]);
        ll temp_length=abs(temp[sz(temp)-1].ff-temp[sz(temp)-2].ff);
        maxo=max(maxo,temp_length);
    }
    printf("%lld\n",maxo);
    // cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    // cin>>test;
    scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    ll capital=0,number=0,special=0,lower=0;
    if((s[0]>='a'&&s[0]<='z')||(s[n-1]>='a'&&s[n-1]<='z'))
        lower++;
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(s)-1;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]>='A'&&s[i]<='Z')
            capital++;
        if(s[i]>='0'&&s[i]<='9')
            number++;

            special++;
        if(s[i]>='a'&&s[i]<='z')
            lower++;
    }
    if(n>=10)

            no
        else
            yes
    }

        no

vector<ll> ans(101,0);
void dfs(vector<vector<ll>>& graph,ll node,ll value=0)
{
    ans[node]=ans[value]^1;
    for(auto x:graph[node])
    {
        if(x!=value)
        {
            dfs(graph,x,node);
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        graph[a].pb(b);
        graph[b].pb(a);
    }
    dfs(graph,1);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cout<<ans[i]+1<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}

// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    vector<vector<ll>>v(26);
    ll n=sz(s);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        v[ll(s[i]-'a')].pb(i+1);
    }
    ll odd=0,pos_odd=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<26;i++){
        if(sz(v[i])&1){
            odd++;
            pos_odd=i;
        }
    }
    if(n&1&&odd>1)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else if(n%2==0&&odd>0)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else{
        vl ans(n);
        if(odd==1){
            ans[n/2]=v[pos_odd].back();
            v[pos_odd].pop_back();
        }
        ll start=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<26;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<sz(v[i]);j++){
                if(j%2==0)
                    ans[start]=v[i][j];
                else{
                    ans[n-start-1]=v[i][j];
                    start++;
                }
            }
        }
        printv(ans);
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,maxo=0;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	ll mini=LONG_MAX;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>v[i];
		maxo=max(maxo,v[i]-mini);
		mini=min(mini,v[i]);
	}
	if(maxo>0)
		cout<<maxo<<endl;
	else
		cout<<"UNFIT"<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
	ll l,d,s,c;
	cin>>l>>d>>s>>c;
	ll temp=s;
	for(ll i=2;i<=d;i++)
	{
		temp=temp+temp*c;
		if(temp>=l)
			break;
	}
	if(temp>=l)
		cout<<"ALIVE AND KICKING"<<endl;
	else
		cout<<"DEAD AND ROTTING"<<endl;
	return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

// datatype definination

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll logo=log2(n);
	if(n==1)
	{
		cout<<1<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	else if(power(2,logo)==n)
	{
		cout<<-1<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	else if(n==3)
	{
		cout<<1<<" "<<3<<" "<<2<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	vl ans;
	ans.pb(2);
	ans.pb(3);
	ans.pb(1);
	for(ll i=4;i<=n;i++)
	{
		logo=log2(i);
		// cout<<"i and logo is "<<i<<" "<<logo<<endl;
		if(power(2,logo)==i)
		{
			ans.pb(i+1);
			ans.pb(i);
			i++;
		}
		else
			ans.pb(i);
	}
	// for(ll i=0;i<(n-1);i++)
	// {
	// 	cout<<"ans is "<<(ans[i]&ans[i+1])<<endl;
	// }
	for(auto x:ans)
	{
		cout<<x<<" ";
	}
	line;
	return 0;
}

	pan;
	// solve();

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair

#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        v[i]=-i;
    }
    for(ll i=2;i<=n;i+=2)
    {
        if(k>0)
        {
            k--;
            v[i]=-v[i];
        }
    }
    ll temp=n;
    if(temp%2==0)
        temp--;
    for(ll i=temp;i>=1;i-=2)
    {
        if(k>0)
        {
            k--;
            v[i]=-v[i];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cout<<v[i]<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,w;
    cin>>n>>w;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    vector<vector<ll>> dp(101,vector<ll>(101,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b,c;
        cin>>a>>b>>c;
        v[i]={a*b,c};
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<=w;j++)
        {
            if(i==0||j==0)
                dp[i][j]=0;
            else if(j>=v[i-1].ss)
            {
                dp[i][j]=max({dp[i-1][j],v[i-1].ff+dp[i-1][j-v[i-1].ss]});
            }
            else
                dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j];
        }
    }
    cout<<dp[n][w]<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll prime(ll num)
{
	ll count=0;
	if(num==1)
		return 1;
	loop(i,2,ll(sqrt(num)+1))
	{
		if(num%i==0)
		{
			count=1;
			return count;
		}
	}
	return count;
}

		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		if(prime(n)==0)
			cout<<"yes"<<endl;
		else
			cout<<"no"<<endl;
	}
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll maxo=1e6+1;
long long solve(vector<ll>& number)
{
    ll x,y;
    scanf("%lld%lld",&x,&y);
    if(y==1)
    {
    	if(x<=2)
    		printf("%s\n","Chef");
    	else
    		printf("%s\n","Divyam");
    	return 0;
    }
    ll count=0;
    count=number[x];
    if(count>y)
    	printf("%s\n","Divyam");
    else
    	printf("%s\n","Chef");
    // cout<<"no of prime up to x is "<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    scanf("%lld",&test);
    vector<bool>prime(maxo,true);
    for(ll i=2;i*i<=maxo;i++)
    {
    	if(prime[i])
    	{
    		for(ll j=i*i;j<maxo;j+=i)
    			prime[j]=false;
    	}
    }
    ll count=0;
    vector<ll> number(maxo,0);
    for(ll i=2;i<=maxo;i++)
    {
    	if(prime[i])
    		count++;
    	number[i]=count;
    }
    while(test--)
    {
        solve(number);
    }
    return 0;
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())

class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        bool isprime(ll n){
            if(n<=1){
                return false;
            }
            for(ll i=2;i*i<=n;i++){
                if(n%i==0){
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        ll solve(){
            ll a,b;
            cin>>a>>b;
            if(a<2 || b<2){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            ll hcf=__gcd(a,b);
            for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(hcf);i++){
                if(hcf%i==0){
                    if(isprime(i) || isprime(hcf/i)){
                        cout<<0<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            cout<<1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;

        ll sum=0,temp=0;
        loop(i,0,n-k+1)
        {
            temp=0;
            loop(j,i,i+k)
            {
                temp+=v[j];
            }
            sum=max(sum,temp);
        }
        cout<<sum<<endl;
    }

	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)

			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}

{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	ll count=0,p=0,need=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if(s[i]=='P')
			p++;
		else
		{
			if(i>=2&&i<=(n-3))
			{
				ll flag=0;
				if(s[i-1]=='P'||s[i-2]=='P')
					flag++;
				if(s[i+1]=='P'||s[i+2]=='P')
					flag++;
				if(flag==2)
					count++;
			}
		}
	}
	need=((n*3)+3)/4;
	if(need<=p)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
	}
	else
	{
		need-=p;
		if(need>count)
			cout<<-1<<endl;
		else
			cout<<need<<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	cc

		solve();
	}

        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            scanf("%lld",&n);
            vl v(n);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                scanf("%lld",&v[i]);
            }
            ll pos=-1;
            for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++){
                if(v[i+1]>=v[i]){
                    continue;
                }
                else{
                    pos=i;
                }
            }
            if(pos==-1){
                printf("YES\n");
                return 0;
            }
            swap(v[pos],v[pos+1]);
            for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++){
                if(v[i+1]>=v[i]){
                    continue;
                }
                else{
                    printf("NO\n");
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            printf("YES\n");
            return 0;
        }

    ll ans=n-1+n-1;

        {
            cin>>v[i];
            maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);

        {
            loop(j,0,c)
            {
                cin>>arr[i][j];
            }
        }
        ll flag=0;
        loop(i,0,r)
        {
            loop(j,0,c)
            {
                if(i==0||i==r-1)
                {
                    if(j==0||j==c-1)
                    {
                        if(arr[i][j]>1)
                        {
                            flag=1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if(arr[i][j]>2)
                        {
                            flag=1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                else if(j==0||j==c-1)
                {
                    if(i==0||i==r-1)
                    {
                        if(arr[i][j]>1)
                        {
                            flag=1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if(arr[i][j]>2)
                        {
                            flag=1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if(arr[i][j]>3)
                    {
                        flag=1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==1)
            cout<<"Unstable"<<endl;
        else
            cout<<"Stable"<<endl;
    }
}

        ll temp,count=1,maxo=0,mini=LONG_MAX;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            temp=v[i];
            count=1;
            for(ll j=i+2;j<n;j++)
            {
                if(v[j]==v[i])
                {
                    count++;
                    j++;
                }
            }
            if(count>maxo)
            {
                // cout<<"count is "<<count<<"  for element is "<<v[i]<<endl;
                maxo=max(maxo,count);
                mini=v[i];
            }
            else if(count==maxo)
            {
                maxo=max(count,maxo);
                mini=min(mini,v[i]);
            }
        }
        cout<<mini<<endl;
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
// policy based ds
#include<ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include<ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 10000009
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,x,p,k;
	cin>>n>>x>>p>>k;
	k--;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	srt(v);
	if(v[p-1]==x)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	if(v[p-1]<x)
	{
		// cout<<"hi "<<endl;
		if(k>(p-1))
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
		else if(k==(p-1))
		{
			ll count=0;
			for(ll i=(p-1);i<n;i++)
				if(v[i]<x)
					count++;
			cout<<count<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
		else if(k<(p-1))
		{
			ll count=0;
			for(ll i=(p-1);i<n;i++)
				if(v[i]<x)
					count++;
			cout<<count<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	else if(v[p-1]>x)
	{
		// cout<<"hi1 "<<endl;
		if(k<(p-1))
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
		else if(k==(p-1))
		{
			ll count=0;
			for(ll i=0;i<=(p-1);i++)
				if(v[i]>x)
					count++;
			cout<<count<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
		else if(k>(p-1))
		{
			ll count=0;
			for(ll i=0;i<=(p-1);i++)
				if(v[i]>x)
					count++;
			cout<<count<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	// solve();
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(n);i++)
    {
        if(n%i==0)
        {
            if((i*i)==n)
            {
                cout<<0<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            else
            {
                mini=min(abs(i-n/i),mini);
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}

}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl ans(n,0);
    ll even=4000000,odd=3999999;
    vector<bool>check(n,false);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {

                    even-=2;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>

using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
vector<ll>v[200001];
vector<ll>rev[200001];
vl ans(200001,INT_MAX);
void dijkstra()
{
    deque<pair<ll,ll>> q;
    q.push_front({0,1});
    while(sz(q))
    {
        auto x=q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        if(ans[x.ss]<x.ff)
            continue;
        for(auto itr:v[x.ss]){
            if(ans[itr]>ans[x.ss]){
                ans[itr]=ans[x.ss];
                q.push_front({ans[itr],itr});
            }
        }
        for(auto itr:rev[x.ss]){
            if(ans[itr]>ans[x.ss]+1){
                ans[itr]=ans[x.ss]+1;
                q.push_back({ans[itr],itr});
            }
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        ll u,V;
        cin>>u>>V;
        v[u].pb(V);
        rev[V].pb(u);
    }
    ans[1]=0;
    dijkstra();
    if(ans[n]==INT_MAX)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<ans[n]<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
const ll N=100001;
ll dfs(ll i,ll j,ll n,ll m,ll value,vector<vector<bool>>& check,vector<vector<char>>& grid){
    // cout<<"i and j is "<<i<<" "<<j<<endl;
    if(i>=n||j>=m||i<0||j<0)
        return value;
    if(check[i][j]==true)
        return value;
    if(grid[i][j]=='0')
        return value;
    check[i][j]=true;
    value++;
    value+=dfs(i-1,j,n,m,0,check,grid);
    value+=dfs(i+1,j,n,m,0,check,grid);
    value+=dfs(i,j-1,n,m,0,check,grid);
    value+=dfs(i,j+1,n,m,0,check,grid);
    return value;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<char>> grid(n,vector<char>(m));
    vector<vector<bool>> check(n,vector<bool> (m,false));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>grid[i][j];
        }
    }
    vl number;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(grid[i][j]=='1'&&check[i][j]==false){
                ll value=0;
                ll temp=dfs(i,j,n,m,value,check,grid);
                number.pb(temp);
            }
        }
    }
    srtGreat(number);
    // printv(number);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(number);i+=2)
        ans+=number[i];
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;

    {
        solve();

    ll count=0;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        m[b]++;
    }
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        count+=(x.ss-1);
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    #endif */

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }

ll sum_of_digits(ll num)
{
    ll sum=0;
    while(num!=0)
    {
        sum+=num%10;
        num/=10;
    }
    return sum;
}

	cc
    {
        ll n,maxo=0;
        cin>>n;
        vl v(n);
        forin(v,n);
        loop(i,0,n)
        {
            loop(j,0,n)
            {
                if(i!=j)
                {
                    ll temp=v[i]*v[j];
                    temp=sum_of_digits(temp);
                    maxo=max(maxo,temp);
                }
            }
        }
        cout<<maxo<<endl;
    }

    vl v2(n);
    forin(v2,n);
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll flag=0;
    if(s[0]=='X')
        flag=2;
    else if(s[0]=='A')
        flag=0;
    else
        flag=1;
    if(s[0]=='X')
        k=k&1;
    else
        k=min(k,1LL);
    ll ans=value;
    while(k--)

        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)

	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)

			res*=x;

	{
		ll temp;
		cin>>temp;
		ll left=max(temp-n,n+1);
		ll right=min(temp-1,(2*n));

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra

#define sz(V) ll(V.size())

template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i==0)
            ans++;
        else if(i==1)
        {
            if(v[i]<v[i-1])
                ans++;
        }
        else if(i==2)
        {
            ll mini=min({v[i-1],v[i-2]});
            if(v[i]<mini)
                ans++;
        }
        else if(i==3)
        {
            ll mini=min({v[i-1],v[i-2],v[i-3]});
            if(v[i]<mini)
                ans++;
        }
        else if(i==4)
        {
            ll mini=min({v[i-1],v[i-2],v[i-3],v[i-4]});
            if(v[i]<mini)
                ans++;
        }
        else
        {
            ll mini=min({v[i-1],v[i-2],v[i-3],v[i-4],v[i-5]});
            if(v[i]<mini)
                ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll r,c;
    cin>>r>>c;
    ll a[r][c];
    ll p=0,ans=0,flag=0;
    for(ll i=0; i<r;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
            cin>>a[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<r;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<c;j++)
        {
             flag=0;
           for(ll m=0;m<c;m++)
           {
               if(a[i][j]>a[i][m])
               {
                   flag=1;
                   break;
               }
           }
           for(ll n=0;n<r;n++)
           {
               if(a[i][j]<a[n][j])
               {
                   flag=1;
                   break;
               }
           }
            if(flag==0)
            {
               ans=a[i][j];
               break;
            }
        }
        if(flag==0)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if(flag==0)
    {
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    else 
    {
        cout<<"GUESS"<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

{
    cc
    {
        ll n,temp,count=0;
        cin>>n;
        ll mini=LONG_MAX,maxo=0;
        vl v(n,0);
        loop0(n)
        {
            cin>>v[i];
            mini=min(mini,v[i]);
            maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
        }
        loop(i,0,n)
        {
            count+=v[i]-mini;
        }
        cout<<count<<endl;
    }
}

Title: SCALSUM
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll MAX=300002;
ll modulo=ll(pow(2,32));
vl weight(MAX+1,0);
vector<ll> root(MAX+1,0);
map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> m;
vector<vector<ll>> adj(MAX+1);
vector<bool>check(MAX+1,false);
queue<ll> qu;
// partially accepted
ll calculate(ll a,ll b)
{
    if(a>b)
        swap(a,b);
    if(m[{a,b}]!=0)
    {
        return m[{a,b}]%modulo;
    }
    else
    {
        ll ans=1;
        ans*=((weight[a]%modulo)*(weight[b]%modulo));
        ans+=calculate(root[a],root[b]);
        ans%=modulo;
        m[{a,b}]=ans;
        return ans;
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    root[1]=0;
    ll n,q;
    scanf("%lld%lld",&n,&q);    
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        scanf("%lld",&weight[i]);
        weight[i]=weight[i]%modulo;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<(n-1);i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        scanf("%lld%lld",&a,&b);
        adj[a].pb(b);
        adj[b].pb(a);
    }
    qu.push(1);
    m[{1,1}]=((weight[1]*weight[1])%modulo);
    while(!qu.empty())
    {
        ll temp=qu.front();
        qu.pop();
        check[temp]=true;
        for(auto x:adj[temp])
        {
            if(check[x]==false)
            {
                qu.push(x);
                check[x]=true;
                root[x]=temp;
                m[{x,x}]=(m[{temp,temp}]%modulo)+((weight[x]%modulo)*(weight[x]%modulo));
            }
        }
    }
    while(q--)
    {
        ll a,b;
        scanf("%lld%lld",&a,&b);
        if(a==1)
        {
            cout<<m[{1,1}]<<endl;
        }
        else
        {
            if(a>b)
                swap(a,b);
            if(m[{a,b}]!=0)
            {
                cout<<m[{a,b}]<<endl;
            }
            else
            {
                ll ans=1;
                ans*=((weight[a]*weight[b])%modulo);
                ans%=modulo;
                ans+=calculate(root[a],root[b]);
                ans%=modulo;
                m[{a,b}]=ans;
                cout<<m[{a,b}]<<endl;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    solve();
    return 0;
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<ll> v={0,20,36,51,60};
    if(n==1)
    	cout<<20<<endl;
    else if(n==2)
    	cout<<36<<endl;
    else if(n==3)
    	cout<<51<<endl;
    else if(n==4)
    	cout<<60<<endl;
    else{
    	ll temp=n/4;
    	ll d=n%4;
    	// (6+5)*4 on rest 8 face
    	ll ans=44*temp+(4-d)*4+v[d];
    	cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    cin>>test;
    // scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    if(n&1)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll one=0,zero=0;
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        if(x=='0')
            zero++;
        else
            one++;
    }
    if(zero==n||one==n)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    cout<<abs(one-zero)/2<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        string s1,s2;

        if(s1.length()==s2.length())
        {
            cout<<s2<<endl;

        else if(s2.length()==1)
        {
            srt(s1);
            cout<<s1<<endl;

            vl v1(26,0),v2(26,0);
            loop0(s1.length())
                v1[s1[i]-'a']++;
            loop0(s2.length())
                v2[s2[i]-'a']++;
            char start=s2[0],next;
            loop(i,1,s2.length())
            {
                if(s2[i]!=s2[0])
                {
                    next=s2[i];
                    break;
                }
                if(i==s2.length()-1)
                {
                    next=s2[s2.length()-1];
                }
            }
            string res="";
            loop(i,0,26)
            {
                char c=char(i+97);
                if(c<start)
                {
                    if(v1[i]>v2[i])
                    {
                        string temp(v1[i]-v2[i],c);
                        res+=temp;
                        v1[i]=v2[i];
                    } 
                }
                else if(c==start)
                {
                    if(next<start)
                    {
                        res+=s2;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        string temp(v1[i]-v2[i],c);
                        res+=temp;
                        v1[i]=v2[i];
                        res+=s2;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            } 
            loop(i,0,26)
            {
                v1[i]-=v2[i];
                if(v1[i]>0)
                {
                    string temp(v1[i],char(i+97));
                    res+=temp;
                }
            }
            cout<<res<<endl;
        }
    }

    vl dp1(n,0),dp2(n,0);
    dp1[0]=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
        dp1[i]=min(dp1[i-1]+1,v[i]);
    dp2[n-1]=v[n-1];

typedef long long ll;
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<ll> v(n);
    ll temp=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
    	cin>>v[i];
    }
    sort(v.begin(),v.end());
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
    	if(v[i]>(i+1)){
    		cout<<"Second"<<endl;
    		return 0;
    	}
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
    	ans+=(i+1-v[i]);
    }
    if(ans&1)
    	cout<<"First"<<endl;
    else
    	cout<<"Second"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    // #endif

    scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

        x = (x*x) % p;

        ll count=0,flag=0;
        loop(i,0,3)
        {
            if(s1[i]=='o'||s2[i]=='o')
            {
                count=0;
                loop(j,0,3)
                {
                    if(i!=j)
                    {
                        if(s1[j]=='b'||s2[j]=='b')
                            count++;
                    }
                }
                if(count==2)
                {
                    flag=1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==1)
            cout<<"yes"<<endl;
        else
            cout<<"no"<<endl;
    }
}

	ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    // vector<vector<char>> v(n,vector<char>(m));
    char v[n][m];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
            cin>>v[i][j];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j+4<m;j++)
        {
            if((v[i][j]=='S'||v[i][j]=='s')&&(v[i][j+1]=='P'||v[i][j+1]=='p')&&(v[i][j+2]=='o'||v[i][j+2]=='O')&&(v[i][j+3]=='O'||v[i][j+3]=='o')&&(v[i][j+4]=='N'||v[i][j+4]=='n'))
            {
                cout<<"There is a spoon!"<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
    {
        for(ll i=0;i+4<n;i++)
        {
            if((v[i][j]=='S'||v[i][j]=='s')&&(v[i+1][j]=='P'||v[i+1][j]=='p')&&(v[i+2][j]=='o'||v[i+2][j]=='O')&&(v[i+3][j]=='O'||v[i+3][j]=='o')&&(v[i+4][j]=='N'||v[i+4][j]=='n'))
            {
                cout<<"There is a spoon!"<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<"There is indeed no spoon!"<<endl;
	return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
ll n;
// Partial AC
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll dfs1(vector<vector<ll>>&graph,bool check[],ll count_distance,ll a,ll u){
    if(u<=0||u>n)
        return 0;
    if(u==a)
        return count_distance;
    if(check[u]==true)
        return 0;
    check[u]=true;
    ll ans=0;
    count_distance++;
    for(auto x:graph[u]){
        ans+=dfs1(graph,check,count_distance,a,x);
    }
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll k,a;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&n,&k,&a);
    vl f(k);
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++){
        scanf("%lld",&f[i]);
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
    bool check[n+1]={false};
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
        ll u,v;
        scanf("%lld%lld",&u,&v);
        graph[u].pb(v);
        graph[v].pb(u);
    }
    vector<ll> distance(k,0);
    ll maxo_distance=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++){
        memset(check,false,sizeof(check));
        distance[i]=dfs1(graph,check,0,a,f[i]);
        maxo_distance=max(maxo_distance,distance[i]);
    }
    // cout<<"calculated distance "<<endl;
    // printv(distance);
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans(n+1,{LONG_MIN,0});
    ans[0].ff=0;
    ans[0].ss=0;
    for(ll j=0;j<k;j++){
        for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
            memset(check,false,sizeof(check));
            ll temp_ans=dfs1(graph,check,0,f[j],i);
            temp_ans=distance[j]-temp_ans;
            if(ans[i].ss==0){
                ans[i].ff=temp_ans;
                ans[i].ss=f[j];
            }
            else if(ans[i].ff<temp_ans){
                ans[i].ff=temp_ans;
                ans[i].ss=f[j];
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(i==n){
            printf("%lld\n",ans[i].ff);
        }
        else
            printf("%lld ",ans[i].ff);
        // cout<<ans[i].ff<<" ";
    }
    // line;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(i==n){
            printf("%lld\n",ans[i].ss);
        }
        else
            printf("%lld ",ans[i].ss);
        // cout<<ans[i].ss<<" ";
    }
    // line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    scanf("%lld",&TestCase);
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n,0);
    forin(v,n);
    vector<int> ans(64);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp=v[i];
        ll pos=0;
        while(temp)
        {
            ans[pos]+=(temp&1);
            temp>>=1;
            pos++;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<64;i++)
    {
        if(ans[i]>=2)
            ans[i+1]+=ans[i]/2;
    }
    // for(auto x:ans)
    //     cout<<x<<" ";
    // line;
    ll result=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<64;i++)
    {
        if(ans[i]!=0)
        {
            result+=pow(2,i);
        }
    }
    cout<<result<<endl;
    return 0;
}

typedef long long ll ;

#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);

#define ss second

#define line cout<<endl;

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v;
            set<ll> s;
            ll ans=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll temp;
                cin>>temp;
                s.insert(temp);
            }
            for(auto x:s){
                v.pb(x);
            }
            srt(v);
            ll mex=v[sz(v)-1]+1;
            for(ll i=0;i<sz(v);i++){
                if(v[i]!=i){
                    mex=i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(mex==0){
                cout<<v[0]-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            if(mex==1){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            n = v.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < n;)
            {
                int cnt = 1;
                int j = i + 1;
                while (j < n && v[j] - v[j - 1] == 1)
                    ++cnt, j++;
                if (cnt >= (mex - 1))
                ++ans;
                i = j;
            }
            --ans;
            cout << ans << endl;
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

{
    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

    ll res = 1;

    {    
        if (y & 1)

                v.pb(temp);

        {
            srtGreat(v);

            cout<<-1<<endl;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

ll solve()
{
    ll x,k;
    cin>>x>>k;
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=2;i<=sqrt(x);i++){
        if(x%i==0){
            while(x%i==0){
                x/=i;
                count++;
            }
        }
    }

        count++;
    }

        {
            loop(j,0,i+1)

            }
        }

        {
            loop(j,0,i+1)
            {
                v[i][j]+=max(v[i+1][j],v[i+1][j+1]);
