<problem>
Title: SUMXOR2
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll mod=998244353;
vector<ll>ans(200001,0);
vector<vector<ll>> cal_ncr(10000,vector<ll>(10000,0));
// partially accepted
void ncr()
{
	cal_ncr[0][0]=1;
	for(ll i=1;i<10000;i++)
	{
		cal_ncr[i][0]=1;
		for(ll j=1;j<10000;j++)
		{
			cal_ncr[i][j]=((cal_ncr[i-1][j]%mod)+(cal_ncr[i-1][j-1]%mod))%mod;
		}
	}
}
ll compute(ll i,vector<ll>& bits,ll n)
{
	ll temp_ans=0;
	for(ll k=0;k<31;k++)
	{
		ll set_bit=bits[k];
		ll non_set_bit=n-set_bit;
        ll temp=0;
		if(set_bit>0)
		{
            for(ll j=1;j<=set_bit&&j<=i;j+=2)
			{
                temp+=((cal_ncr[set_bit][j]%mod)*(cal_ncr[non_set_bit][i-j]%mod))%mod;
			}
		}
        temp_ans+=(((1<<k)%mod)*(temp%mod))%mod;
	}
	return temp_ans;
}
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ncr();
    vector<ll>bits(31,0);
    vector<ll> v(n);
    ll temp_sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
    	cin>>v[i];
    	ll temp=v[i];
    	temp_sum+=v[i];
    	ll pos=0;
    	while(temp)
    	{
    		if(temp&1)
    			bits[pos]++;
    		pos++;
    		temp>>=1;
    	}
    }
    //  set bits  
    // for(ll i=0;i<31;i++)
    // {
    // 	if(bits[i]>0)
    // 	{
    // 		cout<<"set bit at "<<i<<" and its fre "<<bits[i]<<endl;
    // 	}
    // }
    //  compute xor for all k length subset
    for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++)
    {
    	if(i==0)
    	{
    		ans[i]=0;
    	}
        else if(i==1)
            ans[i]=temp_sum%mod;
    	else
    	{
    		ll tempo=compute(i,bits,n);
    		tempo%=mod;
    		ans[i]=((ans[i-1]%mod)+(tempo%mod))%mod;
    		ans[i]%=mod;
    	}
    }
    ll queries;
    cin>>queries;
    while(queries--)
    {
    	ll M;
    	cin>>M;
    	cout<<ans[M]%mod<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    // cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    cin >> s >> t;
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i < n;i++)
    {
        if(s[i] == '1') cnt1++;
        if(t[i] == '1') cnt2++;
    }
    if(cnt1 != cnt2)
    {
        no;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<int> store1, store2;
    for(int i = 0;i < n;i++) 
    {
        if(s[i] == '1' && s[i] != t[i]) store1.pb(i);
        if(t[i] == '1' && s[i] != t[i]) store2.pb(i);
    }
    reverse(all(store2));
    for(int x : store2) 
    {
        if(x > store1.back())
        {
            store1.pop_back();
        }
        else 
        {
            no;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;
}

<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
bool check(char grid[3][3],char ch){
	ll count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<3;i++){
		count=0;
		for(ll j=0;j<3;j++){
			if(grid[i][j]==ch)
				count++;
		}
		if(count==3)
			return true;
		count=0;
		for(ll j=0;j<3;j++){
			if(grid[j][i]==ch)
				count++;
		}
		if(count==3)
			return true;
	}
	count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<3;i++){
		if(grid[i][i]==ch)
			count++;
	}
	if(count==3)
		return true;
	count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<3;i++){
		if(grid[i][2-i]==ch)
			count++;
	}
	if(count==3)
		return true;
	else
		return false;
}
long long solve()
{
    char grid[3][3];
    ll no_of_spaces=0,no_of_O=0,no_of_X=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<3;i++){
    	for(ll j=0;j<3;j++){
    		cin>>grid[i][j];
    		if(grid[i][j]=='_')
    			no_of_spaces++;
    		else if(grid[i][j]=='O')
    			no_of_O++;
    		else
    			no_of_X++;
    	}
    }
    if(no_of_O>no_of_X||(no_of_X-no_of_O)>1)
    	cout<<3<<endl;
    else{
    	bool check_X=check(grid,'X');
    	bool check_O=check(grid,'O');
    	if(check_O==true&&check_X==true)
    		cout<<3<<endl;
    	else if(no_of_X>no_of_O&&check_O==true)
    		cout<<3<<endl;
    	else if(no_of_X==no_of_O&&check_X==true)
    		cout<<3<<endl;
    	else if(check_X==true||check_O==true||no_of_spaces==0)
    		cout<<1<<endl;
    	else
    		cout<<2<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test=1;
    cin>>test;
    // scanf("%lld",&test);
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
/* tc
1
4
hell bell cest test
*/
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    scanf("%lld",&n);
    ll ans=0;
    vector<string> v(n);
    map<string,array<ll,26>> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>v[i];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        string temp=v[i].substr(1);
        m[temp][v[i][0]-'a']++;
        // cout<<"temp is "<<temp<<endl;
    }
    for(auto w:m)
    {
        for(auto x:m)
        {
            if(x.first!=w.first)
            {
                ll sum1=0,sum2=0;
                for(ll i=0;i<26;i++)
                {
                    if(x.second[i]!=0&&w.second[i]==0)
                    {
                        // cout<<"in m first is "<<char('a'+i)<<endl;
                        sum1+=x.second[i];
                    }
                    if(x.second[i]==0&&w.second[i]!=0)
                    {
                        // cout<<"in m2 first is "<<char('a'+i)<<endl;
                        sum2+=w.second[i];
                    }
                }
                ans+=sum1*sum2;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n",ans);
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

                        flag=1;

ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    int cnt[26] = {0};
    for(char c : s) {
        cnt[c - 'a']++;
    }
    int x[3] = {0};
    for(int i = 0;i < 26;i++) {
        if(cnt[i] & 1) {
            x[1]++;
            cnt[i]--;
        }
        x[2] += cnt[i] / 2;
        cnt[i] = 0;
    }
    int ans = 0;
    int p = min(x[1], x[2]);
    ans += p;
    x[1] -= p;
    x[2] -= p;
    int remaining = x[2] * 2;
    ans += remaining / 3;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

ll solve()
{
    ll N,win=0,loss=0,maxo=0;
    cin>>N;
    ll c1=0,c2=0;
    while(N--)
    {
        ll S,T,b;
        cin>>S>>T;
        c1=c1+S;
        c2=c2+T;
        if(c1>c2)
        {
            win=c1-c2;
            if(win>maxo)
            {
                maxo=win;
                loss=1;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            win=c2-c1;
            if(win>maxo)
            {
                maxo=win;
                loss=2;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<loss<<" "<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

            }
            else
            {
                first1+=v[i];
            }
            flag=0;
        }
    }

        cout<<"first"<<endl;
    else if(first1>second1)
        cout<<"second"<<endl;

        cout<<"draw"<<endl;

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }

        {
            loop(j,0,n)
                cin>>arr[i][j];
        }
        ll maxo=0;
        loop(i,0,n)
        {
            loop(j,0,n)
            {
                ll sum=arr[i][j];
                ll temp1=i,temp2=j;
                while(temp1<n-1&&temp2<n-1)
                {
                    sum+=arr[temp1+1][temp2+1];
                    temp1++;
                    temp2++;
                    maxo=max(maxo,sum);
                    // cout<<"pos is "<<temp1<<" "<<temp2<<endl;
                    // cout<<"maxo is "<<maxo<<endl;
                    // cout<<"sum is "<<sum<<endl;
                }
                maxo=max(maxo,sum);
            }
        }
        cout<<maxo<<endl;
    }
}

                flag=1;
        }
        loop0(d1){
            if(set2.find(b[i])==set2.end())
                flag=1;

        else{
            cout<<"no"<<endl;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}

	ll n;

	srt(v);
	for(auto s:v)
		cout<<s<<endl;

    ll count=0;
    while(k--)
    {
        string s;
        ll n;
        cin>>s;
        if(s!="CLOSEALL")
        {
            cin>>n;
            if(v[n]==false)
            {
                count++;
                cout<<count<<endl;
                v[n]=true;
            }
            else if(v[n]==true)
            {
                v[n]=false;
                count--;
                cout<<count<<endl;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            count=0;
            cout<<count<<endl;
            loop(i,1,n1+1)
                v[i]=false;
        }
    }
}

        printf("%lld\n%lld %lld\n",1LL,1LL,1LL);

            printf("%lld %lld %lld %lld\n",3LL,1LL,2LL,n);

        else
            printf("%lld %lld %lld\n",2LL,1LL,2LL);

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll solve()
{
    ll n,d;
    string s;
    cin>>n>>s>>d;
    vl v;
    vector<ll>::iterator it;
    ll b[n];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        b[i]=1000000;
    for(ll i=0;i<d;i++)
    {
        ll p;
        cin>>p;
        b[p-1]=i+1;
    }
    if(s[0]=='1'&&s[1]=='0')
        v.pb(0);
    for(ll i=1;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='1'&&(s[i-1]=='0'||s[i+1]=='0'))
            v.pb(i);
    }
    if(s[n-1]=='1'&&s[n-2]=='0')
        v.pb(n-1);
    v.pb(-1);
    for(ll i=1;i<=d;i++)
    {
        if(v[0]==-1)
            break;
        else
        {
            while(v[0]!=-1)
            {
                if(s[v[0]-1]=='0'&&b[v[0]]>i&&v[0]>0)
                {
                    s[v[0]-1]='1';
                    v.pb(v[0]-1);
                }
                if(s[v[0]+1]=='0' && b[v[0]+1]>i && v[0]<n-1)
                {  
                    s[v[0]+1]='1';
                    v.push_back(v[0]+1);
                }
                it = v.begin(); 
                v.erase(it);
            }
            v.push_back(-1);
            it = v.begin(); 
            v.erase(it);
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='1')
            ans++;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
// tc
/* 1
4 14
4 9 9 10
ans is 4*/
long long pankaj=0,flag=0;
set<pair<long long,long long>> func(set<pair<long long,long long>> st,long long element,long long k)
{
    set<pair<long long,long long>> ans;
    pankaj++;
    for(auto x:st)
    {
        // cout<<"x is "<<x.first<<" "<<x.second<<" and element is "<<element<<endl;
        long long a=x.first;
        long long b=x.second;
        if(a<k)
            ans.insert({a+element,b});
        if(b+element>a)
            ans.insert({b+element,a});
        else
            ans.insert({a,b+element});
        if(b+element>=k&&a>=k)
        {
            // cout<<"a "<<a<<" "<<b<<" "<<element<<endl;
            flag=1;
            return ans;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
long long solve()
{
    long long n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    pankaj=0;
    flag=0;
    vector<long long> v(n);
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>v[i];
    set<pair<long long,long long>> s;
    sort(v.begin(),v.end(),greater<long long>());
    s.insert({0,0});
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        s=func(s,v[i],k);
        // cout<<"in set element "<<i<<endl;
        // for(auto x:s)
        // {
        //     cout<<x.first<<" "<<x.second<<endl;
        // }
        if(flag==1)
        {
            cout<<pankaj<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    // #ifndef ONLINEJUDGE
    //     freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    long long test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

*/

ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl a(n),b(n);
	forin(a,n);
	forin(b,n);
	ll count=0,sum1=0,sum2=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		sum1+=a[i];
		sum2+=b[i];
		if(sum1==sum2)
			if(a[i]==b[i])
				count+=a[i];
	}
	cout<<count<<endl;
	return 0;
}

#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll power(ll a,ll b,ll mod){
    ll ans=1;
    a=a%mod;
    while(b>0){
        if(b&1){
            ans=(ans*a);
            ans=ans%mod;
        }
        b/=2;
        a*=a;
        a%=mod;
    }
    return ans;
}
long long solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    n--;
    ll mod=1e9+7;
    cout<<ll(power(2,n,mod))<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0){
        if(y%2==1){
            res*=x;

    //Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
    //priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/

const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve(){
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    vector<vector<ll>> set_bit(n+1,vector<ll>(32,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    // precalculation
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=v[i];
        ll msb=0;
        while(temp){
            msb++;
            temp/=2;
        }
        set_bit[i+1][msb]++;
        for(ll j=0;j<32;j++){
            set_bit[i+1][j]+=set_bit[i][j];
        }
    }
    ll queries;
    cin>>queries;
    while(queries--){
        ll l,r,x;
        cin>>l>>r>>x;
        ll ans=0;
        ll msb=0;
        while(x){
            msb++;
            x/=2;
        }
        for(ll j=0;j<32;j++){
            if(j!=msb){
                ans+=set_bit[r][j]-set_bit[l-1][j];
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    } 
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

        ll x;

        ll z;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl a(n),b(n),c(n);
    forin(a,n);
    forin(b,n);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        ans^=a[i];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        ans^=b[i];
    vl final(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        final[i]=ans^a[i];
    }
    c=final;
    srt(final);
    srt(b);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(final[i]!=b[i]){
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    printv(c);
    return 0;
}

/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl bits_count(32,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        ll pos=0;
        while(temp){
            if(temp&1){
                bits_count[pos]++;
            }
            pos++;
            temp>>=1;
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(auto x:bits_count){
        ans+=(x+k-1)/k;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	v[n+1]=0;

		cin>>v[i];

	ll sum1=0,sum3=0,maxo=0;

			maxo=sum1;
			sum1+=v[++i];
			sum3+=v[--j];

		}
		else
			sum1+=v[++i];

	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

{
	ll n,k;
	cin>>n>>k;
	map<ll,ll> m;
	vl v(n,0);
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>v[i];
		m[v[i]]++;
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if(m[v[i]]>=2)
		{
			cout<<0<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if((v[i]&k)!=v[i]&&m.count((v[i]&k))>=1)
		{
			cout<<1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if((v[i]&k)!=v[i])
			m[(v[i]&k)]++;
		if(m.count((v[i]&k))&&m[(v[i]&k)]>=2)
		{
			cout<<2<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	cout<<-1<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);

#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	string s,t;
	cin>>s>>t;
	vector<ll>v(26,0);
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		v[ll(s[i]-'a')]++;
		v[ll(t[i]-'a')]--;
	}
	for(ll i=0;i<26;i++)
		if(v[i]!=0)
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	vl ans;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if(s[i]!=t[i])
		{
			ll pos=0;
			for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++)
			{
				if(s[j]==t[i])
				{
					pos=j;
					break;
				}
			}
			for(ll j=pos-1;j>=i;j--)
			{
				swap(s[j],s[j+1]);
				ans.pb(j+1);
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<ans.size()<<endl;
	for(auto x:ans)
		cout<<x<<" ";
	line;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
}

	{
		if(s[i]=='*')
		{
			star=1;
			break;
		}
	}
	if(star==1)
	{
		for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)

		{
			cout<<"YES"<<Endl;
		}
		else
			no;
	}
	else
	{
		if(n==m)
		{
			for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				if(s[i]!=t[i])
				{
					flag=1;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(flag==0)
				yes
			else
				no
		}

			no
	}

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
vl prime_no;
void prime(ll x){
    for(ll i=2;i*i<=x;i++){
        if(x%i==0){
            while(x%i==0){
                x/=i;
            }
            prime_no.pb(i);
        }
    }
    if(x>1){
        prime_no.pb(x);
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v[i]={a,b};
    }
    prime(v[0].ff);
    prime(v[0].ss);
    for(auto x:prime_no){
        ll flag=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(v[i].ff%x!=0&&v[i].ss%x!=0){
                flag++;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(flag==0){
            cout<<x<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	ll ans=1,count=1;
	for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
	{
		if(v[i]<=(2*v[i-1]))

		else

    bx-=ax;
    cx-=ax;
    by-=ay;
    cy-=ay;

    forin(v,n);
    srt(v);
    ll ans=0;
    ll mid=(n-1)/2;
    if(v[mid]==s)
        cout<<0<<endl;
    else if(v[mid]<s){
        for(ll i=mid;i<n;i++){
            if(v[i]>=s)
                break;
            else{
                ans+=abs(s-v[i]);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    else{
        for(ll i=mid;i>=0;i--){
            if(v[i]<=s)
                break;
            else{
                ans+=abs(v[i]-s);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;

    ll ans=0;
    string a,b;
    cin>>a>>b;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(a[i]!=b[i]){
            if(i+1<n){
                if(a[i+1]==b[i]&&b[i+1]==a[i]){
                    swap(a[i],a[i+1]);
                    ans++;
                }
                else{
                    a[i]=b[i];
                    ans++;
                }
            }
            else{
                a[i]=b[i];
                ans++;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;

            // res=res%mod;

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll N=1e5+5;
ll a[N],b[N];
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>a[i];
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>b[i];
    sort(a+1,a+n+1);
    sort(b+1,b+n+1);
    reverse(a+1,a+n+1);
    reverse(b+1,b+n+1);
    ll pos1=1,pos2=1,flag=0;
    ll asum=0,bsum=0;
    while(1){
        if(pos1>n&&pos2>n)
            break;
        else{
            if(!flag){
                if(a[pos1]>=b[pos2]){
                    asum+=a[pos1];
                    pos1++;
                }
                else
                    pos2++;
            }
            else{
                if(b[pos2]>=a[pos1]){
                    bsum+=b[pos2];
                    pos2++;
                }
                else
                    pos1++;
            }
            flag^=1;
        }
    }
    cout<<asum-bsum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        solve();

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)

        cin>>v[i];
        sum+=v[i];
        maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
        mini=min(mini,v[i]);
    }
    ll ans1=0,ans2=0;
    ans2=maxo+k;
    if((n*maxo-sum)>=k)
    {
        cout<<maxo<<" "<<ans2<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        ll diff=k-(n*maxo-sum);
        ans1=diff/n;
        if(diff%n!=0)
            ans1++;
        cout<<maxo+ans1<<" "<<ans2<<endl;
    }
}

    if(m["AC"]&&m["BC"])
        ans=min(ans,m["AC"]+m["BC"]);

        ans=-1;

{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    ll upper=0,lower=0,num=0;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x>='A'&&x<='Z')
            upper++;
        else if(x>='a'&&x<='z')
            lower++;
        else
            num++;
    }
    if(num==0&&lower==0){
        s[0]='a',s[1]='1';
    }
    else if(lower==0&&upper==0)
        s[0]='a',s[1]='A';
    else if(num==0&&upper==0)
        s[0]='1',s[1]='A';
    else if(num==0){
        if(upper>1){
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(isupper(s[i])){
                    s[i]='1';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(islower(s[i])){
                    s[i]='1';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else if(lower==0){
        if(upper>1){
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(isupper(s[i])){
                    s[i]='a';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(isdigit(s[i])){
                    s[i]='a';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else if(upper==0){
        if(lower>1){
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(islower(s[i])){
                    s[i]='A';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(isdigit(s[i])){
                    s[i]='A';
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

    cin>>n;
    ll sum=0;
    if(n<=9)
        sum=n;
    else
    {
        while(n>9)
        {
            n=n-9;
            sum+=9+n%10;
            n=n/10;
        }
        sum+=n;
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
}

<problem>
Title: 1062B Math
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int solve()
{
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    map<int, int> factor;
    int temp = n, ans = 1;
    int maxo = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= int(n); i++)
    {
        if (temp % i == 0)
        {
            ans *= i;
            while (temp % i == 0)
            {
                temp /= i;
                factor[i]++;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << " ";
    int count = 0, count2 = 0;
    while (1)
    {
        maxo = 0;
        for (auto x : factor)
        {
            maxo = max(maxo, x.second);
        }
        // if you use maxo !=1 then it will give you tle, due to n=1 case
        if (maxo > 1)
        {
            count++;
            for (auto x : factor)
            {
                if (x.second % 2 == 0)
                {
                    factor[x.first] /= 2;
                }
                else
                {
                    factor[x.first]++;
                    factor[x.first] /= 2;
                    count2++;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    if (count2)
    {
        count++;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase = 1;
    while (testCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

		if(no%i==0)
			flag=1;
	if(flag==0)
		return 1;
	else
		return 0;

#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<ll>temp(n+m),a,b,ans(m,0);
    forin(temp,(n+m));
    for(ll i=0;i<(n+m);i++)
    {
        ll x;
        cin>>x;
        if(x==1)
            b.pb(temp[i]);
        else
            a.pb(temp[i]);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll pos=(ll)(lower_bound(all(b),a[i])-b.begin());
        if(pos==m)
            ans[m-1]++;
        else if(pos==0)
            ans[0]++;
        else
        {
            if(b[pos]-a[i]<a[i]-b[pos-1])
                ans[pos]++;
            else
                ans[pos-1]++;
        }
    }
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}

        sum+=v[i];

typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007;
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define loopi(a,b) for(int i=a;i<=b;i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	int n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n/2,0);
	vl ans(n,0);
	for(auto &s:v)
		cin>>s;
	ll sum=0;
	int flag=0;
	for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++)
	{
		ll temp=0;
		sum+=v[i];
		temp=int(sqrt(sum));
		for(ll j=temp+1;j<10000000;j++)
		{
			ll temp_square=j*j;
			ll temp_diff=temp_square-sum;
			ll temp_sqrt=sqrt(temp_diff);
			ll temp_previous=sum-v[i]+temp_diff;
			ll temp_previous_sqrt=sqrt(temp_previous);
			if(temp_previous_sqrt*temp_previous_sqrt==temp_previous)
			{
				sum+=temp_diff;
				ans[flag]=temp_diff;
				ans[flag+1]=v[i];
				flag+=2;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	if(flag<n)
		cout<<"No"<<endl;
	else
	{
		cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			if(ans[i]!=0)
				cout<<ans[i]<<" ";
		}
	}
	line;
	// cout<<"no of terms is "<<flag<<Endl;
}

    if(r%d==0)
        a=r/d;

    else
        a=-1;

    return 0;

	for(auto &s:v)
		cin>>s;
	sort(v.begin(),v.end());
	loop0(n)
	{
		if(v[i]!=0)
		{
			cout<<v[i]<<endl;
			k--;
			for(ll j=i+1;j<n&&k>0;j++)
			{
				if(v[j]-v[j-1])
				{
					k--;
					cout<<(v[j]-v[j-1])<<endl;
				}
			}
			break;
		}
	}
	while(k>0)
	{
		k--;
		cout<<0<<endl;
	}
}

    {
        m++;
        if(m==60)
        {
            m=0;
            h=(h+1)%24;
        }
        if(m%10==h/10&&m/10==h%10)
        {
            printf("%02lld:%02lld\n",h,m);
            return 0;
        }

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,temp1,temp2;
    cin>>n;
    map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> m;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> a(n),b(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp1>>temp2;
        a[i]=mp(temp1,temp2);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp1>>temp2;
        b[i]=mp(temp1,temp2);
    }
    ll sum1=0,sum2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            sum1=a[i].ff+b[j].ff;
            sum2=a[i].ss+b[j].ss;
            m[mp(sum1,sum2)]++;
        }
    }
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        if(x.ss==n)
        {
            cout<<x.ff.ff<<" "<<x.ff.ss<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan
    solve();
}

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	ll count=0;
	stack<char> q;
	for(ll i=0;i<s.length();i++)
	{
		if(q.empty())
		{
			// cout<<"khali "<<Endl;
			q.push(s[i]);
		}
		else if(q.top()!=s[i])
		{
			q.push(s[i]);
		}
		else
		{
			q.pop();
			count++;
		}
	}
	if(count&1)
		yes
	else
		no
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	ll temp_sum=0;
	ll ans=0,mini=LONG_MAX;
	for(ll i=1;i<=10000;i++)
	{
		temp_sum=0;
		for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
		{
			if(v[j]>(i+1)||v[j]<(i-1))
			{
				temp_sum+=abs(v[j]-i);
				temp_sum--;
			}
		}
		if(temp_sum<mini)
		{
			mini=temp_sum;
			ans=i;
		}
	}
	cout<<ans<<" "<<mini<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	solve();

    {

                Q.push(x);
                check[x]=true;
            }
        } 
    }
    line;

			if(s1[i]=='a'||s1[i]=='e'||s1[i]=='i'||s1[i]=='o'||s1[i]=='u')
			{
				if(s2[i]=='a'||s2[i]=='e'||s2[i]=='i'||s2[i]=='o'||s2[i]=='u')
					continue;
				else
				{
					flag=1;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if(s2[i]=='a'||s2[i]=='e'||s2[i]=='i'||s2[i]=='o'||s2[i]=='u')
				{
					flag=1;
					break;
				}
				else
					continue;
			}
		}
		if(flag==0)
			yes
		else
			no
	}
	else
		no
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {

    {
        cin>>v[i];
        maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
    }
    ll count=0,maxo_s=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]==maxo)
        {
            count++;
        }
        else
        {
            maxo_s=max(maxo_s,count);
            count=0;
        }
    }
    maxo_s=max(maxo_s,count);
    cout<<maxo_s<<endl;
}

// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll osuf=0,esuf=0,opre=0,epre=0;
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]=temp;
        if(i&1)
            esuf+=temp;
        else
            osuf+=temp;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i&1)
            esuf-=v[i];
        else
            osuf-=v[i];
        if((osuf+epre)==(opre+esuf))
            count++;
        if(i&1)
            epre+=v[i];
        else
            opre+=v[i];
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

*/

int solve()

	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	srt(v);
	ll maxo=0;
	ll j=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		while(j<n&&(v[j]-v[i])<=5)
		{
			j++;
			maxo=max(maxo,(j-i));
		}
	}
	cout<<maxo<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	vl even_v,odd_v ;

	{

	if(temp==0||temp==1)
		cout<<0<<endl;
	else
	{
		ll sum=0;
		if(odd>even)
		{
			sort(odd_v.begin(),odd_v.end());
			loop(i,0,temp-1)
			{
				sum+=odd_v[i];
			}
		}
		else
		{
			sort(even_v.begin(),even_v.end());
			loop(i,0,temp-1)
			{
				sum+=even_v[i];
			}
		}
		cout<<sum<<endl;
	}
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,ll y)

	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

	{
		ll temp;
		cin>>temp;
		if(temp==1)
			one++;
		else
			two++;
	}
	if(two>0)
	{
		two--;
		cout<<2<<" ";
	}
	if(one>0)
	{
		one--;
		cout<<1<<" ";
	}
	while(two--)
		cout<<2<<" ";
	while(one--)
		cout<<1<<" ";
	line;
	return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    set<ll> s;
    ll temp;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        s.insert(temp);
    }
    if(s.size()>3)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if(s.size()==1)
    {
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if(s.size()==2)
    {
        vl ans;
        for(auto x:s)
            ans.pb(x);
        if(abs(ans[1]-ans[0])%2==0)
            cout<<abs(ans[1]-ans[0])/2<<endl;
        else
            cout<<abs(ans[1]-ans[0])<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vl ans;
    for(auto x:s)
        ans.pb(x);
    srt(ans);
    if(ans[0]+ans[2]==2*ans[1])
    {
        cout<<abs(ans[1]-ans[0])<<endl;
    }
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

    {
        if(s[i]=='8')
        {
            if(count1>0)

*/

	int n;

	for(auto &s:v)
		cin>>s;
	int flag=0,count=0;
	for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++)
	{
		if((v[i]==2&&v[i+1]==3)||(v[i]==3&&v[i+1]==2)||(v[i]==v[i+1]))
		{
			flag++;
		}
		else if(v[i+1]==2&&v[i-1]==3&&i>=1)
			count+=2;
		else if((v[i]==2&&v[i+1]==1)||(v[i+1]==2&&v[i]==1))
			count+=3;
		else
			count+=4;
	}
	if(flag>0)
		cout<<"Infinite"<<endl;
	else
	{
		cout<<"Finite"<<endl;

            first[d]++;

ll prime(ll num)
{

    {
        if(num%i==0)
            return i;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(prime(n)==0)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;

    else
    {

        vector<char> v={'a','e','i','o','u'};
        ll pos=0;
        if(temp<5||n/temp<5)
            cout<<-1<<endl;
        else
        {
            for(ll i=0;i<(n/temp);i++)
            {
                pos=i;
                for(ll j=0;j<temp;j++)
                {
                    if(pos>=5)
                        pos=0;
                    cout<<v[pos];
                    pos++;
                }
            }
        }
        line;
    }

#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);

// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
const ll N=500000+15;
vl ans(N,0);
set<ll> s;
void dfs(vector<vector<ll>>&graph,ll node,vector<bool>&check){
    if(check[node]){
        return ;
    }
    check[node]=true;
    s.insert(node);
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        if(check[x]==false){
            dfs(graph,x,check);
        }
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        ll t;
        cin>>t;
        vl v(t);
        forin(v,t);
        if(t>1){
            for(ll j=1;j<t;j++){
                graph[v[j]].pb(v[0]);
                graph[v[0]].pb(v[j]);
            }
        }
    }
    vector<bool>check1(n+1,false);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(check1[i]==false){
            dfs(graph,i,check1);
            for(auto x:s){
                ans[x]=sz(s);
            }
            s.clear();
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cout<<ans[i]<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    //cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll count=0;
    vector<vector<char>> v(n,vector<char>(m));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>v[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(v[i][j]=='W')
            {
                if(j-1>=0&&v[i][j-1]=='P')
                {
                    v[i][j-1]='.';
                    count++;
                }
                else if(j+1<m&&v[i][j+1]=='P')
                {
                    v[i][j+1]='.';
                    count++;
                }
                else if(i-1>=0&&v[i-1][j]=='P')
                {
                    v[i-1][j]='.';
                    count++;
                }
                else if(i+1<n&&v[i+1][j]=='P')
                {
                    v[i+1][j]='.';
                    count++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
}

            one++;

            two++;

    one-=temp;
    two-=temp;
    count+=temp;
    if(one>2)

        temp=one/3;
        count+=temp;
    }
    if(two>2)
        count+=two/3;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;

// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n,m;
            cin>>n>>m;
            vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
            ll mini=LONG_MAX;
            for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
                ll a,b;
                cin>>a>>b;
                mini=min(mini,a);
                mini=min(mini,b);
                graph[a].pb(b);
                graph[b].pb(a);
            }
            vl ans(n+1,-1);
            vector<bool>check(n+1,false);
            ll one=0,zero=0;
            queue<ll> bfs;
            bfs.push(1);
            ans[1]=0;
            zero++;
            check[1]=true;
            while(sz(bfs)){
                ll node=bfs.front();
                bfs.pop();
                for(auto x:graph[node]){
                    if(check[x]==false){
                        bfs.push(x);
                        check[x]=true;
                        ans[x]=ans[node]^1;
                        if(ans[x]==1){
                            one++;
                        }
                        else{
                            zero++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            ll temp=0;
            if(zero>one){
                temp=1;
            }
            // cout<<"temp"<<temp<<" "<<one<<" "<<zero<<endl;
            // printv(ans);
            ll count=0;
            for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
                if(ans[i]==temp){
                    count++;
                }
            }
            cout<<count<<endl;
            for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
                if(ans[i]==temp){
                    cout<<i<<" ";
                }
            }
            line;
            return 0;
        }
};

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);

    {
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();

}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
        vl v;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
            v.resize(17);
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        void cal(vector<ll>& v){
            for(ll i=1;i<=16;i++){
                this->v[i]=((9*i*pow(10,i-1)));
            }
            return ;
        }
        ll solve()
        {
            cal(this->v);
            // printv(this->v);
            ll query=1;
            // cin>>query;
            while(query--){
                ll k;
                cin>>k;
                ll sum=0;
                ll length_of_number=0;
                for(ll i=0;i<17;i++){
                    sum+=this->v[i];
                    if(sum<=k){
                        length_of_number=i+1;
                    }
                    else{
                        break;
                    }
                }
                sum-=this->v[length_of_number];
                // cout<<"sum : "<<sum<<endl;
                ll difference=k-sum;
                // cout<<"difference : "<<difference<<endl;
                ll starting_number=pow(10,length_of_number-1);
                ll distance_from_starting_number=(difference/length_of_number);
                sum+=(distance_from_starting_number*length_of_number);
                ll actual_number=starting_number+distance_from_starting_number-1;
                ll remainder=difference%length_of_number;
                // cout<<"remainder : "<<remainder<<endl;
                // cout<<"actual_number : "<<actual_number<<endl;
                // cout<<"sum : "<<sum<<endl;
                if(remainder==0){
                    cout<<actual_number%10<<endl;
                }
                else{
                    actual_number++;
                    string final_number_as_string=to_string(actual_number);
                    // cout<<"final actual number : "<<actual_number<<endl;
                    cout<<final_number_as_string[remainder-1]<<endl;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()

// to run ctrl+b

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
bool check(ll k,ll a,ll b,ll n,ll count){
    ll temp=k;
    temp-=(count*a);
    temp-=(n-count)*b;
    if(temp<=0){
        return false;
    }
    else{
        return true;
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll k,n,a,b;
    cin>>k>>n>>a>>b;
    ll low=0,high=n;
    while(high>low){
        ll mid=(low+high)/2;
        if(check(k,a,b,n,mid)){
            low=mid+1;
        }
        else{
            high=mid;
        }
    }
    if(!check(k,a,b,n,0)){
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if(check(k,a,b,n,n)){
        cout<<n<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    low--;
    cout<<low<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    {
        sum+=v[i];
        if(sum<=m)

                if(temp_sum<=m)
                    break;

            // count=ans.size()-count;
            cout<<count<<" ";
        }
    }

        ans[ll(s[i]-'a')].pb(i+1);

ll solve()
{
    ll dp[105][105][2];
    ll n1,n2,k1,k2;
    cin>>n1>>n2>>k1>>k2;
    dp[0][0][0]=dp[0][0][1]=1;
    for(ll i=0;i<=n1;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<=n2;j++)
        {
            for(ll k=1;k<=k1&&k<=i;k++)
            {
                dp[i][j][0]=(dp[i][j][0]+dp[i-k][j][1])%mod;
            }
            for(ll k=1;k<=k2&&k<=j;k++)
                dp[i][j][1]=(dp[i][j][1]+dp[i][j-k][0])%mod;
        }
    }
    ll ans=(dp[n1][n2][0]+dp[n1][n2][1])%mod;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    char v[n][m];
    vl row(n,0),col(m,0);
    ll white=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        white=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>v[i][j];
            if(v[i][j]=='.')
                white++;
        }
        row[i]=white;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        white=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            if(v[j][i]=='.')
                white++;
        }
        col[i]=white;
    }
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(v[i][j]=='.'){
                white=row[i]+col[j]-1;
            }
            else{
                white=row[i]+col[j];
            }
            mini=min(mini,white);
        }
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}

            return 0;
        }
        else
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        vector<bool> vp(p.length(),false);
        ll poss=0,flag=0,count=s.length();
        for(ll i=0;i<t.length();i++)
        {
            if(t[i]==s[poss])
            {
                poss++ ;
            }
            else
            {
                flag=0;
                for(ll j=0;j<p.length();j++)
                {
                    if(vp[j]==false&&p[j]==t[i])
                    {
                        count++;
                        flag=1;
                        vp[j]=true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(flag==0)
                {
                    // cout<<" at i  "<<i<<t[i]<<endl;
                    no
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
        // cout<<"count is "<<count<<endl;
        if(count==t.length())
            yes
        else
            no
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        sum+=temp;
        if(temp&1)
            odd.pb(i+1);

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    if(n==1)
        yes
    else
    {
        ll hav=m;
        for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
        {
            ll temp=max(0LL,v[i+1]-k);
            if(v[i]>=temp)
                hav+=v[i]-temp;
            else
            {
                ll need=temp-v[i];
                if(hav<need)
                {
                    no
                    return 0;
                }
                else
                    hav-=need;
            }
        }
        yes
    }
    return 0;
}

    pan;

    cc

	ll temp=v[0]*v[(4*n)-1];
	for(ll i=0;i<(2*n);i++)
	{
		// cout<<v[i]<<" "<<v[i+1]<<" "<<v[(4*n)-1-i]<<" "<<v[((4*n)-2-i)]<<endl;

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	if(n&1)
	{
		vector<ll> v(2*n,0);
		ll x=1,y=2*n,i=0,j=n,k=0;
		while(x<y)
		{
			if(!(k&1))
			{
				v[i++]=x;
				v[j++]=x+1;
				x+=2;
			}
			else
			{
				v[i++]=y;
				v[j++]=y-1;
				y-=2;
			}
			k++;
		}
		yes
		for(auto x:v)
			cout<<x<<" ";
		line;
	}
	else
		no
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49

// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> a(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
            cin>>a[i][j];
    }
    ll count=0;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
    for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j+1<m;j++)
        {
            if(a[i][j]*a[i+1][j]*a[i+1][j+1]*a[i][j+1]>0)
            {
                a[i][j]=2;
                a[i][j+1]=2;
                a[i+1][j]=2;
                a[i+1][j+1]=2;
                ans.pb({i+1,j+1});
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
            if(a[i][j]==1)
                count++;
    if(count!=0)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        cout<<ans.size()<<endl;
        for(auto x:ans)
            cout<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
    }
	return 0;
}

	pan
	solve();

    while (y > 0)

	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	vl mini(n,0);
	mini[0]=v[n-1];
	ll pos=1;
	for(ll i=n-2;i>=0;i--)
	{
		mini[pos]=min(mini[pos-1],v[i]);
		pos++;
	}
	reverse(all(mini));
	ll count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
	{
		if(v[i]>mini[i])
			count++;
	}

	return 0;

	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll a1,a2,k1,k2,n;
	cin>>a1>>a2>>k1>>k2>>n;
	ll mini=0,maxo=0;
	if(k1>k2)
	{
		swap(k1,k2);
		swap(a1,a2);
	}
	if(n-(a1*(k1-1)+(a2*(k2-1)))<=0)

		mini=n-(a1*(k1-1)+(a2*(k2-1)));

		maxo=n/k1;
	else
	{
		maxo=a1+(n-(a1*k1))/k2;
	}
	cout<<mini<<" "<<maxo<<endl;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

set<ll> st;
void dfs(string s)
{
    if(sz(s)>10)
        return ;
    ll num=stoll(s);
    st.insert(num);
    dfs(s+'4');
    dfs(s+'7');
}
ll solve()
{
    dfs("4");
    dfs("7");
    ll l,r;
    cin>>l>>r;
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++)
    {
        ll next=*(st.lower_bound(i));
        sum+=(min(r,next)-i+1)*next;
        i=next;
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
}

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

    cin>>n;
    ll flag=0,flag1=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(flag1==0)
        {
            flag1=1;
            flag=0;
        }
        else
        {
            flag1=0;
            flag=1;
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(flag==0)
            {
                flag=1;
                cout<<"B";
            }
            else
            {
                flag=0;
                cout<<"W";
            }
        }
        line
    }
}

    map<ll,ll> m;
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<d;i++){
        m[v[i]]++;

    mini=min(mini,sz(m));

        if(m[v[i-d]]==1)
            m.erase(v[i-d]);
        else
            m[v[i-d]]--;
        m[v[i]]++;
        mini=min(mini,sz(m));

    return to_string(num);

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod2=998244353;
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k,d;
    cin>>n>>k>>d;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<d;i++){
        m[v[i]]++;
    }
    mini=min(mini,sz(m));
    for(ll i=d;i<n;i++){
        if(m[v[i-d]]==1)
            m.erase(v[i-d]);
        else
            m[v[i-d]]--;
        m[v[i]]++;
        mini=min(mini,sz(m));
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

#define ff first
#define ss second

#define line cout<<endl;

#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(1000,vector<ll>(1000,0));
    ll temp=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>temp;
            v[i][j]=temp;
        }
    }
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        for(ll j=m-1;j>=0;j--)
        {
            if(v[i][j]==0)
                v[i][j]=min(v[i][j+1],v[i+1][j])-1;
            if(i!=0&&j!=0&&(v[i-1][j]>=v[i][j]||v[i][j-1]>=v[i][j]))
            {
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            count+=v[i][j];
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
}

class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    queue<ll> q;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    set<ll> s;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s.find(v[i])!=s.end()){
            continue;
        }
        else{
            if(sz(q)>=k){
                while(sz(q)>=k){
                    ll temp=q.front();
                    q.pop();
                    s.erase(s.find(temp));
                }
                s.insert(v[i]);
                q.push(v[i]);
            }
            else{
                s.insert(v[i]);
                q.push(v[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<sz(q)<<endl;
    vl ans;
    while(sz(q)){
        ans.pb(q.front());
        q.pop();
    }
    reverse(all(ans));
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll t;
	cin>>t;
	while(t--)
	{
		ll a,b,c,temp,res=0;
		cin>>a>>b>>c;
		temp=min(c/2,b);
		b-=temp;
		res+=temp;
		temp=min(b/2,a);
		res+=temp;

}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl in(n),out(n);
    forin(in,n);
    forin(out,n);
    ll pos=0;
    vector<bool> check(n+1,false);
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(pos>=n)
            break;
        if(in[i]==out[pos]){
            pos++;
            continue;
        }
        else if(check[in[i]]==false){
            check[out[pos]]=true;
            ll temp=pos;
            for(ll j=pos;j<n;j++){
                temp=j;
                if(out[j]!=in[i]){
                    count++;
                    check[out[j]]=true;
                }
                else{
                    break;
                }
            }
            pos=temp+1;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    map<char,ll> m;
    m['R']=a;
    m['P']=b;
    m['S']=c;
    string s,ans="";
    ll win=0,lose=0;
    cin>>s;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x=='R'){
            if(m['P']>0){
                win++;
                m['P']--;
                b--;
                ans+='P';
            }
            else
                ans+='@';
        }
        else if(x=='P'){
            if(m['S']>0){
                c--;
                win++;
                m['S']--;
                ans+='S';
            }
            else
                ans+='@';
        }
        else if(x=='S'){
            if(m['R']>0){
                a--;
                win++;
                m['R']--;
                ans+='R';
            }
            else
                ans+='@';
        }
    }
    if(win>=((n+1)/2)){
        yes
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(ans[i]=='@'){
                if(a>0){
                    a--;
                    ans[i]='R';
                }
                else if(b>0){
                    b--;
                    ans[i]='P';
                }
                else{
                    c--;
                    ans[i]='S';
                }
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    else
        no
    return 0;
}

ll solve()

    vector<ll> bit(33,0);
    ll temp=n,pos=0;
    while(temp){
        bit[pos]=temp%3;
        temp/=3;
        pos++;
    }
    // printv(bit);
    ll two=0,two_pos=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<32;i++){
        if(bit[i]==2){
            two++;
            two_pos=i;
        }
    }
    if(two_pos==-1)
        cout<<n<<endl;
    else{
        // cout<<"hi ";

        for(ll i=two_pos+1;i<33;i++){
            if(bit[i]==0)
            {
                change=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<change;i++)
            bit[i]=0;
        bit[change]=1;
        ll ans=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<33;i++){
            ans+=(bit[i]*pow(3,i));
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    n=sz(s);
    string ans="";
    vector<char>  even,odd;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=ll(s[i]-'0');
        if(temp%2==0){
            even.pb(s[i]);
        }
        else{
            odd.pb(s[i]);
        }
    }
    ll first=0,second=0;
    while(first<even.size()&&second<odd.size()){
        if(first>=sz(even)){
            ans+=odd[second++];
        }
        if(second>=sz(odd)){
            ans+=even[first++];
        }
        if(even[first]<odd[second]){
            ans+=even[first++];
        }
        else{
            ans+=odd[second++];
        }
    }
    while(first<sz(even)){
        ans+=even[first++];
    }
    while(second<sz(odd)){
        ans+=odd[second++];
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

	{

{
	pan;
	int test;

	while(test--)
	{
		string s;
		cin>>s;
		ll flag=0;
		loop(i,0,s.length()-1)
		{
			if(s[i]==s[i+1]&&s[i]!='?')
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
			else if(s[i]=='?'&&i>=1)
			{
				loop(j,'a','d')

			}

			loop(i,'a','d')
			{
				if(s[s.length()-2]!=i)
					s[s.length()-1]=char(i);
			}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    vl mini_v(n);
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]={temp,i+1};
    }
    srt(v);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        mini=min(mini,v[i].ss);
        mini_v[i]=mini;
    }
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        sum+=v[i].ss;
        ll temp=(i*(i+1))/2;
        if((sum-temp)%(i+1)==0&&((sum-temp)/(i+1))==mini_v[i])
            cout<<"1";
        else
            cout<<"0";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

    ll r,c;
    cin>>r>>c;
    vvl ans(r,vl(c,1));
    if(r==1||c==1){
        if(r==1&&c==1){
            cout<<0<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else if(r==1){
            ll temp=2;
            for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
                ans[0][j]=temp;
                temp++;
            }
        }
        else if(c==1){
            ll temp=2;
            for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
                ans[i][0]=temp++;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
                cout<<ans[i][j]<<" ";
            }
            line;
        }
    }
    else{
        ll temp=1;
        for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
                ans[i][j]*=temp;
            }
            temp++;
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<c;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<r;j++){
                ans[j][i]*=temp;
            }
            temp++;
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<r;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<c;j++){
                cout<<ans[i][j]<<" ";
            }
            line;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

	cin>>a>>b>>c>>d>>e>>f;
	if(e>f)
	{
		res+=min({a,d})*e;
		d-=min({a,d});
		res+=min({b,c,d})*f;
	}
	else
	{
		res+=min({b,c,d})*f;
		d-=min({b,c,d});
		res+=min({a,d})*e;
	}

Title: 1272B Snow Walking Robot
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve()
{
	string s;
	cin >> s;
	map<char, ll> m;
	for (auto x : s)
	{
		m[x]++;
	}
	ll minUD = min(m['U'], m['D']);
	ll minLR = min(m['L'], m['R']);
	if (minUD == 0 && minLR == 0)
	{
		cout << 0 << endl;
		cout << " " << endl;
	}
	else if (minUD == 0)
	{
		cout << 2 << endl
			 << "LR" << endl;
	}
	else if (minLR == 0)
	{
		cout << 2 << endl
			 << "UD" << endl;
	}
	else
	{
		string s = "";
		for (ll i = 0; i < minUD; i++)
		{
			s += 'U';
		}
		for (ll i = 0; i < minLR; i++)
		{
			s += 'R';
		}
		s += string(minUD, 'D');
		s += string(minLR, 'L');
		cout << s.size() << endl
			 << s << endl;
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	int testCase = 1;
	cin >> testCase;
	while (testCase--)
	{
		solve();
	}
	return 0;
}

	{
		if(y%2==1)

	for(ll i=0;i<k;i++)
	{
		char temp;
		cin>>temp;
		st.insert(temp);
	}
	ll count=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{

			s.insert(temp);

// to run ctrl+b
ll lcm(ll a, ll b) {
    return a * b / __gcd(a, b);
}
ll solve()
{
    ll x;
    cin >> x;
    const ll INF = 1e18;
    ll res = INF;
    pair<ll,ll> best;
    for (ll i = 1; i * i <= x; ++i)
    {
        if (x % i == 0)
        {
            ll y = x / i;
            if (res > max(i, y) && lcm(i, y) == x) {
                res = max(i, y);
                best = {i, y};
            }
        }
    }
    cout << best.first << ' ' << best.second;
    return 0;
}

#include<iostream>
#include<string>

int main()
{
	string str;
	int t,len,count,n;
	cin>>t;
	for(int j=0;j<t;j++)
	{
		cin>>n;
		str.resize(n);
		cin>>str;
		len=str.length();
		string cop;
		count=0;
		for(int i=0;i<len;i++)
		{
			if(str[i]!='0'&&str[i]!='2'&&str[i]!='4'&&str[i]!='6'&&str[i]!='8')
			{
				cop.push_back(str[i]);
				count++;
			}
			if(count==2)
			{
				break;
			}
		}
		if(cop.length()==0)
		{
			cout<<-1<<endl;
		}
		else
		{
			cout<<cop<<endl;
		}
	}
}

	string ans="";
	vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		ll a,b;
		cin>>a>>b;
		v.pb(mp(a,b));

	ll r=v[0].ff;
	ll u=v[0].ss;

	for(ll j=0;j<r;j++)
		ans+='R';

		ans+='U';

	{
		ll r=v[i].ff-v[i-1].ff;

			no
			return 0;
		}
		else
		{
			for(ll j=0;j<r;j++)
				ans+='R';
			for(ll j=0;j<u;j++)
				ans+='U';
		}
	}
	yes
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	vl ans1,ans2;
	ll l=0,r=s.length()-1;
	while(l<r)
	{
		while(l<s.length()&&s[l]==')')
			l++;
		while(r>=0&&s[r]=='(')
			r--;
		if(l<s.length()&&r>=0&&r>l)
		{
			ans1.pb(l+1);
			ans2.pb(r+1);
			l++;
			r--;
		}
	}
	if(ans1.size()==0)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	cout<<1<<endl;
	cout<<ans1.size()*2<<endl;
	for(auto x:ans1)
		cout<<x<<" ";
	reverse(all(ans2));
	for(auto x:ans2)
		cout<<x<<" ";
	line;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	pan
	solve();
    // cc
    // {
    // 	solve();
    // }
}

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        a[i]=temp;
    }
    vector<ll> p(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        p[temp-1]=1;
    }
    while(1)
    {
        bool ok=false;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(p[i]&&a[i]>a[i+1])
            {
                ok=true;
                swap(a[i],a[i+1]);
            }
        }
        if(!ok)
            break;
    }
    bool ok=true;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ok&=a[i]<=a[i+1];
    }
    if(ok)
        yes
    else
        no
    return 0;

    for(ll i=n-2;i>=0;i--){

            break;

{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n+1,0);
	for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
		cin>>v[i];
	vl ans((2*n)+1,0);
	vector<bool> check((2*n)+1);
	ll pos=1;
	for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
	{
		ans[pos]=v[i];
		pos+=2;
		check[v[i]]=true;
	}
	for(ll i=2;i<=(2*n);i+=2)
	{
		ll temp=ans[i-1];
		ll flag=0;
		// cout<<"temp is "<<temp<<" "<<i<<endl;
		for(ll k=temp+1;k<=(2*n);k++)
		{
			if(check[k]==false)
			{
				check[k]=true;
				ans[i]=k;
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
		}
		if(flag==0)
		{
			// cout<<"nahi mila "<<ans[i-1]<<endl;
			cout<<-1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
	}
	for(ll i=1;i<=(2*n);i++)
	{
		cout<<ans[i]<<" ";
	}
	line;
	return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll ncr[61][61];
void compute(){
    ncr[0][0]=1;
    for(ll i=1;i<=30;i++){
        ncr[i][0]=1;
        for(ll j=1;j<=30;j++)
            ncr[i][j]=ncr[i-1][j-1]+ncr[i-1][j];
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    compute();
    ll n,m,t;
    cin>>n>>m>>t;
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll boys=4;boys<=n;boys++){
        for(ll girls=1;girls<=m;girls++){
            if((boys+girls)==t){
                ans+=ncr[n][boys]*ncr[m][girls];
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    string s;
    cin>>n>>s;
    ll open=0,close=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='(')
            open++;
        else
            close++;
    }
    if(open==close){
        ll ans=0;
        vl prefix(n);
        ll count=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(s[i]=='(')
                count++;
            else
                count--;
            prefix[i]=count;
        }
        count=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(prefix[i]<0){
                count=0;
                while(i<n&&prefix[i]<=0){
                    count++;
                    i++;
                }
                i--;
                ans+=count;
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }   
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    {
       cin>>n;

       if(n==1)
       {
           cin>>arr[0];
           if(arr[0]%2==0)
           {
               cout<<1<<"\n"<<1<<endl;
           }
           else
           {
               cout<<-1<<endl;
           }
       }
       else
       {
           for(int k=0;k<n;k++)
           {
               cin>>arr[k];
           }
                if(arr[0]%2==0)
                {
                    cout<<1<<"\n"<<1<<endl;
                }
                else if(arr[1]%2==0)
                {
                    cout<<1<<"\n"<<2<<endl;
                }
                else if(arr[1]%2!=0)
                {
                    cout<<2<<"\n"<<1<<" "<<2<<endl;
                }
       }
    }

    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

            no

        {
            ll flag=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
            {
                for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++)
                {
                    if(v[i]==v[j]&&j-i>=2)
                    {
                        flag=1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(flag)
                    break;
            }
            if(flag)
                yes
            else
                no
