    vector<ll> ans;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll k;
        cin>>k;
        vl arr(k,0);
        forin(arr,k);
        for(ll j=0;j<k;j++)
        {
            if(boy[arr[j]-1]==1)
            {
                boy[arr[j]-1]=0;
                girl[i]=0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(girl[i]==1)
        {
            ans.push_back(i+1);
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(boy[i]==1)
        {
            boy[i]=0;
            ans.push_back(i+1);
            break;
        }
    }
    if(ans.size()==0)
        cout<<"OPTIMAL"<<endl;
    else
    {
        cout<<"IMPROVE"<<endl;
        for(auto x:ans)
            cout<<x<<" ";
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{

    string s="";
    for(ll i=1;i<=n-2;i++){
        s+='a';
    }
    s+="bb";
    // reverse(all(s));
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(s);i++){
        ll sum=(i*(i+1))/2;
        if(sum>=k){
            pos=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"pos is  "<<pos<<endl;
    swap(s[n-pos-1],s[n-2]);
    k-=(pos*(pos+1))/2;
    if(k<0)
        k=pos+k;
    if(k==0)
        k=pos-1;
    else
        k--;
    // cout<<"k is "<<k<<endl;
    swap(s[n-1-k],s[n-1]);
    // reverse(all(s));
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;

	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)

ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	srt(v);
	vector<ll> ans;
	ll mid=0;
	if(v.size()%2==0)
	{
		mid=v.size()/2-1;
	}
	else
		mid=v.size()/2;
	ll right=mid+1;
	ll left=mid-1;
	ans.pb(v[mid]);
	for(ll i=0;i<v.size()/2;i++)
	{
		if(right<v.size())
		{
			ans.pb(v[right]);
			right++;
		}
		if(left>=0)
		{
			ans.pb(v[left]);
			left--;
		}
	}
	for(auto x:ans)
		cout<<x<<" ";
	line;
	return 0;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl ans(n,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(v[i]>v[i-1]&&v[i]>v[i+1])
            ans[i]++;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
        ans[i]+=ans[i-1];
    ll maxo=-1,ans2=1;
    for(ll i=0;i+k-1<n;i++){
        ll temp=ans[i+k-2]-ans[i];
        if(temp>maxo){
            maxo=temp;
            ans2=i;
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo+1<<" "<<ans2+1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll len;
const ll N=40001;
vl prefix(N);
void build(ll a,ll b){
    len=a*b;
    prefix[0]=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=len;i++){
        prefix[i]=prefix[i-1];
        if(((i%a)%b)!=((i%b)%a)){
            prefix[i]++;
        }
    }
}
ll query(ll l){
    ll times=l/len;
    ll remain=l%len;
    ll ans=prefix[len]*times;
    ans+=prefix[remain];
    return ans;
}
ll query(ll l,ll r){
    return query(r)-query(l-1);
}
ll solve()
{
    ll a,b,q;
    cin>>a>>b>>q;
    build(a,b);
    while(q--){
        ll l,r;
        cin>>l>>r;
        cout<<query(l,r)<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

    {
        solve();
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;

typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1e9+7LL
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    cc
    {
        ll n,m,k;
        cin>>n>>m>>k;
        ll ans=0;
        ll d=n/k;
        for(ll i=0;i<m+1;i++)
        {
            for(ll j=0;j<i+1;j++)
            {
                if(i>d)
                    continue;
                if((i+j)>m)
                    continue;
                if(i+(k-1)*j<m)
                    continue;
                ans=max(ans,i-j);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
}

					cost+=x;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    set<ll> s;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        s.insert(temp);
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=1024;i++)
    {
        set<ll> temp_s;
        for(auto x:s)
        {
            ll temp=(x^i);
            temp_s.insert(temp);
        }
        ll flag=0;
        if(temp_s.size()==s.size())
        {
            for(auto x:s)
            {
                if(temp_s.find(x)==temp_s.end())
                {
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
        }
        else
            flag=1;
        if(flag==0)
        {
            cout<<i<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

Title: 1363A Odd selection
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef vector<pair<ll,ll>> vpl;
typedef vector<string> vs;
typedef map<int,int>mi;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
	cc
	{
		ll n,temp,x;
		bool flag=0;
		cin>>n>>x;
		ll odd=0,even=0;
		loop0(n)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			if(temp&1)
				odd++;
			else
				even++;
		}
		for(ll i=1;i<=odd&&i<=x;i+=2)
		{
			ll temp=even;
			ll temp1=x-i;
			if(temp1<=even)
				flag=1;
		}
		if(flag)
			cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
		else
			cout<<"No"<<endl;
	}
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;

typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define loopi(a,b) for(int i=a;i<=b;i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	int test;
	cin>>test;
	while(test--)
	{
		ll n,x,temp=0,maxo=0;
		cin>>n>>x;
		vl v(n,0);
		ll sum=0;
		ll temp_sum=0;
		int flag=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			v[i]=temp;
			sum+=temp;
		}
		temp_sum=sum;
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			if(temp_sum%x!=0)
			{
				flag=1;
				maxo=max(maxo,n-i);
			}
			temp_sum=sum-v[i];
		}
		temp_sum=sum;
		for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
		{
			if(temp_sum%x!=0)
			{
				flag=1;
				maxo=max(maxo,i+1);
			}
			temp_sum=sum-v[i];
		}
		if(flag==0)
			cout<<-1<<endl;
		else
			cout<<maxo<<endl;
	}
}

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl ans;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i==0||i==(n-1)||((1+i<(n))&&(v[i]>v[i-1])!=(v[i]<v[i+1])))
            ans.pb(v[i]);
    }
    cout<<ans.size()<<endl;
    printv(ans);
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    pan;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef vector<pair<ll,ll>> vpl;
typedef vector<string> vs;
typedef map<int,int>mi;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007;
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define loopi(a,b) for(int i=a;i<=b;i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	int test;
	cin>>test;
	while(test--)
	{
		int n,m,no1;
		int count=0;
		cin>>n>>m;
		int arr[n][m];
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<m;j++)
			{
				cin>>arr[i][j];
			}
		}
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<m;j++)
			{
				int flag=0;
				if(arr[i][j]==0)
				{
					//  for row
					for(int k=0;k<n;k++)
					{
						if(arr[k][j]==1)
						{
							flag=1;
						}
					}
					for(int k=0;k<m;k++)
					{
						if(arr[i][k]==1)
						{
							flag=1;
						}
					}
					if(flag!=1)
					{
						arr[i][j]=1;
						count++;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if(count%2==0)
		{
			cout<<"Vivek"<<endl;
		}
		else
			cout<<"Ashish"<<endl;
	}
}

	written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef vector<pair<ll,ll>> vpl;
typedef vector<string> vs;
typedef map<int,int>mi;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007;
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define loopi(a,b) for(int i=a;i<=b;i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	int test;
	cin>>test;
	while(test--)
	{
		int n,no1;
		cin>>n;
		vi a(n,0),b(n,0),c(n,0);
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			cin>>no1;
			a[i]=no1;
			c[i]=no1;
		}
		for(auto &s:b)
			cin>>s;
		int flag=0,zero=0,one=0;
		sort(c.begin(),c.end());
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			if(a[i]!=c[i])
			{
				flag=1;
			}
			if(b[i]==0)
				zero++;
			else
				one++;
		}
		// cout<<"flag is "<<flag<<endl;
		// cout<<"one and zero is "<<one<<" "<<zero<<endl;
		if(flag==0)
		{
			cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
		}
		else if(one>0&&zero>0)
			cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
		else
			cout<<"No"<<Endl;
	}
}

*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll test;
	cin>>test;
	while(test--)
	{
		ll n,temp,even=0,odd=0;
		cin>>n;
		vl v(n,0);
		loop0(n)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			v[i]=temp;
			if(v[i]%2==0)
				even++;
			else
				odd++;
		}
		if(even==(n+1)/2&&odd==n/2)
		{
			ll count=0;
			for(ll i=1;i<n;i+=2)
			{
				if(v[i]%2!=1)
					count++;
			}
			cout<<count<<endl;
		}
		else
			cout<<-1<<endl;
	}
}

		{

				flag=0;

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

	cc
	{
		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		string s;
		cin>>s;
		ll flag=0;
		loop(i,0,n)
		{
			if(s[i]<s[i-1])
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
		}
		if(flag==0)
			cout<<s<<endl;
		else
		{
			string ans;
			loop(i,0,s.size())
			{
				if(s[i]=='1')
					break;
				ans.pb('0');
			}
			ans.pb('0');
			for(ll i=s.size()-1;i>=0;i--)
			{
				if(s[i]=='0')
					break;
				ans.pb('1');
			}
			cout<<ans<<endl;
		}
	}
}

	pan;
	ll test;
	cin>>test;
	while(test--)
	{
		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		vl v(2*n,0);
		for(auto &s:v)
			cin>>s;
		vl odd,even;
		loop0(2*n)
		{
			if(v[i]%2==0)

				even.pb(i+1);

			cout<<ans[i].ff<<" "<<ans[i].ss<<endl;
	}

ll prime(ll num)
{
    for(ll i=2;i<=ll(sqrt(num));i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(n==1)
        cout<<"FastestFinger"<<endl;
    else if(n&1||n==2)
        cout<<"Ashishgup"<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll temp=log2(n);
        // cout<<"temp is "<<temp
        temp=pow(2,temp);
        if(temp!=n)
        {
            temp=n/2;
            if(prime(temp)==1)
                cout<<"FastestFinger"<<endl;
            else
                cout<<"Ashishgup"<<endl;
        }
        else
            cout<<"FastestFinger"<<endl;
    }
    return 0;

Title: 1372B Omkar and Last Class of Math
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(!(n&1))
    {
        cout<<n/2<<" "<<n/2<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll first=0,second=0,maxo=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=ll(sqrt(n));i++)
    {
        if(n%i==0)
        {
            ll a=n/i;
            ll b=n-a;
            ll hcf=__gcd(a,b);
            if(hcf>maxo&&b>0)
            {
                maxo=hcf;
                first=a;
                second=b;
            }
        }
    }
    if(first>0&&second>0)
        cout<<first<<" "<<second<<endl;
    else
    {
        cout<<1<<" "<<n-1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    pan;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

    while(y>0)

        if(y%2==1)

ll solve()
{

    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll start=0,end=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]!=(i+1))
        {
            start=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(v[i]!=(i+1))
        {
            end=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(start>=end)
    {
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        for(ll i=start;i<=end;i++)
        {
            if(v[i]==(i+1))
            {
                cout<<2<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        cout<<1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

    pan
    cc
    {
        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        vl v(n);
        forin(v,n);
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(i%2==0)
            {
                if(v[i]>=0)
                    v[i]=-v[i];
            }
            else
            {
                if(v[i]<=0)
                    v[i]=v[i]*-1;
            }
        }
        for(auto s:v)
            cout<<s<<" ";
        line;
    }
}

#define mod 1e9+7LL
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second

#define Endl "\n"

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	ll n,m;
	cin>>n>>m;
	vector<vector<ll>> v(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
	vector<vector<ll>> ans(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
		{
			if(i==0||j==0||i==(n-1)||j==(m-1))
				ans[i][j]=3;
			else
				ans[i][j]=4;
			cin>>v[i][j];
		}
	}
	ans[0][0]=2;
	ans[n-1][m-1]=2;
	ans[0][m-1]=2;
	ans[n-1][0]=2;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
		{
			if(v[i][j]>ans[i][j])
			{
				no
				return 0;
			}
		}
	}
	yes
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
			cout<<ans[i][j]<<" ";
		line;
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	pan
	// solve();
    cc
    {
    	solve();
    }
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    stringstream pk(s);

    return num;

    return to_string(num);

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
string pattern="abacaba";
int count(string s){
	int cnt=0;
	for(int i=0;i<s.length()-6;i++){
		bool flag=true;
		for(int j=0;j<7;j++){
			if(s[i+j]==pattern[j]) continue;
			else {
				flag=false;
				break;
			}
		}
		if(flag==true) cnt++;
	}
	return cnt;
}
bool check(string s,int ind){
	string s2=s;
	bool flag=true;
	s=s2;
	for(int j=0;j<7;j++){
		if(s[ind+j]==pattern[j] || s[ind+j]=='?') continue;
		else {
			flag=false;
			break;
		}
	}
	if(flag==true){
		for(int i=0;i<7;i++){
			if(s[ind+i]=='?') s[ind+i]=pattern[i]; 
		}
		for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){
			if(s[i]=='?') s[i]='z'; 
		}
		if(count(s)==1){
			cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
			cout<<s<<endl;
			return true;
		}
	}
	return false;
}
ll solve()
{
    bool flag=false;
    int n;
	cin>>n;
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	int freq=count(s);
	if(freq==1){
	    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
		 	if(s[i]=='?') s[i]='z';
		}
		cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
		cout<<s<<endl;
	}
	else if(freq>1){
		cout<<"No"<<endl;
	}
	else{
		flag=false;
		for(int i=0;i<=n-7;i++){
		 	if(check(s,i)) {
		 		flag=true;
		 		break;
		 	}
		else if(s[i]=='?') s[i]='z';
		}
	if(flag==false)
        cout<<"No"<<endl;
	}
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

		forin(b,m);
		ll flag=0;
		ll num=100000;
		loop(i,0,n)
		{
			if(find(all(b),a[i])!=b.end())
			{
				ll temp=a[i];
				num=min(temp,num);
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
		}
		if(flag==0)
			no
		else
		{
			yes
			cout<<1<<" "<<num<<endl;
		}
		a.clear();
		b.clear();
	}
}

<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve()
{
	vector<int> a(3);
	for (auto &it : a)
	{
		cin >> it;
	}
	sort(a.begin(), a.end());
	if (a[1] != a[2])
	{
		cout << "NO" << endl;
	}
	else
	{
		cout << "YES" << endl;
		cout << a[0] << " " << a[0] << " " << a[2] << endl;
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	int testCase = 1;
	cin >> testCase;
	while (testCase--)
	{
		solve();
	}
	return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    map<ll,ll> count;
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll count2=0,count4=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        count2-=count[temp]/2;
        count4-=count[temp]/4;
        count[temp]++;
        count2+=count[temp]/2;
        count4+=count[temp]/4;
    }
    ll q;
    cin>>q;
    while(q--){
        char ch;
        ll temp;
        cin>>ch>>temp;
        count2-=count[temp]/2;
        count4-=count[temp]/4;
        if(ch=='+'){
            count[temp]++;
        }
        else{
            count[temp]--;
        }
        count2+=count[temp]/2;
        count4+=count[temp]/4;
        if(count2>=4&&count4>=1){
            yes
        }
        else{
            no
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

            else if((r%2==1&&g%2==1&&b%2==0&&b>0)||(r%2==0&&r>0&&g%2==1&&b%2==1)||(r%2==1&&g%2==0&&g>0&&b%2==1))
                cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
            else
                cout<<"No"<<endl;
        }
        else
        {
            if(r%2==0&&g%2==0&&b%2==0)
                cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
            else if((r%2==0&&g%2==0&&b%2==1)||(r%2==0&&g%2==1&&b%2==0)||(r%2==1&&g%2==0&&b%2==0))
                cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
            else if(r%2==1&&g%2==1&&b%2==1)
                cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
            else
                cout<<"No"<<endl;
        }
    }
}

// define values.

/* Bit-Stuff */

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,sum=0;
    cin>>n;
    vector<ll> v(n);
    ll temp=0,maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]=temp;
        sum+=temp;
        maxo=max(maxo,temp);
    }
    srtGreat(v);
    if(v[0]>(sum-v[0]))
        cout<<"T"<<endl;
    else
    {
        if(sum&1)
            cout<<"T"<<endl;
        else
            cout<<"HL"<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
	cc
	{
		ll n,temp;
		cin>>n;
		ll minia=LONG_MAX,minib=LONG_MAX;
		vl a(n),b(n);
		loop0(n)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			a[i]=temp;
			minia=min(minia,temp);
		}
		loop0(n)
		{
			cin>>temp;
			b[i]=temp;
			minib=min(minib,temp);
		}
		ll count=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			ll temp1=a[i]-minia;
			ll temp2=b[i]-minib;
			count+=max(temp1,temp2);
		}
		cout<<count<<endl;
	}
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

	cc

		ll n;

		vl v(n);
		forin(v,n);
		ll sum=100;
		ll maxo=0;
		while(sum>0)
		{
			ll count=0;
			vector<bool>check(n,false);
			loop(i,0,n)
			{
				loop(j,0,n)
				{
					if(v[i]+v[j]==sum&&check[i]==false&&check[j]==false&&i!=j)
					{
						check[i]=true;
						check[j]=true;
						count++;
					}
				}
			}
			sum--;
			maxo=max(maxo,count);
		}
		cout<<maxo<<endl;
	}
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;

int main()
{
	cc
	{
		ll n;
		cin>>n;
		string s;
		cin>>s;
		stack<ll>zeros,ones;
		ll count=0;
		vl ans(n);
		loop(i,0,n)
		{
			if(s[i]=='0')
			{
				if(ones.empty())
				{
					count++;
					ans[i]=count;
					zeros.push(count);
				}
				else
				{
					ans[i]=ones.top();
					ones.pop();
					zeros.push(ans[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if(zeros.empty())
				{
					count++;
					ans[i]=count;
					ones.push(count);
				}
				else
				{
					ans[i]=zeros.top();
					zeros.pop();
					ones.push(ans[i]);
				}
			}
		}
		cout<<count<<endl;
		for(auto s:ans)
			cout<<s<<" ";
		line;
	}
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    vl v(7,0);
    forin(v,7);
    vl pre(7);
    pre[0]=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<7;i++)
    {
        pre[i]=pre[i-1]+v[i];
    }
    ll sum=accumulate(all(v),0LL);
    while(n>sum)
        n-=sum;
    for(ll i=0;i<7;i++)
    {
        if(n<=pre[i])
        {
            ans=i+1;
            break;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;
typedef vector<int> vi;

typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    int t = 1, n;
    cin>>t;
    vector<int>a;
    string ans;
    int x;
    string s;
    string test;
    int temp;
    while(t--){
        //cin>>n;
        cin>>s;
        cin>>x;
        ans = "", test = "";
        n = s.size();
        for (int i=0;i<n;i++)
            ans.pb('0'), test.pb('0');
        temp = n - 1 - x;
        for (int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if (i<x){
                if (i + x<n && s[i + x] == '1')
                    ans[i] = '1';
            } else if (i>temp){
                if (i - x>=0 && s[i - x] == '1')
                    ans[i] = '1';
            } else  if (s[i + x] == '1' && s[i - x] == '1')
                ans[i] = '1';
        }
        for (int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if (ans[i] == '1'){
                if (i + x<n)
                    test[i + x] = '1';
                if (i - x>=0)
                    test[i - x] = '1';
            }
        }
        if (test == s)
            cout<<ans<<endl;
        else cout<<-1<<endl;
    }
}

    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll solve()
{

    cin>>n;
    vl v(n,0);
    forin(v,n);
    ll count=0,num=0,sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        sum+=abs(v[i]);
        if(v[i]<0&&num<=0)
        {
            num=0;
        }
        else if(v[i]<0&&num>0)
        {
            ll temp=0;
            temp=min(num,abs(v[i]));
            // cout<<"temp is "<<temp<<endl;
            count+=temp;
            num-=temp;
        }
        else if(v[i]>0)
            num+=v[i];
    }
    // cout<<"count is "<<count<<endl;
    cout<<(sum-(2*count))/2<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll maxProductSubarrayOfSizeK(ll A[], ll n, ll k) 
{ 
	sort(A, A + n); 
	ll product = 1; 
	if (A[n - 1] == 0 && (k & 1)) 
		return 0; 
	if (A[n - 1] <= 0 && (k & 1)) { 
		for (ll i = n - 1; i >= n - k; i--) 
			product *= A[i]; 
		return product; 
	} 
	ll i = 0; 
	ll j = n - 1; 
	if (k & 1) { 
		product *= A[j]; 
		j--; 
		k--; 
	} 
	k >>= 1; 
	for (ll itr = 0; itr < k; itr++)
	{ 
		ll left_product = A[i] * A[i + 1]; 
		ll right_product = A[j] * A[j - 1]; 
		if (left_product > right_product) { 
			product *= left_product; 
			i += 2; 
		} 
		else { 
			product *= right_product; 
			j -= 2; 
		} 
	} 
	return product; 
} 
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll v[n];
	ll temp=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>temp;
		v[i]=temp;
	}
	ll pro=maxProductSubarrayOfSizeK(v,n,5);
	cout<<pro<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	cc
	{
		solve();
	}
}

<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srtGreat(v);
    ll g=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll m=i;
        ll mx=__gcd(g,v[i]);
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++)
        {
            if(__gcd(g,v[j])>mx)
            {
                mx=__gcd(g,v[j]);
                m=j;
            }
        }
        swap(v[i],v[m]);
        g=__gcd(g,v[i]);
    }
    for(auto x:v)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;

	vl a(n),b(n),c(n);
	forin(a,n);
	forin(b,n);
	forin(c,n);
	for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++)
	{
		if(i==0)
		{
			cout<<a[0]<<" ";
			pre=a[0];
			first=a[0];
		}

		{
			ll x=a[i];
			ll y=b[i];
			ll z=c[i];

				cout<<x<<" ";
				pre=x;
			}
			else if(pre!=y)
			{
				cout<<y<<" ";
				pre=y;
			}
			else
			{
				cout<<z<<" ";
				pre=z;
			}
		}
	}
	ll x=a[n-1];
	ll y=b[n-1];
	ll z=c[n-1];
	if(x!=first&&x!=pre)
	{
		cout<<x<<" ";
		first=x;
	}
	else if(first!=y&&y!=pre)
	{
		cout<<y<<" ";
		first=y;
	}
	else
	{
		cout<<z<<" ";
		first=z;
	}
	line;
	return 0;
}

// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll a, b, x, y, n;
    cin >> a >> b >> x >> y >> n;
    ll a1 = a, b1 = b, n1 = n;
    ll ans;
    if(a - x >= n && b - y >= n) {
        ans = min((a - n) * b, a * (b - n));
    } else if(a - x >= n && b - y < n) {
        ans = (a - n) * b;
        n -= (b - y);
        b = y;
        if(a - x >= n) {
            a -= n;
            n = 0;
        } else {
            n -= (a - x);
            a = x;
        }
        ans = min(ans, a * b);
    } else if(a - x < n && b - y >= n) {
        ans = a * (b - n);
        n -= (a - x);
        a = x;
        if(b - y >= n) {
            b -= n;
            n = 0;
        } else {
            n -= (b - y);
            b = y;
        }
        ans = min(ans, a * b);
    } else {
        if(a - x >= n) {
            a -= n;
            n = 0;
        } else {
            n -= (a - x);
            a = x;
        }
        if(b - y >= n) {
            b -= n;
            n = 0;
        } else {
            n -= (b - y);
            b = y;
        }
        if(b1 - y >= n1) {
            b1 -= n1;
            n1 = 0;
        } else {
            n1 -= (b1 - y);
            b1 = y;
        }
        if(a1 - x >= n1) {
            a1 -= n1;
            n1 = 0;
        } else {
            n1 -= (a1 - x);
            a1 = x;
        }
        ans = min(a * b, a1 * b1);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,x,y;
    cin>>n>>x>>y;
    ll m=0,N=0;
    ll temp=0,flag=0;
    for(ll j=n;j<=1000;j++)
    {
        for(ll i=1;i<1000;i++)
        {
            if((y-x)%(j-i)==0)
            {
                temp=(y-x)/(j-i);
                flag=1;
                m=i;
                N=j;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(flag==1)
            break;
    }
    ll a=x-(m-1)*temp;
    while(a<=0)
    {
        a=a+temp;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cout<<a+(i*temp)<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,p,k,x,y;
    cin>>n>>p>>k;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    cin>>x>>y;
    ll ans=INF;
    vl dp(n,0);
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        if((i+k)<n)
            dp[i]=dp[i+k];
        if(s[i]=='0')
            dp[i]+=x;
    }
    ll id=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n-p+1;i++){
        ans=min(id*y+dp[i+p-1],ans);
        id++;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	unordered_map<ll,ll> m1,m2;
	vl c,d;

	{
		cin>>temp;

		if(temp>t)
		{
			c.pb(i+1);

			c.pb(i+1);
		}

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    vl type(n);

    {
        cin>>type[i];
        if(type[i]==0)
            unblocked.pb(v[i]);

    sort(unblocked.begin(),unblocked.end(),greater<ll>());
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)

        if(type[i]==0)
            v[i]=unblocked[pos++];

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	vl odd,even;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if((i+1)%2==0)
		{
			even.pb(ll(s[i]-'0'));
		}
		else
		{
			odd.pb(ll(s[i]-'0'));
		}
	}
	if(odd.size()>even.size())
	{
		ll even_c=0,odd_c=0;
		for(auto x:odd)
		{
			if(x%2==0)
				even_c++;
			else
				odd_c++;
		}
		if(odd_c>0)
			cout<<1<<endl;
		else
			cout<<2<<endl;
	}
	else if(odd.size()<even.size())
	{
		ll even_c=0,odd_c=0;
		for(auto x:even)
		{
			if(x%2==0)
				even_c++;
			else
				odd_c++;
		}
		if(even_c>0)
			cout<<2<<endl;
		else
			cout<<1<<endl;
	}
	else if(even.size()==odd.size())
	{
		ll even_c=0,odd_c=0;
		for(auto x:even)
		{
			if(x%2==0)
				even_c++;
			else
				odd_c++;
		}
		if(even_c>0)
			cout<<2<<endl;
		else
			cout<<1<<endl;
	}
	return 0;
}

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n,0);
	forin(v,n);
	srt(v);
	ll left=0,right=n-1;
	ll flag=0;
	vl ans;
	while(right>=left)
	{
		if(flag==0)
		{
			// cout<<v[right]<<" ";
			ans.pb(v[right]);
			right--;
			flag=1;
		}
		else
		{
			flag=0;
			ans.pb(v[left]);
			// cout<<v[left]<<" ";
			left++;
		}
	}
	ll count=0;
	if(ans.size()<3)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
		for(auto x:ans)
			cout<<x<<" ";
		line;
	}
	else
	{
		for(ll i=1;i<ans.size();i++)
		{
			if(ans[i]<ans[i-1]&&ans[i]<ans[i+1])
				count++;
		}
		cout<<count<<endl;
		for(auto x:ans)
			cout<<x<<" ";
		line;
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();

	// {
	// 	solve();
	// }
}

	while(y>0)

{
	ll n;

	vector<ll> a(n),ans(n);
	forin(a,n);
	srt(a);
	ll count=0;
	ll half=n/2;
	for(ll i=0;i<(n/2);i++)
	{
		ans[(2*i)+1]=a[i];
	}
	for(ll i=half;i<n;i++)
	{
		ans[(2*(i-half))]=a[i];
	}
	for(ll i=1;i<n-1;i++)
	{
		if(ans[i]<ans[i-1]&&ans[i]<ans[i+1])
			count++;
	}
	cout<<count<<endl;
	for(auto x:ans)
		cout<<x<<" ";
	line;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
}

	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)

			res*=x;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
	ll n,q;
	cin>>n>>q;
	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	vl ans;
	ans.pb(v[0]);
	ll flag=0;
	for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
	{
		// cout<<
		if(v[i]>ans.back())
		{
			if(flag==0)
			{
				ans.pop_back();
				ans.push_back(v[i]);
			}
			else
			{
				// cout<<"i is "<<i<<endl;
				flag=0;
				ans.pb(v[i]);
			}
		}
		else if(v[i]<ans.back())
		{
			if(flag==0)
			{
				flag=1;
				ans.push_back(v[i]);
			}
			else
			{
				ans.pop_back();
				ans.push_back(v[i]);
			}
		}
	}
	ll s=ans.size();
	if(s&1)
	{
		ll answer=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<ans.size();i++)
		{
			if(i%2==0)
			{
				answer+=ans[i];
			}
			else
				answer-=ans[i];
		}
		cout<<answer<<endl;
	}
	else
	{
		ll answer=0;
		for(ll i=0;i<ans.size()-1;i++)
		{
			if(i%2==0)
				answer+=ans[i];
			else
				answer-=ans[i];
		}
		cout<<answer<<endl;
	}
	// for(auto x:ans)
	// 	cout<<x<<" ";
	// line;
	return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

int solve()
{
    ll a,b;
    cin>>a>>b;
    if(a==b)
        cout<<0<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll maxo=max(a,b);
        cout<<(a^maxo)+(b^maxo)<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
		for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
			cin>>v[i][j];
	ll ans=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
		{
			vl temp={v[i][j],v[n-i-1][j],v[i][m-j-1],v[n-i-1][m-j-1]};
			srt(temp);
			ans+=labs(v[i][j]-temp[2]);
		}
	}
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans1=0,ans2=0;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        m[a]++;
        m[b]--;
    }
    ll total_population=0;
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        total_population+=x.ss;
        if(total_population>ans2)
        {
            ans2=total_population;
            ans1=x.ff;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans1<<" "<<ans2<<endl;
    return 0;
}

	}
	return res;

*/

ll solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll flag=0;
	ll count=0;
	while(1)
	{
		// cout<<"n is "<<n<<endl;
		if(n<=0)
			break;
		if(flag==0)
		{
			// cout<<"n 1 is "<<n<<endl;
			flag=1;
			if(n&1)
			{
				n--;
				count++;
			}
			else
			{
				if(n%4==0&&n>4)
				{
					n--;
					count++;
				}
				else
				{
					ll temp=n/2;
					count+=temp;
					n/=2;
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			// cout<<"in 2 "<<n<<endl;
			flag=0;
			if(n&1)
				n--;
			else
			{
				if(n%4==0&&n>4)
					n--;
				else
					n/=2;
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<count<<endl;
	return 0;
}

typedef set<string> ss;

typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1e9+7LL
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vl v(n);
	vl pos,neg;
	ll pos_s=0,neg_s=0,sum=0;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>v[i];
		sum+=v[i];
		if(v[i]>=0)
		{
			pos_s+=v[i];
			pos.pb(v[i]);
		}
		else
		{
			neg_s+=abs(v[i]);
			neg.pb(v[i]);
		}
	}
	if(sum==0)
	{
		no
		return 0;
	}
	else
	{
		srt(neg);
		srtGreat(pos);
		yes
		if(pos_s>neg_s)
		{
			for(auto x:pos)
				cout<<x<<" ";
			for(auto x:neg)
				cout<<x<<" ";
			line;
		}
		else
		{
			for(auto x:neg)
				cout<<x<<" ";
			for(auto x:pos)
				cout<<x<<" ";
			line;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	pan
	// solve();
    cc
    {
    	solve();
    }
}

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {

            res = (res*x) % p;

int solve()
{
	ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll flag1=0,flag2=0;
    vector<bool> check(n,false);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='>')
            flag1++;
        else if(s[i]=='<')
            flag2++;
        if(s[i]=='-')
        {
            check[i]=true;
            check[(i+1)%n]=true;
        }
    }
    ll count=0;
    if(flag1>0&&flag2>0)
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(check[i]==true)
                count++;
        }
        cout<<count<<endl;
    }
    else if(flag1==0&&flag2>0)
    {
        cout<<n<<endl;
    }
    else if(flag1>0&&flag2==0)
        cout<<n<<endl;
    else if(flag2==0&&flag1==0)
        cout<<n<<endl;
	return 0;
}

{
	pan
	// solve();
    cc
    {
    	solve();

#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1e9+7LL
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"

#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srt(v);
    ll ans=v[n-1];
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        sum+=v[i];
    }
    if(k>=(n-1))
    {
        cout<<sum<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        ll pos=n-2;
        while(k--)
        {
            ans+=v[pos];
            pos--;
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    pan
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

typedef long long ll ;

typedef vector<bool> vb;

typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    set<ll> s;
    ll maxo=0;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]={temp,i+1};
        s.insert(temp);
        maxo=max(maxo,temp);
    }
    if(s.size()==1)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        // ll ans=0;
        // srt(v);
        for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(v[i].ff==maxo&&v[i-1].ff!=maxo)
            {
                // cout<<" hi ";
                cout<<v[i].ss<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
        {
            if(v[i].ff==maxo&&v[i+1].ff!=maxo)
            {
                cout<<v[i].ss<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

*/

{

    vl v(n,0);
    set<ll> s;
    ll first=-1,second=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    ll temp=v[0];
    first=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]!=temp)
        {

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int prime(ll num)
{
    for(ll i=2;i<=sqrt(num);i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
            return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=2;i<100000;i++)
    {
        // cout<<"i is "<<i<<" "<<prime(i)<<endl;
        if(prime(i)==1&&((i-1)%(n-1))==0)
        {
            ans=(i-1)/(n-1);
            if(prime(ans)==0)
            {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    vl v(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i==(n-1))
            v[i]=1;
        else
            v[i]=ans;
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> matrix(n,vector<ll>(n,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        rotate(v.begin(),v.begin()+1,v.end());
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            matrix[i][j]=v[j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
            cout<<matrix[i][j]<<" ";
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"

#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,x,pos;
    cin>>n>>x>>pos;
    ll greater=n-x;
    ll lower=x-1;
    ll start=0,end=n;
    ll mod=1000000007;
    ll ans=1;
    while(end>start)
    {
        ll mid=(start+end)/2;
        if(mid<pos)
        {
            ans=(ans*lower)%mod;
            lower--;
            start=mid+1;
        }
        else if(mid==pos)
        {
            ans=ans;
            start=mid+1;
        }
        else
        {
            ans=(ans*greater)%mod;
            greater--;
            end=mid;
        }
    }
    lower+=greater;
    while(lower>0)
    {
        ans=(ans*lower)%mod;
        lower--;
    }
    cout<<ans<<Endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    solve();
    // cc

    //     solve();

}

Title: 1439A1 Binary Table(Easy Version)
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<char>> v(n,vector<char>(m));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>v[i][j];
        }
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> ans;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        for(ll j=m-1;j>=0;j--)
        {
            if(i>=1&&j>=1)
            {
                if(v[i][j]=='1'&&v[i][j-1]=='1')
                {
                    ans.push_back({i+1,j+1,i+1,j,i,j+1});
                    v[i][j]='0';
                    v[i][j-1]='0';
                    if(v[i-1][j]=='0')
                        v[i-1][j]='1';
                    else
                        v[i-1][j]='0';
                    // v[i-1][j]^=1
                }
                else if(v[i][j]=='1'&&v[i][j-1]=='0')
                {
                    ans.push_back({(i+1),(j+1),(i),(j+1),(i),(j)});
                    // v[i-1][j-1]^=1;
                    if(v[i-1][j-1]=='0')
                        v[i-1][j-1]='1';
                    else
                        v[i-1][j-1]='0';
                    v[i][j]='0';
                    // v[i-1][j]^=1;
                    if(v[i-1][j]=='0')
                        v[i-1][j]='1';
                    else
                        v[i-1][j]='0';
                }
                else if(v[i][j]=='0'&&v[i][j-1]=='1')
                {
                    ans.push_back({(i+1),(j),(i),(j+1),(i),(j)});
                    // v[i-1][j-1]^=1;
                    if(v[i-1][j-1]=='0')
                        v[i-1][j-1]='1';
                    else
                        v[i-1][j-1]='0';
                    v[i][j-1]='0';
                    if(v[i-1][j]=='0')
                        v[i-1][j]='1';
                    else
                        v[i-1][j]='0';
                    // v[i-1][j]^=1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=m-1;i>0;i--)
    {
        if(i>=1)
        {
            if(v[0][i]=='1'&&v[0][i-1]=='1')
            {
                ans.push_back({(1),(i+1),(2),(i+1),(2),(i)});
                ans.pb({1,(i),(2),(i),(2),(i+1)});
                v[0][i]='0';
                v[0][i-1]='0';
            }
            else if(v[0][i]=='1'&&v[0][i-1]=='0')
            {
                ans.pb({1,(i+1),1,(i),2,i});
                ans.pb({1,(i+1),1,(i),2,(i+1)});
                ans.pb({1,(i+1),2,i,2,(i+1)});
                v[0][i]='0';
                v[0][i-1]='0';
            }
            else if(v[0][i]=='0'&&v[0][i-1]=='1')
            {
                ans.pb({1,(i+1),1,(i),2,i});
                ans.pb({1,(i+1),1,i,2,(i+1)});
                ans.pb({1,i,2,i,2,(i+1)});
                v[0][i]='0';
                v[0][i-1]='0';
            }
        }
    }
    ll count=ans.size();
    cout<<count<<Endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<count;i++)
    {

#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
void kickstart()
{
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    for(ll i=1;i<=test;i++)
    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";
    }
}
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll p,q;
    cin>>p>>q;
    if(p%q)
        cout<<p<<endl;
    else
    {
        map<ll,ll> factor;
        for(ll i=2;i*i<=q;i++)
        {
            if(q%i==0)
            {
                while(q%i==0)
                {
                    q/=i;
                    factor[i]++;
                }
            }
        }
        if(q>1)
            factor[q]++;
        ll ans=-1;
        for(auto x:factor)
        {
            ll temp=p;
            if(temp%x.ff==0)
            {
                while(temp%x.ff==0)
                {
                    temp/=x.ff;
                }
                ll diff=x.ss-1;
                while(diff>0)
                {
                    temp*=x.ff;
                    diff--;
                }
                ans=max(ans,temp);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
bool compare(pair<ll,ll>& a,pair<ll,ll>& b)
{
    return a.ff>b.ff;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,w;
    cin>>n>>w;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a;
        cin>>a;
        v[i]={a,i};
    }
    ll half=(w+1)/2;
    sort(v.begin(),v.end(),compare);
    ll flag=0,sum=0;
    vector<bool>check(n+1,false);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        // cout<<"i is "<<i<<endl;
        sum+=v[i].ff;
        check[v[i].ss]=true;
        if(sum>=half&&sum<=w)
        {
            // cout<<"sum is 1 "<<sum<<endl;
            flag=1;
            break;
        }
        else if(sum>w)
        {
            // cout<<"sum till is "<<sum<<endl;
            for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
            {
                if(check[v[j].ss]==true)
                {
                    sum-=v[j].ff;
                    check[v[j].ss]=false;
                }
                if(sum>=half&&sum<=w)
                {
                    // cout<<"sum is 2 "<<sum<<endl;
                    flag=1;
                    break;
                }
            }
            // cout<<"sum after while loop is "<<sum<<endl;
        }
    }
    if(flag==1)
    {
        vl ans;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(check[i]==true)
            {
                ans.pb(i+1);
            }
        }
        cout<<ans.size()<<Endl;
        for(auto x:ans)
            cout<<x<<" ";
        line;
    }
    else
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    vector<vector<ll>> dp(n+1,vector<ll>(m+1,0));
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=1;j<=m;j++)
        {
            if(s1[i-1]==s2[j-1])
                dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j-1]+2,dp[i][j]);
            else
                dp[i][j]=max({dp[i][j],dp[i-1][j]-1,dp[i][j-1]-1});
            ans=max(ans,dp[i][j]);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    solve();
    // cc
    // {

    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
    ll sum=0;
    ll zeroes=0,neg=0;
    ll mini_neg=LONG_MAX;
    ll pos_sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>v[i][j];
            if(v[i][j]==0)
            {
                zeroes++;
            }
            else if(v[i][j]<0)
            {
                // mini_neg=min(mini_neg,abs(v[i][j]));
                neg++;
            }
            sum+=abs(v[i][j]);
            mini_neg=min(mini_neg,abs(v[i][j]));
        }

    // cout<<"mini is "<<mini_neg<<endl;
    if(zeroes>0)
    {
        cout<<sum<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        if(neg&1)
        {
            // cout<<"hi "<<endl;
            cout<<sum-(2*mini_neg)<<endl;
        }
        else
        {
            cout<<sum<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll mini=LONG_MAX,maxo=0,maxo_pos=-1,mini_pos=-1;
    ll temp=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;;
        if(temp>maxo)
        {
            maxo=temp;
            maxo_pos=i;
        }
        if(temp<=mini)
        {
            mini=temp;
            mini_pos=i;
        }
    }
    ll ans=maxo_pos+abs(mini_pos-(n-1));
    if(mini_pos<maxo_pos)
        ans--;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    solve();
}

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
bool compare(pair<ll,ll>&a ,pair<ll,ll>& b)
{
    if(a.ff==b.ff)
        return a.ss<b.ss;
    else
        return a.ff<b.ff;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v.pb({a,b});
    }
    // srt(v);
    ll flag=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll count=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            if((abs(v[j].ff-v[i].ff)+abs(v[j].ss-v[i].ss))<=k)
            {
                count++;
            }
        }
        if(count==n)
            flag++;
    }
    if(flag)
        cout<<1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // solve();

        solve();

        cout<<2<<endl;

            ans+=2;

        }
        else
        {
            cout<<2<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    cin>>s;
    ll zero=0,one=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='0')
            zero++;
        else
            one++;
    }
    while(q--)
    {
        ll l,r;
        cin>>l>>r;
        // r--;
        char temp1=s[r-1];
        char temp2=s[l-1];
        ll flag=0;
        for(ll i=r;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(s[i]==temp1)
            {
                // cout<<"hi ";
                flag=1;
            }
        }
        if(flag==0)
        {
            for(ll i=0;i<l-1;i++)
            {
                if(s[i]==temp2)
                {
                    flag=1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if(abs(r-l)>=1)
        {
            if(flag)
                yes
            else
                no
        }
        else
            no
    }

    vector<ll> v1(27,0),v2(27,0);
    for(auto x:a)
    {
       v1[ll(x-'a')]++;
    }
    for(auto x:b)
        v2[ll(x-'a')]++;
    bool bad=false;
    for(ll i=0;i<26;i++)
    {
        if(v1[i]<v2[i]||(v1[i]-=v2[i])%k)
            bad=true;

    ll distance=0;

    {
        if(ashish)
        {
            ashish=0;
            utkarsh=1;
            hori+=k;

            utkarsh=0;
            ashish=1;
            verti+=k;
        }
        ll coverd_distance=pow(hori,2)+pow(verti,2);
        if(coverd_distance>d)
        {
            if(ashish)
            {
                cout<<"Ashish"<<endl;
            }
            else
                cout<<"Utkarsh"<<endl;

        }

        cout<<a*2<<endl;

        ll mini=min(a,b);

<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve()
{
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> v(n);
    int maxo = 0;
    long long sum = 0;
    for (auto &x : v)
    {
        cin >> x;
        maxo = max(maxo, x);
        sum += x;
    }
    long long k = max((long long)maxo, ((sum + n - 2) / (n - 1)));
    cout << (k * (n - 1)) - sum << endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase = 1;
    cin >> testCase;
    while (testCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    {
        if(y%2==1)

            // res=res%mod;

ll solve()
{

    cin>>n;
    ll diff=0,ans=0;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll maxo=LONG_MIN;
    for(ll i=1;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]>v[i-1]&&v[i]>v[i+1]||v[i]<v[i-1]&&v[i]<v[i+1])
        {
            diff=abs(v[i]-v[i-1])+abs(v[i]-v[i+1])-abs(v[i-1]-v[i+1]);

    maxo=max(maxo,diff);
    diff=abs(v[n-1]-v[n-2]);
    maxo=max(maxo,diff);
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
        ans+=abs(v[i]-v[i-1]);

    cout<<abs(ans-maxo)<<endl;

    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    map<ll,vector<ll>> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        m[v[i]].pb(i+1);
    }
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        ll count=0,pre=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<x.ss.size();j++)
        {
            // cout<<"elemtn is "<<x.ss[j]<<endl;
            if(j==0)
            {
                if(j==0)
                {
                    if(x.ss[0]==1)
                    {
                        // cout<<"set hua pre first me "<<pre<<endl;
                        pre=1;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        pre=x.ss[0];
                        count++;
                    }
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // cout<<" pre is "<<pre<<"  and x.ss[j] s "<<x.ss[j]<<endl;
                if((x.ss[j]-pre)>1)
                {
                    // cout<<"pre is "<<pre<<"  and x.ss[j] s "<<x.ss[j]<<endl;
                    // cout<<"hi ";
                    pre=x.ss[j];
                    count++;
                }
                pre=x.ss[j];
            }
            if(j==(x.ss.size()-1))
                {
                    if(x.ss[j]==(n))
                    {
                        pre=x.ss[j];
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // cout<<" ji ";
                        count++;
                    }
                }
        }
        mini=min(mini,count);
        // cout<<"count for "<<x.ff<<" is "<<count<<endl;
        // line;
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}
