#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll prime(ll num)
{
    for(ll i=2;i<=ll(sqrt(num));i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll count=0;
    ll maxo=0,ans=0;
    for(ll i=2;i<=ll(sqrt(n));i++)
    {
        // cout<<"hi ";
        count=0;
        if(prime(i)==true)
        {
            ll temp=n;
            count=0;
            while(temp%i==0)
            {
                // cout<<"i "<<i<<endl;
                temp/=i;
                count++;
            }
        }
        if(count>maxo)
        {
            maxo=count;
            ans=i;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"maxo is "<<maxo<<endl;
    // cout<<maxo<<Endl;
    if(maxo==0||maxo==1)
    {
        cout<<1<<endl;
        cout<<n<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        cout<<maxo<<endl;
        ll pro=1;
        for(ll i=0;i<maxo-1;i++)
        {
            pro*=ans;
            cout<<ans<<" ";
        }
        cout<<n/pro<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back

// Some print

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,x;
    cin>>n>>x;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll i=0,ans=0;
    while(i<n)
    {
        if(v[i]<=x)
        {
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        if(is_sorted(all(v))) break;
        swap(v[i],x);
        ans++;
        i++;
    }
    if(is_sorted(all(v)))
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    // solve();
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

{
    ll n,m;

    vl b(m);

    {
        gcd=__gcd(gcd,abs(a[i]-a[i-1]));

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>n>>s1>>s2;
    ll first=0,second=0,equal=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(s1[i]>s2[i])
            first++;
        else if(s2[i]>s1[i])
            second++;
        else
            equal++;
    }
    if(first>second)
        cout<<"RED"<<endl;
    else if(second>first)
        cout<<"BLUE"<<endl;
    else
        cout<<"EQUAL"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

    stringstream pk(s);

    return num;

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<char>> grid(n,vector<char>(m));
    vvl dp(n+1,vl(m+2,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            char temp;
            cin>>temp;
            grid[i][j]=temp;
        }
    }
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        for(ll j=m-1;j>=0;j--){
            if(grid[i][j]=='*'){
                ll temp_j=j+1;
                dp[i][temp_j]=1+min({dp[i+1][temp_j],dp[i+1][temp_j-1],dp[i+1][temp_j+1]});
                sum+=dp[i][temp_j];
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    return to_string(num);

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        sum+=v[i];
    }
    for(ll i=n;i>=1;i--)
    {
        if(sum%i==0)
        {
            ll needsum=sum/i;
            ll currsum=0;
            bool ok=true;
            for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
            {
                currsum+=v[j];
                if(currsum>needsum)
                {
                    ok=false;
                    break;
                }
                else if(currsum==needsum)
                {
                    currsum=0;
                }
            }
            if(ok)
            {
                cout<<n-i<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<ll> cnt(n + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) 
    {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        cnt[x]++;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i - 1] * cnt[i] * cnt[i + 1];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i] * (cnt[i] - 1) / 2 * cnt[i + 1];
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i - 1] * cnt[i] * (cnt[i] - 1) / 2;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i - 1] * cnt[i + 1] * (cnt[i + 1] - 1) / 2;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i + 1] * cnt[i - 1] * (cnt[i - 1] - 1) / 2;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) 
    {
        ans += cnt[i] * (cnt[i] - 1) * (cnt[i] - 2) / 6;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    cc
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll check(ll num)
{
    vl v(9,false);
    ll temp=num;
    while(temp)
    {
        ll d=temp%10;
        if(d>0)
        {
            v[d-1]=true;
        }
        temp/=10;
    }
    ll flag2=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=9;i++)
    {
        if(v[i-1]==true&&num%i==0)

    {

    		ans++;
    		s[i]='@';
    	}

    		s[i]='@';

    }

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)

    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl weight(n);
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>weight[i];
        sum+=weight[i];
    }
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        m[a]++;
        m[b]++;
    }
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> nodes;
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        // cout<<"in map "<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
        if(x.ss>1)
        {
            nodes.pb({-weight[x.ff-1],x.ss});
        }
    }
    cout<<sum<<" ";
    srt(nodes);
    for(auto x:nodes)
    {
        while(x.ss>1)
        {
            x.ss--;
            sum+=(-x.ff);
            cout<<sum<<" ";
        }
        // cout<<"in nodes weight is "<<-x.ff<<" and times is "<<x.ss<<endl;
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

    //     freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    // #endif
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        cin>>temp;
        sum+=temp;
        b[i]=sum;
    }
    ll maxo=0;
    sum=0;
    // for(auto x:r)
    //     cout<<"in r "<<x<<endl;
    // for(auto x:b)
    //     cout<<"in blue "<<x<<endl;
    maxo=max(0LL,*max_element(all(r)))+max(0LL,*max_element(all(b)));
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    return stoi(s);

        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    k--;
    vl h(n);
    forin(h,n);
    ll mini=h[0],maxo=h[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        mini=max(mini-k,h[i]);
        maxo=min(maxo+k,h[i]+k);
        if(mini>maxo)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    if(mini<=h[n-1]&&maxo>=h[n-1])
        yes
    else
        no
    return 0;
}

        solve();

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

{
    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vl a(n+1,0),b(n+1,0);
    ll ans = 0, lst = 1e9, idx = 0;
    for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++)
    {
        cin >> a[i];
        int x = a[i];
        b[i] = 0;
        while(x % k == 0)
        {
            b[i]++;
            x /= k;
        }
        if(b[i] < lst)
            lst = b[i], idx = i;
    }
    for(int i = 1;i <= n;i++)
        ans += 1LL * (lst + 1) * a[i];
    for(int i = 1;i < idx;i++)
        ans += 1LL * a[i];
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    {
        ans[i]=v[i];
        if((i+v[i])<=n)
            ans[i]+=ans[i+v[i]];

    return 0;

{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srtGreat(v);
    ll sum1=0,sum2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]%2==0)
            sum1+=v[i];
        i++;
        if(i>=n)
            break;
        if(v[i]&1)
            sum2+=v[i];
    }
    // cout<<"sum2 "<<sum1<<" "<<sum2<<endl;
    if(sum1==sum2)
        cout<<"Tie"<<endl;
    else if(sum1>sum2)
        cout<<"Alice"<<endl;
    else
        cout<<"Bob"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
pair<string, int> find_lcm(string s)
{
    string t = "";
    for(int i = 0;i < sz(s);i++)
    {
        bool flag = true;
        t += s[i];
        int cnt = 0;
        for(int j = 0;j < sz(s);j += sz(t))
        {
            if(s.substr(j, sz(t)) != t)
            {
                flag = false;
                break;
            }
            else
            {
                cnt++;
            }
        }
        if(flag==1)
        {
            return make_pair(t, cnt);
        }
    }
    return make_pair(s, 1);
}
ll solve()
{
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    string mini="",maxo="";
    if(s1.size()>=s2.size())
    {
        maxo=s1;
        mini=s2;
    }
    else
    {
        maxo=s2;
        mini=s1;
    }
    pair<string,ll> first_=find_lcm(mini);
    pair<string,ll> second_=find_lcm(maxo);
    if(first_.ff!=second_.ff)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll lcm=(first_.ss*second_.ss)/__gcd(first_.ss,second_.ss);
        string temp="";
        for(ll i=0;i<lcm;i++)
            temp+=first_.ff;
        cout<<temp<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    while(y>0)

        if(y%2==1)

            res*=x;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve(vector<bool> prime)
{
    ll first=1,second=0;
    ll d;
    cin>>d;
    for(ll i=1+d;i<=100000;i++)
    {
        if(prime[i]==true)
        {
            first=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"first is "<<first<<endl;
    for(ll i=first+d;i<=100000;i++)
    {
        if(prime[i]==true)
        {
            second=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"second is "<<second<<endl;
    cout<<first*second<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    vector<bool> prime(100000,true);
    for(ll i=2;i*i<=100000;i++)
    {
        if(prime[i])
        {
            for(ll j=i*i;j<100000;j+=i)
                prime[j]=false;
        }
    }
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve(prime);
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
void kickstart()
{
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    for(ll i=1;i<=test;i++)
    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";
    }
}
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    n*=2;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srtGreat(v);
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
        ans.pb({v[0],v[i]});
        multiset<ll> s;
        for(ll j=1;j<n;j++)
        {
            if(i!=j)
                s.insert(v[j]);
        }
        ll curr = v[0];
        bool ok=1;
        while(sz(s)>0)
        {
            auto it=s.end();
            it = prev(it);
            auto it2=s.lower_bound(curr-(*it));
            if(it2==s.end()||(*it)+(*it2)!=curr||(it==it2))
            {
                ok=0;
                break;
            }
            else
            {
                ans.pb({(*it),(*it2)});
                curr=(*it);
                s.erase(it);
                s.erase(it2);
            }
        }
        if(ok)
        {
            yes
            cout<<v[0]+v[i]<<endl;
            for(auto x:ans)
            {
                cout<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
    no
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}
/* stuff you should look before submission 
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer
*/

// to run ctrl+b
const ll N=2e5+5;
pair<ll,ll> store[N];
int boys[N];
int girls[N];
ll solve()
{
    ll a,b,k;
    cin >> a >> b >> k;
    for(int i = 0;i < k;i++) cin >> store[i].ff, boys[store[i].ff]++;
    for(int i = 0;i < k;i++) cin >> store[i].ss, girls[store[i].ss]++;
    ll ans = 0, tmp = 0;
    for(int i = 0;i < k;i++)
    {
        tmp = (k - i) + 1 - boys[store[i].ff] - girls[store[i].ss];
        if(tmp >= 0) {
            ans += tmp;
        }
        boys[store[i].ff]--, girls[store[i].ss]--;
    }
    //cout << endl;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    ll ans=0;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl sum(n,0);
    sum[0]=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        sum[i]=sum[i-1]+v[i];
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        ll temp=(100*v[i+1]+k-1)/k-sum[i];
        ans=max(ans,temp);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        solve();

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
void kickstart()
{
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    for(ll i=1;i<=test;i++)
    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";
    }
}
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll hcf=0;
    srt(v);
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        hcf=__gcd(hcf,abs(v[i]-v[i-1]));
    }
    for(auto x:v)
    {
        if((x-k)%hcf==0)
        {
            yes
            return 0;
        }
    }
    no
    return 0;
}

ll lucky(ll num,ll d)
{
    while(num)
    {
        if(num%10==d)
            return 1;
        num/=10;
    }
    return 0;
}

{
    ll temp,d;
    cin>>temp>>d;
    while(temp--)
    {
        ll n;
        cin>>n;
        if(lucky(n,d)==1)
            yes
        else
        {
            ll flag=1;
            while(n>0)
            {
                n-=d;
                if(lucky(n,d)==1)
                {
                    yes
                    flag=0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(flag)
                no
        }
    }
    return 0;

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>

#define ss second

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
void kickstart()
{
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    for(ll i=1;i<=test;i++)
    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";
    }
}
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    n*=2;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(auto x:v)
    {
        m[x]++;
        if(x&1)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        if(x.ss&1)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    n/=2;
    if(sz(m)!=n)
    {
        no
        return 0;
    }
    vl ans(n);
    ll pos=0;
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        if(x.ff>0)
        {
            ans[pos++]=x.ff/2;
        }
    }
    map<ll,ll> m2;
    ll sum=0;
    srtGreat(ans);
    ll len=n;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp=(ans[i]-sum);
        if(temp%len)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        else
            temp/=len;
        sum+=temp;
        len--;
        m2[temp]++;
        if(temp<=0)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    if(sz(m2)==n)
    {
        for(auto x:m2)
        {
            if(x.ss>1)
            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        yes
    }
    else
        no
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    vl v1(n);
    forin(v1,n);
    vl v2(n);
    forin(v2,n);
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ans[i]={v1[i],v2[i]};

        {
            b-=(temp)*ans[i].ff;

            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;

        u=abs(y);
    else
        d=abs(y);

            u--;

            d--;

            r--;
        else if(x=='L')
            l--;

        yes
    else
        no

ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=-1;
    while(k>0)
    {
        ll pos=0;
        while(pos+1<n)
        {
            if(k<=0)
                break;
            else if(v[pos]<v[pos+1])
            {
                v[pos]++;
                k--;
                break;
            }
            else
                pos++;
        }
        if(pos==n-1)
        {
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        if(k==0)
        {
            ans=pos+1;
            break;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll N=300010;
int n, m;
int a[N], b[N], c[N], ans[N];
vector<int> v[N];
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        v[i].clear();
    forin(a,n);
    forin(b,n);
    forin(c,m);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(a[i]!=b[i])
        {
            v[b[i]].pb(i);
        }
    }
    ll last=-1;
    if(v[c[m-1]].size()>0)
    {
        last=v[c[m-1]].back();
        v[c[m-1]].pop_back();
    }
    else
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(b[i]==c[m-1])
            {
                last=i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(last==-1)
    {
        no
        return 0;
    }
    ans[m-1]=last;
    for(ll i=0;i<m-1;i++)
    {
        if(v[c[i]].size()==0)
        {
            ans[i]=last;
        }
        else
        {
            ans[i]=v[c[i]].back();
            v[c[i]].pop_back();
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        if(sz(v[i])>0)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
        cout<<ans[i]+1<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    ll ans=0;
    if(n&1){
        ll mid=(n-1)/2;
        ans=(k%n+((k-1)/mid))%n;
        if(ans==0)
            ans=n;
    }
    else{
        if(k%n==0)
            ans=n;
        else
            ans=k%n;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

* stuff you should look before submission 
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

// to run ctrl+b
ll query(ll i)
{
    cout<<"? "<<i<<endl;
    ll res;
    cin>>res;
    return res;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    auto incr=[&](ll x)
    {
        if(x==n)
            return true;
        return query(x)<query(x+1);
    };
    ll l=1,r=n,mid=0;
    while(l<r)
    {
        mid=(l+r)/2;
        if(incr(mid))
        {
            r=mid;
        }
        else
        {
            l=mid+1;
        }
    }
    cout<<"! "<<l<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
    {
        ll a=max(v[i],v[i+1]);
        ll b=min(v[i],v[i+1]);
        // cout<<"a nd b is "<<a<<" "<<b<<" "<<a/b<<endl;
        if((a/b)>2||(a/b==2&&a%b>0))
        {
            while(1)
            {
                if((b*2)>=a)
                    break;
                else
                {
                    b*=2;
                    count++;
                    // cout<<"b is "<<b<<endl;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>

#define ss second

#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
void kickstart()
{
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    for(ll i=1;i<=test;i++)
    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";
    }
}
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll zero=0,one=0,two=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp%3==0)
            zero++;
        else if(temp%3==1)
            one++;
        else
            two++;
    }
    ll req=(n/3);
    ll ans=0;
    while(1)
    {
        if(one==req&&two==req&&zero==req)
            break;
        else
        {
            ll mini=min({zero,one,two});
            ll maxo=max({zero,one,two});
            if(mini==zero)
            {
                if(maxo==one)
                {
                    zero++;
                    one--;
                    ans+=2;
                }
                else
                {
                    two--;
                    zero++;
                    ans++;
                }
            }
            else if(mini==one)
            {
                if(maxo==zero)
                {
                    zero--;
                    one++;
                    ans++;
                }
                else
                {
                    one++;
                    ans+=2;
                    two--;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                two++;
                if(maxo==zero)
                {
                    ans+=2;
                    zero--;
                }
                else
                {
                    ans++;
                    one--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

void bfs(ll l,ll r,ll depth,vector<ll>& v,vector<ll>& height)
{
    ll maxo=v[l];
    ll pos=l;
    for(ll i=l+1;i<=r;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]>maxo)
        {
            maxo=v[i];
            pos=i;
        }
    }
    height[pos]=depth;
    if(pos>l)
        bfs(l,pos-1,depth+1,v,height);
    if(pos<r)
        bfs(pos+1,r,depth+1,v,height);
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl height(n,0);
    bfs(0,n-1,0,v,height);
    for(auto x:height)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    vl curr(5010);
    fill(all(curr),0);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=curr[i];
        if(temp<v[i]-1){
            ans+=v[i]-1-temp;
            temp+=v[i]-1-temp;

        if(i+2<n){
            for(ll y=i+2;y<min(n,i+v[i]+1);y++){
                curr[y]++;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;

        {

            // res=res%mod;

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<ll>v(n);
    vl st,ans;
    forin(v,n);
    vl maxo(n);
    maxo[0]=v[0];
    ll temp_max=v[0];
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        temp_max=max(temp_max,v[i]);
        maxo[i]=temp_max;
    }
    ll pos=n-1;
    while(1)
    {
        if(pos<0)
            break;
        while(maxo[pos]!=v[pos])
        {
            if(pos<0)
                break;
            st.pb(v[pos]);
            pos--;
        }
        if(pos>=0)
        {
            st.pb(v[pos]);
            pos--;
        }
        reverse(all(st));
        for(auto x:st)
            ans.pb(x);
        st.clear();
    }
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<" ";
    line;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        solve();

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    string s,t;
    cin>>s>>t;
    vl prefix(m),suffix(m,0);
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        while(t[i]!=s[pos])
            pos++;
        prefix[i]=pos;
        pos++;
    }
    pos=n-1;
    for(ll i=m-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        while(t[i]!=s[pos])
            pos--;
        suffix[i]=pos;
        pos--;
    }
    ll maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i+1<m;i++)
    {
        maxo=max(maxo,suffix[i+1]-prefix[i]);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
map<char, char> reflections;
void solve() {
    ll h, m;
    cin >> h >> m;
    string query;
    cin >> query;
    ll qh = stoi(query.substr(0, 2));
    ll qm = stoi(query.substr(3, 2));
    string nex = "00:00";
    string ans = "";
    for(int i = h - 1;i >= 0;i--) {
        for(int j = m - 1;j >= 0;j--) {
            string time = i > 9 ? to_string(i) : "0" + to_string(i);
            time += ':';
            time += j > 9 ? to_string(j) : '0' + to_string(j);
            bool flag = true;
            string tmp = time;
            reverse(all(time));
            for(int k = 0;k < sz(time);k++) {
                if(time[k] == ':') continue;
                if(reflections.find(time[k]) != reflections.end()) {
                    time[k] = reflections[time[k]];
                } else {
                    flag = false;
                    break;
                }
            } 
            if(!flag) {
                if(i == qh && j == qm) {
                    ans = nex;
                }
                continue;
            }
            int th = 0;
            th = th * 10 + (time[0] - '0');
            th = th * 10 + (time[1] - '0');
            int tm = 0;
            tm = tm * 10 + (time[3] - '0');
            tm = tm * 10 + (time[4] - '0');
            if(th < h && tm < m) {
                nex = tmp;
            }
            if(i == qh && j == qm) {
                ans = nex;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(ans != "")
            break;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
}
int main() {
    reflections['0'] = '0';
    reflections['1'] = '1';
    reflections['2'] = '5';
    reflections['5'] = '2';
    reflections['8'] = '8';
    speed;
    ll test;
    cin>>test;
    while(test--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

        ll y;

            return x+y+z;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    if(s[0]==s[n-1])
        no
    else
    {
        ll ch1=s[0],ch2=s[n-1];
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(s[i]==ch1)
                s[i]='(';
            else if(s[i]==ch2)
                s[i]=')';
        }
        string s1=s,s2=s;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(s1[i]!='('&&s1[i]!=')')
                s1[i]='(';
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(s2[i]!='('&&s2[i]!=')')
                s2[i]=')';
        }
        ll flag=0;
        ll ans=0;
        // cout<<"ss "<<s1<<" "<<s2<<endl;
        for(auto x:s1)
        {
            if(x=='(')
                ans++;
            else
                ans--;
            if(ans<0)
                flag++;
        }
        if(flag==0&&ans==0)
        {
            yes
            return 0;
        }
        else
        {
            ans=0;
            flag=0;
            for(auto x:s2)
            {
                if(x=='(')
                    ans++;
                else
                    ans--;
                if(ans<0)
                {
                    no
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            if(ans>0)
            {
                // cout<<"hi 2"<<endl;
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        yes
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,u,r,d,l;
    ll U=0,R=0,L=0,D=0;
    cin>>n>>u>>r>>d>>l;
    ll temp=n-2;
    for(ll ur=0;ur<=1;ur++)
    {
        for(ll ul=0;ul<=1;ul++)
        {
            for(ll dr=0;dr<=1;dr++)
            {
                for(ll dl=0;dl<=1;dl++)
                {
                    U=u,R=r,L=l,D=d;
                    U-=ur;
                    U-=ul;
                    R-=ur;
                    R-=dr;
                    L-=ul;
                    L-=dl;
                    D-=dr;
                    D-=dl;
                    if(U>=0&&U<=temp&&R>=0&&R<=temp&&L>=0&&L<=temp&&D>=0&&D<=temp)
                    {
                        yes
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    no
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    set<ll> s;
    ll mex=0,maxo=0;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        s.insert(temp);
        maxo=max(maxo,temp);
        m[temp]++;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<=1000000002;i++){
        if(m[i]==0){
            mex=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"mex and maxo is "<<mex<<" "<<maxo<<endl;
    ll ans=sz(s);
    // cout<<"basic ans is "<<ans<<endl;
    if(maxo+1==mex){
        // cout<<"euq "<<endl;
        ans+=k;
    }
    else{
        ll flag=0;
        ll mid=(mex+maxo+1)/2;
        // cout<<"mid is "<<mid<<endl;
        if(find(all(s),mid)!=s.end())
            flag++;
        if(flag==0&&k>0)
        {
            // cout<<"add hua "<<endl;
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// template

T mymax(T x,T y)

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    // diamond-> X axis
    // miners -> Y axis
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl diamond,miners;
    for(ll i=0;i<2*n;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        if(a==0)
            diamond.pb(abs(b));
        else
            miners.pb(abs(a));
    }
    srt(diamond);
    srt(miners);
    cout<<setprecision(12)<<fixed;
    double ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        diamond[i]=diamond[i]*diamond[i];
        miners[i]=miners[i]*miners[i];
        ans+=double(sqrt(diamond[i]+miners[i]));
        // cout<<"ans "<<ans<<endl;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

                v[i][c]='X';
            }
            if(c+2<m){

                    v[1][c+2]='X';
                }
                else{
                    v[0][c+1]='X';
                    v[0][c+2]='X';
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cout<<v[i][j];
        }
        line;
    }

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>

typedef vector<ll> vl;

#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    ll ans=0;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vl v(n);
    vl count(m+1);
    forin(v,n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        count[v[i]%m]++;
    }
    if(count[0]>0){
        ans++;
        count[0]=0;
    }
    if(m%2==0){
        if(count[m/2]>0){
            ans++;
            count[m/2]=0;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=(m-1)/2;i++){
        ll temp=min(count[i],count[m-i]);
        if(temp>0){
            ans++;
            if(count[i]>count[m-i]){
                count[i]--;
                count[i]-=temp;
                count[m-i]-=temp;
            }
            else if(count[m - i] > count[i])
            {
                count[m - i]--;
                count[m - i] -= temp;
                count[i] -= temp;
            }
            else
            {
                count[i] -= temp;
                count[m - i] -= temp;
            }
        }
        ans += (count[i] + count[m - i]);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,w;
    cin>>n>>w;
    multiset<ll> ms;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        ms.insert(temp);
    }
    ll ans=1,space_left=w;
    while(sz(ms)){
        auto it =ms.upper_bound(space_left);
        if(it!=ms.begin()){
            it--;
            int val=*it;
            space_left-=val;
            ms.erase(it);
        }
        else{
            space_left=w;
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll n,k;
ll dp[1001][1001][2];
const ll mod = 1e9 + 7;
ll solve(ll cur,ll k,ll dir)
{
    if(k==1)
        return 1;
    if(dp[cur][k][dir]!=-1)
        return dp[cur][k][dir];
    ll ans=2;
    if(dir==1){
        if(cur<n)
            ans+=solve(cur+1,k,dir)-1;
        ans%=mod;
        if(cur>1)
            ans+=solve(cur-1,k-1,1-dir)-1;
        ans%=mod;
        dp[cur][k][dir]=ans;
    }
    else{
        if(cur>1)
            ans+=solve(cur-1,k,dir)-1;
        ans%=mod;
        if(cur<n)
            ans+=solve(cur+1,k-1,1-dir)-1;
        ans%=mod;
        dp[cur][k][dir]=ans;
    }
    return ans;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        cin>>n>>k;
        memset(dp,-1,sizeof(dp));
        cout<<solve(1,k,1)<<endl;
    }
}

    int ver2 = min(n - k1, n - k2);
    int hor2 = max(n - k1, n - k2) - min(n - k1, n - k2);

        yes;
    } else {
        no;
    }
    return 0;

const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=1000000000000000;
    ll sum_odd=0,sum_even=0,min_odd=1000000001,min_even=1000000001;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(i&1){
            sum_odd+=v[i];
            min_odd=min(min_odd,v[i]);
        }
        else{
            sum_even+=v[i];
            min_even=min(min_even,v[i]);
        }
        ll no_even=i/2+1;
        ll no_odd=(i+1)/2;
        if(i>=1){
            ll temp=(sum_odd-min_odd)+(sum_even-min_even)+min_even*(n-no_even+1)+min_odd*(n-no_odd+1);
            ans=min(ans,temp);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        solve();

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll N=2e7+10;
vl prime(N,1);
void cal(){
    for(ll i=2;i<N;i++){
        if(prime[i]==1){
            for(ll j=i;j<N;j+=i)
                prime[j]+=1;
        }
    }
}
ll fun(ll x,ll c,ll d){
    x+=d;
    if(x%c)
        return 0;
    x/=c;
    return (1<<(prime[x]-1));
}
ll solve()
{
    ll c,d,x;
    cin>>c>>d>>x;
    ll hcf=__gcd(c,d);
    if(x%hcf){
        cout<<0<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    x/=hcf;
    c/=hcf;
    d/=hcf;
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=ll(sqrt(x));i++){
        if(x%i==0){
            ans+=fun(x/i,c,d);
            if(x/i!=i)
                ans+=fun(i,c,d);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    cal();
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    char v[n][m];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
            cin>>v[i][j];
    }
    ll min_i=LONG_MAX,max_i=0,min_j=LONG_MAX,max_j=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(v[i][j]=='*'){
                min_i=min(min_i,i);
                min_j=min(min_j,j);
                max_j=max(max_j,j);
                max_i=max(max_i,i);
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=min_i;i<=max_i;i++){
        for(ll j=min_j;j<=max_j;j++)
            cout<<v[i][j];
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

            return x+y+z;

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll zero=0,one=0;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x=='1')
            one++;
        else
            zero++;
    }
    if(s[0]!='1'||s[n-1]!='1'||n&1){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    if(one&1||zero&1){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    string a(n,' ');
    string b(n,' ');
    ll k=1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='1'){
            if(k>one/2){
                a[i]=')';
                b[i]=')';
            }
            else{
                a[i]='(';
                b[i]='(';
            }
            k++;
        }
        else
            continue;
    }
    ll flag=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='0'){
            if(flag==0){
                a[i]='(';
                b[i]=')';
            }
            else{
                a[i]=')';
                b[i]='(';
            }
            flag^=1;
        }
        else
            continue;
    }
    yes
    cout<<a<<"\n"<<b<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod2=998244353;
bool palindrome(string s){
    string temp=s;
    reverse(all(temp));
    if(temp==s)
        return true;
    else
        return false;
}
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    set<char> st;
    for(auto x:s){
        st.insert(x);
    }
    if(sz(st)==1&&s[0]=='a'){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    if(s[0]=='a'&&s[n-1]!='a')
        s='a'+s;
    else if(s[0]!='a'&&s[n-1]=='a')
        s=s+'a';
    else if(s[0]!='a'&&s[n-1]!='a')
        s+='a';
    else{
        string temp="";
        ll flag=0;
        if(n%2==0){
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(s[n-i-1]!='a'&&flag==0){
                    flag++;
                    temp+='a';
                }
                temp+=s[i];
            }
        }
        else{
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(i!=(n/2)){
                    if(s[n-i-1]!='a'&&flag==0){
                        flag++;
                        temp+='a';
                    }
                    temp+=s[i];
                }
                else{
                    if(flag==0&&s[i]!='a'){
                        temp+='a';
                        flag++;
                        temp+=s[i];
                    }
                    else
                        temp+=s[i];
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==0){
            no
            return 0;
        }
        s=temp;
    }
    yes
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()

    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>n>>s1>>s2;
    vl prefix(n,0);
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s1[i]=='1')
            sum++;
        else
            sum--;
        prefix[i]=sum;
    }
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s1[i]!=s2[i])
            pos=i;
    }
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=pos;i>=0;i--){
        if(s1[i]!=s2[i]&&count%2==0){
            if(prefix[i]==0){
                count++;
                while(i>=0&&s1[i]!=s2[i])
                    i--;
                i++;
            }
            else{
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        else if(s1[i]!=s2[i]&&count%2==1){
            continue;
        }
        else if(s1[i]==s2[i]&&count%2==0)
            continue;
        else if(s1[i]==s2[i]&&count%2==1){
            if(prefix[i]==0){
                count++;
                while(i>=0&&s1[i]==s2[i])
                    i--;
                i++;
            }
            else{
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;
}

class Point

    public:

        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    // even black 2, odd white 1
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> black,white;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
            ll temp=(i+j);
            if(temp&1)
                black.pb({i,j});
            else
                white.pb({i,j});
        }
    }
    ll pos_black=0,pos_white=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=(n*n);i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        ll a,b,c;
        if(temp==1){
            if(pos_black<sz(black)){
                c=2;
                a=black[pos_black].ff,b=black[pos_black].ss;
                pos_black++;
            }
            else{
                c=3;
                a=white[pos_white].ff,b=white[pos_white].ss;
                pos_white++;
            }
        }
        else if(temp==2){
            if(pos_white<sz(white)){
                a=white[pos_white].ff,b=white[pos_white].ss;
                c=1;
                pos_white++;
            }
            else{
                c=3;
                a=black[pos_black].ff,b=black[pos_black].ss;
                pos_black++;
            }
        }
        else{
            if(pos_white<sz(white)){
                c=1;
                a=white[pos_white].ff,b=white[pos_white].ss;
                pos_white++;
            }
            else{
                c=2;
                a=black[pos_black].ff,b=black[pos_black].ss;
                pos_black++;
            }
        }
        cout<<c<<" "<<a<<" "<<b<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k>>s;
    ll cnt=0;
    cnt=count(all(s),'*');
    if(cnt==1){
        cout<<1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll first=0,second=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='*'){
            first=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='*')
            second=i;
    }
    ll ans=2;
    for(ll i=first;i<second;){
        ll j=i+k,temp=0;
        if(j>=second)
            break;
        for(;j>i;j--){
            if(s[j]=='*'){
                temp=j;
                ans++;
                break;
            }
        }
        i=temp;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve()

    cin>>a>>b;
    ll n=sz(a),m=sz(b);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=min(n,m);i++){
        for(ll j=0;j+i<=n;j++){
            for(ll k=0;k+i<=m;k++){
                if(a.substr(j,i)==b.substr(k,i)){
                    ans=max(ans,i);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<n+m-2*ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;

            return x+y+z;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    priority_queue<pair<ll,ll>> q;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        m[temp]++;
    }
    for(auto x:m){
        q.push({x.ss,x.ff});
    }
    ll ans=n;
    while(sz(q)>=2){
        auto [c1,n1]=q.top();
        q.pop();
        auto [c2,n2]=q.top();
        q.pop();
        c1--;
        c2--;
        ans-=2;
        if(c1){
            q.push({c1,n1});
        }
        if(c2)
            q.push({c2,n2});
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll T=0,M=0;
    for(auto x:s){
        if(x=='T')
            T++;
        else
            M++;
    }
    if(T==(2*M)){
        ll temp_t=0,temp_m=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(s[i]=='T')
                temp_t++;
            else
                temp_m++;
            if(temp_m>temp_t){
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        temp_m=0,temp_t=0;
        for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
            if(s[i]=='T')
                temp_t++;
            else
                temp_m++;
            if(temp_m>temp_t){
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        yes
    }
    else
        no
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define ss second

#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back

// loops

// Some print
#define no cout<<"No"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
ll N;
const ll MAXN=2100;
vl v(MAXN),temp(MAXN);
void r1(){
    for(ll i=0;i<N;i+=2){
        swap(v[i],v[i+1]);
    }
}
void r2(){
    for(ll i=0;i<N/2;i++){
        swap(v[i],v[(N/2)+i]);
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>N;
    N*=2;
    for(ll i=0;i<N;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
        v[i]--;
        temp[i]=v[i];
    }
    ll ans1=0;
    while(ans1<(4*N)){
        bool flag=true;
        for(ll i=0;i<N;i++){
            if(v[i]!=i)
                flag=false;
        }
        if(flag)
            break;
        if(ans1&1)
            r2();
        else
            r1();
        ans1++;
    }
    v=temp;
    ll ans2=0;
    while(ans2<4*N){
        bool flag=true;
        for(ll i=0;i<N;i++){
            if(v[i]!=i)
                flag=false;
        }
        if(flag)
            break;
        if(ans2&1)
            r1();
        else
            r2();
        ans2++;
    }
    ll ans=min(ans1,ans2);
    if(ans>=4*N)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    return to_string(num);

        ll x;
        ll y;

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<vector<char>> v(n,vector<char>(n));
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            cin>>v[i][j];
            if(v[i][j]=='*'){
                ans.pb({i,j});
            }
        }
    }
    if(ans[0].ff==ans[1].ff){
        ll temp=ans[0].ff;
        if(temp!=(n-1)){
            v[n-1][ans[0].ss]='*';
            v[n-1][ans[1].ss]='*';
        }
        else{
            v[0][ans[0].ss]='*';
            v[0][ans[1].ss]='*';
        }
    }
    else if(ans[0].ss==ans[1].ss){
        ll temp=ans[0].ss;
        if(temp!=(n-1)){
            v[ans[0].ff][n-1]='*';
            v[ans[1].ff][n-1]='*';
        }
        else{
            v[ans[0].ff][0]='*';
            v[ans[1].ff][0]='*';
        }
    }
    else{
        v[ans[0].ff][ans[1].ss]='*';
        v[ans[1].ff][ans[0].ss]='*';
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
            cout<<v[i][j];
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);

    {
        solve();

    cin>>a>>b;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='?')
            s[i]=s[n-i-1];
    }
    a-=count(all(s),'0');
    b-=count(all(s),'1');
    for(ll i=0;i<=(n/2);i++){
        if(i!=(n-i-1)&&s[i]=='?'){
            if(a>1){
                s[i]='0';
                s[n-i-1]='0';
                a-=2;
            }
            else if(b>1){
                s[i]='1';
                s[n-i-1]='1';
                b-=2;
            }
        }
        else if(s[i]=='?'){
            if(a){
                a--;
                s[i]='0';
            }
            else{
                s[i]='1';
                b--;
            }
        }
    }
    string temp=s;
    reverse(all(temp));
    if(temp==s&&a==0&&b==0)
        cout<<s<<endl;
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    for(ll i=0;i<n+1;i++){
        sum+=v[i];
    }
    ll remain=sum-v[n+1];
    // cout<<"remain is "<<remain<<endl;

                flag=1;
                pos=i;
            }

                if(i!=pos){
                    a.pb(v[i]);

        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){

// template

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n,l,r,s;
    cin>>n>>l>>r>>s;
    vector<bool>check(n+1,false);
    vl v(n,0);
    l--;
    r--;
    if(l>r){
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll len=abs(r-l)+1;
    ll mini=(len*(len+1))/2;
    ll maxo=(n*len)-(len*(len-1))/2;
    // cout<<"mini "<<mini<<" "<<maxo<<endl;
    if(s<mini||s>maxo){
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll ans=1;
    for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++){
        v[i]=ans;
        s-=ans;
        ans++;
    }
    ll temp=n;
    if(s>0){
        for(ll i=r;i>=l;i--){
            ll req=temp-v[i];
            if(s>=req){
                v[i]+=req;
                s-=req;
            }
            else{
                v[i]+=s;
                s=0;
            }
            temp--;
            if(s<=0||temp<=0)
                break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(v[i]>0){
            check[v[i]]=true;
        }
    }
    ll pos=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(check[i]==false){
            pos=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // printv(check);
    // cout<<"pos is "<<pos<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(v[i]==0){
            // cout<<"i is "<<i<<endl;
            while(check[pos]==true)
                pos++;
            v[i]=pos;
            check[pos]=true;
        }
    }
    if(s>0){
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    printv(v);
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        ll j=i;
        while(j<=N){
            temp[j]+=i;
            j+=i;
        }

    for(ll i=1;i<N;i++){

            v[temp[i]]=i;
    }
}

/* Some syntax

//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    ll full_and=v[0];
    m[v[0]]++;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        m[v[i]]++;
        full_and&=v[i];
    }
    if(m[full_and]<2){
        cout<<0<<endl;
    }
    else{
        ll ans=0;
        ans=(m[full_and]*(m[full_and]-1))/2;
        ans%=mod1;
        for(ll i=1;i<=n-2;i++){
            ans*=i;
            ans%=mod1;
        }
        ans*=2;
        ans%=mod1;
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    vl v(n);
    set<ll> s;
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]=temp;
        sum+=v[i];
        s.insert(temp);
    }
    if((sz(s)==1&&v[0]==x)||(sum==x))
        no
    else{
        yes

            printv(v);

            srtGreat(v);
            sum=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
                sum+=v[i];
                if(sum==x){
                    swap(v[i],v[i+1]);
                }
            }
            printv(v);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// function

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;

    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n,l,r;
    cin>>n>>l>>r;
    ll ans=0;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    map<ll,ll> left,right;
    for(ll i=0;i<l;i++)
        left[v[i]]++;
    for(ll i=l;i<n;i++)
        right[v[i]]++;
    for(ll i=0;i<l;i++){
        ll socks=v[i];
        if(right[socks]>0){
            left[socks]--;
            right[socks]--;
            if(right[socks]==0)
                right.erase(socks);
            if(left[socks]==0)
                left.erase(socks);
        }
    }
    ll sz_left=0;
    ll sz_right=0;
    // cout<<"in left "<<endl;
    for(auto x:left){
        sz_left+=x.ss;
        // cout<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
    }
    // cout<<"in right "<<endl;
    for(auto x:right){
        sz_right+=x.ss;
        // cout<<"in rught "<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
    }
    // cout<<"in left "<<sz_left<<" in right "<<sz_right<<endl;
    if(sz_right==sz_left)
        ans+=sz_right;
    else{
        ll increment=0;
        ll sum2=sz_right+sz_left;
        sum2/=2;
        increment=abs(sum2-sz_right);
        ans+=sum2;
        ans+=increment;
        if(sz_right>sz_left){
            for(auto x:right){
                if(increment<=0)
                    break;
                ll temp=x.ss/2;
                if(temp>0){
                    temp=min(temp,increment);
                    increment-=temp;
                    ans-=temp;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            for(auto x:left){
                if(increment<=0)
                    break;
                ll temp=x.ss/2;
                if(temp>0){
                    temp=min(temp,increment);
                    increment-=temp;
                    ans-=temp;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

            // res=res%mod;

ll str_to_num(string s)

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
void dfs(vvl &grid,ll &count,ll number,ll i,ll j,ll n){
    if(count<=0){
        return ;
    }
    if(i>=sz(grid)||i<0){
        return ;
    }
    grid[i][j]=number;
    count--;
    if(grid[i][j-1]==0){
        dfs(grid,count,number,i,j-1,n);
    }
    if(count>0){
        dfs(grid,count,number,i+1,j,n);
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vector<vector<ll>> grid(n,vl (n,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll count=v[i];
        grid[i][i]=v[i];
        dfs(grid,count,v[i],i,i,n);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<=i;j++){
            cout<<grid[i][j]<<" ";
        }
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;

    #endif */

    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl s(n),u(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>s[i];
        s[i]--;
    }
    forin(u,n);
    vvl bst(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        bst[s[i]].pb(u[i]);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        srtGreat(bst[i]);
    vvl prefix(n,vl(1,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(auto x:bst[i])
            prefix[i].pb(prefix[i].back()+x);
    }
    vl ans(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll k=1;k<=ll(sz(bst[i]));k++)
            ans[k-1]+=prefix[i][sz(bst[i])/k*k];
    }
    printv(ans);
    return 0;
}

    cin>>TestCase;

    {
        solve();

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;

// template

// function

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point

        ll x;

        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl a(n),b(n);
    forin(a,n);
    forin(b,n);
    vl from_begin(n),from_end(n);
    vector<vl> dp(5001,vl(5001,0));
    ll maxo=0;
    ll pro=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=a[i]*b[i];
        pro+=temp;
        from_begin[i]=pro;
    }
    pro=0;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
        ll temp=a[i]*b[i];
        pro+=temp;
        from_end[i]=pro;
    }
    for(ll length=1;length<=n;length++){
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            ll j=i+length;
            if(j>=n)
                break;
            if(length==1)
                dp[i][j]=a[i]*b[j]+a[j]*b[i];
            else if(length==2)
                dp[i][j]=a[i]*b[i+2]+a[i+1]*b[i+1]+a[i+2]*b[i];
            else
                dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j-1]+a[i]*b[j]+a[j]*b[i];
        }
    }
    maxo=from_begin[n-1];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++){
            ll subarray_sum=dp[i][j];
            if(i>0)
                subarray_sum+=from_begin[i-1];
            if(j<(n-1))
                subarray_sum+=from_end[j+1];
            maxo=max(maxo,subarray_sum);
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

{
    scanf("%d",&n);
    char M[110][24];
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        scanf("%d%s",&k,M[i]);
        for(j=0;j<k;j++)

            char a[10];

            if(R[i][j]>X[j])X[j]=R[i][j];

    for(i=0;i<3;i++)
    {
        cout<<P[i];
        bool C=0;
        for(j=0;j<n;j++)
            if(R[j][i]==X[i])
            {
                if(C)printf(", ");
                C=1;
                cout<<M[j];
            }
        puts(".");
    }
}

                    ans=2;

{

    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll ans=0;
    vl pos;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='*')
            pos.pb(i);
    }
    if(sz(pos)){
        ll mid=sz(pos)/2;
        mid=max(mid,0LL);
        ll mid_element=pos[mid];
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(pos);i++){
            ans+=abs(mid_element-pos[i])-abs(mid-i);
        }
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    else{
        cout<<0<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;

#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> cache;
void dec(ll pos,ll l,ll r){
    cache[{l,r}]--;
    if(l!=r){
        ll m=(l+r)/2;
        if(pos<=m)
            dec(pos,l,m);
        else
            dec(pos,m+1,r);
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,cases;
    cin>>n>>cases;
    while(cases--){
        ll k;
        cin>>k;
        ll l=0,r=n-1;
        while(l!=r){
            ll m=(l+r)/2;
            pair<ll,ll> range={l,m};
            if(cache.count(range)==0){
                cout<<"? "<<range.ff+1<<" "<<range.ss+1<<endl;
                cin>>cache[range];
                cache[range]=range.ss-range.ff+1-cache[range];
            }
            ll value=cache[range];
            if(k<=value)
                r=m;
            else{
                k-=value;
                l=m+1;
            }
        }
        cout<<"! "<<l+1<<endl;
        dec(l,0,n-1);
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll mini=LONG_MAX,min_pos=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(mini>v[i]){
            mini=v[i];
            min_pos=i;
        }

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(i==min_pos)
            continue;
        else{
            v[i]=mini+abs(i-min_pos);
            cout<<i+1<<" "<<min_pos+1<<" "<<v[i]<<" "<<mini<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
