const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    int n, m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    if(n==1){
        cout<<s<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for(int i=0; i<m; ++i){
        int chng=0;
        string t=s;
        for(int j=0; j<n; ++j){
            if(s[j]=='1') {
                t[j]=='1'; 
                continue;
            }
            else if(j==0 && s[j+1]=='1') {
                t[j]='1';
                chng++;
            } 
            else if(j==n-1 && s[j-1]=='1') {
                t[j]='1';
                chng++;
            }
            else if(j+1<n && j-1>=0 && s[j-1]+s[j+1]=='1'+'0'){
                t[j]='1';
                chng++;
            }
            else{
                t[j]=s[j];
            }
        }
        s=t;
        if(chng==0)
            break;
    }
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

{

    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll sum=0;
    priority_queue<ll,vl,greater<ll>> pq;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        sum+=v[i];
        pq.push(v[i]);
        while(sum<0){
            sum-=pq.top();
            pq.pop();
        }
    }
    cout<<sz(pq)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        {

            // res=res%mod;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll n;
const ll N=2e5+10;
ll dp[2][N];
vector<ll> adj[N];
ll value[2][N];
void dfs(ll root,ll p=-1){
    dp[0][root]=0;
    dp[1][root]=0;
    for(auto child:adj[root]){
        if(child==p)
            continue;
        dfs(child,root);
        dp[0][root]+=max(abs(value[0][root]-value[1][child])+dp[1][child],dp[0][child]+abs(value[0][root]-value[0][child]));
        dp[1][root]+=max(abs(value[1][root]-value[1][child])+dp[1][child],dp[0][child]+abs(value[1][root]-value[0][child]));
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cin>>value[0][i]>>value[1][i];
    }
    fill(adj+1,adj+n+1,vector<ll>());
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        ll u,v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        adj[u].pb(v);
        adj[v].pb(u);
    }
    dfs(1);
    cout<<max(dp[0][1],dp[1][1])<<endl;
    // dp.clear();
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;

    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    }

{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl pos,neg;
    ll zero=0;
    map<ll,ll> m_neg;
    vl v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
        if(v[i]==0)
            zero++;
        else if(v[i]>0)
            pos.pb(v[i]);
        else{
            m_neg[v[i]]++;
            neg.pb(v[i]);
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    ans+=zero;
    ans+=sz(neg);
    if(zero<=1&&sz(neg)==sz(m_neg)){
        srt(neg);
        if(zero)
            neg.pb(0);
        ll flag=0;
        if(sz(pos)){
            srt(pos);
            for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(neg);i++){
                if(abs(neg[i]-neg[i+1])>=pos[0]){
                    continue;
                }
                else
                    flag++;
            }
            if(flag==0)
                ans++;
            }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

const ll INF=LONG_MAX;

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll N=1e6+1;
    vl count(N,2);
    vvl dp(N,vl (2,0));
    count[1]=1;
    for(ll i=2;i<N;i++){
        for(ll j=2*i;j<N;j+=i){
            count[j]++;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<N;i++){
        dp[i][0]=dp[i][1]=0;
    }
    dp[1][0]=1;
    dp[1][1]=1;
    for(ll i=2;i<N;i++){
        dp[i][0]=(dp[i-1][1]+count[i])%mod2;
        dp[i][1]=(dp[i-1][1]+dp[i][0])%mod2;
    }
    cout<<dp[n][0]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */

    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){

                }

            }

        {
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            ll maxo=0;

                maxo=max(maxo,ll(x-'0'));

{

    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> ans(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i+=2){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(i==0){
                if(j%2==0){
                    ans[i][j]=1;
                }
                else{
                    continue;
                }
            }
            else if(i!=n-1){
                if(j==0||j==(m-1)){

                }

                    continue;

            if(j%2==0){
                ans[n-1][j]=1;
            }
            else{
                continue;
            }
        }
    }
    else{
        for(ll j=2;j<=m-3;j++){
            if(j%2==0){
                ans[n-1][j]=1;
            }
            else{
                continue;
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cout<<ans[i][j];

        line;

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

        if(y%2==1)

            // res=res%mod;

    stringstream pk(s);

    pk>>num;
    return num;

    return to_string(num);

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll flag1=0,flag2=0;
    vector<vector<char>> grid(n,vector<char>(m));
    vector<vector<char>> ans1(n,vector<char>(m));
    vector<vector<char>> ans2(n,vector<char>(m));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>grid[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if((i+j)&1){
                ans1[i][j]='W';
                ans2[i][j]='R';
            }
            else{
                ans1[i][j]='R';
                ans2[i][j]='W';
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(grid[i][j]!='.'){
                if(grid[i][j]!=ans1[i][j]){
                    flag1++;
                }
                if(grid[i][j]!=ans2[i][j]){
                    flag2++;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if(flag1&&flag2){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    else if(flag1==0){
        yes
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
                cout<<ans1[i][j];
            }
            line;
        }
    }
    else{
        yes
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
                cout<<ans2[i][j];
            }
            line;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        solve();

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=0;
    if(n==1){
        cout<<v[0]<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(i==0)
            ans+=v[i];
        else
            ans+=abs(v[i]-v[i-1]);
    }
    ans+=v[n-1];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(i==0)
            ans-=max(0LL,v[i]-v[i+1]);
        else if(i>0&&i<n-1)
            ans-=max(0LL,v[i]-max(v[i-1],v[i+1]));
        else
            ans-=max(0LL,v[i]-v[i-1]);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl a(n),b(n);
    forin(a,n);
    forin(b,n);
    vector<bool>check(n,false);
    ll count=0;
    vector<vector<ll>>pos(n+1);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        pos[a[i]].pb(i);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        pos[b[i]].pb(i);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(check[i]==false){
            check[i]=true;
            ll temp=i;
            ll temp1=a[temp];
            ll temp2=b[temp];
            ll temp_pos=pos[temp2][0];
            ll temp3=b[temp_pos];
            check[temp_pos]=true;
            count++;
            // cout<<"temp_pos "<<temp_pos<<" and i is "<<i<<endl;
            while(temp3!=temp1){
                temp=temp_pos;
                temp1=a[temp];
                temp2=b[temp];
                temp_pos=pos[temp2][0];
                temp3=b[temp_pos];
                // cout<<"temp_pos"<<temp_pos<<endl;
                if(check[temp_pos]==true)
                    break;
                check[temp_pos]=true;
            }
        }
    }
    count=power(2,count,mod1);
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

const ll INF=1e18;

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    set<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
    auto ask=[&](ll node){
        cout<<"? "<<node+1<<endl;
        vl temp(n);
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            cin>>temp[i];
            if(temp[i]==1){
                ans.emplace(min(node,i),max(node,i));
            }
        }
        return temp;
    };
    auto d=ask(0);
    vl cnt(2);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cnt[d[i]%2]++;
    }
    ll u=(cnt[0]>cnt[1]?1:0);
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        if(d[i]%2==u)
            ask(i);
    }
    cout<<"!"<<endl;
    for(auto& p:ans){
        cout<<p.ff+1<<" "<<p.ss+1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);

    {
        solve();

// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=0;
    vl odd,even;
    for(auto x:v){
        if(x&1)
            odd.pb(x);
        else
            even.pb(x);
    }
    ans+=sz(odd)*(sz(even));
    ans+=((sz(even)-1)*sz(even))/2;
    srtGreat(odd);
    for(ll i=0;i<sz(odd);i++){
        for(ll j=i+1;j<sz(odd);j++){
            if(ll(__gcd(odd[i],2*odd[j]))>1)
                ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

// transform into graph

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll ans=0;
    ll n=sz(s);
    vl pos(2,-1);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=ll(s[i]-'0');
        if(temp==0||temp==1){
            pos[(temp^(i%2))]=i;
        }
        ll mini=min(pos[0],pos[1]);
        ans+=i-mini;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll zero=0;
    vl pos,neg;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i]=temp;
        if(temp>0)
            pos.pb(temp);
        else if(temp==0)
            zero++;
        else
            neg.pb(temp);
    }
    if(sz(neg)){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    else{
        map<ll,ll> mp;
        for(auto x:v)
            mp[x]++;
        ll check2=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
                if(i!=j){
                     ll temp=abs(v[i]-v[j]);
                    if(mp[temp]==0){
                        check2++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(check2==0){
            yes
            cout<<n<<endl;
            printv(v);
            return 0;
        }
        yes
        ll hcf=0,maxo=0,mini=INF;
        if(sz(pos)){
            for(auto x:pos){
                hcf=__gcd(hcf,x);
            }
            for(auto x:pos){
                maxo=max(maxo,x/hcf);
                mini=min(mini,x/hcf);
            }
        }
        cout<<abs(maxo+1)<<endl;
        for(ll i=0;i<=maxo;i++){
            cout<<hcf*i<<" ";
        }
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()

    ll n;
    string s;
    cin>>n>>s;
    ll d=0,k=0;
    map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> mp;
    vl count_d(n,0),count_k(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='K'){
            k++;
        }
        else
            d++;
        count_d[i]=d;
        count_k[i]=k;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        k=count_k[i];
        d=count_d[i];
        ll hcf=__gcd(k,d);
        k/=hcf;
        d/=hcf;
        mp[{k,d}]++;
        cout<<mp[{k,d}]<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

        if(mini>diff){
            mini=diff;
            pos=i;
        }
    }
    cout<<v[pos]<<" ";
    ll temp_pos=pos+2;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n-2;i++){
        if(temp_pos>=n)
            temp_pos=0;
        cout<<v[temp_pos]<<" ";
        temp_pos++;
    }
    cout<<v[pos+1]<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }

    return true;

    // in case of prime BOB win
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    if(prime(n))
        cout<<"Bob"<<endl;

            cout<<"Bob"<<endl;

            ll temp1=log2(n);
            ll temp2=pow(2,temp1);
            if(temp2==n){
                if(temp1&1)
                    cout<<"Bob"<<endl;
                else
                    cout<<"Alice"<<endl;
            }
            else
                cout<<"Alice"<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;

    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,l,r;
    cin>>n>>l>>r;
    ll ans=0;
    ll a[n];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>a[i];
    sort(a,a+n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp1=lower_bound(a,a+n,l-a[i])-a;
        ll temp2=upper_bound(a,a+n,r-a[i])-a;
        if(temp2==n || a[temp2]+a[i]>r)
            temp2--;
        ans+=temp2-temp1+1;
        if(temp1<=i && i<=temp2)
            ans--;
    }
    ans/=2;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
vl prime;
const ll N=50000;
void calculate(){
    vector<bool> check(N,true);
    for(ll i=2;i*i<=N;i++){
        if(check[i]){
            for(ll j=i*i;j<N;j+=i)
                check[j]=false;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=2;i<N;i++){
        if(check[i])
            prime.pb(i);
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll a,b,k;
    cin>>a>>b>>k;
    ll temp_k=0;
    ll temp_a=a,temp_b=b;
    for(auto x:prime){
        if(temp_a%x==0){
            while(temp_a%x==0){
                temp_k++;
                temp_a/=x;
            }
        }
    }
    for(auto x:prime){
        if(temp_b%x==0){
            while(temp_b%x==0){
                temp_k++;
                temp_b/=x;
            }
        }
    }
    if(temp_a>1)
        temp_k++;
    if(temp_b>1)
        temp_k++;
    if(k==1){
        if((a%b==0||b%a==0)&&(a!=b))
            yes
        else
            no
    }
    else{
        if(temp_k>=k)
            yes
        else
            no
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    calculate();
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    cin>>n>>k>>x;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srt(v);
    ll group=1;
    vl temp;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        ll diff=abs(v[i]-v[i-1]);
        if(diff>x){
            ll req=((diff+x-1)/x)-1;
            temp.pb(req);
            // cout<<"req at i "<<req<<" "<<i<<endl;
        }
    }
    srt(temp);
    // printv(temp);
    group=sz(temp)+1;
    for(auto x:temp){
        if(x<=k){
            k-=x;
            group--;
        }
    }
    cout<<group<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        ll x;

/* ascii value

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v[i]={b,a};
    }
    srt(v);
    ll first=0,second=n-1,ans=0,total=0;
    while(second>=first){
        if(v[first].ff>total){
            ll req=min({abs(v[first].ff-total),v[second].ss});
            total+=req;
            ans+=2*req;
            v[second].ss-=req;
            if(v[second].ss<=0)
                second--;
        }
        else{
            total+=v[first].ss;
            ans+=v[first].ss;
            first++;
        }
        // cout<<"in loop ans "<<ans<<endl;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{

    vl v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        v[i]=i+1;
    }
    if(n&1){
        for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i+=2)
            swap(v[i],v[i+1]);
        swap(v[n-1],v[n-2]);

    else{
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i+=2){

        }

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl a(n);
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        a[i]=temp;
        v[i]={temp,i+1};
    }
    srt(v);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll last=i+1+n;
        ll max_elemen=last/a[i];
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            if(v[j].ff>max_elemen)
                break;
            if(v[j].ss>(i+1)&&(a[i]*v[j].ff)==(i+1+v[j].ss)&&(i+1)!=v[j].ss)
                ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    srt(v);
    vl prefix_sum(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        sum+=v[i];
        prefix_sum[i]=sum;
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=2;i<n;i++){
        ans+=((i-1)*v[i])-prefix_sum[i-2];
    }

ll LCM(ll lcm,ll i){
    return ((lcm*i)/(__gcd(lcm,i)));
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll lcm=1,ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;lcm<=n;i++){
        lcm=LCM(lcm,i);
        if(lcm>n){
            break;
        }
        ans+=n/lcm;
    }
    cout<<(ans+n)%mod1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll ans = abs(x2 - x1) + abs(y1 - y2);
    if (x1 == x2)
    {
        if (x1 == f1)
        {
            if ((f2 >= y1 && f2 <= y2) || (f2 <= y1 && f2 >= y2))
            {
                ans += 2;
            }
        }
    }
    if (y1 == y2)
    {
        if (y1 == f2)
        {
            if ((f1 >= x1 && f1 <= x2) || (f1 >= x2 && f1 <= x1))
                ans += 2;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{

    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    vector<bool>check(n,false);
    ll first=0,second=0;
    ll pos_a=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='a'){
            check[i]=true;
            pos_a=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(pos_a==-1){
        no
        return 0;
    }
    char ch='a';
    ch++;
    ll count=n-1;
    first=pos_a-1,second=pos_a+1;
    if(n==1&&s=="a"){
        yes
        return 0;
    }
    while(1){
        ll flag2=0;
        if(first>=0&&s[first]==ch){
            check[first]=1;
            ch++;
            first--;
            flag2++;
            count--;
        }
        else if(second<n&&s[second]==ch){
            ch++;
            check[second]=1;
            second++;
            flag2++;
            count--;
        }
        if(flag2==0){
            no
            return 0;
        }
        if(count==0){
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(check[i]==false){
            cout<<"i is "<<i<<endl;
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;
}

/* ascii value

/* Some syntax

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll k,n,m;
    cin>>k>>m>>n;
    vl a(m);
    vl b(n);
    forin(a,m);
    forin(b,n);
    vl ans;
    ll pos1=0,pos2=0;
    ll no_of_line=k;
    while(pos1<m&&pos2<n){
        if(a[pos1]==0){
            no_of_line++;
            // cout<<0<<" ";
            ans.pb(0);
            pos1++;
        }
        else if(b[pos2]==0){
            no_of_line++;
            // cout<<0<<" ";
            ans.pb(0);
            pos2++;
        }
        else{
            ll mini=min(a[pos1],b[pos2]);
            if(mini==a[pos1]&&mini<=no_of_line){
                // cout<<a[pos1]<<" ";
                ans.pb(a[pos1]);
                pos1++;
            }
            else if(mini==b[pos2]&&mini<=no_of_line){  
                // cout<<b[pos2]<<" ";
                ans.pb(b[pos2]);
                pos2++;
            }
            else{
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    while(pos1<m){
        if(a[pos1]>no_of_line){
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else{
            if(a[pos1]==0){
                no_of_line++;
            }
            // cout<<a[pos1]<<" ";
            ans.pb(a[pos1]);
            pos1++;
        }
    }
    while(pos2<n){
        if(b[pos2]>no_of_line){
            cout<<-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else{
            // cout<<b[pos2]<<" ";
            if(b[pos2]==0){
                no_of_line++;
            }
            ans.pb(b[pos2]);
            pos2++;
        }
    }
    printv(ans);
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        vector<bool>count(32,0);

        while(temp){
            if(temp&1){
                count[pos]=1;

            temp/=2;

                ans+=pow(2,i);

        pre=ans;

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n,m;
            cin>>n>>m;
            vl v(n,0);
            ll ans=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
                ll x,y;
                cin>>x>>y;
                x--;
                y--;
                if(x>y){
                    swap(x,y);
                }
                if(v[x]==0){
                    ans++;
                }
                v[x]++;
            }
            ll q;
            cin>>q;
            while(q--){
                ll type;
                cin>>type;
                if(type==1){
                    ll x,y;
                    cin>>x>>y;
                    x--;
                    y--;
                    if(x>y){
                        swap(x,y);
                    }
                    if(v[x]==0){
                        ans++;
                    }
                    v[x]++;
                }
                else if(type==2){
                    ll x,y;
                    cin>>x>>y;
                    x--;
                    y--;
                    if(x>y){
                        swap(x,y);
                    }
                    if(v[x]==1){
                        ans--;
                    }
                    v[x]--;                    
                }
                else{
                    cout<<n-ans<<endl;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

            vector<bool>check(n,false);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(s2[i]=='1'&&s1[i]=='1'){
                    if(i-1>=0&&s1[i-1]=='1'&&check[i-1]==false){

                }

    return to_string(num);

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,a,b;
    cin>>n>>a>>b;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll cost=0;
    if(b>=0){
        cost+=(n*(a+b));
    }
    else{
        vl zero,one;
        ll zero_count=0,one_count=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(s[i]=='1'){
                while(s[i]=='1'){
                    one_count++;
                    i++;
                }
                i--;
                one.pb(one_count);
                one_count=0;
            }
            else{
                while(s[i]=='0'){
                    zero_count++;
                    i++;
                }
                i--;
                zero.pb(zero_count);
                zero_count=0;
            }
        }
        // printv(one);
        // printv(zero);
        if(sz(zero)>sz(one)){
            for(auto x:one){
                cost+=(x*a)+b;
            }
            ll sum=0;
            for(auto x:zero){
                sum+=x;
            }
            cost+=(sum*a)+b;
        }
        else{
            for(auto x:zero){
                cost+=(x*a)+b;
            }
            ll sum=0;
            for(auto x:one){
                sum+=x;
            }
            cost+=(sum*a)+b;
        }
    }
    cout<<cost<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    return to_string(num);

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
bool check(vector<ll> v){
    int n=sz(v);
    if(n>=5){
        return false;
    }
    if(n<=2){
        return true;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++){
            for(ll k=j+1;k<n;k++){
                if((v[i]>=v[j]&&v[j]>=v[k])||(v[k]>=v[j]&&v[j]>=v[i])){
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }   
    return true;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll ans=0;
    forin(v,n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        vl temp;
        for(ll j=i;j<n;j++){
            temp.pb(v[j]);
            if(check(temp)==true){
                ans++;
            }
            else{
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){

            while(y>0){

        {
            stringstream pk(s);

            pk>>num;
            return num;

        {
            return to_string(num);

        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll W,H,x1,x2,y1,y2,w,h;
            cin>>W>>H>>x1>>y1>>x2>>y2>>w>>h;
            vector<double> distance;
            ll flag=0;
            // to put in bottom
            ll bottom=0;
            if(y1<h){
                bottom=abs(h-y1);
                ll temp2=H-y2;
                if(temp2>=bottom){
                    distance.pb(bottom);
                }
                else{
                    flag++;
                }
            }
            else{
                distance.pb(0.0);
            }
            // to put in top
            ll top=0;
            ll temp1=H-y2;
            if(temp1<h){
                top=abs(h-temp1);
                ll temp2=y1;
                if(temp2>=top){
                    distance.pb(top);
                }
                else{
                    flag++;
                }
            }
            else{
                distance.pb(0.0);
            }
            // put in right
            ll right=0;
            temp1=W-x2;
            if(w>temp1){
                ll temp2=x1;
                right=abs(temp1-w);
                if(temp2>=right){
                    distance.pb(right);
                }
                else{
                    flag++;
                }
            }
            else{
                distance.pb(0);
            }
            // put in left
            ll left=0;
            if(x1<w){
                left=abs(x1-w);
                ll temp2=W-x2;
                if(temp2>=left){
                    distance.pb(left);
                }
                else{
                    flag++;
                }
            }
            else{
                distance.pb(0.0);
            }
            if(flag==4){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            srt(distance);
            cout<<fixed<<setprecision(10);
            cout<<distance[0]<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll ans=LONG_MAX;
            vl a(n);
            vl b(n);
            forin(a,n);
            forin(b,n);
            vl prefix(n+1,0),suffix(n+2,0);
            ll sum=0;
            a[0]=0;
            b[n-1]=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                sum+=b[i];
                prefix[i+1]=sum;
            }
            sum=0;
            for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
                sum+=a[i];
                suffix[i+1]=sum;
            }
            // printv(prefix);
            // printv(suffix);
            for(ll down=1;down<=n;down++){
                ll temp=max(prefix[down-1],suffix[down+1]);
                ans=min(ans,temp);
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */

    cin>>TestCase;

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            string s;
            ll n,q;
            cin>>n>>q;
            cin>>s;
            string s1="",s2="",s3="",s4="",s5="",s6="";
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(i%3==0){
                    s1+='a';
                    s2+='b';
                    s3+='c';
                    s4+='c';
                    s5+='b';
                    s6+='a';
                }
                else if(i%3==1){
                    s1+='b';
                    s2+='c';
                    s3+='a';
                    s4+='b';
                    s5+='a';
                    s6+='c';
                }
                else{
                    s1+='c';
                    s2+='a';
                    s3+='b';
                    s4+='a';
                    s5+='c';
                    s6+='b';
                }
            }
            // cout<<"s1 is "<<s1<<endl;
            // cout<<"s2 is "<<s2<<endl;
            // cout<<"s3 is "<<s3<<endl;
            // cout<<"s4 is "<<s4<<endl;
            // cout<<"s5 is "<<s5<<endl;
            // cout<<"s6 is "<<s6<<endl;
            vl prefix1(n+1,0),prefix2(n+1,0),prefix3(n+1,0),prefix4(n+1,0),prefix5(n+1,0),prefix6(n+1,0);
            ll temp1=0,temp2=0,temp3=0,temp4=0,temp5=0,temp6=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(s[i]!=s1[i]){
                    temp1++;
                }
                if(s[i]!=s2[i]){
                    temp2++;
                }
                if(s[i]!=s3[i]){
                    temp3++;
                }
                if(s[i]!=s4[i]){
                    temp4++;
                }
                if(s[i]!=s5[i]){
                    temp5++;
                }
                if(s[i]!=s6[i]){
                    temp6++;
                }
                prefix1[i+1]=temp1;
                prefix2[i+1]=temp2;
                prefix3[i+1]=temp3;
                prefix4[i+1]=temp4;
                prefix5[i+1]=temp5;
                prefix6[i+1]=temp6;
            }
            // printv(prefix1);
            // printv(prefix2);
            // printv(prefix3);
            // printv(prefix4);
            // printv(prefix5);
            // printv(prefix6);
            while(q--){
                ll l,r;
                cin>>l>>r;
                l--;
                // r--;
                ll ans=min({prefix1[r]-prefix1[l],prefix2[r]-prefix2[l],prefix3[r]-prefix3[l],prefix4[r]-prefix4[l],prefix5[r]-prefix5[l],prefix6[r]-prefix6[l]});
                cout<<ans<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }

        ll str_to_num(string s)

            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;

            return to_string(num);

        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n,k;
            cin>>n>>k;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll temp;
                cin>>temp;
                v[i]={temp,i};
            }
            srt(v);
            ll count=0;
            ll pre=-1;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(i==0){
                    pre=v[i].ss;
                    count=1;
                    continue;
                }
                if(v[i].ss==(pre+1)){
                    pre=v[i].ss;
                    continue;
                }
                else{
                    count++;
                    pre=v[i].ss;
                }
            }
            if(count<=k){
                yes
            }
            else{
                no
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll size_of_grid=sqrt(n);
            if(size_of_grid*size_of_grid!=n){
                size_of_grid++;
            }
            ll row=size_of_grid,col=size_of_grid;
            ll temp=pow(size_of_grid,2);
            ll diff=abs(n-temp);
            if(diff>=size_of_grid){
                diff-=size_of_grid;
                row=size_of_grid-diff-1;
                col=size_of_grid;
            }
            else{
                row=size_of_grid;
                col=diff+1;
            }
            cout<<row<<" "<<col<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

                            i++;
                        }

        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n,m;
            cin>>n>>m;
            ll ans=0;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n*m);
            for(ll i=0;i<n*m;i++){
                cin>>v[i].ff;
                v[i].ss=i;
            }
            srt(v);
            for(ll i=0;i<n*m;i++){
                v[i].ss*=-1;
            }
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                sort(v.begin()+m*i,v.begin()+m*i+m);
                for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
                    for(ll k=0;k<j;k++){
                        if(v[i*m+k].ss>v[i*m+j].ss){
                            ans++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);

        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;

                string s="";
                for(int j=0;j<i;j++){
                    s+='(';
                }
                for(int j=0;j<i;j++){
                    s+=')';
                }
                for(int j=0;j<n-i;j++){
                    s+='(';
                }
                for(int j=0;j<n-i;j++){
                    s+=')';
                }
                cout<<s<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }

			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vector<ll> v(n),temp(n);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                temp[i]=v[i];
            }
            srt(v);
            vector<vector<ll>> ans;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                // printv(temp);
                ll pos=-1;
                for(ll j=i;j<n;j++){
                    if(temp[j]==v[i]){
                        pos=j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                // cout<<" pos is "<<pos<<endl;
                rotate(temp.begin()+i,temp.begin()+pos,temp.end());
                // cout<<"after roat "<<endl;
                // printv(temp);
                if(abs(pos-i)>0){
                    ans.pb({i+1,n,abs(pos-i)});
                }
            }
            cout<<sz(ans)<<endl;
            for(auto x:ans){
                for(auto y:x){
                    cout<<y<<" ";
                }
                line;
            }
			return 0;
		}
};

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
	if(m==0) return 1;
	ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
	tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
	return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
	ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
		return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
	}
	ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return (n+m)%mod;
	}
	ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return n*m %mod;
	}
	ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
	}
	ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
	}
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
	private:
		// read only variable
		const ll INF=1e18;
		const ll mod1=1e9+7;
		const ll mod2=998244353;
	public:
		Codeforces(){
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y){
			ll result=1;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n,m,k;
			cin>>n>>m>>k;
			vector<vector<char>> grid(n,vector<char>(m));
			vector<vector<bool>> check(n,vector<bool>(m,false));
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
				for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
					cin>>grid[i][j];
				}
			}
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
				for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
					if(grid[i][j]=='*'){
						ll len=0;
						while(1){
							if(i-len<0||j-len<0||j+len>=m||grid[i-len][j-len]=='.'||grid[i-len][j+len]=='.'){
								break;
							}
							else{
								len++;
							}
						}
						len--;
						if(len>=k){
							check[i][j]=1;
							for(ll t=1;t<=len;t++){
								check[i-t][j-t]=1;
								check[i-t][j+t]=1;
							}
						}
						else{
							continue;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
				for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
					if(grid[i][j]=='*'&&check[i][j]==false){
						no
						return 0;
					}
				}
			}
			yes
			return 0;
		}
};

                }

            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;

                x%=mod;

        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            forin(v,n);
            priority_queue<pair<ll,ll>> q;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(v[i]>0){
                    q.push({v[i],i+1});
                }
            }
            vector<vector<ll>> ans;
            while(q.size()>1){
                ll a=q.top().ff;
                ll a_pos=q.top().ss;
                q.pop();
                ll b=q.top().ff,b_pos=q.top().ss;
                a--;
                b--;
                // cout<<"a and b is "<<a<<" "<<b<<endl;
                q.pop();
                ans.pb({a_pos,b_pos});
                if(a>0){
                    q.push({a,a_pos});
                }
                if(b>0){
                    q.push({b,b_pos});
                }
            }
            cout<<sz(ans)<<endl;
            for(auto x:ans){
                for(auto y:x){
                    cout<<y<<" ";
                }
                line;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
            cin>>n;
            if(n==1){
                cout<<1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            ll ans=1;
            for(ll i=3;i<=2*n;i++){
                ans=(ans*i)%mod1;
                // ans=(ans*i);
            }
            cout<<ans%mod1<<endl;
            // cout<<(ans/2)%mod1<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
};

				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}

			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;

		ll solve()
		{
			ll n,m,k;
            cin>>n>>m>>k;
            k-=2;
            if(m>(n*(n-1))/2){
                no
                return 0;
            }
            if(k<0){
                no
                return 0;
            }
            if(k==0){
                if(m==0&&n==1){
                    yes
                }
                else{
                    no
                }
                return 0;
            }
            if(m<(n-1)){
                no
                return 0;
            }
            if(k>=3){
                yes
                return 0;
            }
            if(k==1){
                if(m==(n*(n-1))/2){
                    yes
                }
                else{
                    no
                }
                return 0;
            }
            yes
			return 0;
		}
};

                if(num%i==0){
                    return true;

            return false;
        }
		ll solve()

                sum+=v[i];
            }
            if(composite(sum)){
                cout<<n<<endl;
                for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
                    cout<<i<<" ";
                }
                return 0;
            }

                for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){

                            if(j-1!=i){
                                cout<<j<<" ";
                            }
                        }
                        line;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            }
			return 0;
		}

		ll power(ll x,ll y){
			ll result=1;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll x,y;
			cin>>x>>y;
			ll ans=0;
			ll temp1=(y/3)*x;
			if(y%3){
				temp1+=(x/3)*(y%3);
                if(x%3){
                    if(x%3==2&&y%3==2){
                        temp1+=2;
                    }
                    else{
                        temp1++;
                    }
                }
			}
			ll temp2=(x/3)*y;
			if(x%3){
				temp2+=(y/3)*(x%3);
                if(x%3==2&&y%3==2){
                        temp2+=2;
                    }
                    else{
                        temp2++;
                    }
			}
			ans=min(temp1,temp2);
			cout<<ans<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
};

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

					result*=x;

				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}

				x*=x;

/*

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
	if(m==0) return 1;
	ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
	tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
	return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
	ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
		return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
	}
	ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return (n+m)%mod;
	}
	ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return n*m %mod;
	}
	ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
	}
	ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
	}
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
	private:
		// read only variable
		const ll INF=1e18;
		const ll mod1=1e9+7;
		const ll mod2=998244353;
	public:
		Codeforces(){
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y){
			ll result=1;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
            char ch;
            cin>>n>>ch;
            string s;
            cin>>s;
			ll last=-1;
			for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
				if(s[i-1]!=ch){
					last=i;
				}
			}
			if(s[n-1]!=ch){
				ll index=n-1;
				while(index>=0&&s[index]!=ch){
					index--;
				}
				if(index<0){
					cout<<"2\n"<<n<<" "<<n-1<<endl;
				}
				else{
					index++;
					if(index*2>n){
						cout<<"1\n"<<index<<endl;
					}
					else{
						cout<<"2\n"<<n<<" "<<n-1<<endl;
					}
				}
			}
			else{
				if(last==-1){
					cout<<0<<endl;
				}
				else{
					cout<<"1\n"<<n<<endl;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
	speed;
	/* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
		freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
		freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
	#endif */
	ll TestCase=1;
	cin>>TestCase;
	while(TestCase--)
	{
		Codeforces cf;
		cf.solve();
	}
}

				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
			cin>>n;
			vl a(n),b(n);
			map<ll,ll> ma,mb;
			for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
				cin>>a[i]>>b[i];
				ma[a[i]]++;
				mb[b[i]]++;
			}
			ll ans=(n*(n-1)*(n-2))/6;
			for(ll  i=0;i<n;i++){
				ans-=(ma[a[i]]-1)*(mb[b[i]]-1);
			}
			cout<<ans<<endl;
			return 0;
		}
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
	speed;
	/* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
		freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
		freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
	#endif */
	ll TestCase=1;
	cin>>TestCase;
	while(TestCase--)
	{
		Codeforces cf;
		cf.solve();
	}
}

bool compare(pair<ll,ll>& a,pair<ll,ll>& b)
{
    if(a.ff>b.ff)
        return true;
    else if(a.ff==b.ff)
    {
        if(a.ss<b.ss)
            return true;
        else
            return false;
    }
    else
        return false;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v.pb({a,b});
    }
    sort(v.begin(),v.end(),compare);
    ll a=v[k-1].ff,b=v[k-1].ss;
    ll count=0;
    for(auto x:v)
    {
        if(x.ff==a&&x.ss==b)
            count++;
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,x;

    vector<ll> v;
    v.pb(0);
    ll flag=0;
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp==x)
            flag=1;
        v.pb(temp);
    }
    if(flag==0)
    {
        n++;
        v.pb(x);
        count++;
    }
    srt(v);

    ll match_pos1=-1,match_pos2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]==x)
        {
            if(match_pos1==-1)
                match_pos1=i;
            match_pos2=i;

    {
        cout<<count<<endl;

    else if(match_pos1>required_pos)
    {
        count+=abs((2*match_pos1)-n-1);
        cout<<count<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        for(ll i=1;i<=10000;i++)
        {
            if((n+i+1)/2==(match_pos2+i))
            {
                cout<<count+i<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve(){
    int n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll negative=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
        if(v[i]<0){
            negative++;
            v[i]*=-1;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<negative;i++){
        v[i]*=-1;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++){
        if(v[i]<=v[i+1]){
            continue;
        }
        else{
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;
}
int main(){
    speed;
    /*
        #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

    cin>>n>>b;
    vl v(n);

    {

{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;

            n=n/i;
            temp+=n;
            i=1;
        }
    }
    temp++;
    cout<<temp<<endl;

ll cal(ll n){
    if(m.find(n)!=m.end())
        return m[n];
    ll ans=n;
    for(ll i=2;i<=sqrt(n);i++){
        if(n%i==0){
            ans=max({ans,n+cal(n/i),n+cal(i)});
        }
    }
    m[n]=ans;
    return ans;

typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;
	}
	return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll prime(ll num)
{
	ll count=0;
	loop(i,2,(sqrt(num)+1))
	{
		if(num%i==0)
		{
			count=1;
		}
	}
	return count;
}
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll n,k;
	cin>>n>>k;
	vl v;
	for(ll i=2;i<=n;i++)
	{
		if(prime(i)==0)
		{
			v.pb(i);
		}
	}
	ll count=0;
	loop(i,0,v.size()-1)
	{
		ll temp=v[i]+v[i+1]+1;
		if(prime(temp)==0&&temp<=n)
		{
			count++;
		}
	}
	if(count>=k)
		yes
	else
		no
}

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    ll a,b,c,d;
    ll count=0;
    if(s1.length()!=s2.length())
        no
    else
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<s1.length();i++)
        {
            if(s1[i]!=s2[i])
            {
                if(count==0)
                {
                    count++;
                    a=i;
                }
                else if(count==1)
                {
                    b=i;
                    count++;
                }
                else
                    count++;
            }
        }
        if(count!=2)
            no
        else
        {
            if(s1[a]==s2[b]&&s1[b]==s2[a])
                yes
            else
                no
        }
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
	ll n,a,b,c;
	cin>>n>>a>>b>>c;
	vector<ll> dp(n+1,0);
	dp[0]=0;
	for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
	{
		ll r1=LONG_MIN,r2=LONG_MIN,r3=LONG_MIN;
		if(i>=a)
			r1=dp[i-a];
		if(i>=b)
			r2=dp[i-b];
		if(i>=c)
			r3=dp[i-c];
		dp[i]=1+max({r1,r2,r3});
	}
	cout<<dp[n]<<endl;
	return 0;
}

	//freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
	pan;
	solve();
}

Title: 1947C Beautiful Triple Pairs
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve(){
	ll n, ans=0;
	cin>>n;
	map<tuple<ll,ll,ll>,ll> mp;
	vector<ll> v(n);
	for(auto &x:v){
		cin>>x;
	}
	for(ll i=0;i+2<n;i++){
		ans+=(mp[{v[i],v[i+1],-1}]+mp[{v[i],-1,v[i+2]}]+mp[{-1,v[i+1],v[i+2]}]-3*mp[{v[i],v[i+1],v[i+2]}]);
		mp[{v[i], v[i + 1], -1}]++;
		mp[{v[i], -1, v[i + 2]}]++;
		mp[{-1, v[i + 1], v[i + 2]}]++;
		mp[{v[i], v[i + 1], v[i + 2]}]++;
	}
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	int testCase=1;
	cin>>testCase;
	while(testCase--){
		solve();
	}
	return 0;
}

    forin(a,n);
    cin>>m;
    vl b(m);
    forin(b,m);

    ll maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll x[300],y[300];
vector<ll> edges[1005];
bool visited[1005];
void dfs(ll u)
{
    visited[u]=1;
    for(auto x:edges[u])
    {
        if(visited[x]==0)
        {
            dfs(x);
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    memset(visited,0,1005);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>x[i]>>y[i];
        edges[i].clear();
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++)
        {
            if(x[i]==x[j]||y[i]==y[j])
            {
                edges[i].pb(j);
                edges[j].pb(i);
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(visited[i]==0)
        {
            dfs(i);
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    {
        ll temp;

        v1.pb(temp);
        v2.pb(temp);

ll solve()
{

    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll ans=0;
    ll d=0;
    if (k==2)
    {
        for(ll i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if(s[i] == 'A' + (i&1) ) d++;
        ans = n - d < d ? n - d : d;
        for(ll i = 0; i < n; i++)
            s[i] = 'A' +( ( (d == ans) + i )&1 );
        cout<<ans<<endl;
        cout<<s;
        return 0;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if (s[i]==s[i+1])
        {
            char c = 'A';
            ll index=0;
            while((s[i+2]==c||s[i]==c))
            {
                index++;
                if (index<k)
                {
                    c= 'A'+index;
                }   
            }
            s[i+1]=c;
            ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    cout<<s;
    return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
const ll maxo=1024;
ll v[maxo][maxo];
ll rows[maxo],columns[maxo];
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld",&n,&m,&k);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
            scanf("%lld",&v[i][j]);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        rows[i]=i;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
        columns[i]=i;
    while(k--)
    {
        char ch;
        ll l,r;
        scanf(" %c%lld%lld",&ch,&l,&r);
        l--,r--;
        if(ch=='g')
            printf("%lld\n",v[rows[l]][columns[r]]);
        else if(ch=='r')
        {
            swap(rows[l],rows[r]);
        }
        else
        {
            swap(columns[l],columns[r]);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
}

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<ll> v(n);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        m[v[i]]++;
    }
    if(sz(m)<k)
        cout<<-1<<" "<<-1<<endl;
    else
    {
        m.clear();
        ll l=0,r=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(v[i]==v[0])
                l=i;
            else
                break;
        }
        if(k==1)
        {
            cout<<1<<" "<<1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        m[v[0]]++;
        r=l;
        for(r=l+1;r<n;r++)
        {
            m[v[r]]++;
            if(sz(m)==k)
            {
                for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++)
                {
                    if(m[v[i]]>1)
                    {
                        m[v[i]]--;
                        continue;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        l=i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                cout<<l+1<<" "<<r+1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    #endif */

    {
        solve();
    }
}

        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vl pos(n,0),neg(n,0);
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]>=0)
            count++;
        neg[i]=count;
    }
    count=0;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(v[i]<=0)
            count++;
        pos[i]=count;
    }
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++)
    {
        ll temp=neg[i]+pos[i+1];
        mini=min(mini,temp);
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll d(ll num,ll modulo)
{
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=ll(sqrt(num));i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
        {
            if((i*i)==num)
            {
                count++;
                count%=modulo;
            }
            else
            {
                count+=2;
                count%=modulo;
            }
        }
    }
    return count;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll a,b,c;
    cin>>a>>b>>c;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    ll modulo=1073741824;
    ll count=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=a;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=1;j<=b;j++)
        {
            for(ll k=1;k<=c;k++)
            {
                ll temp=(i*j*k);
                if(m[temp]>0)
                {
                    count+=m[temp];
                }
                else
                {
                    ll temp2=d(temp,modulo);
                    m[temp]=temp2;
                    count+=temp2;
                }
                count%=modulo;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    solve();

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<bool> check((n*k)+1,false);
    vector<ll> v[k];
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        v[i].pb(temp);
        check[temp]=true;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++)
    {
        if(v[i].size()<n)
        {
            ll require=abs(n-sz(v[i]));
            for(ll j=1;j<=n*k;j++)
            {
                if(check[j]==false)
                {
                    if(require>0)
                    {
                        require--;
                        v[i].pb(j);
                        check[j]=true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<k;i++)
    {
        for(auto X:v[i])
            cout<<X<<" ";
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,d;
    cin>>n>>d;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=0;
    ll left=0,right=0;
    for(left=0,right=0;left<=n-3;left++)
    {
        while(right<n&&v[right]-v[left]<=d)
        {
            right++;
        }
        ll count=right-left-1;
        count=((count*(count-1))/2);
        ans+=count;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
