// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k,sum=0;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl pos,neg;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp>0)
            pos.pb(temp);
        else
            neg.pb(temp);
    }
    srtGreat(neg);
    for(ll i=sz(neg)-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(k==0)
            break;
        else
        {
            k--;
            pos.pb(-neg.back());
            neg.pop_back();
        }
    }
    srt(pos);
    if(k>0)
    {
        if(k&1)
        {
            pos[0]*=-1;
        }
    }
    sum=accumulate(all(pos),0LL)+accumulate(all(neg),0LL);
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
}

        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        sum+=i*(n-i);
    }
    cout<<sum+n<<endl;

	}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll prime(ll temp)
{
	int count=0;
	for(int i=2;i<=sqrt(temp);i++)
	{
		if(temp%i==0)
		{
			count=1;
			break;
		}
	}
	return count;
}
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll count=0;
	if(n<=5)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	else
	{
		for(ll i=6;i<=n;i++)
		{
			set<ll> s;
			for(ll j=2;j<=i;j++)
			{
				if(prime(j)==0&&i%j==0)
				{
					s.insert(j);
				}
			}
			if(s.size()==2)
				count++;
		}
	}
	cout<<count<<endl;
}

    vl prime(100400,0);

    {
        if(prime[i]==0)
        {
            for(ll j=i*i;j<=100400;j+=i)

    {
        count=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            count+=(*lower_bound(all(ans),matrix[j][i])-matrix[j][i]);
        }
        mini=min(count,mini);
    }

    return 0;

// to run ctrl+b
ll tree1[300001];
void update(ll x,ll val,ll n)
{
    while(x<=n)
    {
        tree1[x]+=val;
        x+=(x&-x);
    }
}
ll read(ll x)
{
    ll sum=0;
    while(x>0)
    {
        sum+=tree1[x];
        x-=(x&-x);
    }
    return sum;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,q;
    cin>>n>>q;
    ll ans=0;
    vl v(n,0),count(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>v[i];
    srtGreat(v);
    while(q--)
    {
        ll l,r;
        cin>>l>>r;
        update(l,1,n);
        update(r+1,-1,n);
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        count[i-1]=read(i);
    }
    srtGreat(count);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ans+=(count[i]*v[i]);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    return to_string(num);

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll n,m,graph_length,max_length;
vector<ll> employes[101];
vector<ll> languages[101];
ll visited[101];
void dfs(ll employee)
{
    if(visited[employee])
        return ;
    visited[employee]=1;
    for(ll i=0;i<employes[employee].size();i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<languages[employes[employee][i]].size();j++)
        {
            dfs(languages[employes[employee][i]][j]);
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll checkMute=1;
    memset(visited,0,101);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        visited[i]=0;
        ll num;
        cin>>num;
        if(num>0)
            checkMute=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<num;j++)
        {
            ll lang;
            cin>>lang;
            employes[i].pb(lang);
            languages[lang].pb(i);
        }
    }
    if(checkMute)
    {
        cout<<n<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    ll graphCount=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(visited[i]==0)
        {
            graphCount++;
            dfs(i);
        }
    }
    cout<<graphCount-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
}

    forin(v,n);
    ll maxo=0,first=0,second=0,sum_=0;
    vl sum;
    sum.pb(0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        sum_+=v[i];
        sum.pb(sum_);
    }
    while(second<=n&&first<=n)
    {
        ll temp_sum=sum[second]-sum[first];
        ll len=abs(first-second);
        if(temp_sum>t)
        {
            first++;
        }
        else
        {
            maxo=max(maxo,len);
            second++;
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>

#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second

#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n, m, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> d;
    ll arr[n][m];
    for(ll i= 0;i < n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j = 0;j < m;j++)
            cin >> arr[i][j];
    }
    bool flag = true;
    ll x = arr[0][0] % d;
    for(ll i = 0;i < n;i++) {
        for(ll j = 0;j < m;j++) {
            if(arr[i][j] % d != x) {
                flag = false;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if(!flag)
    {
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    for(ll i = 0;i < n;i++) for(ll j = 0;j < m;j++) arr[i][j] /= d;
    ll ans = -1;
    for(ll i = 0;i < n;i++) {
        for(ll j = 0;j < m;j++) {
            ll cnt = 0;
            for(ll k = 0;k < n;k++) {
                for(ll l = 0;l < m;l++) {
                    cnt += abs(arr[i][j] - arr[k][l]);
                }
            }
            if(ans == -1) {
                ans = cnt;
            } else {
                ans = min(ans, cnt);
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    solve();
    // cc
    // {
    //     solve();
    // }
}

//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll t,sx,sy,ex,ey;
    cin>>t>>sx>>sy>>ex>>ey;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll north=0,south=0,east=0,west=0;
    if(ex>=sx)
    {
        west=0;
        east=abs(ex-sx);
    }
    else
    {
        east=0;
        west=abs(ex-sx);
    }
    if(ey>=sy)
    {
        south=0;
        north=abs(ey-sy);
    }
    else
    {
        south=abs(ey-sy);
        north=0;
    }
    // cout<<"dire "<<north<<" "<<south<<" "<<east<<" "<<west<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<t;i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='S')
        {
            if(south>0)
                south--;
        }
        else if(s[i]=='N')
        {
            if(north>0)
                north--;
        }
        else if(s[i]=='E')
        {
            if(east>0)
                east--;
        }
        else
        {
            if(west>0)
                west--;
        }
        if(north==0&&south==0&&east==0&&west==0)
        {
            cout<<i+1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    solve();
    // cc

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

int main()
{
    ll n,temp;
    cin>>n;
    ll pos=0,zero=0,neg=0;
    vl posv,zerov,negv;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp>0)
        {
            pos++;
            posv.pb(temp);
        }
        else if(temp<0)
        {
            neg++;
            negv.pb(temp);
        }
        else
        {
            zero++;
            zerov.pb(temp);
        }
    }
    cout<<1<<" "<<negv[0]<<endl;
    if(posv.size()>0)
    {
        cout<<1<<" "<<posv[0]<<endl;
        cout<<(posv.size()-1+negv.size()-1+zerov.size())<<" ";
        for(ll i=1;i<posv.size();i++)
            cout<<posv[i]<<" ";
        for(ll i=1;i<negv.size();i++)
            cout<<negv[i]<<" ";
        for(ll i=0;i<zerov.size();i++)
            cout<<zerov[i];
        line;
    }
    else
    {
        cout<<2<<" "<<negv[1]<<" "<<negv[2]<<endl;
        cout<<(zerov.size()+negv.size()-3)<<" ";
        for(ll i=0;i<zerov.size();i++)
            cout<<zerov[i]<<" ";
        for(ll i=3;i<negv.size();i++)
            cout<<negv[i]<<" ";
        line;
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,count=0;
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=i;j<=n;j++)
        {
            ll a=i*i,b=j*j;
            a=a+b;
            b=ll(sqrt(a));
            if((b*b)==a&&b<=n&&b>=1)
                count++;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{

    ll temp=str_to_num(s);
    if(temp>0)
    {
        cout<<temp<<endl;
    }
    else
    {
        ll temp1=str_to_num(s);
        string s1,s2="";
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(s);i++)
        {
            if(i==(sz(s)-1))
            {
                s2+=s[i];
            }
            else if(i==(sz(s)-2))
            {
                s1+=s[i];
            }
            else
            {
                s1+=s[i];
                s2+=s[i];
            }
        }
        ll temp2=str_to_num(s1);
        ll temp3=str_to_num(s2);
        cout<<max({temp1,temp2,temp3})<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;

#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
vector<vector<ll>> graph(101,vector<ll>());
ll dfs(vector<bool>& check,ll node){
    if(check[node])
        return 0;
    check[node]=true;
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        if(!check[x])
            dfs(check,x);
    }
    return 0;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll q;
    cin>>q;
    ll a,b,c;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v;
    while(q--){
        cin>>a>>b>>c;
        if(a==1){
            v.pb({b,c});
            for(ll i=0;i<sz(v);i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<sz(v);j++){
                    if(i!=j){
                        if((v[i].ff>v[j].ff&&v[i].ff<v[j].ss)||(v[i].ss>v[j].ff&&v[i].ss<v[j].ss)){
                            graph[i+1].pb(j+1);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            vector<bool> check(101,false);
            dfs(check,b);
            if(check[b]==true&&check[c]==true)
                cout<<"YES"<<endl;
            else
                cout<<"NO"<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())

T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll r, g, b;
    cin >> r >> g >> b;
    ll ans = (r / 3) + (g / 3) + (b / 3);
    ll r_r = r % 3, g_r = g % 3, b_r = b % 3;
    r -= r_r;
    g -= g_r;
    b -= b_r;
    if(r_r == 0 && g_r == 2 && b_r == 2)
    {
        if(r >= 2)
        {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    else if(r_r == 2 && g_r == 0 && b_r == 2)
    {
        if(g >= 2)
        {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    else if(r_r == 2 && g_r == 2 && b_r == 0)
    {
        if(b >= 2)
        {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        ans += min({r_r, g_r, b_r});
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll count_zero=0,one=0,maxo=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]==1)
        {
            one++;
            if(count_zero>0)
                count_zero--;
        }
        else
        {
            count_zero++;
            maxo=max(maxo,count_zero);
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo+one<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    {
        if(s[i]=='.')
            ans+='0';

/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll count=0;
    ll current=1;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp>n)
            temp=temp%n;
        if(temp==0)
            temp=n;
        if(temp>=current)
        {
            count+=abs(current-temp);
            current=temp;
        }
        else
        {
            count+=abs(n-current);
            count+=abs(0-temp);
            current=temp;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    solve();

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    ll temp;
    cin>>n;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        m[temp]++;
    }
    ll mini1=min({m[1],m[2],m[4]});
    ll mini2=min({m[1]-mini1,m[3],m[6]});
    ll mini3=min({m[1]-mini1-mini2,m[2]-mini1,m[6]-mini2});
    // cout<<"minis "<<mini1<<" "<<mini2<<" "<<mini3<<endl;
    if((mini3+mini2+mini1)==n/3)
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<mini1;i++)
            cout<<"1 2 4"<<endl;
        for(ll i=0;i<mini2;i++)
            cout<<"1 3 6"<<endl;
        for(ll i=0;i<mini3;i++)
            cout<<"1 2 6"<<endl;
    }
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    solve();

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

    ll five=0,zero=0;

        cin>>temp;
        if(temp==5)
            five++;
        else
            zero++;
    }
    // cout<<"five is "<<five<<endl;
    ll temp1=five/9;
    if(temp1<=0&&zero>0)
        cout<<0<<endl;
    else if(zero==0)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<temp1*9;i++)
            cout<<5;
        for(ll i=0;i<zero;i++)
            cout<<0;
        line;
    }
}

ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,temp;
    cin>>n;
    set<ll> s;
    map<ll,vector<ll>> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        m[temp].pb(i+1);
        s.insert(temp);
    }
    map<ll,ll> ans;
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        vl v;
        for(auto y:m[x])
        {
            v.pb(y);
        }
        if(v.size()==1)
        {
            ans[x]=0;
        }
        else
        {
            ll flag=0;
            ll d=v[1]-v[0];
            for(ll i=0;i+1<v.size();i++)
            {
                if(v[i+1]-v[i]!=d)
                {
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
            if(flag==0)
            {
                ans[x]=d;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans.size()<<endl;
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x.ff<<" "<<x.ss<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan
    solve();
}

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        sum1+=a;
        sum2+=b;
        if(a%2!=b%2)
            count++;
    }
    if(sum1%2==0 and sum2%2==0)
        cout<<0<<endl;
    else if(sum1&1&&sum2&1)
    {
        if(count>0)
            cout<<1<<endl;
        else
            cout<<-1<<endl;

    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;

                v[b]=1;

                v[b]=3;

                v[a]=1;
                v[b]=3;

            else
            {
                v[a]=1;
                v[b]=2;
            }
        }
        else if(v[a]>0&&v[b]>0&&v[c]==0)
        {
            temp[v[a]]++;
            temp[v[b]]++;
            for(ll i=1;i<=3;i++)
            {
                if(temp[i]==0)
                {
                    v[c]=i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        else if(v[a]>0&&v[c]>0&&v[b]==0)
        {
            temp[v[a]]++;
            temp[v[c]]++;
            for(ll i=1;i<=3;i++)
            {

    if(n<=2)
    {
    	cout<<"no"<<endl;

    vl pre(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

T mymax(T x,T y)

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// function

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
int Count,flag=0,free_cell,k,n,m;
void dfs(vector<vector<char>>& v,int i,int j,vector<vector<bool>>& check)
{
    if(flag)
        return ;
    if(check[i][j]==true||v[i][j]=='#')
        return ;
    else
    {
        check[i][j]=true;
        Count++;
        if(Count==(free_cell-k))
        {
            flag=1;
            return ;
        }
        if(i-1>=0)
            dfs(v,i-1,j,check);
        if(j-1>=0)
            dfs(v,i,j-1,check);
        if((i+1)<n)
            dfs(v,i+1,j,check);
        if((j+1)<m)
            dfs(v,i,j+1,check);
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    free_cell=0 ;
    vector<vector<char>> v(n,vector<char>(m));
    vector<vector<bool>> check(n,vector<bool>(m));
    ll first=0,second=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            check[i][j]=false;
            cin>>v[i][j];
            if(v[i][j]=='.')
            {
                first=i;
                second=j;
                free_cell++;
            }
            else
            {
                check[i][j]=true;
            }
        }
    }
    Count=0 ;
    dfs(v,first,second,check);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(v[i][j]=='.'&&check[i][j]==false)
                v[i][j]='X';
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cout<<v[i][j];
        }
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second

#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

int main()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll temp=0,flag=0;
    loop(i,0,n)
    {
        loop(j,0,m)
        {
            cin>>temp;
            if(temp==1)
            {
                if(i==0||i==n-1||j==0||j==m-1)
                {
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if(flag)
        cout<<2<<endl;
    else
        cout<<4<<endl;
}

typedef long long ll ;

#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1e9+7LL
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	vector<string> v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	ll len=v[0].size();
	string ans;
	for(ll i=0;i<len;i++)
	{
		set<char> s;
		for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
		{
			if(v[j][i]!='?')
				s.insert(v[j][i]);
		}
		if(s.size()>1)
			ans+='?';
		else if(s.size()==0)
			ans+='a';
		else
		{
			for(auto x:s)
				ans+=x;
		}
	}
	cout<<ans<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	pan
	solve();

// to run ctrl+b
ll dp[2005][2002];
const ll mod=1e9+7;
ll solve()
{
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    for(ll i=0;i<2002;i++)
        dp[1][i]=1;
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=2;i<=m;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
            for(ll k=j;k<=n;k+=j){
                dp[i][k]+=dp[i-1][j];
                dp[i][k]%=mod;
            }
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        ans=(ans+dp[m][i])%mod;
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

        solve();

#include<math.h>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	int n,no,count=0,rem=0;
	cin>>n;
	for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)
	{
		cin>>no;
		if(no>0)
		{
			count=count+no;
		}
		else if(no<0)
		{
			if(count<=0)
			{
				rem=rem+1;
			}
			else
			{
				count=count+no;
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<rem;
}

{
    return stoi(s);

{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;

        {
            return x+y+z;

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll N=1e5+2;
vector<ll> ans;
vector<bool> check(N,false);
vector<vector<ll>> graph(N,vector<ll>());
ll dfs(ll node,ll even,ll odd,ll level,vector<ll>& goal,vector<ll>& init){
    ll cur=0;
    if(level%2==0)
        cur=(init[node]+even)%2;
    else
        cur=(init[node]+odd)%2;
    if(goal[node]!=cur){
        ans.pb(node);
        if(level%2==0)
            even++;
        else
            odd++;
    }
    check[node]=true;
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        if(check[x]==false){
            dfs(x,even,odd,level+1,goal,init);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        graph[a].pb(b);
        graph[b].pb(a);
    }
    vl init(n+1,0),goal(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cin>>init[i];
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cin>>goal[i];
    }
    dfs(1,0,0,0,goal,init);
    cout<<sz(ans)<<endl;
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
const ll N=1e5+1;
vector<bool>check(N,false);
vector<vector<ll>> graph(N);
ll n;
vl initial(N,0);
vl final(N,0);
vl ans;
void dfs(ll node,ll odd,ll even,ll level){
    if(node<=0||node>n)
        return ;
    if(check[node])
        return ;
    check[node]=true;
    if(level&1){
        if(initial[node]!=final[node]){
            if(!(odd&1)){
                ans.pb(node);
                odd++;
            }
        }
        else{
            if(odd&1){
                ans.pb(node);
                odd++;
            }
        }
    }
    else{
        if(initial[node]!=final[node]){
            if(!(even&1)){
                ans.pb(node);
                even++;
            }
        }
        else{
            if(even&1){
                ans.pb(node);
                even++;
            }
        }
    }
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        if(check[x]==false){
            dfs(x,odd,even,(level+1)%2);
        }
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
        ll u,v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        graph[u].pb(v);
        graph[v].pb(u);
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>initial[i];
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>final[i];
    ll changes=0;
    dfs(1,0,0,0);
    cout<<sz(ans)<<endl;
    for(auto x:ans)
        cout<<x<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();

}

	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>temp;
		if(temp==100)
			one++;
		else
			two++;
	}
	ll sum=((two*2)+one);
	if(sum%2==0)
	{
		ll flag=0;

		{
			if((2*i)<=sum&&sum-(2*i)<=one)

				flag=1;
				break;
			}

			no
	}

    return (x>y)?x:y;

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v[i]={a,b};
    }
    ll fromlastdays=0,ans=0;
    for(ll day=1;day<=3001;day++)
    {
        ll curday=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(v[i].ff==day)
                curday+=v[i].ss;
        }
        if(curday+fromlastdays<=k)
        {
            ans+=fromlastdays+curday;
            fromlastdays=0;
        }
        else
        {
            ans+=k;
            ll temp=k-fromlastdays;
            if(temp<0)
                temp=0;
            fromlastdays=curday-temp;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

using namespace std;
int main()
{
	char ch;
	int d,count=0;
	int *arr=new int[26];
	fill_n(arr,26,0);
	cin>>ch;
	while(ch!='}')
	{
		if(int(ch)>=97 && int(char(ch))<=122)
		{
			d=int(char(ch))-97;
			arr[d]=arr[d]+1;
		}
		cin>>ch;
	}
	for(int i=0;i<26;i++)
	{
		if(arr[i]!=0)
		{
			count++;
		}
	}
	cout<<count;
}

bool check[101][101];
ll bfs(ll x,ll y,char ch)
{
    if(x>=n||y>=m)
        return 0;
    if(x<0||y<0)
        return 0;
    if(check[x][y]==false&&v[x][y]=='.')
    {
        check[x][y]=true;
        v[x][y]=ch;
        if(ch=='B')
            ch='W';
        else
            ch='B';
        bfs(x,y+1,ch);
        bfs(x+1,y,ch);
        bfs(x-1,y,ch);
        bfs(x,y-1,ch);
    }
    return 0;
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>v[i][j];
        }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(v[i][j]=='.')
            {
                bfs(i,j,'B');
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cout<<v[i][j];
        }
        line;
    }
    return 0;
}

    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(26,0);
    ll maxo=0,count=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<26;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<s.length();i++)

        ll temp=ll(s[i]-'a');
        count+=((i+1)*v[temp]);
    }
    for(ll i=s.length()+1;i<=n+s.length();i++)
        count+=(maxo*i);
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n),temp(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        temp[i]=v[i];
    }
    srt(v);
    ll first=-1,second=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]!=temp[i])
        {
            if(first==-1)
                first=i;
            second=i+1;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"first  "<<first<<" "<<second<<endl;
    reverse(temp.begin()+first,temp.begin()+second);
    // for(auto x)
    if(is_sorted(all(temp)))
    {
        cout<<"yes"<<endl;
        if(first==-1)
            first=0;
        if(second==-1)
            second=1;
        cout<<first+1<<" "<<second<<endl;
    }
    else
        cout<<"no"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    double n,m;
    cin>>m>>n;
    double ans=0.0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=m;i++)
    {
        double temp=(double)i;
        ans+=temp*(pow(temp/m,n)-pow((temp-1.0)/m,n));
    }
    cout<<fixed<<setprecision(12)<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

*/

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=0,pos=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i-1]>v[i])
        {
            ans++;
            pos=i;
        }
    }
    if(ans==0)
        cout<<0<<endl;
    else if(ans>1)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else if(ans==1)
    {
        if(v[0]>=v[n-1])
            cout<<n-pos<<endl;
        else
            cout<<-1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

        if(y%2==1)

*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    vector<ll> v(26,0);
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        v[ll(x-'A')]++;
    }
    srtGreat(v);
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<26;i++)
    {
        // cout<<"element is "<<v[i]<<endl;
        if(v[i]>0)
        {
            if(k>=v[i])
            {
                k-=v[i];
                sum+=(v[i]*v[i]);
            }
            else
            {
                sum+=(k*k);
                k=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        // cout<<"sum is "<<sum<<endl;
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,a,b;
    cin>>n>>m>>a>>b;
    ll mini=(n*a);
    for(ll i=0;i<=n;i++){
        ll temp=(m*i);
        ll cost=(i*b);
        if(temp<=n){
            cost+=(n-(m*i))*a;
        }
        mini=min(mini,cost);
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    {
        solve();

ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    vl v(n+1,0);
    vector<vector<ll>> dp(n+1,vector<ll> (n+1,0));
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
    	cin>>v[i];
    	v[i]+=v[i-1];
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=k;i++)
    {
    	for(ll j=i*m;j<=n;j++)
    	{
    		dp[i][j]=max(dp[i][j-1],dp[i-1][j-m]+v[j]-v[j-m]);

ll fac(ll n)
{
    ll ans=1;
    for(ll i=2;i<=n;i++)
        ans*=i;
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    ll plus1=0,plus2=0,minus1=0,minus2=0,unknown=0;
    for(auto x:s1)
    {
        if(x=='+')
            plus1++;
        else
            minus1++;
    }
    for(auto x:s2)
    {
        if(x=='+')
            plus2++;
        else if(x=='-')
            minus2++;
        else
            unknown++;
    }
    cout << fixed << setprecision(12);
    if(plus2>plus1 or minus2>minus1)
        cout<<0.0<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll total=pow(2,unknown);
        ll arrangement=fac(unknown);
        ll similar_plus=fac(plus1-plus2);
        ll similar_minus=fac(minus1-minus2);
        ll selected=(arrangement)/(similar_plus*similar_minus);
        double ans=(double)selected/total;
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;

    {
        solve();
    }

	ll m,s;

    if(s==0&&m>1||s>9*m)
        cout<<-1<<" "<<-1<<endl;
    else
    {
        ll temp=s;
        vl dp(m,0);
        if(m>1)
            dp[0]=1;
        temp--;
        for(ll i=m-1;i>=0;i--)
        {
            // cout<<"temp is "<<temp<<endl;
            if(temp>0)
            {
                if(temp>=9)

                    dp[i]+=9;

                   dp[i]+=temp;
                   temp=0;

            {
                break;
            }

        if(m==1)

            cout<<s;

        else
        {
            for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
            {
                if(dp[i]>0)
                {
                    cout<<dp[i];
                    pos=i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            for(ll i=0;i<pos;i++)
            {
                cout<<dp[i];
            }
            for(ll i=pos+1;i<m;i++)
            {
                cout<<dp[i];
            }
        }
        cout<<" ";
        vl dp2(m,0);
        for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
        {
            if(s>0)
            {
                if(s>=9)
                {
                    s-=9;
                    dp2[i]+=9;
                }
                else
                {
                    dp2[i]=s;
                    s=0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                break;
            }
        }
        srtGreat(dp2);
        for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
        {
            cout<<dp2[i];
        }
        line;

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// function

{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

    return stoi(s);

string num_to_str(ll num)

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,r,avg;
    cin>>n>>r>>avg;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(n);
    ll sum=0,need=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        v[i]={b,abs(r-a)};
        sum+=a;
    }
    need=(n*avg)-sum;
    if(need>0)
    {
        srt(v);
        ll cost=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(need>v[i].ss)
            {
                need-=v[i].ss;
                cost+=(v[i].ss*v[i].ff);
            }
            else
            {
                cost+=(need*v[i].ff);
                need=0;
                break;
            }
        }
        cout<<cost<<endl;
    }
    else
        cout<<0<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

*/

	cin>>d>>s;
	ll sum=0,sum2=0;
	vector<pair<ll,ll>> v(d);
	for(ll i=0;i<d;i++)
	{
		ll a,b;
		cin>>a>>b;
		v[i]=(mp(a,b));

			{
				s--;
				count--;
				temp++;
			}
			cout<<temp<<" ";
		}
		line;
	}
	return 0;

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }

int main()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll temp=n;
    ll maxo=0;
    while(temp!=0)
    {
        maxo=max(maxo,temp%10);
        temp/=10;
    }
    vector<string>dp(maxo,"");
    temp=n;
    while(temp!=0)
    {
        ll d=temp%10;
        temp/=10;
        for(ll i=0;i<d;i++)
        {
            dp[i]+="1";
        }
        for(ll i=d;i<maxo;i++)
        {
            dp[i]+='0';
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    string ans="";
    for(ll i=0;i<dp.size();i++)
    {
        ans=dp[i];
        reverse(all(ans));
        ll flag=0;
        for(auto x:ans)
        {
            if(x!='0')
            {
                flag=1;
            }
            if(flag!=0)
                cout<<x;
        }
        cout<<" ";
        // cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
    }
    line;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y)

	ll res=1;
	// x=x%mod;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)
		{
			res*=x;
			// res=res%mod;
		}
		y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
	}
	return res;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

{
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll flag=0;
	ll count=n-1;
	cout<<1<<" ";
	n--;
	ll pre=1;
	while(n--)
	{
		if(flag==0)
		{
			flag=1;
			pre+=count;
			cout<<pre<<" ";
			count--;
		}
		else
		{
			flag=0;
			pre-=count;
			cout<<pre<<" ";
			count--;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll ab=sz(s),ba=sz(s);
    for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(s);i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='A'&&s[i+1]=='B')
        {
            ab=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(s);i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='B'&&s[i+1]=='A')
        {
            ba=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    ll flag=0;
    for(ll i=ab+2;i+1<sz(s);i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='B'&&s[i+1]=='A')
        {
            flag++;
            break;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=ba+2;i+1<sz(s);i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='A'&&s[i+1]=='B')
        {
            flag++;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(flag)
        yes
    else
        no
    return 0;

		if(y%2==1)res*=x;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

int main()
{
	pan;
	ll n,x;
	cin>>n>>x;
	vl v;
	loop(i,1,sqrt(x)+1)
	{
		if(x%i==0)
		{
			if(i*i==x)
				v.pb(i);
			else

			}

				temp=no;
				max_++;
			}
		}

ll n,m;
const int max_=1e5+5;
vector<ll> cats(max_);
vector<ll> grp[max_];
vector<bool>check(max_,false);
void dfs(ll v,ll consecutive_cats,ll& count)
{
    check[v]=true;
    if(cats[v]==1)
        consecutive_cats++;
    else
        consecutive_cats=0;
    if(consecutive_cats>m)
        return ;
    if(v!=1&&ll(grp[v].size())==1)
        count++;
    for(auto x:grp[v])
    {
        if(check[x]==false)
        {
            dfs(x,consecutive_cats,count);
        }
    }
}

    ll count=0;
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
        cin>>cats[i];
    ll l,r;
    for(ll i=1;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        grp[a].pb(b);
        grp[b].pb(a);
    }
    count=0;
    dfs(1,0,count);
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    ll lower=0,upper=0;
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        if(x>='a'&&x<='z')
            lower++;
        else
            upper++;
    }
    string ans="";
    if(lower<upper)
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
            ans+=toupper(s[i]);
    }
    else
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
            ans+=tolower(s[i]);
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)

		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

int main()
{
	pan;
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	int count=0,flag=0;
	map<char,char> mp;
	mp['>']='<';
	mp[')']='(';
	mp['}']='{';
	mp[']']='[';
	stack<char> stk;
	loop(i,0,s.length())
	{
		if(s[i]=='('||s[i]=='{'||s[i]=='<'||s[i]=='[')
		{
			stk.push(s[i]);
		}
		else
		{
			if(stk.size())
			{
				char c;
				c=stk.top();
				if(c!=mp[s[i]])
					count++;
				stk.pop();
			}
			else
			{
				flag=1;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	if(flag==1||stk.size())
	{
		cout<<"Impossible"<<Endl;
	}
	else
		cout<<count<<endl;
}

    {
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
        {
            cin>>v[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll maxo=0;

            maxo=max(maxo,v[i][j]);

        ans[i]=maxo;

    {
        if(ans[i]==(n-1))
        {
            ans[i]++;
            break;
        }
    }
    for(auto s:ans)

    line;
    return 0;

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)

    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    string ans="";
    for(ll i=0;i<sz(a);i++)
    {

            ans+='0';

            ans+='1';
    }

#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int main()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    srtGreat(v);
    ll sum=0;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(m[v[i]]==0)
        {
            m[v[i]]++;
        }
        else
        {
            for(ll j=v[i]-1;j>=0;j++)
            {
                if(v[i]<=0)
                {
                    v[i]=0;
                    break;
                }
                if(m[v[i]]==0)
                {
                    m[v[i]]++;
                    break;
                }
                else
                {
                    v[i]--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(auto s:v)
    {
        if(s>=0)
            sum+=s;
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
}

void dfs(char ch){
    check[ch]=3;
    if(check[graph[ch]]!=3&&graph[ch])
        dfs(graph[ch]);
    ans+=ch;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        string s;
        cin>>s;
        for(ll i=1;i<sz(s);i++){
            graph[s[i-1]]=s[i];
            check[s[i]]=2;
        }
        if(check[s[0]]!=2)
            check[s[0]]=1;
    }
    for(char i='a';i<='z';i++){
        if(check[i]==1)
            dfs(i);
    }
    reverse(all(ans));
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {

    cin>>n>>a;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll count=0;
    if(v[a-1]==1)
        count++;
    ll left=a-1;
    ll right=a-1;
    // cout<<"top "<<count<<endl;
        while(left >= 0 || right <= n - 1) {
        left--;
        right++;
        if(left >= 0 && right <= n - 1) {
            if(v[left] == 1 && v[right] == 1) {
                count += 2;
            }
        } else if(left < 0 && right <= n - 1) {
            if(v[right] == 1) {
                count++;
            }
        } else if(left >= 0 && right >= n) {
            if(v[left] == 1) {
                count++;
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
}

const ll INF=LONG_MAX;

const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll alice=1,bob=n-2;
    ll alice_sum=v[0],bob_sum=v[n-1];
    while(1){
        if(alice>=n||bob<0||bob<alice)
            break;
        else{
            if(alice_sum>bob_sum){
                bob_sum+=v[bob];
                bob--;
            }
            else{
                alice_sum+=v[alice];
                alice++;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<alice<<" "<<n-alice<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    cin>>n>>s;
    ll ans1=0,ans2=0;
    ll temp1=0,temp2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i%2==0&&s[i]=='r')
            temp1++;
        else if(i%2==1&&s[i]=='b')
            temp2++;
    }
    ans1=max(temp1,temp2);
    temp1=0,temp2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(i%2==0&&s[i]=='b')
            temp1++;
        else if(i%2==1&&s[i]=='r')
            temp2++;
    }
    ans2=max(temp1,temp2);
    cout<<min(ans1,ans2)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

                cout<<(maxo-1-c)<<endl;
            else if(a==c&&a!=b)
                cout<<maxo-1-b<<endl;
            else
                cout<<(maxo-1-b)+(maxo-1-c)<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else if(maxo==b)
        {
            if(b==a&&b!=c)
                cout<<maxo-1-c<<endl;
            else if(b==c&&b!=a)
                cout<<maxo-1-a<<endl;
            else
                cout<<(maxo-1-a)+(maxo-1-c)<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else if(maxo==c)
        {
            if(c==a&&c!=b)
                cout<<maxo-1-b<<endl;
            else if(c==b&&c!=a)
                cout<<maxo-1-a<<endl;
            else
                cout<<(maxo-1-b)+(maxo-1-a)<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	pan
	solve();
    // cc
    // {
    // 	solve();
    // }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;

	vl v(n);
	forin(v,n);
	ll count=0;
	unordered_map<ll,ll> m;
	for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		ll temp=(x^v[i]);
		count+=m[temp];
		m[v[i]]++;
	}

    {

        no

    {

        no

        yes
}

    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }

{
    string s1,s2;
    cin>>s1>>s2;
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    cout<<s1<<" "<<s2<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {

    while(n--)
    {
        cin>>a>>b;
        v1.pb(mp(a,b));
    }
    cin>>m;
    while(m--)
    {
        cin>>a>>b;
        v2.pb(mp(a,b));
    }
    ll max1=0,min1=LONG_MAX,max2=0,min2=LONG_MAX;
    for(auto s:v1)
    {
        max1=max(max1,s.ff);
        min1=min(min1,s.ss);
    }
    for(auto x:v2)
    {
        max2=max(max2,x.ff);
        min2=min(min2,x.ss);
    }
    maxo=max(0LL,max(max2-min1,max1-min2));
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
}

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl odd_pos,odd_neg,even_pos,even_neg;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp>0){
            if(temp&1)
                odd_pos.pb(temp);
            else
                even_pos.pb(temp);
        }
        else{
            if(temp&1)
                odd_neg.pb(temp);
            else
                even_neg.pb(temp);
        }
    }
    ll sum=0;
    for(auto x:even_pos)
        sum+=x;
    srt(odd_pos);
    for(auto x:odd_pos)
        sum+=x;
    srtGreat(odd_neg);
    if(sz(odd_pos)%2==0){
        if(sz(odd_pos)){
            if(sz(odd_neg)){
                sum-=min(abs(odd_neg[0]),odd_pos[0]);
            }
            else
                sum-=odd_pos[0];
        }
        else{
            if(sz(odd_neg)){
                if(!(sum&1))
                    sum+=odd_neg[0];
            }
            else{
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    return to_string(num);

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<string> v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    ll sum=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<sz(v[0]);i++){
        rotate(v[0].begin(),v[0].begin()+1,v[0].end());
        sum=0;
        for(ll j=1;j<n;j++){
            ll count=-1;
            string temp=v[j];
            if(temp==v[0])
                count=0;
            else{
                for(ll k=0;k<sz(temp);k++){
                    rotate(temp.begin(),temp.begin()+1,temp.end());
                    // cout<<"temp is "<<j<<temp<<endl;
                    if(temp==v[0]){
                        // cout<<"equal hua "<<v[0]<<endl;
                        count=k+1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(count==-1){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            else
                sum+=count;
        }
        if(i!=sz(v[0])-1)
            sum+=i+1;
        mini=min(mini,sum);
    }
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);

string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    if(k>(n*n)){
        cout<<-1<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<vector<ll>> grid(n+1,vector<ll>(n+1,0));
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
            if(k>0){
                if(i==1&&j==1){
                    k--;
                    grid[i][j]=1;
                    continue;
                }
                else if(i==j){
                    grid[i][j]=1;
                    k--;
                }
                else{
                    if(k>=2){
                        if(grid[i][j]==0)
                            k--;
                        if(grid[j][i]==0)
                            k--;
                        grid[i][j]=1;
                        grid[j][i]=1;
                    }
                }
            }
            else
                break;
        }
    }
    if(k==0){
        for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
            for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++)
                cout<<grid[i][j]<<" ";
            line;
        }
    }
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

Title: 817C Really Big Numbers
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef set<pair<int,int>> spi;
typedef set<pair<ll,ll>> spl;
typedef vector<pair<int,int>> vpi;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef vector<pair<ll,ll>> vpl;
typedef vector<string> vs;
typedef map<int,int>mi;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<string> ss;
typedef set<int> si;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
#define mod 1000000007;
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define loopi(a,b) for(int i=a;i<=b;i++)
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl
// function
ll digit_sum(ll mid)
{
	ll sum=0;
	while(mid!=0)
	{
		sum+=mid%10;
		mid/=10;
	}
	return sum;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int main()
{
	pan;
	ll n,s;
	cin>>n>>s;
	if(s<0)
	{
		cout<<0<<endl;
		return 0;
	}
	else
	{
		ll ans=0;
		ll left=0;
		ll right=n;
		ll mid=0;
		while(left<=right)
		{
			mid=(left+right)/2;
			if(mid-digit_sum(mid)>=s)
			{
				ans=n-mid+1;
				right=mid-1;
			}
			else
			{
				left=mid+1;
			}
		}
		cout<<ans<<endl;
	}
}

ll d(ll temp)
{
	ll count=0;
	for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(temp);i++)
	{
		if(temp%i==0)
		{
			if(temp/i==i)
				count++;
			else
				count+=2;
		}
	}
	// cout<<"count is "<<count<<endl;
	return count;
}
int main()
{
	pan;
	char ch1,ch2;
	cin>>ch1>>ch2;
	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	map<char,int> m;
	m['v']=0;
	m['<']=1;
	m['^']=2;
	m['>']=3;
	n=n%4;
	if(n==0)
		cout<<"undefined"<<endl;
	else
	{
		ll start=m[ch1];
		ll temp_n=n;
		while(n--)
		{
			if(start>3)
				start=0;
			start++;
		}
		if(start>3)
				start=0;
		ll end=m[ch2];
		if(end==start&&temp_n!=2)
			cout<<"cw"<<endl;
		else if(end!=start&&temp_n!=2)
			cout<<"ccw"<<endl;
		else
			cout<<"undefined"<<endl;
	}
}

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;

        if(y%2==1)

            // res=res%mod;

    return to_string(num);

    public:
        ll x;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll zero=0,one=0;
    ll ans=0;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(n,vector<ll>(m,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>v[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            if(v[i][j]==0)
                zero++;
            else
                one++;
        }
        ans+=pow(2,one)-1+pow(2,zero)-1;
        zero=0;
        one=0;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            if(v[j][i]==0)
                zero++;
            else
                one++;
        }
        ans+=pow(2,one)-1+pow(2,zero)-1;
        ans-=one;
        ans-=zero;
        zero=0;
        one=0;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

    return to_string(num);

// to run ctrl+b

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll a,b,f,k;
    cin>>a>>b>>f>>k;
    ll count=0;
    ll fuel=b;
    ll flag=0;
    while(k>1){
        if(flag==0){
            if(fuel>=(a+a-f)){
                k--;
                flag=1;
                fuel-=a;
            }
            else{
                if(fuel>=f){
                    fuel-=f;
                    fuel=b;
                    count++;
                    if(fuel>=2*(a-f)){
                        fuel-=(a-f);
                        k--;
                        flag=1;
                    }
                    else{
                        cout<<-1<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
                else{
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            if(fuel>=(a+f)){
                fuel-=a;
                k--;
                flag=0;
            }
            else{
                if(fuel>=(a-f)){
                    fuel-=(a-f);
                    fuel=b;
                    count++;
                    if(fuel>=(2*f)){
                        fuel-=f;
                        flag=0;
                        k--;
                    }
                    else{
                        cout<<-1<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
                else{
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    while(k){
        if(flag==0){
            if(fuel>=a){
                fuel-=a;
                k--;
            }
            else{
                if(fuel<f){
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
                fuel=b;
                count++;
                if(fuel>=(a-f)){
                    k--;
                }
                else{
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
        else{
            if(fuel>=a){
                k--;
            }
            else{
                if(fuel<(a-f)){
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
                fuel=b;
                count++;
                if(fuel>=f){
                    k--;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    //cin>>TestCase;

    {
        solve();

    return to_string(num);

/* ascii value

//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl a(n+1,0);
    vl fre(n+1,0);
    vl h(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cin>>a[i];
        h[a[i]]++;
    }
    ll count=0;
    set<ll> s;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(h[i]==0){
            s.insert(i);
        }
        else{
            count+=h[i]-1;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(h[a[i]]==1){
            fre[a[i]]=1;
            continue;
        }
        if(fre[a[i]]||*s.begin()<a[i]){
            h[a[i]]--;
            a[i]=*s.begin();
            fre[*s.begin()]=1;
            s.erase(s.begin());
        }
        else{
            fre[a[i]]=1;
        }
    }        
    cout<<count<<endl;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        cout<<a[i]<<" ";
    }
    line;
    return 0;
}

#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/

    v.pb("Nikita");

    {
        for(ll i=0;i<s.length();i++)
        {
            ll pos=0;
            ll count2=0;
            if(s[i]==x[0])
            {
                for(ll j=i;j<i+x.length();j++)
                {
                    if(s[j]==x[pos])
                    {
                        pos++;
                        count2++;
                    }
                    else
                        break;
                }
            }
            if(count2==x.length())
                count++;
        }
    }
    if(count==1)
        yes
    else
        no
}

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    return stoi(s);

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll N=1e5+5;
ll freq[N];
ll v[5][100];
void process1(ll i,ll j){
    for(ll x=1;x<=6;x++){
        for(ll y=1;y<=6;y++){
            ll temp=v[i][x]*10+v[j][y];
            freq[temp]++;
        }
    }
}
void process2(ll i,ll j,ll k){
    for(ll x=1;x<=6;x++){
        for(ll y=1;y<=6;y++){
            for(ll z=1;z<=6;z++){
                ll temp=v[i][x]*100+v[j][y]*10+v[k][z];
                freq[temp]++;
            }
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=6;j++){
            cin>>v[i][j];
            freq[v[i][j]]++;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
            if(i!=j){
                process1(i,j);
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
            if(i!=j){
                for(ll k=1;k<=n;k++){
                    if(k==i||k==j)
                        continue;
                    process2(i,j,k);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=1000;i++){
        if(freq[i]==0){
            cout<<i-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

        ll temp=(pow(2,i)-1)*(pow(2,i-1));
        if(temp>n)
            break;
        else
        {
            v.pb(temp);
        }
    }
    for(auto s:v)
    {
        if(n%s==0)
        {
            maxo=max(maxo,s);
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll dfs(vector<vector<ll>>& graph,ll node,ll n,vector<bool>& check){
    if(node>n)
        return 0;
    if(check[node]==true)
        return 0;
    check[node]=true;
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        dfs(graph,x,n,check);
    }
    return 0;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> c(n+1);
    vector<bool> check(n+1,false);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        c[i]={temp,i};
    }
    srt(c);
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
    for(ll i=1;i<=m;i++){
        ll u,v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        graph[u].pb(v);
        graph[v].pb(u);
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        ll pos=c[i].ss;
        if(check[pos]==false){
            ans+=c[i].ff;
            dfs(graph,pos,n,check);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<char>> s(n,vector<char>(m));
    vector<vector<ll>>a(100,vector<ll>(26,0)),b(100,vector<ll>(26,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>s[i][j];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            a[i][s[i][j]-'a']++;
            b[j][s[i][j]-'a']++;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(a[i][s[i][j]-'a']+b[j][s[i][j]-'a']==2)
                cout<<s[i][j];
        }
    }
    line;
}

Title: 910A The way to home
<code>
/*
	written by Pankaj Kumar.
	country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve(){
	ll n,d;
	cin>>n>>d;
	string s;
	cin>>s;
	ll j=0,current_pos=0,count=0;
	while(j<n)
	{
		ll temp_pos=0;
		for(ll k=j+1;k<=j+d&&k<n;k++)
		{
			if(s[k]=='1')
				temp_pos=k;
		}
		if(temp_pos!=0)
		{
			current_pos=temp_pos;
			j=temp_pos;
			count++;
		}
		else
			break;
	}
	if(j==n-1)
		cout<<count<<endl;
	else
		cout<<-1<<endl;
	return 0;
}
int main()
{
	int testCase=1;
	while(testCase--){
		solve();
	}
	return 0;
}

// define values.
#define mod 1000000007;
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))

// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y)
{
	ll res=1;
	while(y>0)
	{
		if(y%2==1)res*=x;
		y/=2; x*=x;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

int main()
{
	pan;
	int n,temp;
	cin>>n;
	vi v(n,0),v1(n,0);
	for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>temp;
		v[i]=temp;
		v1[i]=temp;
	}
	sort(v.begin(),v.end());
	int first=-1;
	int second=-1;
	int mini=1000000;
	for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		if(v1[i]==v[0])
		{
			// cout<<"hai "<<i<<endl;
			first=i;
		}
		for(int j=first+1;j<n;j++)
		{
			if(v1[j]==v[1])
			{
				second=j;
				break;
			}
		}
		if(first>=0&&second>0)
		{
			// cout<<"posit "<<first<<" "<<second<<endl;
			mini=min(mini,abs(first-second));
			// cout<<"mini is "<<mini<<endl;
			first=-1;
			second=-1;
		}
	}
	cout<<mini<<endl;
}

        count=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
            cin>>v[i][j];

                count++;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
set<ll>s;
ll l,r;
void cal(ll num){
    if(num>r)
        return ;
    if(s.find(num)!=s.end())
        return ;
    s.insert(num);
    cal(num*2);
    cal(num*3);
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    cin>>l>>r;
    cal(1);
    ll count=0;
    for(auto x:s){
        // cout<<"x is "<<x<<endl;
        if(x>=l&&x<=r)
            count++;
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vl a(n),b(m);
    forin(a,n);
    forin(b,m);
    ll ans=INF;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=-INF;
        for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
            if(j!=i){
                for(ll k=0;k<m;k++){
                    temp=max(temp,a[j]*b[k]);
                }
            }
        }
        ans=min(ans,temp);
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)

#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

{
    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    vl a,b,c;
    ll A=0,B=0,C=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<s.length();i++)
    {
        if(s[i]=='a')
        {
            a.pb(i);
            A++;
        }
        else if(s[i]=='b')
        {
            B++;
            b.pb(i);
        }
        else
        {
            C++;
            c.pb(i);
        }
    }
    if(C==A||C==B)
    {
        if(a.size()==0||a[0]!=0)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        if(b.size()==0||b[0]!=a[a.size()-1]+1)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        if(c.size()==0||c[0]!=b[b.size()-1]+1)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        for(ll i=0;1+i<a.size();i++)
        {
            if(a[i+1]-a[i]!=1)
            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;1+i<b.size();i++)
        {
            if(b[i+1]-b[i]!=1)
            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;1+i<c.size();i++)
        {
            if(c[i+1]-c[i]!=1)
            {
                no
                return 0;
            }
        }
        yes
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        no
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan
    solve();
}

    		if(str_to_num(s)>=n)
    		{
    			cout<<s<<endl;
    			return 0;
    		}
    	}
    	while(next_permutation(all(s)));
    }
    return 0;
}

		m[temp]++;
	}

	it=m.begin();
	string most=it->ff;

#define ss second

#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
vector<bool>check(200001,0);
vector<vector<ll>> grp(200001);
vector<ll> degree(200001,false);
void dfs(ll& v,ll& flag)
{
    if(degree[v]!=2)
    {
        flag=1;
    }
    check[v]=true;
    for(auto x:grp[v])
    {
        if(check[x]==false)
        {
            dfs(x,flag);
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    ll count=0;
    cin>>n>>m;
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        grp[a].pb(b);
        grp[b].pb(a);
        degree[a]++;
        degree[b]++;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        ll flag=0;
        if(check[i]==false)
        {
            // cout<<"start dfs "<<i<<endl;
            dfs(i,flag);
            // cout<<"dfs end "<<i<<" and flag is "<<flag<<endl;
            if(flag==0)
            count++;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// function
ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

        cout<<n+1<<endl;

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>mt[i][j];
            if(mt[i][j]=='1')
            {
                ans[j]++;
            }
        }
    }
    // for(auto x:ans)
    //     cout<<"x is "<<x<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll flag=0;
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(mt[i][j]=='1')
            {
                // cout<<"j is "<<j<<" and  i is "<<i<<" ans "<<ans[j]<<endl;
                if(ans[j]<2)
                {
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
        }
        if(flag==0)
        {
            yes
            return 0;
        }
    }
    no
    return 0;
}

//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl s(n);
    forin(s,n);
    vl c(n);
    forin(c,n);
    ll mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=1;i+1<n;i++){
        ll temp_1=LONG_MAX,temp_2=LONG_MAX;
        for(ll j=0;j<i;j++){
            if(s[j]<s[i]){
                temp_1=min(temp_1,c[j]);
            }
        }
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++){
            if(s[j]>s[i]){
                temp_2=min(temp_2,c[j]);
            }
        }
        if(temp_1!=LONG_MAX and temp_2!=LONG_MAX)
            mini=min(mini,temp_2+temp_1+c[i]);
    }
    if(mini==LONG_MAX)
        mini=-1;
    cout<<mini<<endl;
    return 0;
}
