ll solve()
{
    ll n,p;
    string s;
    cin>>n>>p>>s;
    bool check=1;
    for(ll i=p;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i-p]=='.'&&s[i]!='.'){
            ll temp=s[i]-'0';
            temp^=1;
            s[i-p]=char(temp+'0');
            check=0;
        }
        else if(s[i]=='.'&&s[i-p]!='.'){
            ll temp=s[i-p]-'0';
            temp^=1;
            s[i]=char(temp+'0');
            check=0;
        }
        else if(s[i]=='.'&&s[i-p]=='.'){
            s[i-p]='0',s[i]='1';
            check=0;
        }
        else{
            check&=(s[i]==s[i-p]);
        }
    }
    if(check){
        no
    }
    else{
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(s[i]=='.')
            s[i]='0';
        }
        cout<<s<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    return to_string(num);

// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    ll l,r,x,y;
    cin>>l>>r>>x>>y;
    ll ans=0;
    ll product = y/x;
    if(y%x){
        ans=0;
    }
    else{
        // cout<<"proiduct is "<<product<<endl;
        for(ll i=1;i<=ll(sqrt(product));i++){
            if(product%i==0){
                ll a=i,b=product/i;
                ll no1=a*x,no2=b*x;
                if(ll(__gcd(a,b))==1&&no1>=l&&no1<=r&&no2>=l&&no2<=r){
                    // cout<<"a and b is "<<a<<" "<<b<<endl;
                    if(a==b){
                        ans++;
                    }
                    else{
                        ans+=2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

	ll n;
	cin>>n;
	ll count=0;
	for(auto s:v)
	{
		count+=n/s;
		n=n%s;
	}

}

using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<bool> vb;
typedef vector<char> vc;
typedef map<ll,ll> ml;
typedef set<char>sc;
typedef set<ll> sl;
#define pan cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,b;
    cin>>n>>b;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    vector<ll> ans;
    ll odd=0,even=0;
    for(ll i=0;i+1<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]&1)
            odd++;
        else
            even++;
        if(odd==even)
        {
            ans.push_back(abs(v[i]-v[i+1]));
        }
    }
    srt(ans);
    ll count=0;
    for(auto x:ans)
    {
        b-=x;
        if(b>=0)
            count++;
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    solve();
    // cc
    // {
    //     solve();

    return 0;
}

// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(26,0);
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll sum=0;
    string ans="";
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        v[ll(x-'a')]++;
    }
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        ll sum=0;
        ll temp=ll(x-'a');
        for(ll i=0;i<temp;i++)
            sum+=v[i];
        if(k>0)
        {
            if(sum<k&&(sum+v[temp])>=k)
            {
                v[temp]--;
                k--;
            }
            else if(sum>=k)
                ans+=x;
        }
        else
            ans+=x;
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan;
    solve();
    // cc

}

{
    string s;
    getline(cin,s);
    ll count=0,flag=-1,letter=0;
    for(auto x:s)
    {
        if(flag==1)
        {
            if(x==' '||(x>='a'&&x<='z')||(x>='A'&&x<='Z'))
                letter++;
            else if(x==','||x==':'||x==';'||x=='-')
                flag=0;
        }
        if(x=='(')
        {
            letter=0;
            flag=1;
            count++;
        }
        else if(x==')')
        {
            count++;
            if(flag==1&&letter>=0)
            {
                flag=0;
                count-=2;
            }
            letter=0;
        }
    }
    cout<<count<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
vector<int> v[2005];
int vis[2005];
int dfs(int a)
{
    int z = 0;
    vis[a] = 1;
    for (int x : v[a])
    {
        if (!vis[x])
            z = max(z, dfs(x));
    }
    return (z + 1);
}
void solve()
{
    set<int> boss;
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
    {
        int t;
        cin >> t;
        if (t == -1)
            boss.insert(i);
        else
            v[t].push_back(i);
    }
    int z = 0;
    for (int a : boss)
    {
        z = max(z, dfs(a));
    }
    cout << z;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase=1;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve()
{
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> d(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){
        cin >> d[i];
    }
    sort(d.begin(), d.end());
    long long num =(long long) d[0] * d[n - 1];
    vector<int> b;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(num); i++)
    {
        if (num % i == 0)
        {
            b.push_back(i);
            if (i != num / i)
                b.push_back(num / i);
        }
    }
    sort(b.begin(), b.end());
    if (b == d)
        cout << num << endl;
    else
        cout << -1 << endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase = 1;
    cin >> testCase;
    while (testCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin >> n;
    ll a, b, c;
    cin >> a >> b >> c;
    map<char, ll> m;
    m['R'] = a;
    m['P'] = b;
    m['S'] = c;
    string s, ans = "";
    ll win = 0, lose = 0;
    cin >> s;
    for (auto x : s)
    {
        if (x == 'R')
        {
            if (m['P'] > 0)
            {
                win++;
                m['P']--;
                b--;
                ans += 'P';
            }
            else
                ans += '@';
        }
        else if (x == 'P')
        {
            if (m['S'] > 0)
            {
                c--;
                win++;
                m['S']--;
                ans += 'S';
            }
            else
                ans += '@';
        }
        else if (x == 'S')
        {
            if (m['R'] > 0)
            {
                a--;
                win++;
                m['R']--;
                ans += 'R';
            }
            else
                ans += '@';
        }
    }
    if (win >= ((n + 1) / 2))
    {
        cout<<"YES"<<endl;
        for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (ans[i] == '@')
            {
                if (a > 0)
                {
                    a--;
                    ans[i] = 'R';
                }
                else if (b > 0)
                {
                    b--;
                    ans[i] = 'P';
                }
                else
                {
                    c--;
                    ans[i] = 'S';
                }
            }
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    else{
        cout<<"NO"<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    long long testCase;
    cin>>testCase;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

Title: 140C New Year Snowmen
<code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
    int n;
    map<int, int> mp;
    cin>>n;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    vector<vector<int>> ans;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    {
        cin>>arr[i];
        mp[arr[i]]++;
    }
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    for (auto it : mp)
    {
        q.push({it.second, it.first});
    }
    while (q.size() > 2)
    {
        vector<pair<int, int>> v(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        {
            v[i] = q.top();
            q.pop();
        }
        vector<int> pos;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; ++k)
        {
            pos.push_back(v[k].second);
            v[k].first--;
            if (v[k].first){
                q.push(v[k]);
            }
        }
        sort(pos.rbegin(),pos.rend());
        ans.push_back(pos);
    }
    cout << ans.size() << endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < ans.size(); ++i)
    {
        cout << ans[i][0] << " " << ans[i][1] << " " << ans[i][2] << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve(){
    long long n;
    cin>>n;
    long long mini = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f, maxo = 0;
    // cout<<"mini "<<mini<<" "<<LONG_MAX<<" "<<mini-LONG_MAX<<endl;
    for(long long i=1;i*i*i<=n;i++){
        if(n%i==0){
            for(long long j=1;j*j<=(n/i);j++){
                if((n/i)%j==0){
                    long long k=(n/i)/j;
                    maxo = max(maxo, (i + 1) * (j + 2) * (k + 2));
                    maxo = max(maxo, (i + 2) * (j + 1) * (k + 2));
                    maxo = max(maxo, (i + 2) * (j + 2) * (k + 1));
                    mini = min(mini, (i + 1) * (j + 2) * (k + 2));
                    mini = min(mini, (i + 2) * (j + 1) * (k + 2));
                    mini = min(mini, (i + 2) * (j + 2) * (k + 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<mini-n<<" "<<maxo-n<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    int testCase=1;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }

    double princess = p * t,T;
    int bijous = 0;
    if (p < d)
    {
        while (princess < c)
        {
            T = princess / (d - p);
            princess += T * p;

                bijous++;

        }
    }

    for (long long i = 2; i * i <= n; i++)
    {
        if (n % i == 0)
        {
            long long temp = n / i;
            for (long long j = 2; j * j <= temp; j++)
            {
                if (temp % j == 0)
                {
                    cout << 1 << endl
                         << i * j << endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            cout << 2;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << 1 << endl
         << 0;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase=1;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
	if(m==0) return 1;
	ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
	tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
	return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
	ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
		return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
	}
	ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return (n+m)%mod;
	}
	ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return n*m %mod;
	}
	ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
	}
	ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
	}
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
	private:
		// read only variable
		const ll INF=1e18;
		const ll mod1=1e9+7;
		const ll mod2=998244353;
	public:
		Codeforces(){
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y){
			ll result=1;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            forin(v,n);
            vector<ll> bit(33,0);
            for(auto x:v){
                int num=x;
                int pos=0;
                while(num){
                    if(num&1){
                        bit[pos]++;
                    }
                    num>>=1;
                    pos++;
                }
            }
            ll hcf=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<33;i++){
                hcf=__gcd(hcf,bit[i]);
            }
            // cout<<"hcf "<<hcf<<endl;
            if(hcf==0){
                for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
                    cout<<i<<" ";
                }
                line;
                return 0;
            }
            vl ans;
            // ans.pb(1);
            for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(hcf);i++){
                if(hcf%i==0){
                    if(i*i==hcf){
                        ans.pb(i);
                    }
                    else{
                        ans.pb(i);
                        ans.pb(hcf/i);
                    }
                }
            }
            srt(ans);
            for(auto x:ans){
                cout<<x<<" ";
            }
            line;
			return 0;
		}
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
	speed;
	/* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
		freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
		freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
	#endif */
	ll TestCase=1;
	cin>>TestCase;
	while(TestCase--)
	{
		Codeforces cf;
		cf.solve();
	}
}

                        temp[i][j]=v[j];

                    map<ll,ll> mp;
                    for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
                        mp[temp2[j]]++;
                    }

                        v[j]=mp[temp2[j]];

                }

            cin>>q;
            while(q--){
                ll x,k;
                cin>>x>>k;
                x--;
                if(k>=10){
                    k=10;
                }
                cout<<temp[k][x]<<endl;
            }
			return 0;
		}

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve(){
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    bool ok = true;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
    {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        bool found = false;
        for (int j = i + 1; j >= 2; j--)
        {
            if (x % j)
            {
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        ok &= found;
    }
    if (ok)
    {
        cout << "YES\n";
    }
    else
    {
        cout << "NO\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase=1;
    cin>>testCase;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

	}

					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;

		}

		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n;
			cin>>n;
			vl v(n);
			forin(v,n);
			if(n%2==0){
				yes
				return 0;
			}
			bool strict_increasing=true;
			for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
				if(v[i]<=v[i-1]){
					strict_increasing=false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if(!strict_increasing){
				yes
				return 0;
			}
			else{
				no
				return 0;
			}
			return 0;
		}
};

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        bool check_ab_ba_equal(string s){
            int ab=0,ba=0;
            for(int i=0;i+1<sz(s);i++){
                if(s[i]=='a' && s[i+1]=='b'){
                    ab++;
                }
                if(s[i]=='b' && s[i+1]=='a'){
                    ba++;
                }
            }
            return ab==ba;
        }
        ll solve()
        {
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            int n=sz(s);
            string ans=s;
            int mini=INT_MAX;
            if(check_ab_ba_equal(s)){
                cout<<ans<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            for(int i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
                int length=0;
                string temp=s;
                if(s[i]=='a'){
                    for(int j=i;j<n;j++){
                        if(temp[j]=='a'){
                            temp[j]='b';
                            length++;
                        }
                        else{
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                else{
                    for(int j=i;j<n;j++){
                        if(temp[j]=='b'){
                            temp[j]='a';
                            length++;
                        }
                        else{
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if(check_ab_ba_equal(temp)&&length<mini){
                    ans=temp;
                    mini=length;
                }
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

    }
}

}
namespace mod_operations{
	ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
		return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
	}
	ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return (n+m)%mod;
	}
	ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return n*m %mod;
	}
	ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
		return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
	}
	ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
		return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
	}
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
	private:
		// read only variable
		const ll INF=1e18;
		const ll mod1=1e9+7;
		const ll mod2=998244353;
	public:
		Codeforces(){
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y){
			ll result=1;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
			ll result=1;
			x%=mod;
			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){
					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n,q;
            cin>>n>>q;
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            vector<bool>check(n,false);
            ll ans=0;
            for(ll i=0;i+2<n;i++){
                if(s[i]=='a'&&s[i+1]=='b'&&s[i+2]=='c'){
                    ans++;
                    check[i]=true;
                    check[i+1]=true;
                    check[i+2]=true;
                }
            }
            // cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
            while(q--){
                ll pos;
                char c;
                cin>>pos>>c;
                pos--;
                if(check[pos]){
                    if(s[pos]=='a'){
                        if(c=='a'){
                            // do nothing
                        }
                        else if(c=='b'){
                            ans--;
                            check[pos]=false;
                            check[pos+1]=false;
                            check[pos+2]=false;
                        }
                        else{
                            ans--;
                            check[pos]=false;
                            check[pos+1]=false;
                            check[pos+2]=false;
                            ll flag=0;
                            if(pos-1>=0&&s[pos-1]=='b'){
                                flag++;
                            }
                            if(pos-2>=0&&s[pos-2]=='a'){
                                flag++;
                            }
                            if(flag==2){
                                ans++;
                                check[pos]=true;
                                check[pos-1]=true;
                                check[pos-2]=true;
                            }                            
                        }
                    }
                    else if(s[pos]=='b'){
                        if(c=='b'){
                            // do nothing
                        }
                        else{
                            ans--;
                            check[pos]=false;
                            check[pos+1]=false;
                            check[pos-1]=false;
                        }
                    }
                    else{
                        if(c=='c'){
                            // do nothing
                        }
                        else if(c=='b'){
                            ans--;
                            check[pos]=false;
                            check[pos-1]=false;
                            check[pos-2]=false;
                        }
                        else{
                            ans--;
                            check[pos]=false;
                            check[pos-1]=false;
                            check[pos-2]=false;
                            ll flag=0;
                            if(pos+1<n&&s[pos+1]=='b'){
                                flag++;
                            }
                            if(pos+2<n&&s[pos+2]=='c'){
                                flag++;
                            }
                            if(flag==2){
                                ans++;
                                check[pos]=true;
                                check[pos+1]=true;
                                check[pos+2]=true;
                            }                            
                        }
                    }
                    s[pos]=c;
                }
                else{
                    // yes
                    s[pos]=c;
                    ll flag=0;
                    // cout<<"temp_string is "<<temp_string<<endl;
                    for(ll i=pos;i<=pos+2;i++){
                        if(i<n&&s[i]==char('a'+i-pos)){
                            flag=1;
                        }
                        else{
                            flag=0;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if(flag){
                        ans++;
                        check[pos]=true;
                        check[pos+1]=true;
                        check[pos+2]=true;
                    }
                    flag=0;
                    for(ll i=pos-2;i<=pos;i++){
                        if(i<n&&s[i]==char('a'+i-pos+2)){
                            flag=1;
                        }
                        else{
                            flag=0;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if(flag){
                        ans++;
                        check[pos]=true;
                        check[pos-1]=true;
                        check[pos-2]=true;
                    }
                    if((pos-1>=0&&s[pos-1]=='a')&&(pos+1<n&&s[pos+1]=='c')&&s[pos]=='b'){
                        ans++;
                        check[pos]=true;
                        check[pos-1]=true;
                        check[pos+1]=true;
                    }
                }
                // cout<<"string is "<<s<<endl;
                // printv(check);
                cout<<ans<<endl;
            }
			return 0;
		}
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
	speed;
	/* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
		freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
		freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
	#endif */
	ll TestCase=1;
	// cin>>TestCase;
	while(TestCase--)
	{
		Codeforces cf;
		cf.solve();
	}
}

            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        bool check(ll k,vector<ll> diff_v,ll h){
            ll sum=0;
            for(auto x:diff_v){
                sum+=min(k,x);
            }
            sum+=k;
            // cout<<"sum="<<sum<<" h="<<h<<endl;
            return sum>=h;
        }
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n,h;
            cin>>n>>h;
            // h++;
            vl v(n);
            forin(v,n);
            vl diff_v(n-1);
            ll diff=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
                diff=abs(v[i+1]-v[i]);
                // diff++;
                diff_v[i]=diff;
            }
            ll first=1,second=1e18;
            while(second>first){
                ll mid=(first+second)/2;
                // cout<<"mid is "<<mid<<endl;
                if(check(mid,diff_v,h)){
                    second=mid;
                }
                else{
                    first=mid+1;
                }
            }
            cout<<first<<endl;
            // cout<<"first is "<<first<<" second is "<<second<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

Title: 1615B And It's Non Zero
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    // pre calculation
    vector<ll> bit_count(19, 0);
    vector<vector<ll>> bit_count_map(200001);
    for (ll i = 0; i <= 18; i++)
    {
        bit_count_map[0].push_back(0);
    }
    for (ll i = 1; i <= 200000; i++)
    {
        ll pos = 0;
        ll temp = i;
        while (temp)
        {
            if (temp & 1)
            {
                bit_count[pos]++;
            }
            temp >>= 1;
            pos++;
        }
        for (ll j = 0; j <= 18; j++)
        {
            bit_count_map[i].push_back(bit_count[j]);
        }
    }
    ll test;
    cin >> test;
    while (test--)
    {
        ll l, r;
        cin >> l >> r;
        ll total = abs(l - r) + 1;
        ll mini = LONG_MAX;
        for (ll bits = 0; bits <= 18; bits++)
        {
            ll total_set_bit = 0;
            total_set_bit = bit_count_map[r][bits] - bit_count_map[l - 1][bits];
            ll mini_temp = total - total_set_bit;
            mini = min(mini, mini_temp);
            // cout<<"total_set_bit : "<<total_set_bit<<endl;
        }
        cout << mini << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    long long testCase;
    cin>>testCase;
    while(testCase--){
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)

    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);

        {
            vl v(7);
            forin(v,7);

            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            ll hcf1=0,hcf2=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                if(i&1){
                    hcf2=__gcd(hcf2,v[i]);
                }
                else{
                    hcf1=__gcd(hcf1,v[i]);
                }
            }
            // cout<<"t "<<hcf1<<" "<<hcf2<<endl;
            if(hcf1==hcf2){
                cout<<0<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            else{
                ll flag=0;
                for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                    if(i&1&&v[i]%hcf1==0){
                        flag=1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(flag){
                    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                        if(i%2==0&&v[i]%hcf2==0){
                            flag++;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if(flag==2){
                        cout<<0<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                    else{
                        cout<<hcf2<<endl;
                        return  0;
                    }                   
                }
                else{
                    cout<<hcf1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;

        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }

        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }

        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            set<ll> st;
            for(ll i=1;i*i<=n;i++){
                st.insert(i*i);
            }
            for(ll i=1;i*i*i<=n;i++){
                st.insert(i*i*i);
            }
            cout<<sz(st)<<endl;
            return 0;
        }

                }

            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;

            pk>>num;

        ll solve()
        {
            string a,s;
            cin>>a>>s;
            ll n=sz(a);
            ll m=sz(s);
            string ans="";
            ll first=n-1,second=m-1;
            while(first>=0 && second>=0){
                // yes
                if(s[second]>=a[first]){
                    ans+=char('0'+(s[second]-'0')-(a[first]-'0'));
                    first--;
                    second--;
                }
                else{
                    if(second>=1){
                        ll temp_num=s[second-1]-'0';
                        temp_num*=10;
                        temp_num+=s[second]-'0';
                        char temp='1';
                        temp=char('0'+((temp_num)-(a[first]-'0')));
                        if(temp>='0'&&temp<='9'){
                            ans+=temp;
                        }
                        else{
                            cout<<-1<<endl;
                            return 0;
                        }
                        first--;
                        second-=2;
                    }
                    else{
                        cout<<-1<<endl;
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(first>=0){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            string temp_ans=s.substr(0,second+1);
            reverse(all(temp_ans));
            ans+=temp_ans;
            ll pos=-1;
            reverse(all(ans));
            for(ll i=0;i<ans.size();i++){
                if(ans[i]!='0'){
                    pos=i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(pos==-1){
                cout<<0<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            string final_ans="";
            for(ll i=pos;i<sz(ans);i++){
                final_ans+=ans[i];
            }
            cout<<final_ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
int solve()
{
    long long w, h;
    cin >> w >> h;
    long long maxo = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
    {
        long long k;
        cin >> k;
        long long x, y;
        cin >> x;
        k--;
        while (k--)
        {
            cin >> y;
        }
        if (i < 2)
        {
            maxo = max(maxo, (y - x) * h);
        }
        else
        {
            maxo = max(maxo, (y - x) * w);
        }
    }
    cout << maxo << endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    int testCase = 1;
    cin >> testCase;
    while (testCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}

                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            forin(v,n);
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            vl ans(n);
            ans=v;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> dislike,like;
            ll dislike_count=0;
            ll number=1;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(s[i]=='0'){
                    dislike_count++;
                    dislike.pb({v[i],i});
                }
                else{
                    like.pb({v[i],i});
                }
            }
            srt(dislike);
            srt(like);
            number=1;
            for(auto x:dislike){
                ans[x.ss]=number;
                number++;
            }
            for(auto x:like){
                ans[x.ss]=number;
                number++;
            }
            printv(ans);
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */

    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}

                    result*=x;

                x*=x;

                cin>>v[i];

            srt(v);
            vector<ll> check(n+1,false);
            ll count=0;
            for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
                ll temp=v[i];
                while(temp>=1){
                    if(temp<=n && check[temp]==false){
                        check[temp]=true;
                        count++;
                        break;

                    }

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
class Codeforces
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            map<ll,vector<ll>> m;
            ll flag=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll temp;
                cin>>temp;
                m[temp].pb(i);
                if(sz(m[temp])>1){
                    flag=1;
                }
            }
            if(flag){
                ll max_length=0;
                for(auto x:m){
                    for(ll i=0;i+1<x.ss.size();i++){
                        max_length=max(max_length, (x.ss[i]+n-x.ss[i+1]));
                    }
                }
                cout<<max_length<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            else{
                cout<<-1<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

		ll power(ll x,ll y){

			while(y>0){
				if(y&1){

		{
			ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll vertex_with_more_than_one_degree=0;
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> edges;
            map<ll,vector<ll>> m;
            map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> m1;
            vector<bool>check(n+1,false);
            for(ll i=1;i<n;i++){
                ll u,v;
                cin>>u>>v;
                m[u].pb(v);
                m[v].pb(u);
                edges.pb({min(u,v),max(u,v)});
            }
            for(auto x:m){
                // yes
                // cout<<x.ff<<" ";
                // for(auto y:x.ss){
                //     cout<<y<<" ";
                // }
                // line;
                if(x.ss.size()>2){
                    vertex_with_more_than_one_degree++;
                }
            }
            if(vertex_with_more_than_one_degree>0){
                cout<<-1<<endl;
            }
            else{
                ll vertex_with_degree_one=0;
                for(auto x:m){
                    if(x.ss.size()==1){
                        vertex_with_degree_one=x.ff;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                ll flag=0,count=n-1;
                while(count--){
                    // cout<<"with degree one "<<vertex_with_degree_one<<endl;
                    for(auto y:m[vertex_with_degree_one]){
                        // cout<<"  connecte "<<y<<endl;
                        if(check[y]==false){
                            // cout<<"y is "<<y<<endl;
                            m1[{min(vertex_with_degree_one,y),max(y,vertex_with_degree_one)}]=flag+2;
                            flag^=1;
                            check[vertex_with_degree_one]=true;
                            vertex_with_degree_one=y;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for(auto x:edges){
                    cout<<m1[x]<<" ";
                }
                line;
            }
			return 0;
		}
};

					result*=x;
					result%=mod;
				}
				y>>=1;
				x*=x;
				x%=mod;
			}
			return result;
		}
		ll str_to_num(string s)
		{
			stringstream pk(s);
			ll num;
			pk>>num;
			return num;
		}
		string num_to_str(ll num)
		{
			return to_string(num);
		}
		// Techniques :
		// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
		// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
		// transform into graph
		// Experience :
		// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
		ll solve()
		{
			ll n,k;
			cin>>n>>k;
			ll total=(n*k);
			ll even=(total+1)/2;
			ll odd=total-even;
			ll number_of_row=(even/k)+(odd/k);
			if(number_of_row!=n||odd%k||even%k){
				no
				return 0;
			}
			else{
				yes
				vector<ll> even,odd;
				vector<vector<ll>> grid(n,vector<ll>(k));
				for(ll i=1;i<=n*k;i++){
					if(i&1){
						odd.pb(i);
					}
					else{
						even.pb(i);
					}
				}
				ll even_pos=0,odd_pos=0;
				ll flag=1;
				for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
					if(flag){
						for(ll j=0;j<k;j++){
							grid[i][j]=odd[odd_pos++];
							if(odd_pos>=odd.size()){
								flag=0;
							}
						}
					}
					else{
						for(ll j=0;j<k;j++){
							grid[i][j]=even[even_pos++];
							if(even_pos>=even.size()){
								flag=1;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
					for(ll j=0;j<k;j++){
						cout<<grid[i][j]<<" ";
					}
					cout<<endl;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
	speed;
	/* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
		freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
		freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
	#endif */
	ll TestCase=1;
	cin>>TestCase;
	while(TestCase--)
	{
		Codeforces cf;
		cf.solve();
	}
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Atcoder
{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Atcoder(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s)
        {
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num)
        {
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            vector<pair<ll,ll>> a(n);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                a[i]=mp(v[i],i);
            }
            srt(a);
            ll c=-1,b=-1;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(a[i].ff!=v[i]){
                    c=i,b=a[i].ss;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(c==-1){
                printv(v);
            }
            else{
                // cout<<"c "<<c<<" "<<b<<endl;
                if(c>b){
                    swap(c,b);
                }
                for(ll i=0;i<c;i++){
                    cout<<v[i]<<" ";
                }
                for(ll i=b;i>=c;i--){
                    cout<<v[i]<<" ";
                }
                for(ll i=b+1;i<n;i++){
                    cout<<v[i]<<" ";
                }
                line;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

        Atcoder at;

#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;

// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"No"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0){
        if(y%2==1){
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s){
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num){
    return to_string(num);
}
/* ascii value 
    A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
    //Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
    //priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve(){
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl odd,even;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp&1){
            odd.pb(temp);
        }
        else{
            even.pb(temp);
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(odd);i++){
        if(odd[i]<odd[i-1]){
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<sz(even);i++){
        if(even[i]<even[i-1]){
            no
            return 0;
        }
    }
    yes
    return 0;
}

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif 
    */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        solve();
    }
}

        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve()
        {
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            map<char,ll> m;
            ll flag=0;
            for(auto x:s){
                if(x=='R'||x=='G'||x=='B'){
                    if(x=='R'){
                        x='r';
                    }
                    else if(x=='G'){
                        x='g';
                    }
                    else{
                        x='b';
                    }
                    if(m[x]){
                        flag++;
                    }
                }
                m[x]++;
            }
            if(flag==3){
                yes
            }
            else{
                no
            }
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

    #endif */

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            vector<vector<ll>> suffix(sz(s)+1,vector<ll>(27,0));
            for(ll i=sz(s)-1;i>=0;i--){
                for(ll j=0;j<26;j++){
                    ll temp=s[i]-'a';
                    if(temp==j){
                        suffix[i][j]=suffix[i+1][j]+1;
                    }
                    else{
                        suffix[i][j]=suffix[i+1][j];
                    }
                }
            }
            string ans="";
            ll pos=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
                ll temp=s[i]-'a';
                if(suffix[i+1][temp]){
                    continue;
                }
                else{
                    pos=i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            ans=s.substr(pos,sz(s)-pos);
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

<code>

    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            ll sum=0;
            priority_queue<ll> p,q;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                ll x;
                cin>>x;
                p.push(x);
                sum+=x;
            }
            // cout<<"sum is "<<sum<<endl;
            q.push(sum);
            for(ll i=1;i<=n-1;i++){
                if(i==1){
                    ll x=q.top();
                    q.pop();
                    ll temp1=x/2;
                    ll temp2=x-temp1;
                    q.push(temp1);
                    q.push(temp2);
                }
                else{
                    while(p.size()&&q.size()&&p.top()==q.top()){
                        p.pop();
                        q.pop();
                    }
                    ll x=q.top();
                    q.pop();
                    ll temp1=x/2;
                    ll temp2=x-temp1;
                    q.push(temp1);
                    q.push(temp2);
                }
                while(p.size()&&q.size()&&p.top()==q.top()){
                    p.pop();
                    q.pop();
                }
            }
            // cout<<"after loop size "<<q.size()<<" "<<p.size()<<endl;
            while(p.size()&&q.size()&&p.top()==q.top()){
                p.pop();
                q.pop();
            }
            if(p.size()==0 && q.size()==0){
                yes
            }
            else{
                no
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

    speed;

    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;

        Codeforces cf;

        const ll mod1=1e9+7;

    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>> n;
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            ll move=0;
            stack<char> st;
            ll pos=-1;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(st.size()){
                    move++;
                    pos=i;
                    st.pop();
                }
                else{
                    if(s[i]=='('){
                        st.push(s[i]);
                    }
                    else{
                        pos=i-1;
                        bool flag=false;
                        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++){
                            if(s[j]==')'){
                                pos=j;
                                i=j;
                                flag=true;
                                move++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if(!flag){
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            cout<<move<<" "<<n-pos-1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

            string s="";
            ll temp_r=r;
            ll temp=(r+b)/(b+1);
            ll temp2=n-(temp*(b+1)); // remain
            for(ll i=0;i<b;i++){
                if(temp2){
                    temp2--;
                }
                else{
                    if(temp2==0){
                        temp--;
                        temp2=-1;
                    }

                    s+='R';
                    temp_r--;
                }
                r=temp_r;
                s+='B';
            }
            while(temp_r>0){
                s+='R';
                temp_r--;
            }            
            cout<<s<<endl;
            return 0;
        }

        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n,k;
            string s;
            cin>>n>>k>>s;
            vector<ll> v(n,0);
            if(k&1){
                ll pos_first_one=n-1;
                for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                    if(s[i]=='1'){
                        pos_first_one=i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                    if(i==pos_first_one){
                        continue;
                    }
                    if(s[i]=='0'){
                        s[i]='1';
                    }
                    else{
                        s[i]='0';
                    }
                }
                k--;
                v[pos_first_one]++;
            }
            // cout<<"temp s "<<s<<endl;
            ll one=0,zero=0;
            vector<ll> v_zero,v_one;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(s[i]=='0'){
                    zero++;
                    v_zero.pb(i);
                }
                else{
                    one++;
                    v_one.pb(i);
                }
            }
            for(ll i=0;i+1<v_zero.size() && k>0;i+=2){
                v[v_zero[i]]++;
                v[v_zero[i+1]]++;
                s[v_zero[i]]='1';
                s[v_zero[i+1]]='1';
                k-=2;
            }
            if(v_zero.size()&1 && k>0){
                v[v_zero.back()]++;
                s[v_zero.back()]='1';
                s[n-1]='0';
                v[n-1]++;
                k-=2;
            }
            if(k>0){
                v[n-1]+=k;
            }
            cout<<s<<endl;
            printv(v);
            return 0;
        }
};
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--){
        Codeforces cf;
        cf.solve();
    }
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vector<ll> parent(n+1);
            parent[0]++;
            for(ll i=1;i<=n-1;i++){
                ll p;
                cin>>p;
                parent[p]++;
            }
            vector<ll> degree;
            for(auto x:parent){
                if(x>0){
                    degree.pb(x);
                }
            }
            srt(degree);
            ll ans=sz(degree);
            priority_queue<ll> pq;
            for(ll i=0;i<sz(degree);i++){
                ll temp=max(0LL,degree[i]-i-1);
                if(temp>0){
                    pq.push(temp);
                }
            }
            ll d=0;
            while(pq.size() && pq.top()>d){
                d++;
                ans++;
                ll u=pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                pq.push(u-1);
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

    speed;

}

        ll power(ll x,ll y){

            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }

        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }

        // transform into graph

        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.

            ll a,b;
            cin>>a>>b;
            ll mini=min(a,b);
            ll maxo=max(a,b);
            if(mini==1){
                if(maxo<=2){
                    if(maxo==1){
                        cout<<0<<endl;
                    }
                    else{
                        cout<<1<<endl;
                    }
                }
                else{
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
                return 0;
            }
            else{
                ll ans=0;
                ans+=(mini-1)*2;
                // cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
                maxo-=mini;
                if(maxo&1){
                    ans+=(maxo/2)*4;
                    ans++;
                }
                else{
                    ans+=(maxo/2)*4;
                }
                cout<<ans<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Codeforces{
    private:
        // read only variable
        const ll INF=1e18;
        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:
        Codeforces(){
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph
        // Experience :
        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n;
            cin>>n;
            vl v(n);
            ll ans=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
            }
            // sum->index+1
            map<ll,ll> m;
            ll sum=0;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                sum+=v[i];
                m[sum]=i+1;
            }
            sum=0;
            for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
                sum+=v[i];
                if(m[sum]>0 && m[sum]<(i+1)){
                    ans=max(ans,m[sum]+n-i);
                }
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

        const ll mod1=1e9+7;
        const ll mod2=998244353;
    public:

        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y){
            ll result=1;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod){
            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                    result%=mod;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
                x%=mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
        ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
        string num_to_str(ll num){
            return to_string(num);
        }
        // Techniques :
        // divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
        // sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
        // transform into graph

        // Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
        ll solve(){
            ll n,m;
            cin>>n>>m;
            vector<vector<char>> grid(n,vector<char>(m));
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
                    cin>>grid[i][j];
                }
            }
            vector<vector<char>> ans(n,vector<char>(m,'.'));
            for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
                ll sum=0;
                for(ll j=0;j<n;j++){
                    if(grid[j][i]=='*'){
                        sum++;
                    }
                    else if(grid[j][i]=='o'){
                        ans[j][i]='o';
                        for(ll k=1;k<=sum;k++){
                            ans[j-k][i]='*';
                        }
                        sum=0;
                    }
                }
                if(sum){
                    for(ll k=1;k<=sum;k++){
                        ans[n-k][i]='*';
                    }
                }
            }
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                for(ll j=0;j<m;j++){
                    cout<<ans[i][j];
                }
                cout<<endl;
            }
            return 0;
        }
};

        ll solve(){
            ll n,k;
            cin>>n>>k;
            ll ans=0;
            vector<ll> bit_count(31,0);
            vector<ll> v(n);
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                cin>>v[i];
                for(ll j=0;j<31;j++){
                    if(v[i]&(1<<j)){
                        bit_count[j]++;
                    }
                }
            }
            for(ll i=30;i>=0;i--){
                if(bit_count[i]+k>=n){
                    k-=(n-bit_count[i]);
                    bit_count[i]=n;
                }
                if(k==0){
                    break;
                }
            }
            for(ll i=30;i>=0;i--){
                if(bit_count[i]==n){
                    ans+=(1<<i);
                }
            }
            cout<<ans<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
};

            ll flag=1;

                ll diff=temp[i-1]-temp[i];
                if(diff==0 || diff==1 || diff==2){

                    flag=0;
                    break;
                }

                yes
                return 0;

        ll solve(){
            string s;
            cin>>s;
            ll n=sz(s);
            map<char,ll> m;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                m[s[i]]++;
            }
            if(sz(m)==1){
                cout<<"YES"<<endl;
                return 0;
            }
            map<char,vector<ll>> m2;
            for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
                m2[s[i]].pb(i);
            }
            for(auto x:m2){
                for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(x.ss);i++){
                    if(abs(x.ss[i]-x.ss[i+1])<sz(m)){
                        no
                        return 0;
                    }
                }

            yes
            return 0;

ll solve(){
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    ll n=sz(s);
    ll one=0,zero=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='1'){
            one=i+1;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]=='0'){
            zero=i+1;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(one==0 && zero==0){
        cout<<n<<endl;
    }
    else if(one==0){
        cout<<zero<<endl;
    }
    else if(zero==0){
        cout<<n-one+1<<endl;
    }
    else{
        cout<<abs(one-zero)+1<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

    // x=x%mod;

            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
