bool check_palindrome(ll n){
    string s=to_string(n);
    string s1=s;
    reverse(all(s));
    return s1==s;
}
ll solve(){
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(n);i++){
        if(n%i==0){
            if((i*i)==n){
                if(check_palindrome(i)){
                    ans++;
                }
            }
            else{
                if(check_palindrome(i)){
                    ans++;
                }
                if(check_palindrome(n/i)){
                    ans++;
                }
            }            
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    for(auto x:s){
        if(x>='A'&&x<='Z'){
            upper++;
        }
        else if(x>='a'&&x<='z'){
            lower++;
        }
        else if(x>='0'&&x<='9'){
            digit++;
        }
        else{
            special++;
        }
    }

        s+='A';
        n++;
    }
    if(lower==0){
        s+='a';
        n++;
    }
    if(digit==0){
        s+='1';
        n++;
    }
    if(special==0){
        s+='@';
        n++;
    }
    while(n<7){
        s+='@';
        n++;
    }
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve(){
    ll n,x,y;
    cin>>n>>x>>y;
    ll sum_total=(n*(n+1))/2;
    if((sum_total%(x+y))==0){
        cout<<"POSSIBLE"<<endl;
        ll temp=sum_total/(x+y);
        temp*=x;
        ll number=min(temp,n);
        vl v;
        while(temp>0){
            if(temp>=number){
                v.pb(number);
                temp-=number;
                number--;
            }
            else{
                v.pb(temp);
                temp=0;
            }
        }
        cout<<sz(v)<<endl;
        printv(v);
    }
    else{
        cout<<"IMPOSSIBLE"<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    int n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
    }
    vector<int> ans(n,-1);
    multiset<int> ms;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        ms.insert(v[i]);
    }
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        ms.erase(ms.find(v[i]));
        auto x = ms.upper_bound(2*v[i]);
        if(x==ms.begin()){
            ans[i]=-1;
        }
        else{
            ans[i]=*(--x);
        }
        ms.insert(v[i]);
    }
    for(auto x:ans){
        cout<<x<<" ";
    }
    cout<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    stringstream pk(s);

    pk >> num;
    return num;

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll, null_type, less<ll>, rb_tree_tag, tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
ll solve()
{
    int n, q;
    cin >> n >> q;
    vector<vector<int>> v(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++)
    {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        v[a - 1].pb(b - 1);
        v[b - 1].pb(a - 1);
    }
    vector<int> height(n, 0);
    vector<bool> visited(n, false);
    queue<int> q1;
    q1.push(0);
    visited[0] = true;
    height[0] = 0;
    while (!q1.empty())
    {
        int root = q1.front();
        q1.pop();
        for (auto x : v[root])
        {
            if (!visited[x])
            {
                visited[x] = true;
                height[x] = height[root] + 1;
                q1.push(x);
            }
        }
    }
    map<int,int> m;
    for(auto x:height){
        m[x]++;
    }
    vector<int> checkpoint;
    int sm = 0;
    for (auto it : m)
    {
        sm += it.second;
        checkpoint.push_back((sm));
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < q; i++)
    {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
    }
    checkpoint.push_back(n);
    cout << *--upper_bound(all(checkpoint), q) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase = 1;
    cin >> TestCase;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= TestCase; i++)
    {
        cout << "Case #" << i << ": ";
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    long long rs,rh;
    cin>>rs>>rh;
    long long n,m;
    cin>>n;
    long long radius_distance = (rs+rh)*(rs+rh);
    vector<long long> red;
    long long a,b;
    for (long long i = 0; i < n; i++)
    {
        cin >> a >> b;
        long long temp = a*a + b*b;
        if(temp<=radius_distance){
            red.push_back(temp);
        }
    }
    cin>>m;
    vector<long long> yellow;
    for(int i=0;i<m;i++){
        cin>> a >> b;
        long long temp = a*a + b*b;
        if(temp<=radius_distance){
            yellow.push_back(temp);
        }
    }
    sort(red.begin(),red.end());
    sort(yellow.begin(),yellow.end());
    if(red.size()==0){
        cout<<"0 "<<yellow.size()<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else if(yellow.size()==0){
        cout<<red.size()<<" 0"<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else{
        if(red[0]>yellow[0]){
            long long count=0;
            for(auto x:yellow){
                if(x<red[0]){
                    count++;
                }
            }
            cout<<"0 "<<count<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else if(red[0]<yellow[0]){
            long long count=0;
            for(auto x:red){
                if(x<yellow[0]){
                    count++;
                }
            }
            cout<<count<<" 0"<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
        else{
            cout<<0<<" "<<0<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    ll mex=-1;
    vl v(n);
    map<ll,ll> m;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i];
        m[v[i]]++;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<=100005;i++){
        if(m[i]==0){
            mex=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    vector<bool>check(mex,false);
    ll count=mex;
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
        if(v[i]<mex){
            if(check[v[i]]==false)
                count--;
            check[v[i]]=true;
            m[v[i]]--;
            // cout<<"v "<<v[i]<<endl;
        }
        if(count==0){
            ll flag=0;
            for(ll j=0;j<mex;j++){
                // yes
                if(m[j]==0){
                    cout<<-1<<endl;
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            cout<<i+1<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Partially AC
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(n,vector<ll>(3,0));
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        cin>>v[i][0];
        v[i][2]=i;
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cin>>v[i][1];
    srt(v);
    vl ans(n,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll total=n-i;
        ll have=v[i][1];
        if(have>total)
            ans[v[i][2]]=-1;
        else if(have==1){
            ans[v[i][2]]=1;
        }
        else{
            for(ll j=i;j<n;j++){
                if(v[j][2]>=v[i][2]){
                    have--;
                    if(have==0){
                        ans[v[i][2]]=v[j][2]-v[i][2]+1;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(have){
                ans[v[i][2]]=-1;
            }
        }
    }
    printv(ans);
    return 0;
}

#include <ext/pb_ds/assoc_container.hpp>
#include <ext/pb_ds/tree_policy.hpp>

using namespace __gnu_pbds;
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<ll> vl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// define values.
// #define mod 1000000007
#define phi 1.618
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"No"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} line;
// some extra
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ONLINE JUDGE */
// #ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
//     freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
// #endif
// template
template <typename T>
T mymax(T x,T y)
{
    return (x>y)?x:y;
}
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}
ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);
}
string num_to_str(ll num)
{
    return to_string(num);
}
// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    ll diff=m;
    for(ll i=0;i<=max(n,m);i++)
    {
        if(diff<0)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        ll ans=(n*i);
        ans=k-ans;
        if(diff==0)
        {
            if(ans==0)
            {
                yes
            }
            else
            {
                no
            }
            return 0;
        }
        if(ans>=0&&ans%diff==0&&ans/diff<=n)
        {
            yes
            return 0;
        }
        if(ans<0)
        {
            no
            return 0;
        }
        diff-=2;
    }
    no
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    // freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
    // freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;

    ll maxo=0;
    ll time=0,order=0;
    vector<pair<pair<ll,ll>,ll>> v;
    while(n--)
    {
        ll l,r,x;
        cin>>l>>r>>x;
        v.push_back({{r,l},x});

    srt(v);
    for(auto x:v)
    {
        order+=x.ss;
        time=x.ff.ff;
        ll ans=ceil(double(double(order)/double(time)));
        maxo=max(maxo,ans);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    map<ll,ll> mini;
    map<ll,ll> maxo;
    map<ll,bool> check;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(check[temp]==false)
        {
            check[temp]=true;
            mini[temp]=i;

        maxo[temp]=i;

    for(auto x:mini)
    {
        sum+=abs(maxo[x.ff]-mini[x.ff]);

    cout<<sum<<endl;
    return 0;

ll dp[1001][1001][3];
// dp[horizontal][vertical][total]
ll solve()
{
    memset(dp,0,sizeof(dp));
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    char arr[n][m];
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            cin>>arr[i][j];
            if(i==0&&j==0)
            {
                dp[i][j][2]=1;
                dp[i][j][0]=1;
                dp[i][j][1]=1;
            }
            if(arr[i][j]=='*')
            {
                dp[i][j][2]=0;
                dp[i][j][0]=0;
                dp[i][j][1]=0;
            }
        }
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
        {
            if(arr[i][j]=='*')
            {
                dp[i][j][2]=0;
                dp[i][j][0]=0;
                dp[i][j][1]=0;
            }
            else
            {
                if(i==0&&j==0)
                    continue;
                if(j>=1)
                {
                    dp[i][j][2]+=dp[i][j-1][0];
                    dp[i][j][0]=dp[i][j-1][0];
                    dp[i][j][2]%=mod;
                    dp[i][j][0]%=mod;
                }
                if(i>=1)
                {
                    dp[i][j][2]+=dp[i-1][j][1];
                    dp[i][j][1]=dp[i-1][j][1];
                    dp[i][j][1]%=mod;
                    dp[i][j][2]%=mod;
                }
                dp[i][j][0]+=dp[i][j][2];
                dp[i][j][0]%=mod;
                dp[i][j][1]+=dp[i][j][2];
                dp[i][j][1]%=mod;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<dp[n-1][m-1][2]%mod<<endl;
    // for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    // {
    //     for(ll j=0;j<m;j++)
    //     {
    //         for(ll k=0;k<3;k++)
    //             cout<<dp[i][j][k];
    //         cout<<" ";
    //     }
    //     line;
    // }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()
{
    ll n,c01,c10;
    cin>>n>>c01>>c10;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    string s1="",s2="";
    ll flag=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(flag==0)
        {
            flag=1;
            s1+='0';
            s2+='1';
        }
        else
        {
            flag=0;
            s1+='1';
            s2+='0';
        }
    }
    ll cost1=0,cost2=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        char temp='1';
        if(v[i]==0)
            temp='0';
        if(temp!=s1[i])
        {
            if(temp=='0')
            {
                cost1+=c01;
            }
            else
            {
                cost1+=c10;
            }
        }
        if(temp!=s2[i])
        {
            if(temp=='0')
                cost2+=c01;
            else
                cost2+=c10;
        }
    }
    cout<<min(cost2,cost1)<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    {
        solve();

ll solve()
{
        ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> ans;
    vl v(n);
    ll neg=0;
    forin(v,n);
    ll sum=0,mini=LONG_MAX;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]>=0)
        {
            sum+=v[i];
            mini=min(mini,v[i]);
        }
        else
        {
            neg++;
            if(mini!=LONG_MAX)
            {
                ans.pb({sum,mini});
                sum=0;
                mini=LONG_MAX;
            }
        }
    }
    if(mini!=LONG_MAX)
    {
        ans.pb({sum,mini});
        sum=0;
        mini=LONG_MAX;
    }
    ll maxo=0;
    if(sz(ans)==1)
    {
        if(neg==0)
        {
            maxo=ans[0].ff-ans[0].ss;
        }
        else
            maxo=ans[0].ff;
        cout<<maxo<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    else
    {
        vector<ll>maximum(sz(ans),0);
        ll temp_maxo=0;
        for(ll i=sz(ans)-1;i>=0;i--)
        {
            maximum[i]=temp_maxo;
            temp_maxo=max(temp_maxo,ans[i].ff);
        }
        // printv(maximum);
        temp_maxo=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(ans);i++)
        {
            temp_maxo=max(temp_maxo,ans[i].ff);
            maxo=max(maxo,temp_maxo+maximum[i]);
        }
        cout<<maxo<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

ll solve()

    ll n;

    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    // bits manipulation approach
    ll maxo_bits=0;
    vector<ll>bits(65,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp=v[i],pos=0;
        while(temp){
            if(temp&1)
                bits[pos]++;
            pos++;
            temp>>=1;
        }
    }
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<=64;i++){
        ll count_one=bits[i],count_zero=n-bits[i];
        if(count_one>count_zero){
            ans+=pow(2,i);
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
// partially AC
ll solve()
{
    ll n,q;
    scanf("%lld%lld",&n,&q);
    vl v(n);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        scanf("%lld",&v[i]);
    while(q--){
        ll type;
        scanf("%lld",&type);
        if(type==1){
            ll l,r;
            scanf("%lld%lld",&l,&r);
            l--;
            v[l]=r;
        }
        else{
            ll l,r;
            scanf("%lld%lld",&l,&r);
            l--;
            r--;
            ll ans=0;
            ll maxo=0;
            for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++){
                maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
            }
            for(ll i=l;i<=r;i++){
                if(v[i]!=maxo){
                    ll temp=abs(v[i]-maxo);
                    ans+=temp/2;
                    if(temp&1)
                        ans++;
                }
            }
            printf("%lld\n",ans);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll pos=-1,pos1=-1;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]!=(i+1))
        {
            pos=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if(pos!=-1)
    {
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(v[i]==(pos+1))
            {
                pos1=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        // cout<<"pos1 and pos is "<<pos1<<" "<<pos<<endl;
        swap(v[pos1],v[pos]);
    }
    else
    {
        swap(v[n-1],v[n-2]);
    }
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        cout<<v[i]<<" ";
    line;
    v.clear();
    return 0;
}

    speed;

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

T mymax(T x,T y)

    return (x>y)?x:y;

// function
ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

ll str_to_num(string s)
{
    return stoi(s);

{
    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(k<=0)
            break;
        else if(s[i]!='a')
        {
            ll req='z'-s[i];
            req++;
            if(k>=req)
            {
                k-=req;
                s[i]='a';
            }
        }
    }
    if(k>0)
    {
        ll req='z'-s[n-1];
        if(req>=k)
        {
            s[n-1]='z';
            k-=req;
            k%=26;
            s[n-1]=char('z'+k);
        }
        else
        {
            k%=26;
            for(ll i=0;i<k;i++)
            {
                // cout<<"before "<<s[n-1]<<endl;
                s[n-1]++;
                if(s[n-1]>='z')
                    s[n-1]='z';
                // cout<<"after "<<s[n-1]<<endl;
            }
        }
    }
    cout<<s<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll ;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
// partially accepted.
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    string temp=s;
    temp+='@';
    vector<pair<char,ll>> v;
    char pre=s[0],count=1;
    ll flag=1;
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        if(temp[i]!=pre)
        {
            flag=0;
            v.push_back({pre,count});
            pre=temp[i];
            count=1;
        }
        else
        {
            flag=1;
            count++;
        }
    }
    if(flag)
        v.push_back({pre,count});
    cout<<"null"<<endl;
    cout<<1<<endl;
    cout<<"print(\""<<v[0].first<<"\"*"<<v[0].second;
    for(ll i=1;i<v.size();i++)
    {
        cout<<"+\""<<v[i].first<<"\"*"<<v[i].second;
    }
    cout<<")";
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    ll TestCase=1;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    }
    return res;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    string s,t;
    ll n;
    cin>>n>>s>>t;
    ll i = 0, j = 0; 
    ll sum = 0;  
    for(i=0;i<n;i++)
    { 
        j = i;
        while (s[j] != t[i])
        { 
            j += 1; 
        }
        while (i < j&&j<n)
        { 
            swap(s[j],s[j-1]);
            j -= 1; 
            sum += 1; 
        }
    }
    srt(s);
    srt(t);
    if(s==t)
    {
        if(sum%2==0)
            yes
        else
        {
            unordered_map<char,ll> mt;
            for(auto x:t)
            {
                mt[x]++;
                if(mt[x]>=2)
                {
                    yes
                    return 0;
                }
            }
            no
        }
    }
    else
        no
    // }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;

        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    for(auto x:s1)
    {
        if(x!='?')
            m[x]++;
    }
    for(auto x:s2)
    {
        if(x!='?')
            m[x]--;
    }
    ll flag=0,one=0,neg=0;
    for(auto x:m)
    {
        if(x.ss!=0)
        {
            if(x.ss==1)
                one++;
            else if(x.ss==-1)
                neg++;
            else
                flag++;
        }
    }
    if(flag)
        no
    else
    {
        if((one==1&&neg==1)||(one==0&&neg==0))
            yes
        else
            no
    }
    return 0;
}

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    ll length=n-2;
    ll maxo=(n*(n+1))/2;
    ll mini=(2*n)-1;
    if(m>maxo||m<mini)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
    {
        vector<ll> v(n+1,1);
        ll diff=abs(maxo-m);
        for(ll i=2;i<=n;i++)
        {
            // storing head of node.
            v[i]=i-1;
        }
        while(diff>0)
        {
            if(diff<=length)
            {
                v[n-diff+1]=v[n-diff];
                diff=0;
                length--;
            }
            else
            {
                v[n-length+1]=v[n-length-1];
                diff-=length;
                length--;
            }
        }
        for(ll i=2;i<=n;i++)
        {
            cout<<i<<" "<<v[i]<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

ll find_lcm(vector<ll>&s)
{
    ll lcm=s[0];
    loop(i,1,s.size())
    {
        lcm=(s[i]*lcm)/(__gcd(s[i],lcm));
    }
    return lcm;
}

	cc
    {
        ll n,m,k;

        vl v(n,0);
        forin(v,n);
        ll temp=find_lcm(v);
        temp=pow(temp,k);
        temp=temp%m;
        cout<<temp<<endl;
    }
}

            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;
}

    stringstream pk(s);
    ll num;
    pk>>num;
    return num;

    return to_string(num);

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll N=200001;
ll dfs(ll node,ll n,vector<vector<ll>>& graph,vector<bool>& check){
    if(node<=0||node>n)
        return 0;
    if(check[node])
        return 0;
    ll ans=1;
    check[node]=true;
    for(auto x:graph[node]){
        if(check[x]==false){
            ans+=dfs(x,n,graph,check);
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll ans=0;
    ll n,m;
    cin>>n>>m;
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
    vector<bool> check(n+1,false);
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
        ll l,r;
        cin>>l>>r;
        graph[l].pb(r);
        graph[r].pb(l);
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(check[i]==false){
            ll temp=dfs(i,n,graph,check);
            // cout<<"temp for i is "<<i<<" "<<temp<<endl;
            ans+=(n-temp)*temp;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

typedef long long ll ;

#define phi 1.618
/* Bit-Stuff */
#define get_set_bits(a) (__builtin_popcount(a))
#define get_set_bitsll(a) ( __builtin_popcountll(a))
#define get_trail_zero(a) (__builtin_ctz(a))
#define get_lead_zero(a) (__builtin_clz(a))
#define get_parity(a) (__builtin_parity(a))
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define line cout<<endl;
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
// loops
#define loop(i,start,end) for(ll i=ll(start);i<ll(end);i++)
#define loop0(num) for(ll i=0;i<ll(num);i++)
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
#define cc ll test;cin>>test;while(test--)
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// function
ll power(ll x,ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
} 
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122 1=49
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
// freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
int solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        maxo=max(maxo,v[i]);
    }
    ll pos_of_max=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]==maxo)
        {
            pos_of_max=i;
            break;
        }
    }
    // cout<<"max pos is "<<pos_of_max<<endl;
    for(ll i=0;i+1<=pos_of_max&&(i+1)<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp=(v[i]/2);
        v[i]-=temp*2;
        v[i+1]+=temp;
    }
    for(ll i=(n-1);(i-1)>=pos_of_max;i--)
    {
        ll temp=v[i]/2;
        v[i]-=temp*2;
        v[i-1]+=temp;
    }
    for(auto x:v)
    {
        cout<<"element in v is "<<x<<endl;
        maxo=max(maxo,x);
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    solve();

    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;

        x = (x*x) % p;

vector<ll> ans;
vector<bool> check(200001,false);
void dfs(vector<vector<ll>>& graph,ll num,ll n)
{
    if(check[num]==true)
        return ;
    if(num>n)
        return ;
    if(check[num]==false)
    {
        for(auto x:graph[num])
        {
            check[x]=true;
            ans.pb(x);
            dfs(graph,x,n);
        }
    }
    return ;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vector<char> ch(n+1);
    ch[0]='a';
    for(ll i=1;i<n+1;i++)
        cin>>ch[i];
    vl v(n+1,0);
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1);
    for(ll i=2;i<n+1;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        graph[v[i]].pb(i);
    }
    ans.pb(1);
    check[1]=true;
    for(auto x:graph[1])
    {
        if(check[x]==false)
        {
            ans.pb(x);
            // cout<<"from 1 se "<<x<<endl;
            dfs(graph,x,n);
        }
    }
    ll N=0,F=0;
    ll count=0,flag=0;
    for(auto x:ans)
    {
        if(ch[x]=='F')
        {
            F++;
            count+=N;
        }
        else
        {
            flag=1;
            N++;
        }
    }
    cout<<max(0LL,count/n)<<endl;
    // cout<<"now in ans is "<<endl;
    // for(auto x:ans)
    //     cout<<x<<" ";
    // line;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;

    {
        solve();
    }

    // x=x%mod;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

// partially accepted
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll pos=0,maxo=0,flag=0;
    ll sum1=0,sum2=0,sum3=0,sum4=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(v[i]>maxo)
        {
            maxo=v[i];
            pos=i;
        }
    }
    for(ll i=pos;i<n;i++)
    {
        if(flag==0)
        {
            flag=1;
            sum1+=v[i];
        }
        else
        {
            flag=0;
            sum2+=v[i];
        }
    }
    for(ll i=pos-1;i>=0;i--)
    {
        if(flag==0)
        {
            flag=1;
            sum1+=v[i];
        }
        else
        {
            flag=0;
            sum2+=v[i];
        }
    }
    sum3=0,sum4=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i+=2)
    {
        sum3+=v[i];
        sum4+=v[i+1];
    }
    if(sum1<sum3)
    {
        sum1=sum3;
        sum2=sum4;
    }
    else if(sum3==sum1)
    {
        if(sum4>sum2)
        {
            sum2=sum4;
        }
    }
    sum3=0,sum4=0;
    for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i-=2)
    {
        sum3+=v[i];
        sum4+=v[i-1];
    }
    if(sum1<sum3)
    {
        sum1=sum3;
        sum2=sum4;
    }
    else if(sum3==sum1)
    {
        if(sum4>sum2)
        {
            sum2=sum4;
        }
    }
    cout<<sum1<<" "<<sum2<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;

        solve();

    ll test;

    {
        cout<<"Case #"<<i<<": ";

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;
    }
    return res;

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
// partially accepted
map<pair<ll,ll>,ll> m;
vector<ll> dfs(vector<vector<ll>>& v,ll x,vector<bool> check,ll n)
{
    vector<ll> ans;
    if(check[x]==true)
        return ans;
    if(x<1||x>n)
        return ans;
    if(x==n)
        return ans;
    check[x]=true;
    for(auto y:v[x])
    {
        if(check[y]==false)
        {
            cout<<"y is "<<y<<endl;
            ans.pb(m[mp(max(x,y),min(x,y))]);
            // cout<<"push hua for"<<y<<" and "<<x<<" cost is "<<m[mp(max(x,y),min(x,y))]<<endl;
            check[y]=true;
            dfs(v,y,check,n);
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m1,k;
    cin>>n>>m1>>k;
    vector<vector<ll>> v(n+1);
    for(ll i=0;i<m1;i++)
    {
        ll a,b,c;
        cin>>a>>b>>c;
        v[a].pb(b);
        v[b].pb(a);
        m[mp(max(a,b),min(a,b))]=c;
    }
    ll ans1=LONG_MAX,flag=0;
    for(auto x:v[1])
    {
        // cout<<"  connected to 1 is "<<x<<endl;
        vector<bool> check(n+1,false);
        check[1]=true;
        // check[x]=true;
        vector<ll>ans;
        ans=dfs(v,x,check,n);
        ans.pb(m[mp(max(1LL,x),min(1LL,x))]);
        ll sum=0,maxo=0;
        // cout<<"now in ans "<<endl;
        for(auto y:ans)
        {
            maxo=max(maxo,y);
            sum+=y;
            // cout<<"in ans is "<<y<<endl;
        }
        sum-=maxo;
        sum+=(maxo/k);
        ans1=min(ans1,sum);
        flag++;
    }
    if(flag)
        cout<<ans1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

ll power(ll x,ll y,ll mod)
{
    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)
        {
            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;

    }

    return stoi(s);

            return x+y+z;
        }

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

// to run ctrl+b
vector<ll> factor(ll num)
{
    vector<ll> v;
    for(ll i=1;i<=sqrt(num);i++)
    {
        if(num%i==0)
        {
            if((i*i)==num)
                v.pb(i);
            else
            {
                v.pb(i);
                v.pb(num/i);
            }
        }
    }
    return v;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    ll sum=0,maxo=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>v[i];
        sum+=v[i];
    }
    vector<ll>ans=factor(sum);
    for(auto x:ans)
    {
        // cout<<"in vector "<<x<<endl;
        vector<bool> check(n,false);
        ll flag=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(check[i]==false)
            {
                for(ll j=0;j<n;j++)
                {
                    if(i!=j&&check[j]==false&&(v[i]+v[j])%x==0)
                    {
                        check[j]=true;
                        check[i]=true;
                        // cout<<"for x "<<x<<" sum pair mila hai "<<i<<" and "<<j<<" pe"<<endl;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(check[i]==false)
            {
                flag=1;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(flag==0)
        {
            maxo=max(maxo,x);
        }
    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

    return to_string(num);

            return x+y+z;

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Partially AC
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    map<ll,ll> m;
    vector<bool>check(n+1,false);
    vector<vector<ll>> graph(n+1,vector<ll>());
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        graph[a].pb(b);
        graph[b].pb(a);
        m[a]++;
        m[b]++;
    }
    vector<pair<ll,ll>> temp;
    for(auto x:m){
        temp.pb({x.ss,x.ff});
    }
    srt(temp);
    reverse(all(temp));
    ll flag=0;
    for(auto x:temp){
        ll vertex=x.ss;
        // cout<<"vertex is "<<vertex<<endl;
        if(flag){
            check[vertex]=true;
            // cout<<"dfs verts "<<vertex<<endl;
            for(auto z:graph[vertex])
                check[z]=true;
        }
        flag^=1;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++){
        if(check[i]==false){
            // cout<<"i is "<<i<<endl;
            cout<<"SAFE"<<endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout<<"UNSAFE"<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

    #endif */

    cin>>TestCase;

    {
        solve();
    }
}

#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>

    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;

        {
            return x+y+z;
        }

// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
vector<vector<ll>> ncr_value(1001,vector<ll>(1001,0));
void ncr(){
    ncr_value[0][0]=1;
    for(ll i=1;i<=1000;i++){
        ncr_value[i][0]=1;
        for(ll j=1;j<=1000;j++){
            ncr_value[i][j]=ncr_value[i-1][j-1]+ncr_value[i-1][j];
            ncr_value[i][j]%=mod1;
            // cout<<"v "<<ncr_value[i][j]<<endl;
        }
    }
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    ll ans=0;
    ll even=0,odd=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        ll temp;
        cin>>temp;
        if(temp&1)
            odd++;
        else
            even++;
    }
    for(ll i=1;i<=min(k,odd);i+=2){
        ll temp_even=k-i;
        if(even>=temp_even){
            // yes   
            ans+=(ncr_value[even][temp_even]%mod1)*(ncr_value[odd][i]%mod1);
            ans%=mod1;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ncr();
    ll TestCase=1;
    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=LONG_MAX;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
ll solve()
{
    ll n;
    cin>>n;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        for(ll j=i+1;j<n;j++){
            ll temp1=v[j]-v[i];
            ll temp2=((i+1)*(i+1))+((j+1)*(j+1));
            // cout<<"temp "<<temp1<<" "<<temp2<<endl;
            if(abs(temp2)==abs(temp1))
                ans++;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

    speed;

        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;

    {
        solve();

    ll high=log2(n);
    if(ll(pow(2,high))<n)
        high++;
    high=ll(pow(2,high));

    for(ll i=0;i<=high;i++){
        ll a=(n^i);
        if(a<=high){
            ll pro=a*i;
            maxo=max(maxo,pro);

    }
    cout<<maxo<<endl;

		cin>>ch[i];
	}

	{
		cout<<"invalid";
	}
	else
	{
		first=int(ch[0])-int(ch[1]);
		second=int(ch[3])-int(ch[4]);
		third=int(ch[4])-int(ch[5]);
		forth=int(ch[7])-int(ch[8]);
		if(first%2==0&&second%2==0&&third%2==0&&forth%2==0)

			cout<<"valid";

		{
			cout<<"invalid";

#include<string.h>

int main()
{
	string a,b;
	int t,len_a,len_b,count=0;
	cin>>t;
	for(int i=0;i<t;i++)
	{
		count=0;
		cin>>a>>b;
		len_a=a.length();
		len_b=b.length();
		for(int i=0;i<len_a;i++)
		{
			for(int j=0;j<len_b;j++)
			{
				if(a[i]==b[j])
				{
					// cout<<b[j]<<" ";
					b[j]='@';
					count++;
					break ;
				}
			}
		}
		cout<<(len_b+len_a-count-count)<<endl;
	}
}

        cin>>a[i];

    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){

ll power(ll x,   ll y, ll p)  
{  
    ll res = 1;      
    x = x % p;             
    while (y > 0)  
    {    
        if (y & 1)  
            res = (res*x) % p;   
        y = y>>1; 
        x = (x*x) % p;  
    }  
    return res;  
}

	vl v(n);
	ll count=0;
	loop(i,0,n)
	{
		cin>>v[i];
		v[i]--;
		count=max(count,i-v[i]);
	}
	count++;
	cout<<count<<endl;
}

{
    ll n,k;
    cin>>n>>k;
    vl v(n);
    forin(v,n);
    int max,index;
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        max=v[i];
        index=i;
        for(int j=i+1;j<=i+k&&j<n;j++)
        {
            if(v[j]>max)
            {
                max=v[j];
                index=j;
            }
        }
        v.insert(v.begin()+i,max);
        v.erase(v.begin()+index+1);
        k-=(index-i);
        if(k==0)
            break;
    }
    for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
        cout<<v[i];
    line;
    return 0;
}

#include<iostream>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	int T;
	// yanh pe agar ans and k ko else ke andar declare karo
	// ya int declare kiye to wrong dega.
	long int c,n,ans,k;
	cin>>T;
	for(int i=0;i<T;i++)
	{
		cin>>c>>n;
		if(c<(n*(n+1))/2)
		{
			cout<<c<<endl;
		}
		else
		{
			k=(c-(n*(n-1))/2)/n;
			ans =c-n*k-(n*(n-1))/2;

		}
	}

<code>
#include<iostream>
#include<string.h>
#include<math.h>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	long int N,number,temp=0,odd=0,even=0;
	string s;
	cin>>N;
	for(long int i=1;i<=N;i++)
	{
		//first digit
		if(i<=N/2)
		{
			cin>>s;
			temp=(int(s[0])-48);
			if(i%2==0)
			{
				even=even+temp;
			}
			else
			{
				odd=odd+temp;
			}
		}
		// last digit
		else
		{
			cin>>number;
			temp=number%10;
			if(i%2==0)
			{
				even=even+temp;
			}
			else
			{
				odd=odd+temp;
			}
		}
	}
	if((even-odd)%11==0)
	{
		cout<<"OUI"<<endl;
	}
	else
	{
		cout<<"NON"<<endl;
	}
}

    cin>>n>>s>>t;
    ll ans=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
        if(s[i]==t[i])
            continue;
        else{
            ans++;
            while(i<n&&s[i]!=t[i]){
                i++;
            }
            i--;
        }
    }
    cout<<ans<<endl;
    return 0;
}

	{

#include<iostream>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	int T,X;
	cin>>T;
	for(int i=0;i<T;i++)
	{
		cin>>X;
		for(int j=0;j<X;j++)
		{
			for(int k=0;k<2*X;k++)
			{
				if(j>=k||2*X-j-1<=k)
				{
					cout<<"*";
				}
				else
					cout<<"#";
			}
			cout<<"\n";
		}
		cout<<"\n";
	}
}

<code>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;
int main()
{
	long int D,oc,of,od,cs,cb,cm,cd;
	long int online,classic;
	cin>>D;
	cin>>oc>>of>>od;
	cin>>cs>>cb>>cm>>cd;
	online = oc + (D-of)*od;
	classic = cb+(D/cs)*cm+D*cd;
	if(classic<online)
	{
		cout<<"Classic Taxi"<<endl;
	}
	else if(classic>=online)
		cout<<"Online Taxi"<<endl;
}

    {

    ll res=1;
    // x=x%mod;
    while(y>0)

        if(y%2==1)

            res*=x;
            // res=res%mod;
        }
        y/=2; x*=x; // x=x%mod;

    return to_string(num);

/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/

// to run ctrl+b
ll solve()
{
    string s;
    cin>>s;
    stack<char> st;
    for(ll i=0;i<sz(s);i++)
    {
        if(sz(st)==0)
            st.push(s[i]);
        else
        {
            if(st.top()==s[i])
                st.pop();
            else
                st.push(s[i]);
        }
    }
    if(sz(st)==0)
        cout<<"KHALI"<<endl;
    else
    {
        string ans="";
        while(sz(st)>0)
        {
            ans+=st.top();
            st.pop();
        }
        reverse(all(ans));
        cout<<ans<<endl;
    }
    return 0;
}

    #endif */

    cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	{

<problem>
Title: little shino common factor
<code>
#include<iostream>
#include<math.h>
using namespace std;
long int hcf(long int a,long int b);
int main()
{
	long int a,b,count=0,temp;
	cin>>a>>b;
	if(a>b)
	{
		temp=a;
		a=b;
		b=temp;
	}
	temp=hcf(a,b);
	for(long int i=1;i<=sqrt(temp)+1;i++)
	{
		if(a%i==0 && b%i==0)
		{
			count ++;
		}
	}
	cout<<count;
}
long int hcf(long int a,long int b)
{
	if(b%a==0)
		return b;
	else
		return hcf(b,b%a);
}

ll sum_of_digits(ll num)

    ll sum=0,temp=0;
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        cin>>temp;
        sum+=temp;
    }
    if(sum==2*(n-1))
        cout<<"Yes"<<endl;
    else
        cout<<"No"<<endl;
    return 0;
}
int main()

    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);

    solve();

Title: no of steps
<code>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;
int equal(int *array,int size);
int main()
{
	int n,count=1000;
	cin>>n;
	int *a=new int[n];
	int *b=new int[n];
	for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>a[i];
	}
	for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
	{
		cin>>b[i];
	}
	while(equal(a,n)!=1)
	{
		count--;
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			if(a[i]>=b[i])
			{
				a[i]=a[i]-b[i];
			}
		}
	}
	cout<<(1000-count);
}
int equal(int *array,int size)
{
	int count=0;
	for(int i=0;i<size;i++)
	{
		if(array[0]==array[i])
		{
			count++;
		}
	}
	if(count==size)
		return 1;
	else
		return 0;
}

ll solve()
{

    scanf("%lld%lld",&n,&q);
    ll sum=0;
    vl prefix(n+1,0);
    for(ll i=0;i<n;i++)
    {
        ll temp;
        scanf("%lld",&temp);
        sum+=temp;
        prefix[i+1]=sum;
    }
    while(q--)
    {
        ll l,r;
        scanf("%lld%lld",&l,&r);
        ll ans=prefix[r]-prefix[l-1];

    ll res=1;
    while(y>0)
    {
        if(y%2==1)res*=x;
        y/=2; x*=x;
    }
    return res;
}
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll solve()
{

    {

        }

ll power(ll x,ll y)

        y/=2; x*=x;

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

ll bfs(vector<ll> graph[],ll n,ll m,ll k)
{
    ll span_edges=0,count_component=0;
    vector<bool>flag(n+1,false);
    for(ll i=1;i<=n;i++)
    {
        if(flag[i]==false)
        {
            flag[i]=true;
            queue<ll> q;
            q.push(i);
            while(!q.empty())
            {
                ll temp=q.front();
                q.pop();
                for(auto x:graph[temp])
                {
                    if(flag[x]==false)
                    {
                        span_edges++;
                        q.push(x);
                        flag[x]=true;
                    }
                }
            }
            count_component++;
        }
    }
    if(count_component>k)
        cout<<-1<<endl;
    else
        cout<<(m-span_edges)+(k-count_component)<<endl;
    return 0;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll n,m,k;
    cin>>n>>m>>k;
    vector<ll> graph[n+1];
    for(ll i=0;i<m;i++)
    {
        ll u,v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        graph[u].pb(v);
        graph[v].pb(u);
    }
    bfs(graph,n,m,k);
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    //freopen("input.txt"a, "r", stdin);
    pan
    solve();
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

// template

ll str_to_num(string s)

    return stoi(s);

    return to_string(num);

// datatype definination
#define ordered_set tree<ll,null_type,less<ll>,rb_tree_tag,tree_order_statistics_node_update>
class Point
{
    public:
        ll x;
        ll y;
        ll z;
        ll getsum()
        {
            return x+y+z;
        }
};
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll maxn=5e5+20;
vector<ll> adj[maxn];
ll st[maxn],ft[maxn],now=-1,is[maxn];
void dfs(int v,int p=-1){
    st[v]=++now;
    for(auto u:adj[v]){
        if(u!=p)
            dfs(u,v);
    }
    ft[v]=now+1;
}
ll mn[maxn*4],t[maxn*4],Add[maxn*4],n;
void build(ll s=0,ll e=n,ll v=1){
    t[v]=e-s;
    if(e-s<2)
        return ;
    ll mid=(s+e)/2;
    build(s,mid,2*v);
    build(mid,e,2*v+1);
}
void add(ll l ,ll r, ll val,ll s=0,ll e=n,ll v=1){
    if(l<=s&&e<=r){
        mn[v]+=val;
        Add[v]+=val;
        return ;
    }
    if(r<=s||e<=l)
        return ;
    ll mid=(s+e)/2;
    add(l,r,val,s,mid,2*v);
    add(l,r,val,mid,e,2*v+1);
    mn[v]=min(mn[2*v],mn[2*v+1]);
    t[v]=0;
    if(mn[v]==mn[2*v])
        t[v]+=t[2*v];
    if(mn[v]==mn[2*v+1])
        t[v]+=t[2*v+1];
    mn[v]+=Add[v];
}
pair<ll,ll> get(ll l, ll r,ll s=0,ll e=n,ll v=1){
    if(l<=s&&e<=r)
        return mp(mn[v],t[v]);
    if(r<=s||e<=l)
        return mp(1e9,0);
    ll mid=(s+e)/2;
    auto x=get(l,r,s,mid,2*v);
    auto y=get(l,r,mid,e,2*v+1);
    pair<ll,ll> ans={1e9,0};
    ans.ff=min({x.ff,y.ff});
    if(ans.ff==x.ff)
        ans.ss+=x.ss;
    if(ans.ff==y.ff)
        ans.ss+=y.ss;
    ans.ff+=Add[v];
    return ans;
}
ll solve()
{
    ll q;
    cin>>n>>q;
    for(ll i=0;i<n-1;i++){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        a--;
        b--;
        adj[a].pb(b);
        adj[b].pb(a);
    }
    dfs(0);
    build();
    while(q--){
        ll a,b;
        cin>>a>>b;
        b--;
        if(a==1){
            add(st[b],ft[b],is[b]?-1:1);
            is[b]^=1;
        }
        else{
            if(is[b])
                cout<<0<<endl;
            else
                cout<<ll(get(st[b],ft[b]).ss)<<endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
int main()
{
    speed;
    /* #ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
        freopen("input.txt","r",stdin);
        freopen("output.txt","w",stdout);
    #endif */
    ll TestCase=1;
    // cin>>TestCase;
    while(TestCase--)
    {
        solve();
    }
}

	{

                if(y&1){
                    result*=x;
                }
                y>>=1;
                x*=x;
            }
            return result;
        }

            ll result=1;
            x%=mod;
            while(y>0){
                if(y&1){

                }

<problem>
Title: 1009.Complement of Base 10 Integer
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int bitwiseComplement(int n)
    {
        if (n == 0)
            return 1;
        vector<int> bit(32, 0);
        int ans = 0;
        int pos = 0;
        while (n)
        {
            if (n & 1)
            {
                bit[pos] = 1;
            }
            n >>= 1;
            pos++;
        }
        for (ll i = 0; i < pos; i++)
        {
            ans += (1 - bit[i]) * pow(2, i);
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    bool isSymmetric(TreeNode* root) {
        if(root->right==nullptr&&root->left==nullptr){
            return true;
        }
        if(root->right==nullptr&&root->left!=nullptr){
            return false;
        }
        if(root->left==nullptr&&root->right!=nullptr){
            return false;
        }
        if(root->right->val!=root->left->val){
            return false;
        }
        queue<TreeNode*> q1,q2;
        q1.push(root->left);
        q2.push(root->right);
        while(q1.size()){
            queue<TreeNode*> tempq1,tempq2;
            while(q1.size()){
                TreeNode* left_side=q1.front();
                q1.pop();
                TreeNode* right_side=q2.front();
                q2.pop();
                if((left_side==nullptr&&right_side==nullptr)){
                    continue;
                }
                if(left_side==nullptr||right_side==nullptr){
                    return false;
                }
                if(left_side->val!=right_side->val){
                    return false;
                }
                tempq1.push(left_side->left);
                tempq1.push(left_side->right);
                tempq2.push(right_side->right);
                tempq2.push(right_side->left);
            }
            q1=tempq1;
            q2=tempq2;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;

namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;

        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }

class Solution {

    int smallestRepunitDivByK(int k) {
        map<int,int> m;
        int remainder=1;
        m[1]++;
        int length=1;
        while(1){
            if(remainder%k==0){
                return length;
            }
            else{
                length++;
                remainder=(remainder*10+1)%k;
            }
            if(m[remainder]){
                return -1;
            }
            m[remainder]++;
        }
        return -1;

/**

 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };

class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> levelOrder(TreeNode* root) {
        vector<vector<int>> ans;
        queue<TreeNode* > q;
        if(root==nullptr){
            return ans;
        }
        q.push(root);
        while(q.size()){
            queue<TreeNode*> temp_q;
            vl temp;
            while(q.size()){
                TreeNode* node=q.front();
                q.pop();
                temp.pb(node->val);
                if(node->left!=nullptr){
                    temp_q.push(node->left);
                }
                if(node->right!=nullptr){
                    temp_q.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            q=temp_q;
            ans.pb(temp);
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

Title: 1020.Number of Enclaves
<code>

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    void dfs(vector<vector<int>>& arr,int i,int j){
        if(i>=arr.size() or i<0 or j<0 or j>=arr[0].size() or arr[i][j]==0 or arr[i][j]==2)
            return;
        arr[i][j]=2;
        dfs(arr,i,j+1);
        dfs(arr,i,j-1);
        dfs(arr,i+1,j);
        dfs(arr,i-1,j);
    }
    int numEnclaves(vector<vector<int>>& arr) {
        int ans=0;
        for(int i=0;i<arr.size();i++){
            if(i==0 or i==arr.size()-1){
                for(int j=0;j<arr[i].size();j++){
                    if(arr[i][j]==1){
                        dfs(arr,i,j);
                    }
                }
            }
            if(arr[i][0]==1){
                dfs(arr,i,0);
            }
            if(arr[i][arr[i].size()-1]==1){
                dfs(arr,i,arr[i].size()-1);
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<arr.size();i++){
            for(int j=0;j<arr[i].size();j++){
                if(arr[i][j]==1){
                    ans++;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

Title: 1027.Longest Arithmetic Subsequence
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int longestArithSeqLength(vector<int> &nums)
    {
        int n = nums.size();
        if (n <= 2)
        {
            return n;
        }
        // Create a vector of unordered maps
        vector<unordered_map<int, int>> dp(n);
        int maxLength = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            {
                int diff = nums[i] - nums[j];
                // If the difference exists in the subsequence ending at index j
                // Extend the subsequence and update the length in dp[i]
                if (dp[j].find(diff) != dp[j].end())
                {
                    dp[i][diff] = dp[j][diff] + 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    // If the difference doesn't exist, initialize it to 2
                    dp[i][diff] = 2;
                }
                maxLength = max(maxLength, dp[i][diff]);
            }
        }
        return maxLength;
    }
};

    	for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
    		int maxo=0,temp=0;
    		for(int j=i;j>=max(i-k+1,0);j--){
    			maxo=max(maxo,arr[j]);
    			temp=max(temp,maxo*(i-j+1)+dp[j]);
    		}
    		dp[i+1]=temp;
    	}
    	return dp[n];
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/
/*
* stuff you should look before submission 
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int lastStoneWeight(vector<int>& stones) {
        priority_queue<int>pq(stones.begin(),stones.end());
        while(pq.size()>1){
            int x=pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            int y=pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            if(x!=y){
                pq.push(abs(x-y));
            }
        }
        if(pq.empty())
            return 0;
        return pq.top();
    }
};

/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
#define Endl "\n"
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value 
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
// add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    string removeDuplicates(string s) {
        stack<char> st;
        string ans="";
        for(auto x:s){
            if(sz(st)==0){
                st.push(x);
            }
            else{
                if(st.top()==x){
                    st.pop();
                }
                else{
                    st.push(x);
                }
            }
        }
        while(sz(st)){
            ans+=st.top();
            st.pop();
        }
        reverse(all(ans));
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* buildTree(vector<int>& preorder, vector<int>& inorder) {
        return make_tree(0,0,sz(inorder)-1,preorder,inorder);
    }
    TreeNode* make_tree(int preorder_start,int inorder_start,int end_inorder,vector<int> preorder,vector<int> inorder){
        if(preorder_start>sz(preorder)-1||inorder_start>end_inorder){
            return NULL;
        }
        TreeNode* root=new TreeNode(preorder[preorder_start]);
        if(inorder_start==end_inorder){
            return root;
        }
        int inorder_index=-1;
        for(int i=inorder_start;i<=end_inorder;i++){
            if(inorder[i]==root->val){
                inorder_index=i;
            }
        }
        root->left= make_tree(preorder_start+1,inorder_start,inorder_index-1,preorder,inorder);
        root->right= make_tree(preorder_start+inorder_index-inorder_start+1,inorder_index+1,end_inorder,preorder,inorder);
        return root;
    }
};

/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* buildTree(vector<int>& inorder, vector<int>& postorder) {
        return make_tree(inorder,postorder,0,sz(inorder)-1,sz(postorder)-1);
    }
    TreeNode* make_tree(vl inorder,vl postorder,int inorder_start,int inorder_end,int postorder_end){
        if(inorder_start>inorder_end){
            return NULL;
        }
        if(postorder_end<0){
            return NULL;
        }
        TreeNode* node=new TreeNode(postorder[postorder_end]);
        int index=0;
        for(int i=inorder_start;i<=inorder_end;i++){
            if(inorder[i]==node->val){
                index=i;
            }
        }
        int no_of_nodes_in_right=inorder_end-index+1;
        node->left= make_tree(inorder,postorder,inorder_start,index-1,postorder_end-no_of_nodes_in_right);
        node->right= make_tree(inorder,postorder,index+1,inorder_end,postorder_end-1);
        return node;
    }
};

/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    TreeNode* rec(vector<int>& nums, int start, int end) {
        if (start >= end) return NULL;
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        TreeNode* node = new TreeNode(nums[mid]);
        node->left = rec(nums, start, mid);
        node->right = rec(nums, mid+1, end);
        return node;
    }
    TreeNode* sortedArrayToBST(vector<int>& nums) {
        return rec(nums,0,sz(nums));
    }
};

Title: 1091.Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> matrix;
    vector<vector<bool>> check;
    int shortestPathBinaryMatrix(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {
        int n=grid.size();
        int m=grid[0].size();
        check.resize(n,vector<bool>(m,false));
        matrix.resize(n,vector<int>(m,100000));
        if(grid[0][0]==1) return -1;
        matrix[0][0]=1;
        queue<pair<int,int>> q;
        q.push({0,0});
        check[0][0]=true;
        while(q.size()>0){
            int i=q.front().ff;
            int j=q.front().ss;
            q.pop();
            if(i+1<n && check[i+1][j]==false && grid[i+1][j]==0){
                matrix[i+1][j]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i+1][j]);
                check[i+1][j]=true;
                q.push({i+1,j});
            }
            if(j+1<m && check[i][j+1]==false && grid[i][j+1]==0){
                matrix[i][j+1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i][j+1]);
                check[i][j+1]=true;
                q.push({i,j+1});
            }
            if(i-1>=0 && check[i-1][j]==false && grid[i-1][j]==0){
                matrix[i-1][j]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i-1][j]);
                check[i-1][j]=true;
                q.push({i-1,j});
            }
            if(j-1>=0 && check[i][j-1]==false && grid[i][j-1]==0){
                matrix[i][j-1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i][j-1]);
                check[i][j-1]=true;
                q.push({i,j-1});
            }
            if(i+1<n && j+1<m && check[i+1][j+1]==false && grid[i+1][j+1]==0){
                matrix[i+1][j+1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i+1][j+1]);
                check[i+1][j+1]=true;
                q.push({i+1,j+1});
            }
            if(i-1>=0 && j-1>=0 && check[i-1][j-1]==false && grid[i-1][j-1]==0){
                matrix[i-1][j-1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i-1][j-1]);
                check[i-1][j-1]=true;
                q.push({i-1,j-1});
            }
            if(i+1<n && j-1>=0 && check[i+1][j-1]==false && grid[i+1][j-1]==0){
                matrix[i+1][j-1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i+1][j-1]);
                check[i+1][j-1]=true;
                q.push({i+1,j-1});
            }
            if(i-1>=0 && j+1<m && check[i-1][j+1]==false && grid[i-1][j+1]==0){
                matrix[i-1][j+1]=min(matrix[i][j]+1,matrix[i-1][j+1]);
                check[i-1][j+1]=true;
                q.push({i-1,j+1});
            }
        }
        if(matrix[n-1][m-1]==100000) return -1;
        return matrix[n-1][m-1];
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

Title: 1092.Shortest Common Supersequence
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    string shortestCommonSupersequence(string str1, string str2) {
        string ans="";
        int n=str1.size(),m=sz(str2);
        vector<vector<int>> dp(n+1,vector<int>(m+1,0));
        for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<=m;j++){
                if(i==0||j==0){
                    continue;
                }
                else if(str1[i-1]==str2[j-1]){
                    dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j-1]+1;
                }
                else{
                    dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1]);
                }
            }
        }
        int i=n,j=m;
        while(i>=1&&j>=1){
            if(str1[i-1]==str2[j-1]){
                ans+=str1[i-1];
                i--;
                j--;
            }
            else if(dp[i-1][j]>=dp[i][j-1]){
                ans+=str1[i-1];
                i--;
            }
            else{
                ans+=str2[j-1];
                j--;
            }
        }
        while(i>0){
            ans+=str1[i-1];
            i--;
        }
        while(j>0){
            ans+=str2[j-1];
            j--;
        }
        reverse(all(ans));
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/
/*
* stuff you should look before submission
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer
*/

        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);

class Solution {
public:
    bool carPooling(vector<vector<int>>& trips, int capacity) {
        vector<int> v(1001,0);
        for(auto x:trips){
            v[x[1]]+=x[0];
            v[x[2]]-=x[0];
        }
        int current_capacity=0;
        for(int i=0;i<=1000;i++){
            current_capacity+=v[i];
            if(current_capacity>capacity){
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    int maxArea(vector<int>& height) {
        int n = sz(height);
        int max_area = 0, i = 0, j = n-1;
        max_area = min(height[i] , height[j])*(j-i);
        while(j>i){
            if(height[i]<height[j]){
                i++;
            }
            else{
                j--;
            }
            max_area = max(max_area, min(height[i] , height[j]) * (j-i));
        }

    }

Title: 111.Minimum Depth of Binary Tree
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
#include <queue>
class Solution
{
public:
    int minDepth(TreeNode *root)
    {
        if (root == nullptr)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        int minDepth = 0;
        queue<TreeNode *> q;
        q.push(root);
        while (!q.empty())
        {
            int size = q.size();
            minDepth++;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            {
                TreeNode *node = q.front();
                q.pop();
                if (node->left == nullptr && node->right == nullptr)
                {
                    return minDepth;
                }
                if (node->left != nullptr)
                {
                    q.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right != nullptr)
                {
                    q.push(node->right);
                }
            }
        }
        return minDepth;
    }
};

 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;

//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> path;
    vector<vector<int>> all_path;
    void dfs(TreeNode* root,int targetSum,int& sum){
        if(root==nullptr){
            return ;
        }
        sum+=root->val;
        path.pb(root->val);
        if(root->left==nullptr&&root->right==nullptr&&sum==targetSum){
            all_path.pb(path);
        }
        dfs(root->left,targetSum,sum);
        dfs(root->right,targetSum,sum);
        sum-=root->val;
        path.pop_back();
        return ;
    }
    vector<vector<int>> pathSum(TreeNode* root, int targetSum) {
        int sum=0;
        dfs(root,targetSum,sum);
        return all_path;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

class Solution
{

    int tribonacci(int n)
    {
        vector<int> dp(n+1,0);
        dp[0]=0;
        if(n==0)
            return dp[0];

        if(n==1)

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int longestCommonSubsequence(string text1, string text2) {
        int n=sz(text1),m=sz(text2);
        vector<vector<int>> dp(n+1,vector<int>(m+1,0));
        for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<=m;j++){
                if(i==0||j==0){
                    dp[i][j]=0;
                    continue;
                }
                else if(text1[i-1]==text2[j-1]){
                    dp[i][j]=1+dp[i-1][j-1];
                }
                else{
                    dp[i][j]=max(dp[i][j-1],dp[i-1][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][m];
    }
};

typedef long long ll ;

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class SnapshotArray
{
private:
    int snapId;
    map<int, map<int, int>> data;
public:
    SnapshotArray(int length)
    {
        snapId = 0;
        data = map<int, map<int, int>>();
    }
    void set(int index, int val)
    {
        data[index][snapId] = val;
    }
    int snap()
    {
        return snapId++;
    }
    int get(int index, int snap_id)
    {
        auto it = data[index].upper_bound(snap_id);
        if (it == data[index].begin())
        {
            return 0;
        }
        return prev(it)->second;
    }
};

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
/*
// Definition for a Node.
class Node {
public:
    int val;
    Node* left;
    Node* right;
    Node* next;
    Node() : val(0), left(NULL), right(NULL), next(NULL) {}
    Node(int _val) : val(_val), left(NULL), right(NULL), next(NULL) {}
    Node(int _val, Node* _left, Node* _right, Node* _next)
        : val(_val), left(_left), right(_right), next(_next) {}
};
*/
class Solution {
public:
    Node* connect(Node* root) {
        if(root==nullptr){
            return nullptr;
        }
        queue<Node*> q;
        q.push(root);
        while(q.size()){
            queue<Node*>temp_q;
            while(q.size()){
                Node* node=q.front();
                q.pop();
                if(node->left!=nullptr){
                    temp_q.push(node->left);
                }
                if(node->right!=nullptr){
                    temp_q.push(node->right);
                }
                if(q.size()){
                    node->next=q.front();
                }
                else{
                    node->next=nullptr;
                }
            }
            q=temp_q;
        }
        return root;
    }
};

Title: 1161.Maximum Level Sum of a Binary Tree
<code>
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}
 *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    int maxLevelSum(TreeNode *root)
    {
        if (!root)
            return 0;
        int maxSum = root->val;
        int maxLevel = 1;
        int level = 1;
        queue<TreeNode *> q;
        q.push(root);
        while (!q.empty())
        {
            int size = q.size();
            int currentSum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            {
                TreeNode *node = q.front();
                q.pop();
                currentSum += node->val;
                if (node->left)
                    q.push(node->left);
                if (node->right)
                    q.push(node->right);
            }
            if (currentSum > maxSum)
            {
                maxSum = currentSum;
                maxLevel = level;
            }
            level++;
        }
        return maxLevel;
    }
};

//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int maxDistance(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {
        vector<pair<int,int>> water,land;
        int maxo=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(grid);i++){
            for(ll j=0;j<sz(grid[0]);j++){
                if(grid[i][j]==1){
                    land.pb(mp(i,j));
                }
                else{
                    water.pb(mp(i,j));
                }
            }
        }
        if(sz(land)==0 || sz(water)==0){
            return -1;
        }
        for(auto x:water){
            int dist=INT_MAX;
            for(auto y:land){
                dist=min(dist,abs(x.first-y.first)+abs(x.second-y.second));
            }
            maxo=max(maxo,dist);
        }
        return maxo;
    }
};

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
