/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<bool>> check;
    void dfs(vector<vector<int>>& grid1,vector<vector<int>>& grid2,int i,int j,bool& flag){
        if(i<0 || j<0 || i>=sz(grid2) || j>=sz(grid2[0]) || grid2[i][j]==0 || check[i][j]){
            return;
        }
        check[i][j]=true;
        if(grid1[i][j]==0){
            flag=false;
        }
        dfs(grid1,grid2,i+1,j,flag);
        dfs(grid1,grid2,i-1,j,flag);
        dfs(grid1,grid2,i,j+1,flag);
        dfs(grid1,grid2,i,j-1,flag);
    }
    int countSubIslands(vector<vector<int>>& grid1, vector<vector<int>>& grid2) {
        int n=sz(grid2),m=sz(grid2[0]);
        check.resize(n,vector<bool>(m,false));
        int ans=0;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                if(grid2[i][j]==1 && check[i][j]==false){
                    bool flag=true;
                    dfs(grid1,grid2,i,j,flag);
                    if(flag){
                        ans++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

<problem>
Title: 1930. Unique Length 3 Palindromic Subsequences
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int countPalindromicSubsequence(string s)
    {
        int n = s.size(),ans=0;
        vector<int> pref(26,0), suff(26,0), se(26*26,0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            suff[s[i]-'a']++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            suff[s[i]-'a']--;
            for (char ch = 'a'; ch <= 'z'; ch++)
            {
                if (min(pref[ch-'a'], suff[ch-'a']) > 0)
                {
                    // plaindrome string = ch+s[i]+ch;
                    se[(ch-'a')*26+(s[i]-'a')]++;
                }
            }
            pref[s[i]-'a']++;
        }
        for(auto x:se){
            if(x>0){
                ans++;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding

class Solution {
public:
    long long numberOfWeeks(vector<int>& milestones) {
        long long n=sz(milestones);
        long long ans=0;
        long long maxo=0,sum=0;
        for(auto x:milestones){
            maxo=max(maxo,(long long)x);
            sum+=x;
        }
        sum-=maxo;
        if(maxo<=(sum+1)){
            ans=sum+maxo;
        }
        else{
            ans=2*sum+1;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    long long maxMatrixSum(vector<vector<int>>& matrix) {
        long long mini=INT_MAX;
        long long no_of_neg=0;
        long long sum=0;
        int n=matrix.size(),m=sz(matrix[0]);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                sum+=abs(matrix[i][j]);
                mini=min(mini,(long long)(abs(matrix[i][j])));
                if(matrix[i][j]<0){
                    no_of_neg++;
                }
            }
        }
        if(no_of_neg&1){
            sum-=2*mini;
        }
        return sum;
    }

Title: 1976.Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination

    written by Pankaj Kumar.

    Institute: National Institute of Technology, Uttarakhand
*/
typedef long long ll ;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// loops
#define forin(arr,n) for(ll i=0;i<n;i++) cin>>arr[i];
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int min_distance(vector<long long> distance,vector<bool>check){
        long long mini=LONG_MAX,node=0;
        for(ll i=0;i<distance.size();i++){
            if(check[i]==false&&mini>=distance[i]){
                mini=distance[i];
                node=i;
            }
        }
        return node;
    }
    int countPaths(int n, vector<vector<int>>& roads) {
        vector<long long> distance(n,LONG_MAX);
        vector<bool>check(n,false);
        distance[0]=0;
        vector<long long> ways(n,0);
        ways[0]=1;
        for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++){
            long long node=min_distance(distance,check);
            check[node]=true;
            for(auto x:roads){
                int connected_node=-1,cost=0;
                if(x[0]==node){
                    connected_node=x[1];
                    cost=x[2];
                }
                else if(x[1]==node){
                    connected_node=x[0];
                    cost=x[2];
                }
                if(connected_node!=-1&&check[connected_node]==false&&distance[node]!=LONG_MAX){
                    long long temp=distance[node]+cost;
                    if(distance[connected_node]==temp){
                        ways[connected_node]+=ways[node];
                        ways[connected_node]%=mod1;
                    }
                    else if(distance[connected_node]>temp){
                        ways[connected_node]=ways[node];
                        ways[connected_node]%=mod1;
                    }
                    distance[connected_node]=min((long long)distance[connected_node],temp);
                }
            }
        }
        return ways[n-1];
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/
/*
* stuff you should look before submission
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer
*/
<eos>

<problem>
Title: 198.House Robber
<code>
class Solution {
public:
    int rob(vector<int>& nums) {
        int n=nums.size();
        vector<int> dp(n+1,0);
        if(n==0)
            return 0;
        else if(n==1)
            return nums[0];
        else if(n==2)
            return max(nums[0],nums[1]);
        else
        {
            dp[0]=nums[0];
            dp[1]=max(nums[0],nums[1]);
            for(int i=2;i<n;i++)
                dp[i]=max(dp[i-1],(dp[i-2]+nums[i]));
            return dp[n-1];
        }
    }
};

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int minimizeTheDifference(vector<vector<int>>& mat, int target) {
        int n=sz(mat),m=sz(mat[0]);
        vector<vector<bool>> dp(n,vector<bool>(4901,false));
        int mini=INT_MAX;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(i==0){
                for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                    dp[i][mat[i][j]]=true;
                }
            }
            else{
                for(int k=0;k<=4900;k++){
                        if(dp[i-1][k]==true){
                            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                                dp[i][k+mat[i][j]]=true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<=4900;i++){
            if(dp[n-1][i]==true){
                mini=min(mini,abs(target-i));
            }
        }
        return mini;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

bool compare(string s,string t){
    if(sz(s)>sz(t)){
        return true;
    }
    else if(sz(s)==sz(t)){
        for(int i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
            if(s[i]==t[i]){
                continue;
            }
            else if(s[i]>t[i]){
                return true;
            }
            else{
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    else{
        return false;
    }
    return false;
}

        printv(nums);

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int findMiddleIndex(vector<int>& nums) {
        int ans=-1;
        int sum=0;
        int n=sz(nums);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            sum+=nums[i];
        }
        int left_sum=0;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            int right_sum=sum-left_sum-nums[i];
            if(left_sum==right_sum){
                return i;
            }
            left_sum+=nums[i];
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> findFarmland(vector<vector<int>>& land) {
        vector<vector<int>> ans;
        int n=sz(land),m=sz(land[0]);
        vector<vector<bool>> check(n,vector<bool>(m,false));
        for(int row=0;row<n;row++){
            for(int col=0;col<m;col++){
                if(land[row][col]==1&&check[row][col]==false){
                    int flag=0,temp1=0,temp2=0;
                    int row_count=0,col_count=INT_MAX;
                    for(int k1=0;k1+row<n;k1++){
                        temp2=0;
                        for(int k2=0;k2+col<m;k2++){
                            if(land[k1+row][k2+col]==1&&check[row+k1][col+k2]==false){
                                temp2++;
                            }
                            else{
                                flag=1;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if(temp2){
                            col_count=min(col_count,temp2);
                            row_count++;
                        }
                        else{
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    for(int i=row;i<row+row_count;i++){
                        for(int j=col;j<col+col_count;j++){
                            check[i][j]=true;
                        }
                    }
                    ans.pb({row,col,row+row_count-1,col+col_count-1});
                }   
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph

//Add main code here
/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    ListNode* addTwoNumbers(ListNode* l1, ListNode* l2) {
        ListNode* ans = new ListNode(-1);
        ListNode* temp_ans=ans;
        int temp_sum=0,flag=0;
        while(1){
            flag=0;
            if(l1!=NULL){
                temp_sum+=l1->val;
                l1=l1->next;
                flag++;
            }
            if(l2!=NULL){
                temp_sum+=l2->val;
                l2=l2->next;
                flag++;
            }
            if(flag==0){
                break;
            }
            ans->next = new ListNode(temp_sum%10);
            ans=ans->next;
            temp_sum/=10;
        }
        if(temp_sum){
            ans->next = new ListNode(temp_sum);
        }
        return temp_ans->next;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

class Solution {
public:
    bool isValid(string s) {
        stack<char> st;
        int flag=0;
        for(auto x:s)
        {
            if(x=='('||x=='{'||x=='[')
                st.push(x);
            else
            {
                if(st.size()>0)
                {
                    if((x==')'&&st.top()=='(')||(x=='}'&&st.top()=='{')||(x==']'&&st.top()=='['))
                        st.pop();
                    else
                        return false;
                }
                else
                    return false;
            }
        }
        if(st.size()==0)
            return true;
        else
            return false;
    }
};

// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    void dfs(vector<vector<char>>&grid,int i,int j,vector<vector<bool>>& check){
        if(i<0 || j<0 || i>=sz(grid) || j>=sz(grid[0]) || grid[i][j]=='0' || check[i][j]==true){
            return;
        }
        check[i][j]=true;
        dfs(grid,i+1,j,check);
        dfs(grid,i-1,j,check);
        dfs(grid,i,j+1,check);
        dfs(grid,i,j-1,check);
    }
    int numIslands(vector<vector<char>>& grid) {
        int island=0;
        int n=sz(grid);
        int m=sz(grid[0]);
        vector<vector<bool>> check(n,vector<bool>(m,false));
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                if(grid[i][j]=='1' && check[i][j]==false){
                    island++;
                    dfs(grid,i,j,check);
                }
            }
        }
        return island;
    }
};

// sort

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}
using namespace mod_operations;
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    string reversePrefix(string word, char ch) {
        string ans="";
        int j=0;
        for(int i=0;i<sz(word);i++){
            if(word[i]==ch){
                j=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        for(int i=j;i>=0;i--){
            ans+=word[i];
        }
        for(int i=j+1;i<sz(word);i++){
            ans+=word[i];
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

* stuff you should look before submission
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)

        return n*m %mod;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxProduct(string s) {
        int n = sz(s);
        int ans = 0;
        vl dp(50000,0);
        for(int i = 1; i < (1<<n); i++){
            string temp="";
            for(int j=0;j<n;j++){
                if(i&(1<<j)){
                    temp+=s[j];
                }
            }
            string temp2=temp;
            reverse(all(temp));
            if(temp2==temp){
                dp[i]=sz(temp);
            }
        }
        for(int i=1;i<(1<<n);i++){
            for(int j=1;j<(1<<n);j++){
                if(!(i&j)){
                   ans=max(ans,dp[i]*dp[j]);
                }
            }
        } 
        return ans;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 201.Bitwise And of Numbers Range
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int rangeBitwiseAnd(int left, int right)
    {
        vector<int> bits(32, 0);
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        {
            if (left & (1 << i))
            {
                bits[i]++;
            }
            if (right & (1 << i))
            {
                bits[i]++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 31; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (bits[i] & 1)
            {
                break;
            }
            else if (bits[i] == 2)
            {
                ans += (long long)((1 << i));
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 2017.Grid Game
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    long long gridGame(vector<vector<int>> &grid)
    {
        long long m = grid[0].size(), mini = LONG_MAX;
        // we will calculate prefix of 1st row and suffix of 0th row
        vector<long long> pre(m, 0), suff(m, 0);
        // calculate prefix sum
        pre[0] = grid[1][0];
        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++)
        {
            pre[i] += grid[1][i] + pre[i - 1];
        }
        // calculate suffix sum
        suff[m - 1] = grid[0][m - 1];
        for (int i = m - 2; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            suff[i] += suff[i + 1] + grid[0][i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
        {
            long long temp1 = 0, temp2 = 0;
            if (i != 0)
            {
                temp1 = pre[i - 1];
            }
            if (i != m - 1)
            {
                temp2 = suff[i + 1];
            }
            long long temp_maxo = max(temp1, temp2);
            mini = min(mini, temp_maxo);
        }
        return mini;
    }
};
<eos>

Title: 202.Happy Number
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    bool isHappy(int n)
    {
        map<int, int> m;
        while (1)
        {
            if (n == 1)
                return true;
            else if (m[n])
                return false;
            else
            {
                m[n]++;
                int temp = 0;
                while (n)
                {
                    temp += (n % 10) * (n % 10);
                    n /= 10;
                }
                n = temp;
            }
        }
    }
};

const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
// "TTTFFFTFTFFTFFT"
// 3 ans is 11
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int maxConsecutiveAnswers(string ans, int k) {
        int n=sz(ans);
        int t=0,f=0;
        for(auto x:ans){
            if(x=='T'){
                t++;
            }
            else{
                f++;
            }
        }
        if(t+k>=n||f+k>=n){
            return n;
        }
        else{
            vl vt(n,0),vf(n,0);
            f=0,t=0;
            for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                if(ans[i]=='T'){
                    vt[i]=1;
                }
                else{
                    vf[i]=1;
                }
                // vt[i]=t;
                // vf[i]=f;
            }
            int answ=0;
            int first=-1;
            int temp_ans=0;
            // making continue T block
            for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                while(first+1<n){
                    first++;
                    temp_ans+=vf[first];
                    if(temp_ans>k){
                        temp_ans-=vf[first];
                        first--;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(temp_ans<=k){
                    answ=max(answ,abs(first-i+1));
                }
                temp_ans-=vf[i];
            }
            // // making continue blog of F block
            first=-1;
            temp_ans=0;
            for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
                while(first+1<n){
                    first++;
                    temp_ans+=vt[first];
                    if(temp_ans>k){
                        temp_ans-=vt[first];
                        first--;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(temp_ans<=k){
                    answ=max(answ,abs(first-i+1));
                }
                temp_ans-=vt[i];
            }
            return answ;
        }
        return 0;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    vector<int> missingRolls(vector<int> &rolls, int mean, int n)
    {
        int m = rolls.size();
        int sum = mean * (n + m);
        for (auto x : rolls)
        {
            sum -= x;
        }
        int a = sum / n, b = sum % n;
        vector<int> ans(n, a), temp;
        if (sum > 6 * n || sum < n)
        {
            return temp;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < b; i++)
        {
            ans[i]++;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 203.Remove Linked List Elements
<code>
/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    ListNode* removeElements(ListNode* head, int val) {
        ListNode* pre=head;
        ListNode* temp=head;
        int n=0;
        while(temp!=NULL)
        {
            temp=temp->next;
            n++;
        }
        temp=head;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(temp->val==val)
            {
                if(temp==head)
                {
                    head=head->next;
                    pre=head;
                    temp=head;
                }
                else
                {
                    pre->next=temp->next;
                    temp=temp->next;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                pre=temp;
                temp=temp->next;
            }
        }
        return head;
    }
};

ll ppow(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
    if(m==0) return 1;
    ll tmp=ppow(n, m/2, mod);
    tmp=tmp*tmp%mod;
    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;
}
namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }
}

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> twoOutOfThree(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2, vector<int>& nums3) {
        vl ans;
        for(int i=0;i<101;i++){
            int flag=0;
            for(auto x:nums1){
                if(x==i){
                    flag++;
                    break;
                }
            }
            for(auto x:nums2){
                if(x==i){
                    flag++;
                    break;
                }
            }
            for(auto x:nums3){
                if(x==i){
                    flag++;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(flag>=2){
                ans.pb(i);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 204 Count Primes
<code>
class Solution {
public:
    int countPrimes(int n) {
        int count=0;
        vector<int> prime(n+1,0);
        for(int i=2;i*i<n;i++)
        {
            if(prime[i]==0)
            {
                for(int j=i*i;j<n;j+=i)
                    prime[j]=i;
            }
        }
        for(int i=2;i<n;i++)
        {
            if(prime[i]==0)
            {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
};

    bool isIsomorphic(string s, string t) {

            return false;
        }
        map<char,set<char>> mapping_s,mapping_t;
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
            mapping_s[s[i]].insert(t[i]);
            mapping_t[t[i]].insert(s[i]);

            return false;
        }

            if(sz(x.ss)>1){
                return false;
            }
        }
        for(auto x:mapping_t){
            if(sz(x.ss)>1){
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

/**

 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;

 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}

 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}

class Solution {
public:
    ListNode* reverseList(ListNode* head) {
        ListNode* temp1=nullptr,*temp2=head;
        while(head!=nullptr){
            temp2=head->next;
            head->next=temp1;
            temp1=head;
            head=temp2;
        }
        head=temp1;
        return head;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 207.Course Schedule
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
class Solution
{
public:
    bool canFinish(int numCourses, vector<vector<int>> &prerequisites)
    {
        // Create adjacency list to represent the course dependencies
        vector<vector<int>> graph(numCourses);
        vector<int> inDegree(numCourses, 0);
        // Build the graph and calculate in-degrees of each course
        for (const auto &prerequisite : prerequisites)
        {
            int course = prerequisite[0];
            int prerequisiteCourse = prerequisite[1];
            graph[prerequisiteCourse].push_back(course);
            inDegree[course]++;
        }
        // Perform a cycle detection using BFS
        queue<int> q;
        // Add all courses with in-degree 0 to the queue
        for (int i = 0; i < numCourses; i++)
        {
            if (inDegree[i] == 0)
            {
                q.push(i);
            }
        }
        int courseCount = 0;
        while (!q.empty())
        {
            int currentCourse = q.front();
            q.pop();
            courseCount++;
            // Traverse the dependent courses and reduce their in-degrees
            for (int dependentCourse : graph[currentCourse])
            {
                inDegree[dependentCourse]--;
                // If the in-degree becomes 0, add it to the queue
                if (inDegree[dependentCourse] == 0)
                {
                    q.push(dependentCourse);
                }
            }
        }
        return courseCount == numCourses;
    }
};

Title: 209.Minimum Size Subarray Sum
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int minSubArrayLen(int target, vector<int> &nums)
    {
        int n = nums.size();
        int minLength = INT_MAX;
        int left = 0;
        int sum = 0;
        for (int right = 0; right < n; right++)
        {
            sum += nums[right];
            while (sum >= target)
            {
                minLength = min(minLength, right - left + 1);
                sum -= nums[left];
                left++;
            }
        }
        return (minLength != INT_MAX) ? minLength : 0;
    }
};

Title: 2090.K Radius Subarray Averages
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    vector<int> getAverages(vector<int> &nums, int k)
    {
        int n = nums.size();
        vector<int> ans(n, -1);
        long long sum = 0;
        if (n < 2 * k)
        {
            return ans;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * k; i++)
        {
            sum += nums[i];
        }
        for (int i = 2 * k; i < n; i++)
        {
            sum += nums[i];
            int average = (sum) / (2 * k + 1);
            ans[i - k] = average;
            sum -= nums[i - 2 * k];
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph

//Add main code here
/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    ListNode* mergeTwoLists(ListNode* l1, ListNode* l2) {
        ListNode* head=new ListNode(2);
        ListNode* ans=head;
        while(1){
            if(l1==nullptr||l2==nullptr){
                break;
            }
            if(l1->val>l2->val){
                ListNode* temp=new ListNode(l2->val);
                l2=l2->next;
                head->next=temp;
                head=head->next;
            }
            else{
                ListNode* temp=new ListNode(l1->val);
                l1=l1->next;
                head->next=temp;
                head=head->next;
            }
        }
        while(l1!=nullptr){
            ListNode* temp=new ListNode(l1->val);
            l1=l1->next;
            head->next=temp;
            head=head->next;
        }
        while(l2!=nullptr){
            ListNode* temp=new ListNode(l2->val);
            l2=l2->next;
            head->next=temp;
            head=head->next;
        }
        head=ans->next;
        return head;
    }
};

class WordDictionary {
	public:
	class Node{
		public:
			Node* child[26];
			bool isEnd;
			Node(){
				isEnd=false;
				for(int i=0;i<26;i++){
					child[i]=NULL;
				}
			}
	};
	class Trie{
		public:
			Node* root;
			Trie(){
				root=new Node();
			}
			void insert(string& s){
				Node* current=root;
				for(int i=0;i<s.size();i++){
					int index=s[i]-'a';
					if(current->child[index]==NULL){
						current->child[index]=new Node();
					}
					current=current->child[index];
				}
				current->isEnd=true;
			}
			bool isFound(string& s, Node* node, int it=0){
				if(!node){
					return false;
				}
				if(it==sz(s)){
					return node->isEnd;
				}
				if(s[it]!='.'){
					return isFound(s,node->child[s[it]-'a'],it+1);
				}
				else{
					for(int i=0;i<26;i++){
						if(isFound(s,node->child[i],it+1)){
							return true;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
	};
	Trie t1;
    WordDictionary() {
    }
    void addWord(string word) {
        t1.insert(word);
    }
    bool search(string word) {
        return t1.isFound(word,t1.root);
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> executeInstructions(int n, vector<int>& startPos, string s) {
        int m=sz(s);
        vl ans(m);
        for(ll i=0;i<m;i++){
            ll temp_ans=0;
            ll row=startPos[0],col=startPos[1];
            for(ll j=i;j<m;j++){
                if(s[j]=='R'){
                    col++;
                }
                else if(s[j]=='L'){
                    col--;
                }
                else if(s[j]=='U'){
                    row--;
                }
                else{
                    row++;
                }
                if(row>=0&&row<n&&col>=0&&col<n){
                    temp_ans++;
                }
                else{
                    break;
                }
            }
            ans[i]=temp_ans;
        }
        return ans;  
    }
};

Title: 2125.Number of Laser Beams in a Bank
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int numberOfBeams(vector<string> &bank)
    {
        int ans = 0;
        int previous = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bank.size(); i++)
        {
            int count = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < bank[i].size(); j++)
            {
                if (bank[i][j] == '1')
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }
            if (count)
            {
                ans += previous * count;
                previous = count;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

// transform into graph

//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    string capitalizeTitle(string title) {
        int n=sz(title);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(i==0){
                title[i]=toupper(title[i]);
            }
            else if(title[i]==' '){
                title[i+1]=toupper(title[i+1]);
            }
            else if(title[i-1]!=' '){
                title[i]=tolower(title[i]);
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(title[i]>='A'&&title[i]<='Z'){
                int count=0;
                for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++){
                    if(title[j]==' '){
                        break;
                    }
                    else{
                        count++;
                    }
                }
                if(count<2){
                    title[i]=tolower(title[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return title;
    }
};

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding

/**
 * Definition for singly-linked list.
 * struct ListNode {
 *     int val;
 *     ListNode *next;
 *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}
 *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    int pairSum(ListNode* head) {
        vl value;
        while(head){
            value.pb(head->val);
            head=head->next;
        }
        int maxo=0;
        for(int i=0;i<value.size()/2;i++){
            int sum=value[i]+value[value.size()-1-i];
            maxo=max(maxo, sum);
        }
        return maxo;
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    int longestPalindrome(vector<string>& words) {
        map<string,int> m;
        int length_of_palindrome_string=0;
        for(auto x:words){
            string temp=x;
            reverse(all(temp));
            if(m[temp]){
                length_of_palindrome_string+=4;
                m[temp]--;
            }
            else{
                m[x]++;
            }
        }
        int flag=0;
        for(auto x:m){
            if(x.ss==1&&flag==0&&x.ff[0]==x.ff[1]){
                length_of_palindrome_string+=2;
                flag=1;
            }
        }
        return length_of_palindrome_string;
    }
};

class Solution {

        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            vector<int>check(n+1,false);
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                check[matrix[i][j]]=true;
            }
            for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
                if(check[j]==false){
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<m;i++){
            vector<int>check(n+1,false);
            for(int j=0;j<n;j++){
                check[matrix[j][i]]=true;
            }
            for(ll j=1;j<=n;j++){
                if(check[j]==false){
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int countElements(vector<int>& nums) {
        map<int,int> m;
        int mini=INT_MAX,maxo=INT_MIN;
        for(auto x:nums){
            m[x]++;
            mini=min(mini,x);
            maxo=max(maxo,x);
        }
        if(mini==maxo){
            return 0;
        }
        return sz(nums)-m[mini]-m[maxo];
    }
};

Title: 2149.Rearrange Array Elements by Sign
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1e18;
const ll mod1 = 1e9 + 7;
const ll mod2 = 998244353;
// Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    vector<int> rearrangeArray(vector<int> &nums)
    {
        int pos = 0, neg = 1;
        int n = nums.size();
        assert(n % 2 == 0);
        vector<int> ans(n, 0);
        for (auto x : nums)
        {
            if (x > 0)
            {
                ans[pos] = x;
                pos += 2;
            }
            else
            {
                ans[neg] = x;
                neg += 2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

Title: 215.Kth Largest Element in an Array
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int findKthLargest(vector<int>& nums, int k) {
        priority_queue<int> pq(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        for(int i = 0; i < k-1; ++i) pq.pop();
        return pq.top();
    }
};

const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> findLonely(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<int> ans;
        if(sz(nums)==1){
            ans.pb(nums[0]);
            return ans;
        }
        srt(nums);
        for(int i=0;i<sz(nums);i++){
            if(i==0||i==sz(nums)-1){
                if(i==0){
                    if(nums[i]!=nums[i+1]&&nums[i]!=nums[i+1]-1){
                        ans.pb(nums[i]);
                    }
                }
                else{
                    if(nums[i]!=nums[i-1]&&nums[i]!=nums[i-1]+1){
                        ans.pb(nums[i]);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            if(nums[i]!=nums[i-1]&&nums[i]!=nums[i+1]&&nums[i]!=nums[i-1]+1&&nums[i]!=nums[i+1]-1){
                ans.pb(nums[i]);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

    return m%2 ? tmp*n%mod: tmp;

namespace mod_operations{
    ll modInv(ll n, ll mod){
        return ppow(n,mod-2, mod);
    }
    ll modAdd(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return (n+m)%mod;
    }
    ll modMul(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return n*m %mod;
    }
    ll modSub(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        n=(n%mod+mod)%mod; m=(m%mod+mod)%mod;
        return modAdd(n,-m, mod);
    }
    ll modDiv(ll n, ll m, ll mod){
        return modMul(n, modInv(m, mod), mod);
    }

/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> maxScoreIndices(vector<int>& nums) {
        int n=nums.size();
        vector<int>prefix(n+1,0),suffix(n+1,0);
        vector<int> ans;
        int maxo=0;
        int one=0;
        int zero=0;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(nums[i]==0){
                zero++;
            }
            prefix[i+1]=zero;
        }
        for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
            if(nums[i]==1){
                one++;
            }
            suffix[i]=one;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){
            maxo=max(maxo, prefix[i]+suffix[i]);
        }
        for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){
            if((prefix[i]+suffix[i])==maxo){
                ans.pb(i);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<long long> maximumEvenSplit(long long finalSum) {
        vector<ll> ans;
        ll temp1=0;
        if(finalSum&1){
            return ans;
        }
        for(ll i=1;i<=INT_MAX;i++){
            ll substract=2*i;
            if(substract>finalSum){
                if(finalSum>0){
                    ans.pb(finalSum);
                }
                temp1=finalSum;
                break;
            }
            else{
                ans.pb(substract);
                finalSum-=substract;
            }
        }
        ll n=ans.size();
        if(n>=2){
            ll pos=temp1/2;
            if(pos<=n-1&&pos>0){
                ll temp=ans[n-1];
                ans.pop_back();
                temp+=ans[n-2];
                ans.pop_back();
                ans.pb(temp);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

Title: 22.Generate Parentheses
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    vector<string> ans;
    void solve(int open_bracket, int close_bracket, string str)
    {
        if (open_bracket == 0 && close_bracket == 0)
        {
            ans.push_back(str);
            return;
        }
        if (open_bracket - 1 >= 0 && close_bracket >= open_bracket)
        {
            solve(open_bracket - 1, close_bracket, str + '(');
        }
        if (close_bracket - 1 >= 0 && close_bracket >= open_bracket)
        {
            solve(open_bracket, close_bracket - 1, str + ')');
        }
        return;
    }
    vector<string> generateParenthesis(int n)
    {
        int open_bracket = n, close_bracket = n;
        string str = "";
        solve(open_bracket, close_bracket, str);
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

* stuff you should look before submission

* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.

class Solution {
public:
    long long maximumSubsequenceCount(string text, string pattern) {
        ll n=sz(text),m=sz(pattern);
        vector<ll> first(n+1,0),second(n+1,0);
        ll ans=0;
        ll start=0,end=0;
        ll maxo1=0,maxo2=0;
        for(ll i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
            if(text[i]==pattern[1]){
                end++;
                second[i]=end;
                maxo1=max(maxo1,second[i]);
            }
            else{
                second[i]=second[i+1];
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            if(text[i]==pattern[0]){
                start++;
                first[i+1]=start;
                ans+=second[i+1];
                maxo2=max(maxo2,first[i+1]);
            }
            else{
                first[i+1]=first[i];
            }
        }
        // printv(first);
        // printv(second);
        // cout<<"ans is "<<ans<<endl;
        ans+=max(maxo1,maxo2);
        return ans;
    }
};

#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int halveArray(vector<int>& nums) {
        priority_queue<double>pq;
        int no_of_operation = 0;
        double sum=0.0;
        for(auto x:nums){
            sum+=(double)x;
            pq.push(x);
        }
        sum/=2;
        while(sum>0.0){
            double x=pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            x/=2;
            sum-=x;
            if(x>0.0){
                pq.push(x);
            }
            no_of_operation++;
        }
        return no_of_operation;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/
/*
* stuff you should look before submission

* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)

<problem>
Title: 221 Maximal Square
<code>
class Solution {
public:
    int maximalSquare(vector<vector<char>>& matrix) {
        int m=matrix[0].size();
        int n=matrix.size();
        vector<vector<int>> dp(n+1,vector<int>(m+1,0));
        int ans=0;
        for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)
        {
            for(int j=1;j<=m;j++)
            {
                if(matrix[i-1][j-1]=='1')
                {
                    dp[i][j]=1+min({dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1],dp[i-1][j-1]});
                    ans=max(ans,dp[i][j]);
                }
                else
                    dp[i][j]=0;
            }
        }
        return ans*ans;
    }
};

class Solution {

    int countHillValley(vector<int>& nums) {
        int ans=0;
        vector<int> temp;
        int n=sz(nums);
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            temp.pb(nums[i]);

            while(i<n&&nums[i]==num){
                i++;

                ans++;
            }
            else if(temp[i]<temp[i-1] && temp[i]<temp[i+1]){

            }
        }

    int countCollisions(string directions) {
        int ans=0;
        int r=0,s=0,l=0;
        for(auto x:directions){
            if(x=='R'){
                r++;
            }
            else if(x=='L'){
                l++;
                if(r){
                    ans+=2;
                    ans+=(r-1);
                    r=0;
                    l=0;
                    s++;
                }
                else if(s){
                    ans++;
                    r=0;
                    s++;
                }
            }
            else if(x=='S'){
                s++;
                if(r){
                    ans+=r;
                    r=0;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> maximumBobPoints(int numArrows, vector<int>& aliceArrows) {
        vector<int> ans(12,0);
        int maxo=0;
        for(int i=0;i<(1<<12);i++){
            int sum =0;
            vector<int> temp(12,0);
            int count=numArrows;
            for(int j=0;j<12;j++){
                if(i&(1<<j)){
                    if(aliceArrows[j]+1<=count){
                        count-=aliceArrows[j]+1;
                        temp[j]=aliceArrows[j]+1;
                    }
                }
            }
            if(count){
                int pos=0,mini=INT_MAX;
                for(int i=0;i<12;i++){
                    if(temp[i]<mini){
                        mini=temp[i];
                        pos=i;
                    }
                }
                temp[pos]=count;
                count=0;
            }
            sum=0;
            for(int i=0;i<12;i++){
                if(temp[i]>aliceArrows[i]){
                    sum+=(i);
                }
            }
            if(sum>maxo){
                maxo=sum;
                ans=temp;
                // cout<<"maxo is "<<maxo<<endl;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

        vector<vector<int>> ans(2);

            m1[x]++;
        }

                temp2.insert(x);
            }
        }

            ans[0].push_back(x);

        for(auto x:temp2){
            ans[1].push_back(x);
        }

class Solution {
public:
    vector<long long> kthPalindrome(vector<int>& queries, int intLength) {
        vector<ll> ans(sz(queries));
        ll n=((intLength+1)/2)-1;
        ll number = pow(10,n);
        for(ll i=0;i<sz(queries);i++){
            ll temp=number+queries[i]-1;
            string s=to_string(temp);
            string s1="";
            if(intLength&1){
                for(ll j=0;j<sz(s)-1;j++){
                    s1+=s[j];
                }
            }
            else{
                s1=s;
            }
            reverse(all(s1));
            s+=s1;
            // cout<<"s is "<<s<<endl;
            ans[i]=str_to_num(s);
            if(sz(s)>intLength){
                ans[i]=-1;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

<problem>
Title: 2218.Maximum Value of K Coins From Piles
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class Solution
{
public:
    int maxValueOfCoins(vector<vector<int>> &piles, int k)
    {
        int n=piles.size();
        vector<vector<int>> dp(n+1, vector<int>(k+1,0));
        for(int noOfPiles=1;noOfPiles<=n;noOfPiles++){
            // noOfPiles -> currently aab tak itne pile select kiye coin lene ke liye
            for(int noOfCoin=1;noOfCoin<=k;noOfCoin++){
                // noOfCoin -> aab tak total itne coin select kiye
                dp[noOfPiles][noOfCoin]+=dp[noOfPiles-1][noOfCoin];
                int sum=0;
                for(int takeCoin=1;takeCoin<=min(noOfCoin,(int)piles[noOfPiles-1].size());takeCoin++){
                    // takeCoin -> currect pile se itne coin select kiye
                    sum += piles[noOfPiles - 1][takeCoin-1];
                    dp[noOfPiles][noOfCoin] = max(dp[noOfPiles][noOfCoin], dp[noOfPiles - 1][noOfCoin - takeCoin] + sum);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][k];
    }
};

#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int minBitFlips(int start, int goal) {
        vector<int> v1(32,0),v2(32,0);
        int count=0,maxo=0;
        while(goal){
            if(goal&1){
                v1[maxo]++;
            }
            maxo++;
            goal>>=1;
        }
        int pos=0;
        while(start){
            if(start&1){
                v2[pos]++;
            }
            pos++;
            start>>=1;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<max(pos,maxo);i++){
            if(v1[i]!=v2[i]){
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int triangularSum(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<int> v;
        v=nums;
        int n=sz(nums);
        while(n>1){
            vector<int> temp;
            n--;
            for(int j=1;j<sz(v);j++){
                temp.pb((v[j-1]+v[j])%10);
            }
            v=temp;
        }
        return v[0]%10;
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    int convertTime(string current, string correct) {
        int ans=0;
        int minutes1=(current[3]-'0')*10+(current[4]-'0');
        int minutes2=(correct[3]-'0')*10+(correct[4]-'0');
        // cout<<"minutes1= "<<minutes1<<" minutes2= "<<minutes2<<endl;
        int diff=0;
        int flag=0;
        if(minutes2>=minutes1){
            diff=minutes2-minutes1;
        }
        else{
            diff=minutes2+60-minutes1;
            flag++;
        }
        while(diff>=60){
            diff-=60;
            ans++;
        }
        while(diff>=15){
            diff-=15;
            ans++;
        }
        while(diff>=5){
            diff-=5;
            ans++;
        }
        ans+=diff;
        // cout<<"ans= "<<ans<<endl;
        int hour1=(current[0]-'0')*10+(current[1]-'0');
        int hour2=(correct[0]-'0')*10+(correct[1]-'0');
        if(flag){
            hour1++;
        }
        // cout<<"hour1 "<<hour1<<" hour2 "<<hour2<<endl;
        if(hour2>=hour1){
            ans+=hour2-hour1;
        }
        else{
            ans+=hour2+24-hour1;
        }
        // if(flag){
        //     ans--;
        // }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> findWinners(vector<vector<int>>& matches) {
        vector<vector<int>> ans;
        vector<int>f,s;
        map<int,int> present,loss;
        for(auto x:matches){
            present[x[0]]++;
            present[x[1]]++;
            loss[x[1]]++;
        }
        for(auto x:present){
            if(loss[x.ff]==0){
                f.pb(x.ff);
            }
            if(loss[x.ff]==1){
                s.pb(x.ff);
            }
        }
        ans.pb(f);
        ans.pb(s);
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int maximumCandies(vector<int>& candies, long long k) {
        ll maxo=0;
        ll first=1,second=(ll)1e12;
        while(second>=first){
            ll mid=first+((second-first)/2);
            ll temp=0;
            for(auto x:candies){
                temp+=(x/mid);
            }
            if(temp>=k){
                maxo=mid;
                first=mid+1;
            }
            else{
                second=mid-1;
            }
        }
        return maxo;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

#define ss second

#define srt(V) sort(all(V))

ll str_to_num(string s){
            stringstream pk(s);
            ll num;
            pk>>num;
            return num;
        }
class Solution {
public:
    int largestInteger(int num) {
        vector<int> odd,even;
        int temp=num;
        while(temp){
            int d=temp%10;
            if(d&1){
                odd.pb(d);
            }
            else{
                even.pb(d);
            }
            temp/=10;
        }
        srtGreat(odd);
        srtGreat(even);
        string s=to_string(num);
        int pos1=0,pos2=0;
        for(int i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
            int d=s[i]-'0';
            if(d&1){
                s[i]=odd[pos1]+'0';
                pos1++;
            }
            else{
                s[i]=even[pos2]+'0';
                pos2++;
            }
        }
        return str_to_num(s);
    }
};

// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph

// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    string minimizeResult(string expression) {
        string s1="",s2="";
        int i=0;
        string final_ans="";
        int mini=INT_MAX;
        for(;i<sz(expression);i++){
            // cout<<expression[i]<<" "<<i<<endl;
            if(expression[i]=='+'){
                break;
            }
            else{
                s1+=expression[i];
            }
        }
        i++;
        for(;i<sz(expression);i++){
            s2+=expression[i];
        }
        reverse(all(s2));
        // cout<<"s1 and s2 is "<<s1<<" "<<s2<<endl;
        vector<int> v1,v2,v3,v4;
        int num=0;
        for(i=0;i<sz(s1);i++){
            string temp=s1.substr(i,sz(s1)-i);
            num=stoi(temp);
            v1.pb(num);
            temp=s1.substr(0,i);
            if(temp.size()>0){
                num=stoi(temp);
                v3.pb(num);
            }
        }
        num=0;
        for(i=0;i<sz(s2);i++){
            string temp=s2.substr(i,sz(s2)-i);
            reverse(all(temp));
            num=stoi(temp);
            v2.pb(num);
            temp=s2.substr(0,i);
            reverse(all(temp));
            if(temp.size()>0){
                num=stoi(temp);
                v4.pb(num);
            }
        }
        reverse(all(v1));
        reverse(all(v2));
        reverse(all(v3));
        reverse(all(v4));
        // cout<<"v1 is "<<endl;
        // printv(v1);
        // cout<<"v2 is "<<endl;
        // printv(v2);
        // cout<<"v3 is "<<endl;
        // printv(v3);
        // cout<<"v4 is "<<endl;
        // printv(v4);
        for(int k=0;k<sz(v1);k++){
            for(int j=0;j<sz(v2);j++){
                int temp=(v1[k]+v2[j]);
                string temp_ans="";
                if(k!=sz(v1)-1){
                    temp*=v3[k];
                    temp_ans+=to_string(v3[k]);
                }
                temp_ans+="(";
                temp_ans+=to_string(v1[k]);
                temp_ans+="+";
                temp_ans+=to_string(v2[j]);
                temp_ans+=")";
                if(j!=sz(v2)-1){
                    temp*=v4[j];
                    temp_ans+=to_string(v4[j]);
                }
                if(temp<mini){
                    mini=temp;
                    final_ans = temp_ans;
                    // cout<<"final_ans is "<<final_ans<<endl;
                }
                // cout<<"temp is "<<temp<<endl;
            }
        }
        return final_ans;
    }
};

/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int maximumProduct(vector<int>& nums, int k) {
        priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>>pq;
        long long pro=1;
        for(auto x:nums){
            pq.push(x);
        }
        while(k){
            int x=pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            x++;
            k--;
            pq.push(x);
        }
        while(!pq.empty()){
            pro*=pq.top();
            pro%=mod1;
            pq.pop();
        }
        return (int)pro;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

class Solution {
public:
    int findClosestNumber(vector<int>& nums) {
        int mini=INT_MAX,ans=INT_MIN;
        for(auto x:nums){
            int diff=abs(x);
            if(mini>diff){
                mini=diff;
            }
        }
        for(auto x:nums){
            int diff=abs(x);
            if(mini==diff){
                ans=max(ans,x);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

class ATM {
public:
    map<long,long> m;
    ATM() {
        m[20]=0;
        m[50]=0;
        m[100]=0;
        m[200]=0;
        m[500]=0;
    }
    void deposit(vector<int> banknotesCount) {
        m[20]+=banknotesCount[0];
        m[50]+=banknotesCount[1];
        m[100]+=banknotesCount[2];
        m[200]+=banknotesCount[3];
        m[500]+=banknotesCount[4];
    }
    vector<int> withdraw(int amount) {
        vector<int>v(5,0);
        ll ans=0;
        ans=amount/500;
        ans=min((ll)ans,(ll)m[500]);
        v[4]=ans;
        amount-=ans*500;
        ans=amount/200;
        ans=min((ll)ans,(ll)m[200]);
        v[3]=ans;
        amount-=ans*200;
        ans=amount/100;
        ans=min((ll)ans,(ll)m[100]);
        v[2]=ans;
        amount-=ans*100;
        ans=amount/50;
        ans=min((ll)ans,(ll)m[50]);
        v[1]=ans;
        amount-=ans*50;
        ans=amount/20;
        ans=min((ll)ans,(ll)m[20]);
        v[0]=ans;
        amount-=ans*20;
        if(amount!=0){
            return {-1};
        }
        m[20]-=v[0];
        m[50]-=v[1];
        m[100]-=v[2];
        m[200]-=v[3];
        m[500]-=v[4];
        return v;
    }
};

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer

class Solution {
public:
    string digitSum(string s, int k) {
        while(s.size()>k){
            string ans="";
            for(int i=0;i<sz(s);i++){
                int sum=0;
                int temp_i;
                for(int j=i;j<min((int)sz(s),i+k);j++){
                    sum+=s[j]-'0';
                    temp_i=j;
                }
                i=temp_i;
                ans+=to_string(sum);
            }
            s=ans;
        }
        return s;
    }
};

#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);

A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122

/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int minimumRounds(vector<int>& tasks) {
        map<int,int> m;
        int ans=0;
        for(auto x:tasks){
            m[x]++;
        }
        int flag=0;
        for(auto x:m){
            int t=x.ss;
            ans+=(t/3);
            if(t%3==2){
                ans++;
            }
            else if(t%3==1 && t<=1){
                flag++;
            }
            else if(t%3==1 && t>=2){
                ans++;
            }
        }
        if(flag){
            return -1;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

Title: 2245.Maximum Trailing Zeros in a Cornered Path
<code>

    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA

typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int maxTrailingZeros(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {
        vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> dp(sz(grid),vector<pair<int,int>>(sz(grid[0]),{0,0}));
        int n=sz(grid),m=sz(grid[0]);
        vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> up(n,vector<pair<int,int>>(m,{0,0}));
        vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> down(n,vector<pair<int,int>>(m,{0,0}));
        vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> left(n,vector<pair<int,int>>(m,{0,0}));
        vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> right(n,vector<pair<int,int>>(m,{0,0}));
        int maxo=0;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                int temp=grid[i][j];
                int count_5=0,count_2=0;
                while(temp%5==0){
                    temp/=5;
                    count_5++;
                }
                while(temp%2==0){
                    temp/=2;
                    count_2++;
                }
                dp[i][j].ff=count_5;
                dp[i][j].ss=count_2;
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                if(j==0){
                    right[i][j].ff=dp[i][j].ff;
                    right[i][j].ss=dp[i][j].ss;
                }
                else{
                    right[i][j].ff=right[i][j-1].ff+dp[i][j].ff;
                    right[i][j].ss=right[i][j-1].ss+dp[i][j].ss;
                }
            }
        }
        for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
            for(int j=m-1;j>=0;j--){
                if(j==m-1){
                    left[i][j].ff=dp[i][j].ff;
                    left[i][j].ss=dp[i][j].ss;
                }
                else{
                    left[i][j].ff=left[i][j+1].ff+dp[i][j].ff;
                    left[i][j].ss=left[i][j+1].ss+dp[i][j].ss;
                }
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                if(i==0){
                    down[i][j].ff=dp[i][j].ff;
                    down[i][j].ss=dp[i][j].ss;
                }
                else{
                    down[i][j].ss=down[i-1][j].ss+dp[i][j].ss;
                    down[i][j].ff=down[i-1][j].ff+dp[i][j].ff;
                }
            }
        }
        for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                if(i==n-1){
                    up[i][j].ff=dp[i][j].ff;
                    up[i][j].ss=dp[i][j].ss;
                }
                else{
                    up[i][j].ff=up[i+1][j].ff+dp[i][j].ff;
                    up[i][j].ss=up[i+1][j].ss+dp[i][j].ss;
                }
            }
        }
        // cout<<"right "<<endl;
        // for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        //     for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
        //         cout<<right[i][j].ff<<","<<right[i][j].ss<<"  ";
        //     }
        //     cout<<endl;
        // }
        // cout<<"left "<<endl;
        // for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        //     for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
        //         cout<<left[i][j].ff<<","<<left[i][j].ss<<"  ";
        //     }
        //     cout<<endl;
        // }
        // cout<<"up "<<endl;
        // for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        //     for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
        //         cout<<up[i][j].ff<<","<<up[i][j].ss<<"  ";
        //     }
        //     cout<<endl;
        // }
        // cout<<"down "<<endl;
        // for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
        //     for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
        //         cout<<down[i][j].ff<<","<<down[i][j].ss<<"  ";
        //     }
        //     cout<<endl;
        // }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            for(int j=0;j<m;j++){
                int temp_2=0,temp_5=0;
                // for
                // |
                // |
                // |
                // ____
                temp_2=up[i][j].ss+right[i][j].ss-dp[i][j].ss;
                temp_5=up[i][j].ff+right[i][j].ff-dp[i][j].ff;
                maxo=max(maxo,min(temp_2,temp_5));
                // for
                //  |
                //  |
                //  |
                //---
                temp_2=down[i][j].ss+left[i][j].ss-dp[i][j].ss;
                temp_5=down[i][j].ff+left[i][j].ff-dp[i][j].ff;
                maxo=max(maxo,min(temp_2,temp_5));
                // for
                // ------
                //      |
                //      |
                //      |
                temp_2=left[i][j].ss+up[i][j].ss-dp[i][j].ss;
                temp_5=left[i][j].ff+up[i][j].ff-dp[i][j].ff;
                maxo=max(maxo,min(temp_2,temp_5));
                // for
                // -----
                // |
                // |
                // |
                temp_2=right[i][j].ss+down[i][j].ss-dp[i][j].ss;
                temp_5=right[i][j].ff+down[i][j].ff-dp[i][j].ff;
                maxo=max(maxo,min(temp_2,temp_5));
            }
        }
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++){
            maxo=max(maxo,min(up[i][0].ss,up[i][0].ff));
        }
        // ----------------
        for(int i=0;i<m;i++){
            maxo=max(maxo,min(right[0][i].ss,right[0][i].ff));
        }
        return maxo;
    }
};

Title: 2249.Count Lattice Points Inside a Circle
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    int countLatticePoints(vector<vector<int>>& circles) {
        set<pair<int,int>> s;
        for(auto v:circles){
            int x_cordinates_start=v[0]-v[2];
            int x_cordinates_end=v[0]+v[2];
            int y_cordinates_start=v[1]-v[2];
            int y_cordinates_end=v[1]+v[2];
            // equation of cirlce with (h,k) as center and r as radius
            // (x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2
            for(int x=x_cordinates_start;x<=x_cordinates_end;x++){
                for(int y=y_cordinates_start;y<=y_cordinates_end;y++){
                    int value=((x-v[0])*(x-v[0]))+((y-v[1])*(y-v[1]))-v[2]*v[2];
                    if(value<=0){
                        s.insert({x,y});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return s.size();
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/
/*
* stuff you should look before submission
* constraint and time limit
* int overflow
* special test case (n=0||n=1||n=2)
* don't get stuck on one approach if you get wrong answer
*/

typedef long long ll ;
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
//Add main code here
class MyStack
{
public:
    /** Initialize your data structure here. */
    queue<int> q;
    MyStack()
    {
        q.clear();
    }
    /** Push element x onto stack. */
    void push(int x)
    {
        q.push(x);
    }
    /** Removes the element on top of the stack and returns that element. */
    int pop()
    {
        queue<int> temp;
        while (q.size() > 1)
        {
            temp.push(q.front());
            q.pop();
        }
        int t = q.front();
        q.pop();
        q = temp;
        return t;
    }
    /** Get the top element. */
    int top()
    {
        return q.back();
    }
    /** Returns whether the stack is empty. */
    bool empty()
    {
        return q.size() == 0;
    }
};
/**
 * Your MyStack object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * MyStack* obj = new MyStack();
 * obj->push(x);
 * int param_2 = obj->pop();
 * int param_3 = obj->top();
 * bool param_4 = obj->empty();
 */

class Solution {

    int minimumCardPickup(vector<int>& cards) {
        map<int,int> m;
        int mini=INT_MAX;
        for(int i=0;i<sz(cards);i++){
            if(m[cards[i]]){
                mini=min(mini,abs(m[cards[i]]-i-1)+1);
            }
            m[cards[i]]=i+1;
        }
        if(mini==INT_MAX){
            mini=-1;
        }
        return mini;
    }

const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;

// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
public:
    long long appealSum(string s) {
        ll n=sz(s);
        ll ans=0;
        map<char,vector<ll>> mp;
        for(ll i=0;i<n;i++){
            ans+=(i+1)*(n-i);
            mp[s[i]].pb(i);
        }
        for(char ch='a';ch<='z';ch++){
            vector<ll> temp=mp[ch];
            if(sz(temp)>1){
                for(ll i=0;i+1<sz(temp);i++){
                    ll temp_len=(n-temp[i+1])*(temp[i]+1);
                    ans-=temp_len;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

Title: 2265.Count Nodes Equal to Average of Subtree
<code>
/*
    written by Pankaj Kumar.
    country:-INDIA
*/
typedef long long ll ;
typedef vector<int> vl;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvl;
#define speed cin.tie(0);cout.tie(0);ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
/*  Abbrevations  */
#define ff first
#define ss second
#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
// Some print
#define no cout<<"NO"<<endl;
#define yes cout<<"YES"<<endl;
// sort
#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
#define sz(V) ll(V.size())
/* ascii value
A=65,Z=90,a=97,z=122
*/
/* Some syntax 
//Syntax to create a min heap for priority queue
//priority_queue <int, vector<int>, greater<int>>pq;
*/
/*  --------------------MAIN PROGRAM----------------------------*/
// to run ctrl+b
const ll INF=1e18;
const ll mod1=1e9+7;
const ll mod2=998244353;
// Techniques :
// divide into cases, brute force, pattern finding
// sort, greedy, binary search, two pointer
// transform into graph
// Experience :
// Cp is nothing but only observation and mathematics.
//Add main code here
class Solution {
    int ans=0;
    pair<int,int> dfs(TreeNode*cur){
        if(!cur){
            return {0,0};
        }
        auto [lsize,lsum]=dfs(cur->left);
        auto [rsize,rsum]=dfs(cur->right);
        if((lsum+rsum+cur->val)/(lsize+rsize+1)==cur->val){
            ans++;
        }
        return {lsize+rsize+1,lsum+rsum+cur->val};
    }
public:
    int averageOfSubtree(TreeNode* root) {
        dfs(root);
        return ans;
    }
};
/* -----------------END OF PROGRAM --------------------*/

#define all(V) (V).begin(),(V).end()
#define srt(V) sort(all(V))
#define srtGreat(V) sort(all(V),greater<ll>())
// some extra
#define printv(v) for(ll i=0;i<ll(v.size());i++){cout<<v[i]<<" ";} cout<<endl;
#define precision(x) cout<<fixed<<setprecision(x);
